review_body: My husband, who is gluten intolerant and usually gets quite sick when eating wheat, can eat this.  I made cinnamon rolls for the first time in years and they were so good.  I've served him bread and other items made with this wheat flour and he shows no signs of it bothering his system.  If you have a gluten allergy, give this a try.

product_title: Yamamotoyama - Genmai Cha (Brown Rice Tea) 90 Bag Value Pack
review_body: This is the fourth time I have ordered for my wife and she loves the tea. We will order again.

product_title: Melitta Cone Coffee Filters
review_body: Malita is the standard in Coffee filters. You can not get better and they have excellent quality control. A good package.

product_title: Hodgson Mill Active Dry Yeast, 0.31 Ounce (Pack of 48)
review_body: Not much to say.. but this works. I have a tough time getting bread to rise because I use heavy flours, and add almond flour, soy flour, flax seed, chia seed.. super healthy but hard to rise. This did the best of any yeast, and I learned to keep this, and my flour in the refridgerator too.

product_title: Better than Bouillon Clam Base 8 oz
review_headline: A great addition to my kitchen basics
review_body: This bouillon adds a lot of body to my  homemade clam sauce, and it's very hard to find in stores.  Getting it from Amazon makes it a real pleasure.

product_title: RiseBar Breakfast Crunchy, 12-Count Bars
review_headline: not what I expected - but like it anyway
review_body: The description says "crunchy" but I guess that is meant to describe the macadamia nuts, as that is the crunchy part. It's not overall a crunchy bar, it's rather soft. I love anything with macadamia nuts and pineapple so I'm happy with the purchase.

product_title: Tanka Bar,natural Buffalo Cranberry Bar, 28 g (Pack of 12)
review_body: I really like the taste of these. Not spicy, not sweet, very moist. Doesn't have an aftertaste. Would absolutely buy again.

product_title: Anacon Wheat Nuts - 7 oz Jar
review_headline: Luv the "Nuts" but seriously- $12.99 for 7 oz?
review_body: I really love the Wheat Nuts and have been paying $1.99 to $3.99 in the grocery. Can't believe you are charging this.  I'll pass - thank you.  I'm giving the Wheat Nuts 4 stars but only for taste and nutrition - not pricing.

product_title: JUICY PEAR Jelly Belly Beans ~ 1/2 to 10 Pounds
review_body: I was mildly concerned about getting these online because old jelly beans are hard as rocks and just not enjoyable. These are fresh with great flavor. Great seller, great deal. Actually more fresh than the ones at my local mall candy store.

product_title: Trident Sugarless Gum with Xylitol, Wild Blueberry Twist Flavor, 12/18 Stick Packs -(216 Sticks Per Box!)
review_body: This gum is the best.  It has a delicious sweet, fruity flavor.  Xylitol replaces sugar as the sweetner.  Hard to find in grocery stores. A favorite!

product_title: Yanabah Navajo Caffeine Free Herbal Tea, 20 Tea Bags
review_body: I love these teas - I have tried two of them so far and I like them both.  Never tried them cold, but it makes a nice hot cup of tea.

product_title: The Coffee Fool French Press Coffee, Fool's Coconut Dreams, 12 Ounce
review_body: The only thing I would change is I could is to make the flavors stronger, without adding any unhealthy ingredients.

product_title: Nutiva Organic Shelled Hempseed
review_headline: I Put It In My Oatmeal Every Morning
review_body: Organic hemp seed is an excellent source of omegas and protein.  10g of protein at breakfast without any dairy or eggs is a healthy way to go.  Tastes great.  High quality product.

product_title: Silver Chocolate Rocks Candy Nuggets 1LB Bag
review_body: everyone who saw the construction cake asked where I purchased this candy because it was so realistic,perfect gray/black tone, tasted good too

product_title: Licorice Twists, 4 Pound
review_headline: Very Poor Quality and Tastes like Play Doh
review_body: This is nothing like Grape licorice I used to buy years ago.  I expected a very flavorful grape taste and it wound up tasting like Play Doh in your mouth.  I took these to work and 50% of my co-workers spit it out in the trash.  Save your money and buy a different brand.

product_title: Spicy World Cloves, Whole, 1 Pound
review_body: These are the best. The day after we got these I went to work and came home to a great smelling house. They work great for simmering on the stove. Great Price for how many you receive.

product_title: Jack Link's Premium Cuts Beef Steak, Original, 2-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: Disappointing. Ive gotten these before but this time they were just awful. Definitely not worth the outrageous account charged for them considering the last batch I got. Didn't even bother contacting Amazon because I don't they'd care.

product_title: Sweet Chili Sauce - 25 oz (Pack of 3)
review_body:
Great for making Bang Bang Shrimp or using in a fresh salad. Thought originally that a 3 pack was too much, but I'm happy to say
that I'm almost out, need to restock for the summer! Like experimenting with this product using different food combos

product_title: Collection of the Four Best Clean Air Plants for Your Home in Four Inch Pots
review_body: These plants came in the mail all as described , except my pothos plant. Which was still pretty good in my opinion , as soon as i got my plants i went to home depot to buy new pots and soil . As soon as i got home i replanted them with organic soil and get them spread out all around my house . Within weeks i realized my pothos started dying! Ive been doing my best to help it survive and so far every leaf has died and its down to 1 root with only 1 leaf left on it , im doing my best to keep it alive and its staying strong as til now . If it does end up dying or i see no hope left in my plant i will contact there company , since reading many reviews before purchasing that they have incredible customer service, but all in all these plants were great and arrived to my house on time , and i would gladly order from this company again !

product_title: Bigelow Green Tea with Pomegranate, 20-Count Boxes
review_headline: This green tea turned me into a regular green tea drinker
review_body:
I had tried many types, flavors, and brands of green tea, because of the health benefits, but I had never like the taste of any of them and always gave away most of the boxfuls once I had tried them.

I was pleasantly surprised when I tasted my first cup of Bigelow's pomegranate green tea. It was delicious!

When I had used most of that box of teabags, I ordered several more boxes, and even ordered a box of Bigelow Lemon Green Tea.

Now I drink a cup of each, Lemon and Pomegranate, each morning with my breakast. And later in the day I have Bigelow Raspberry Royale, either hot or iced. Delicious!

product_title: Spicy World Cinnamon Sticks Round 2.75-Inch, 5-Pound
review_body: As expected. Works for what I wanted them for and saved a ton of cash.. no complaints from us. Thanks

product_title: Viva Naturals Organic Extra Virgin Coconut Oil, 16 Ounce
review_body: I have only used this as a body lotion so far. Product quality seems good, I was looking for more as a lotion but this is just my preference. It doesn't smell as great as other reviews suggested. So much hype now about coconut oil I should probably try it as a hair mask or in cooking!

product_title: Buffalo Bob's Alligator Cajun Style Jerky 3 Pack
review_body: Got as a gift for my son. He LOVED it. It was a great price as well. I was in Florida and had a hard time finding it. I will order from them again as prices were good and they ship quickly!

product_title: Kevala Organic Sesame Oil, 128 Fluid Ounce
review_body: This organic sesame oil is much better than I expected. It is great oil for cooking and making aromatherapy products.

product_title: 100% RAW UMF 16+ ACTIVE MANUKA HONEY 1.1lb by Haddrell's of Cambridge
review_body: Originally bought some Manuka honey when in New Zealand and loved the taste as well as the fact everyone says how healthy it is!  Was about to have my family mail me some from there when I thought to check Amazon and was surprised to find it available here.  But then these days I am almost more surprised if something is NOT available on Amazon :-)  The jar arrived intact and the honey tastes just as good as the one I bought in New Zealand.  I use it mostly for sore throats for its healing properties so one jar lasts me a long time.

product_title: Heinz Curry Gewurz Ketchup Chili 700 MI
review_body: In Germany, they eat a curry catsup on bratwurst.  Tried to buy it back her in the U.S.  my daughter eats this like regular catsup.  I'm not a curry fan, myself, but she loves it

product_title: A.C. Legg Bratwurst Seasoning
review_headline: don't know what they put in this, but it's great for rouning meat
review_body: I tried two of their seasoning, yuck, yuck. won't waist my time and meat using any of their seasoning packages.

product_title: Twix
review_body: Twix bars, with peanut butter added instead of caramel.  You can't beat it.  A great between meal snack.  I consider it as more of a cookie than candy.  Thumbs up!

product_title: Coconut, Natural Flavor Blend - 4 Ounce Bottle
review_body: Too many liquid coconut flavors are so light tasting you have to use too much of it to work.  THIS product is just right...I love to create a yogurt parfait with coconut flavoring and shredded coconut...ADD chopped almonds AND YOU HAVE A GREAT EXPENSIVE TASTING snack or dessert.

product_title: Gorge Delights JustFruit Bars, Pear Blueberry, 16-Count 1.4-Ounce Bars
review_body:
I have first tried this product at a bike event and the owner is a wonderful man.
I buy them local but having the boxes at home available is key.
I have shared them with co-workers who are also sensitive to allergies as a snack and they are ideal.
OR made and supports cyclist which is always an incentive!

product_title: Cherry Blossom Tea, 20 Sachets in Tin by Harney & Sons
review_body: A pretty average green tea, it is quite drinkable, but the cherry blossom flavor is very subdued, easily overpowered by the base green tea.

product_title: Kellogg's Special K Coffee House Breakfast Shake, Chocolate Mocha, 10 Ounce Bottles (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Awesome new treat from Special K
review_body:
I gave the new Special K Coffee House Breakfast Shake, Chocolate Mocha the highest rating because it is awesome. Low in calories, great for a quick breakfast or pick me up!
It is wonderful that I can just order it from Amazon and have it delivered to me door. Great price.
I think everything Special K does is a winner!
It also comes in vanilla. There is a bit if an aftertaste but nothing that would deter me from buying!

product_title: Carnation Breakfast Essentials, Classic Chocolate Malt Powder, 1.26 oz, 10-Count Envelopes (Pack of 6)
review_body: Strawberry carnation breakfast is a delicious quick breakfast for my husband as he runs out the door to work.  I also use it in Nutriblast smoothies and in my skinny toddler's milk to get him extra calories and to get him to drink more milk.  The whole family loves carnation breakfast essentials!

product_title: Activa Naturals Energy Boost Formula - Sugar Free Grape Flavored Drink Mix Powder
review_headline: Great source of all natural energy
review_body:
I'm the type of person who heavily relies on energy drinks and coffee
for energy throughout the day. The only problem with this is that I crash
mid day and feel lethargic. I gave energy boost formula a try because it's sugar free and I
also needed a healthy alternative that wouldn't make me jittery but would
also give me enough energy. I'm happy to report that I'm in love with this
supplement!

product_title: Purely American Canyon De Chelly Black Bean Chili, 16 Ounce
review_headline: Tastes great and easy to manage
review_body: I wanted to try this mix, because I like these Native American black beans. The instructions are easy to make the chili, but you can just cook the beans. And have to say the teeny tiny Tobasco bottle is just adorable.

product_title: Nutiva Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, 15 Ounce
review_headline: This product better than Trader Joes
review_body: My wife and I like this product much better than the stuff from Trader Joe's. Better price, and a better product.

product_title: Crystal Light Drink Mix, Variety Pack, On The Go Packets
review_headline: Great having a large variety pack.
review_body: We like having a variety pack instead of having to buy several different packages of one flavor each.  We had gotten one of these at Costco and when we wanted more, as usual they were gone.  So we tried Amazon, and were thrilled to find you carried it.

product_title: SnackMasters California Style Turkey Jerky
review_headline: High in salt, like most jerky, a little tough, good flavor
review_body: I love the flavor of this jerky, but it is a little too tough and sinewy. As with most jerky, it is high in salt, so watch you blood pressure if you consume a lot of it.

product_title: Ferrero Collection
review_body: Valentines day gift for my boyfriend who is more of chocoholic than i am. No complaints from him; and i didn't expect any to be honest.

product_title: Grassfed Organic Ghee - Pure Indian Foods Brand
review_body: This is organic, has a great taste, however, it is also very expensive for such a small amount of ghee.

product_title: Pamela's Products Gluten Free Whenever Bars, 6 Count
review_body: I have tried all the flavors. These are good as well as the chocolate ones. I eat them for breakfast when I have little time to make a GF meal.

product_title: Daily Chef Foodservice Film -12in x 3,000ft
review_body: I am very pleased with this film. I had bought some years ago- the film is easy to use and adheres well to whatever I am using it on.

product_title: Flower Delivery - 25 RED PREMIUM FRESH ROSES. FREE SHIPPING, FREE GIFT MESSAGE by Spring in the Air Luxury Roses.
review_headline: 25 Giant, Red Roses from Spring in the Aire
review_body:
I received my Roses in excellent condition; upon opening the box is the beautiful smell of the lovely Roses. Today, I have trimmed them again changed the water and they are picture perfect. I would recommend anyone to get these beautiful Roses I am sure they will last another 2 weeks or more.
Thank you for the care and lovely Roses.

product_title: Coffee People Black Tiger Dark Roast, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: if you like strong coffee to wake you up, this is it. i will order it again. it is the best i have tried

product_title: Beaver Cranberry Mustard Squeezable Bottle
review_body: This particular mustard is just delicious on brats!! I had this in a restaurant. When I was served a red sauce and a mustard for some German brats, the red sauce was wonderful. I asked our waiter if they sold it at the restaurant. She said they didn't, but then told me that it was Beaver cranberry mustard. So glad I was able to find some on Amazon. Delicious!! :)

product_title: True Lime Shaker
review_body: Easy to add lime flavor to everything without having to zest or dilute with juice.  Great flavor.  Will buy again.

product_title: Natierra Organic Cacao Nibs
review_body:
This is the only brand of Cacao Nibs I have given a shot, and I like them. However, I can see how they aren't for everyone.

In case you didn't know, they are a quite bitter. They don't taste like a milk chocolate Easter bunny, because they aren't supposed to. They give anyone who is Sugar Free/Dairy Free a nice chocolate kick without any added ingredients.

I almost always pair them with raisins or fresh strawberries to add in some sweetness.

product_title: Grand Ghirardelli Chocolate Gift Basket
review_body: It was so cheap looking. Nothing stood up like it looks in the picture. There are a few candy bars laying flat in a basket with plastic over it. Not even a bow

product_title: Community Coffee Private Reserve Ground Medium-Dark Roast, 100% Chicory, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: Don't make the mistake I did. This is not coffee with chicory in it. It's 100% chicory. Sure, it says that right on the label, but it bears repeating. Great for blending in with your favorite ground coffee to give it that authentic Louisiana taste. But brewing it alone is just gross.

product_title: Cameron's Whole Bean Coffee
review_headline: now that isn't the real truth
review_body: now the after taste it gives tastes a bit processed.  over all give it a try. i'm in between reorder/not.

product_title: Nature's Bakery Whole Wheat Fig Bar, Apple Cinnamon, 12 Count Box
review_body: I really love all these flavors and so does my family, great buy when you purchase them as an add-on. The are moist and the cookie is crispy great combo.

product_title: Kirkland Signature, Jelly Belly Jelly Beans
review_body: This company is well known for the flavorful jelly beans.  This was shipped and received in the estimated time frame and in new condition.  I was very happy with the product and would recommend this to anyone who would like to get a different flavor by eating one jelly bean at a time.

product_title: Pork Clouds - Set of 3
review_headline: A bit spicy, crispy and good
review_body: While I am not a fan of anything very spicy due recently, this had just enough zip to be good flavor without setting my sensitive tongue on fire. Very good, nice amt of protein and very satisfying snack!

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Cacao Nibs
review_body: Not sure why there's no recall on this item. I've been using this brand for years and just read on consumer's lab that they found high levels of cadmium in this product. This is a toxic heavy metal and the amount was actually over the legal limit in Europe. I've written to the company and haven't received a response yet.

product_title: Decaffeinated Ceylon Tea, Loose Tea in 4 Ounce Tin
review_body: This tea is perfect with cream and won't keep you up at night!  I would absolutely buy it another time.

product_title: Light Purple Colors of M & M's - 1 lbs bag
review_body: The packaging was inferior.  When I opened the outer plastic, I found the inner plastic bag was opened.  There  no protective bubble wrap as I found with my other M & M deliveries.  I have all original shipping plastic bags and intend to send it back.

product_title: A.C. Legg INC #10 Pork Sausage Seasoning, 8 oz
review_headline: wasn't sure about this but wow
review_body: Purely an amateur here have just started getting into sausage making. I miss old time southern sausage like I had as a child. This is really close to what I remember seasoning to be like when I was a kid.

product_title: Seapoint Farms Energy Blend 34oz Jar
review_body: I love this snack, and so good for you. Just quarter cup and you very satisfied wonderful snack. Wish I could buy local.

product_title: Green & Black's Organic Chocolate, 3.5-Ounce Bars (Pack of 10)
review_body: These are my favorite brand chocolate... They have the best flavor then all the others out there.. The real dark chocolate taste the way it meant to be!  Love them

product_title: Badia Spices inc Spice, Cloves Whole, 12-Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_body: Fast delivery and price is good.  Smell was good and pungent like it should be. Would recommend it to friends who cook in large batches.

product_title: Jelly Beans Just Born bulk 4.5 lbs lbs
review_body: could be way cheaper. If you're buying for baskets, get these in bulk elsewhere. I didn't taste them, I just needed hem for bulk.

product_title: Brussel's Hawaiian Umbrella Tree Bonsai
review_headline: Package was damaged and pot was broken.
review_body: Amazon has a 20% policy on partial returns which we opted for instead of killing the plant shipping it back and forth.  The return would come out to about 12 dollars which would in no way pay for the pot it had come with.  Too bad we bought it as a mothers day gift or I would have gone through all the trouble of returning it, though since it was a gift we did not want mom to deal with all that.

product_title: 72-Layer Cream Cheese Biscuits, One Dozen
review_body: These biscuits are surprisingly light and incredibly good. I buy them for Christmas and Easter to treat my guests. They are good alone or with jam. Oftentimes you get at least 2 or more boxes so you can bake 8-12 at a time and save the remaining box(es) for later. After serving them at a special dinner or brunch I have also warmed up one  cold biscuit the next day by wrapping it gently in a moistened paper towel for about 15-20 seconds in the microwave which preserves their soft texture. There are recipes to make these but I have not had the nerve to try any of them.

product_title: Jml Instant Noodle Artificial Stew Pork Flavour 5 small bags
review_body: good

product_title: Yummy Earth Organic Drops Pouches
review_headline: The pomegranate flavor has a weird aftertaste of menthol
review_body: I love every flavor except one. The pomegranate has a menthol taste and about 1/4 of the bags I purchased are this nasty flavor. The lollipops are labeled so that you can know in advance which one you are getting. Also, I only got a few of the listed flavors in both this product and the lollipops made by this brand.

product_title: Helen Ou@sichuan Specialty: Haobashi Dried Tofu 750g/1.65lb/26.5oz Bulk Package 9 Tastes
review_body: Haobashi has always been my favorite tofu snacks brand but it is not easy to get in the US. It's good to find it on Amazon. The shipment took exactly two weeks or 9 business days with Memorial Day being excluded, which was fast to me considering it was not express mail. I am happy with this purchase.

product_title: Tea's Tea Sencha Shot, Green Tea, 6.4 oz
review_headline: $5 for one little tiny can of green tea?  Really?!
review_body: See subject line.  Tea is good, but this price point is a blatant attempt to bilk some unsuspecting mouse click.  $150/case of 30 when Amazon is selling a case of 30 for $36???

product_title: Roland Rough Cut Demerara Sugar Cubes - 17.6 oz
review_body:
These demerara sugar cubes are definitely worth the money, which I didn't find them to be particularly expensive as other reviews had stated.

They are beautiful to offer when guests are over and add a unique sweetness that I find much more pleasant than refined sugar. I plan to buy this product again. And it arrived VERY quickly!

product_title: Jet Puffed Chocolate Mint Mini Marshmallow, 8-Ounce (Pack of 8)
review_body: Love these!  Great chocolate/light mint taste.  I highly recommend using them in hour hot chocolate.  Delicious!  Have given bags to my friends.

product_title: Kirkland Signature Peanut Butter Pretzel
review_body: I love these~  I did not find, like others, an over amount of broken pieces in its' container. I am only sad they took them off of the auto order program. When you're looking for that little "somethin' - somethin" these fit the bill.

product_title: Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Coconut Palm Sugar
review_body: Switched from sugar, does the job and has a very low glycemic index.  Can't go wrong if you want to be healthier.  Taste is pleasant, not artificial...just milder than straight sugar.  Does not taste or smell like coconut to me at all.

product_title: Wellbee's Super Fine Blanched Almond Flour / Powder
review_headline: The finest texture I have found.
review_body: I've bought almond flour from other companies and was a little disappointed with the textures.  I tried this product and its texture is the finest I have found so far.  I will definitely buy it again.

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Raw Chia Seeds
review_body: This was my second chia purchase. I got these at a great price so got them here instead of Trader Joe's. You do get a lot in this 1 lb pouch so they are lasting a long time.

product_title: Alaska Smokehouse Ketchikan Gift Basket, 3-Pound Packages
review_body: I bought this as a gift. It came in a cardboard box no basket .It was totally cheap looking and not good quality food .I will not order any food baskets form here again.

product_title: Keurig, The Original Donut Shop, K-Cup packs
review_body: This is, by far, our favorite coffee. We first tried it after we bought the Keurig and now, we bring the Keurig on certain vacations (renting a vacation house near the water) so we can have our favorite coffee.

product_title: Melitta Coffee Pods, 18 Count (Pack of 4)
review_body: Yes they are a little fuller then other pods but thats what gives it that "real coffee flavor" I'm so in love with these that I have set up a subscription to keep them coming.

product_title: Bulk Save Dr. McDougall's Tortilla Big Soup Cup 6 to 24 packs each 2 Oz
review_headline: Great flavor!  Still needs some tweaking.
review_body: Tortilla soup has great flavors but it is a bit grainy.  I always add slices of hot peppers of any kind. Usually habenero!

product_title: Viva Naturals Organic Extra Virgin Coconut Oil, 16 Ounce
review_headline: Viva Labs #1 Organic Extra Virgin Coconut Oil
review_body: This is the first coconut oil I have purchased (based on some other Amazon reviews).  I am extremely pleased with this product and will definitely purchase it again.

product_title: YummyEarth Sour Jelly Beans Snack Packs
review_body:
These are very good sour beans. My 7 year old son really likes them as well. They are chewy and tasty and I really like the initial sour "punch" you get from these.

Yes, they're candy... but if you're going to eat candy, this is probably a better choice than your typical option.

But I have to knock a star off because the packs seems a little small and the price is relatively high.

product_title: Wheat Thins Crackers
review_headline: Seemed like a good flavor to try.
review_body: I bought these to add to my son's lunch for something different.  They came quick, but half the box was crumbs.

product_title: Caza Trail Coffee, Single Serve Coffee Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-Count
review_body: Good, bold flavor without being bitter or too strong. Works fine in my K-cup compatible brewer. Have not had any of the cups fail or leak or have any manufacturing flaws.

product_title: Whole Spice Bay Leaves Powder, 1.6 Ounce
review_body: Finally I no longer have to go digging for those pesky leaves. Now I I can have the taste that I desire without the mess...

product_title: Rippin Good Windmill Cookies, 10-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: I am part of an organization that was formed 102 years ago for the purpose of saving a windmill that was originally built on the very spot it still occupies in 1787.  I am please to say we have, thus far, successfully been able to preserve and protect the windmill.  We have it open to the public during the summer months on weekends.  We hold several functions each year to raise money for this purpose and we like to serve windmill cookies at most of those events.  I am very pleased with taste of these cookies as well as the excellent condition they were in when delivered to my home.  I would definitely order them again.

product_title: KIND PLUS Gluten Free Bars
review_headline: Yummy and at least better than a candy bar...lol
review_body: These aren't really all that healthy, but they're delicious and have kept me from indulging in something much worse for me on MANY occasions.

product_title: 100% Colombian Supremo Coffee, Fresh Roasted Coffee LLC
review_body: I've ordered these beans from Fresh Roasted Coffee several times.  They're always "just-roasted" fresh and an excellent flavor--rich and hearty with no bitter aftertaste.  I coarse grind and brew in a French press and always have a perfect cup of coffee.  Fresh Roasted is located in Selinsgrove, PA and uses green methods for roasting, which makes me feel a little better about drinking a pot a day.  Some day I'll probably try a different variety, but I'll never change the vendor.  Highly recommended!

product_title: 3 Maple Sap Ecolo Spouts with 2 ft. Blue Drop Lines, Spile, Tap, Syrup.
review_body: I ordered more spouts for next year.  They were so easy to use and I ordered some for my daughter and son in law for their walnut trees.  I had them use some of mine this year and they got a lot of sap from those trees as well.

product_title: Antimo Caputo 00 Pizzeria Flour (Molino Caputo)
review_headline: now thats a gooda pizza flour
review_body: I have been making my own pizza dough for years.  I thought it was good.. I tried using this flour and it made my recipe great...

product_title: Pink - Revolutionary Energy Drink For Today's Woman - 100% Natural - NO CRASH - (30 Individual Servings) Try It..Feel It...Share It...
review_body: My wife makes me buy several boxes of this every month.  She has attributed her 24lb wait loss to it (cause lord knows she doesn't work out or diet).  I'm still skeptical, but she swears by it.

product_title: Jarritos Drink, Grapefruit, 50.7 Ounce (Pack of 8)
review_body: This is a sweet soda and tastes great too! A great soda to use in the recipe for a paloma.

product_title: Bulk Save Muir Glen Crushed Tomato With Basil 12 to 48 packs each 28 Oz
review_headline: DON'T LIKE THE TOMATO PEEL MIXED IN THE SAUCE
review_body: The taste of this product is really good.  However, I don't like the pieces of tomato peel that are mixed in the sauce.  Also, although the name of the product says "crushed", it is more liked diced tomatoes.  The tomatoes haven't been mashed, instead they have been diced.

product_title: Mrs. Dash Original Blend Salt Free Seasoning Blend (224083) 2.5 oz
review_body: I first encountered Mrs. Dash during a long hospital stay in which I was on a very restricted salt diet. Yuk. But, I had to have something, and I found that when I got home and began to cook with it like any other spice, it made all the difference in the world. The hospital would give you a small package of Mrs. D to pour over your overcooked scrambled eggs - it was not a pretty sight. Now I add her into every dish early on, and I found out she carries a lot of spices and a little heat. Much better when cooked into the food.

product_title: True Lemon and True Lime Shaker Kit (2pk)
review_headline: As good as the real thing, but won't go moldy!
review_body: Tastes like real fresh citrus, and it's shelf stable - no more digging in the open fridge only to find half a moldy lemon/lime or that the bottled juice tipped over and made a sticky mess.

product_title: Splenda - Sugar Alternative Sweet Minis - 16.5g

product_title: Planters Dry Roasted Sunflower Kernels (Case of 12)
review_headline: Good Product in Convenient Jar, But Not Same Product as in Snack Bags
review_body: I recently found that I love sunflower kernels---out-of-hand, in Greek yogurt, or on cereal and salads.  I was excited to find that Planters packs those kernels in 5.85-ounce jars identical to those used for Planters nuts so that the jar can be securely closed after removing the desired amount of kernels.  After the 12 jars arrived I discovered that the contents of the snack-sized bags and the jars are not identical.  The 3-ounce bag of Planter's sunflower kernels contains simply sunflower seed kernels, oils, and salt.  The 5.85-ounce jar contains spices (including celery), dried onion, dried garlic, paprika, natural flavor, sugar, gelatin, torula yeast, cornstarch, dried corn syrup, and maltodetxrin.  With the (possible) exception of the paprika (I can't make a judgement about the "natural flavor" since I don't know what it is.), I didn't expect, and didn't like the additions to the usual simple nutty, toasty flavor of the sunflower kernels.  I don't know why there is a difference in the bag and jar recipes. A check of the Planters website confirmed that the ingredient lists are indeed different, squashing my hope that I had purchased a batch that had been processed from an old recipe that was no longer being used.  The herb-y, vegetable-like flavors were a distraction to the pure flavor of the kernels, though the roasted flavor was a very pleasant addition, and a contrast to the kernels of other processors who do not add roasting to the process.  The texture was almost "crispy", making them a fabulous addition to smooth and creamy or soft foods.  Additional flavorings are even less acceptable in the larger home-sized product which is likely destined to be used as an additive to other foods instead of being consumed as a snack.  If you prefer the more-processed flavor of the "souped-up" sunflower kernels the convenience of ordering a case of them may be to your liking, but I have found that the prices for this product offered by Amazon sellers are not competitive with those found in other retailers' brick-and-mortar stores, and since i prefer the unadorned product I'll likely not purchase these again.

review_headline: This Product is Fine, but the Advertising IS Misleading..(BTW, Please Read My Comments on Other Sugars You May Want to Try)
review_body: My major concern, as with others, is that these companies (more than one) did advertise it as being from Hawaii, which is why many of us bought it. On the other hand, the elusive color of the product and the heterogeneity in the product's molasses content is not too surprising and actually necessary for this type of packaging and use. I have used many other raw sugar products for coffee which include higher levels of molasses (including Sucanat, Demerara and Muscovado) and the problem is that they harden up if not kept very tightly sealed, usually in glass containers, and cannot be packaged in paper envelopes. So the lower (and thus by chance more heterogeneous molasses content) is probably necessary. If you want some real kick in your coffee, try those other sugars...they are great !!

product_title: Monin Flavored Syrup, Candied Orange, 33.8-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Monin does it again! Candied Orange edition. A+!!!
review_body:
Monin is world renowned for it's massive variety of flavored syrups that can add delight to almost any drink. I'm a fan of oranges and orange drinks anyway, and thought this sounded like a wonderful new flavor to try. It's sweeter than their regular orange syrup, very much capturing the flavor of candied orange slices and gummies. I've not found much it doesn't go well in. In fact, I LOVE to add it to my orange drink mixes, and a splash into Sprite or 7UP is a whole other kind of refreshing. It adds to orange juice and is terrific for us with milk in Orange Julius recipes. In short, just about anything that makes sense to add orange to, is going to be even more delicious with this syrup. It goes great in teas of almost any flavor, all of the drink mixes like Crystal Light and Wyler's, and even milk. It goes great over ice cream and many other desserts.

Best of all, the price for this 4 pack is incredible. On average, a single bottle of Monin in the 33.8 ounce sizes run right about 15$. Separately you'd be paying over 60 for four of these, while the four pack puts it just over half price.

In short, anyone who loves oranges and orange flavoring is going to enjoy this syrup. A little goes a long way in a drink, and this is a great addition to any bar whether you're using it for non-alcoholic drinks or for your cocktails.

That's my $.02 folks. Give it a try, and I don't think you'll be disappointed. Thanks! R.A. McDowell

product_title: Parboiled Organic Rice From Greece - 500g
review_headline: Good rice, still wondering about organic certification
review_body:
I googled Organic Parboiled rice and this was the one hit I got .I wanted parboiled rice because it has resistant starch, a low glycemic index and higher nutrient value. But USA grown parboiled rice (e.g., Uncle Ben's converted) is often grown in fields that previously grew cotton, and there is a concern about arsenic in the rice. So.. I gave this rice a try. It arrived about two weeks after I ordered it -- to be expected, I guess since it shipped from Greece. The mailing envelope had Greek stamps on it, the directions on the rice pack are all in Greek -- very cool, but I had to research how to cook it (I don't speak or read Greek): bottom line - go 2 to 1 (2 cups water to 1 cup rice) and cook for 25 minutes. The rice comes out great -- fluffy, seperated grains, not mushy, good for rice salads or stuffing peppers -- any dish where you don't want the rice to clump. The only improvement I would make is in the "organic" certification. Although the rice is described as organic, it's not clear that an independent certifying agent has bestowed that label.

That said, I ordered three more pounds for myself and for friends. It's very good rice, and parboiled -- even if organic is not verifiable -- is worthy of pursuing.

product_title: Melitta Coffee Maker, Single Cup Pour-Over Brewer with Travel Mug (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Great coffee pot, but some caveats
review_body:
This makes good drip brewed coffee. It does come with the carafe. Easy clean up.

Some caveats:
- It's not small. This is designed to larger quantities. You're going to need some storage space.
- The cone will fit in a coffee mug/cup, but the bottom extends so far below the lip that you can't get the full amount of coffee in. It is designed to be used with the carafe. (I didn't know that and it destroyed my planned usage, thus the -1 star. It is a great product, though, so I couldn't deduct more.)
- Heat the carafe with hot water before you start brewing or it will suck the heat out of your coffee.
- Use 1-2 TBS of grounds for each "cup" (6oz) of coffee you are wanting. If you use too little it tastes weak.
- This is NOT HEATED. If you make a lot of coffee, it will get cold - QUICK! This is good in that the coffee won't burn, but bad in that you should only make as much as you need for each round.

product_title: Quaker Chewy Variety Pack 60 Granola Bars (Peanut Butter and Chocolate Chip), 50.7OZ
review_headline: Perfect Snack for Outdoor Activities at the Boys and Girls Club
review_body:
I've yet to meet a child who doesn't like Quaker Chewy Granola Bars! And when you add chocolate chips (and peanut butter) into the mix, these things are irresistible. Even I, a 22 year adult, find these things addicting!

Honestly, I like to lie to myself and say these are healthy. And granted, they are better than a candy bar- they're still not the best snack in the world. But at my Boys and Girls Club, where we're on a budget, unfortunately granola bars are cheaper than apples. So granola bars is what we get.

One box of 60 gets each of our kids one granola bar. Not the most filling after-school snack, and I'd like to feed them something better- but right now it's our only choice. And the great thing is, all the kids like them. So no kid leaves starving. They all get a small snack after school. For some of my kids, it may be the only food they get that evening- so it's really important that I find food they like. Granola bars are never refused, and that's why I love them.

They each come in their own wrapper, and the wrappers are really easy to open. Even our 2 and 3 year old kids can manage to get the granola bar out of the package. Some snacks aren't so convenient, and I really appreciate the fact these packages are so easy to open. It's so much better than having 50 kids waiting in line, while I cut each package open with a pair of scissors for each individual kid.

This pack comes with two flavors. Chocolate chip and peanut butter chocolate chip. They're equally as delicious, and honestly I don't think the kids can tell the difference. I just tell them they're all the same flavor to prevent arguing over who gets what. They have yet to figure out there are two different kinds in the box.

They're a great snack for after school- and also really convenient for our outdoor days. When I take the kids outside these are an easy snack we can take with us. They can't spill them all over like trail mixes. And they won't melt in the sun like candy bars. Pretty much the perfect picnic, playground, or hiking food! And they taste so good the kids will eat them anywhere!melt in the sun like candy bars. Pretty much the perfect picnic, playground, or hiking food! And they taste so good the kids will eat them anywhere!

It takes some real creative tales to satisfy them. Especially now that they're approaching high school age.

The same principle works when they ask about the birds and the bees. I just flip on one of those battery operated airport gift shop weasel-in-a-sock deals, and my job as a parent is easy peasy.

product_title: California Olive Ranch Extra Virgin Olive Oil
review_body:
So far I have used two flavors of the California Olive Ranch EV oils: this Arbequina and also their Miller's Blend. The flavors are EXACTLY as described by the company in their product descriptions. This one is light and fruity and the Miller's Blend has a mild peppery flavor but is not "hot" spicy. I love them both.

Although EVOO should not be used in cooking because heat destroys the delicate beneficial polyphenols, this brand of olive oil should most definitely never be used in cooking - or you will lose not only the health benefits but also the delicate flavor. The light, fruity flavor of this Arbequina is totally heavenly as a bread dip, and swirling it over lightly cooked veggies also complements the flavor of the vegetables without leaving an "olive oil taste" like the Zoe brand I used to use. And for salads, combined with freshly squeezed lemon juice, it is totally delicious! (You could use it with a good balsamic or red wine vinegar also, but I don't use vinegar of any kind.)

This is not a highly processed and filtered oil. There is sediment in the bottom of the bottle. This information about the sediment is also found on the bottle itself. Shaking it well before pouring enhances the flavor.

I have not tried the most expensive brands of olive oil on the market so I can't compare this mid price oil to them, but for the price I truly believe this is the best oil on the market. If you are looking for a light, fruity EVOO I recommend the C.O.R. Arbequina.

product_title: SToK Caffeinated Black Coffee Shots, 264-Count Single-Serve Packages
review_body: I agree with all the positive reviews of the product.  It is basically tasteless, the color of black coffee, and a quick, cheap way to add caffeine.  However, I second the point another reviewer made about the hair in the packaging.  The bottom of the box was nearly covered in short hairs!  The small plastic cups were shipped loose in the box and had hair stuck all over them.  The hairs are all the same length, about 3/4 of an inch, and grayish brown.  I don't think it's human.  The uniformity of the length and color make is unlike what I would expect from a barber shop.  The texture doesn't seem right, either.  I suspect it could be dog, because the hairs are slightly curled.  I can't think of another animal likely to have wavy hair.  It might be rodent hair, though.  (Hair shed from our hamsters looks similar.)  Although I like the product itself, I won't order again.  Because of the hair, I'm concerned the cups are too dirty to use.  Because another reviewer had the same problem, I have to assume the hair in my box wasn't just a fluke.

product_title: Semolina Pasta Flour
review_body: I have ordered Bob's Semolina flour (4 packs) twice now and it's wonderful for authentic homemade pasta.  I have not bought other brands of semolina (I trust Bob's products) so I can't compare texture or taste to other brands.  Before buying this semolina, I made pasta with regular unbleached AP flour which was good but not great.  Adding the semolina does make a difference in pasta and pizza adding wonderful flavor and texture.  I use 1 cup organic unbleached AP flour,  1 cup Bob's semolina, 1 tsp. kosher salt, 3 eggs, 1 T. organic extra virgin olive oil and mix in my kitchenaid with dough hook-sometimes I need to add a bit of water (tablespoon at a time) and sometimes not.  (combine the flours and salt, make a well in the center add the eggs & olive oil, mix on low using a spatula to gradually push the flour from the sides of the bowl to the center - much like if doing pasta by hand on a countertop.  Once the dough comes together I let the kitchenaid do the work of kneading for 8-10 minutes.  Don't skimp on the kneading time, I've found it really needs at least 8 minutes.  Remove dough, knead a bit by hand if needed to form a smooth ball.  Wrap in plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.  Kitchenaid pasta roller makes the rest a snap.  The dough may feel a bit "grainy" but once rolled and cooked the pasta is velvety and delicious.  Cooking the pasta will take 3 minutes or less. This recipe yields a lot of linguine noodles, (maybe over a lb.-rolled thru setting 6) plenty for a family of 4.  I have been making a lot more pasta now since buying Bob's semolina so I will probably add this to my subscribed products.  Great price for a pack of 4.

product_title: Matcha Green Tea Powder - Powerful Antioxidant Japanese Organic
review_body:
I was thrilled when Kiss Me Organics contacted me to review this product.

Let it be known first that I'm not a big fan of traditional green tea. This matcha powder, however, is quite delicious, and after only a couple of uses, I'm already a fan.

I was most impressed by the health benefits it offers; matcha is chock-full of antioxidants, relaxation-promoting proteins, and properties to protect skin from UV rays and boost metabolism. Who doesn't love those attributes?

I first enjoyed my matcha in a simple fruit smoothie. The matcha blended nicely and offered a subtle grassy, earthy flavor to an otherwise sweet and fruity drink.

I next tried using matcha in baked oatmeal and was surprised at how well the mellow (I used only 1/4 tsp) matcha flavor complemented the chocolate chips and coconut that I used.

I'm anxious to try the many other ways this matcha can be used: brewed as tea, in other baked goods, in sauces, and in more mixed drinks and smoothies.

The resealable package is convenient, since matcha should be stored in an air-tight container out of direct sunlight. And while $25 may seem like a high price, the 4-oz package will yield many servings, making it worth the price.

Even if you're not a big green tea fan, you'll find the flavor of matcha can be as subtle or as strong as you wish. It mixes well with other flavors, and I think it would suit most people's tastebuds. Give it a try!

I have no problem with people buying pink salt, of course, but if there is a difference between it and other rock salt, it's in whatever impurity causes the pink color - at least they might mention what that is, and do away with all the non-GMO nonsense.

The marketing is deceptive & unfortunately when it comes to people who want to believe its better for them will hand over the doubled price for the sake of satiating their want for that edge. product_title: Enjoy Life Cookies
review_headline: I am Gluten-free, my Son is Dairy-free
review_body: I have Celiac Disease and have been eating these on and off for a few years.  I try not to buy a lot of cookies but occasionally you just want a cookie.  I should probably mention that just because these are free of the top allergens, they are not health food.  Recently, we discovered that our toddler has an allergy to dairy and I have since went dairy-free as well.  These have been a great snack.  I have never had a reaction to these and either has my child.  The cookies are very moist and they taste pretty good in comparison to other gluten-free/dairy-free products.  The variety pack consists of 2 boxes of chocolate chip, 2 boxes of brownie, 1 box of snickerdoodle, and 1 box of ginger spice.  They are all good, although I tend to like the chocolate chip and brownie best.  Snickerdoodle isn't my favorite cookie but it does taste snickerdoodle.  The ginger spice has a little kick to it.  I probably wouldn't buy them individually because they have this "I just ate a spicy chicken wing" aftertaste but I still eat them.  Would I recommend these cookies to people without allergies?  No.  They cost around $5 a box in stores which is why I order them from Amazon.  You don't get a lot and I've been known to eat a whole box in a day which is why I don't buy a lot of cookies.  I do however highly recommend these to people who have allergies, especially children.  Also, if you are looking for something for a friend or relative with allergies, these are a safe bet.

review_headline: If you must drink decaf in the USA, this is the one
review_body:
I carefully brew my tea in the proper English manner, using a preheated ceramic teapot, filtered water, and a steeping time of precisely five minutes.

Even with a full five minutes of infusion, this is a light-bodied tea that packs little punch in the flavour department. Still, I rate this at 4 starts because it really does taste like tea, without the soapy, grassy, musty "dishwater" taste of competing decaf teas sold in the USA, most notably Lipton and Tetley.

To sum it up: while Red Rose Decaffeinated Tea won't knock your socks off with robust flavour, there's nothing about it that offends, either. Brew it carefully and you'll be rewarded with a passable cuppa.

review_body:

Disclaimer: I roast my coffee in a popcorn popper (google it) when I can find the time! 2nd best is from online roaster SweetMarias, but price + shipping is high. I very much like Trader Joe's Maragogype but Farmers Market Jo has now supplanted it as my value-priced favorite. No roast date on the bag, but I understand they do day-after-roast shipping to Amazon's warehouses, and so far it seems fresher than anything I've tried that doesn't have a guaranteed roast date. It's medium roast so lively and not oily with a robust flavor profile. Roast levels are subjective and much debated, but a really good coffee can be roasted to "full city" vs. dark and have MORE flavor, in my opinion, than a lot of the charcoal water out there. Read the tasting notes, it has those flavors, too, not just the aroma!

product_title: Frontier Bulk Meadowsweet Herb, Cut & Sifted, 1 lb. package
review_body:
Well, I was reading about meadowsweet and some of its capabilities hit a lot of my sweet spots. Meadowsweet is supposedly used for colds, bronchitis, upset stomach, heartburn, peptic ulcer disease, and joint disorders including gout. It is supposed to contain tannins, which might decrease inflammation (swelling) and decrease mucus (phlegm). It also has small amounts of salicylates, which are similar to aspirin.

This bag contains a lot of meadowsweet so I can see it lasting a long time. I put a teaspoon of the dried herb in a tea strainer and drop it into a hot cup of water. It steeps for about 15-20 minutes and then it is ready. The taste is very pleasant - a lot like regular tea with just a slight hint of mintiness. It is not a strong tea, so if you like a miler tasting tea, you will like this. I do not add any sweetener to my tea - I drink is straight. So, this will be on our staple list of tea to keep around the house.

product_title: Enjoy Life Bars
review_headline: Originally Very Berry, now Mixed Berry, results in a Complete Failure
review_body:
Being a family with food sensitivities, Enjoy Life products have been a “go to provider” for our snacks.

We have used Subscribe and Save for years to order the original Enjoy Life snack bar: Very Berry; and would purchase multiple boxes of this product every so many months… Well, this past month we received the Mixed Berry (we guess the new improve product that Enjoy Life has replaced the Very Berry with). And unfortunately they have made the same mistake we have seen so many other manufacturers make. They change a product thinking they are improving it which of course might save them some money during the manufacturing process and allow them to make more of a margin while alienating their current audience who “enjoyed” what they originally started with. We have seen this with diapers, clothing, toys… All manufacturers that think they have to improve on a product so that it does not become dull, or they need to cut costs so they can make more on consumers; equals BIG MISTAKE.

Our 5 year old who loved the Very Berry bars was brave enough to try this new one (Mixed Berry) and he took an initial bite hoping to experience the same enjoyment as the original (Very Berry) bar and immediately spit it out saying it tasted disgusting. And we have to say that upon looking at the new bars, they look like a bunch of bird seed stuck together with sun-butter including bits of dried debris (aka dried fruit) as if they were dropped on a dirty floor. Totally unappetizing and completely disappointing in a product that was always a big hit in our house. Another problem is that because of the change, these snack bars are about three quarters of the size of the original Very Berry bars. We are paying about the same amount for these and getting less, and that does not work for us…

We hope this is not a trend for Enjoy Life, because we purchase several of their other products because they not only taste good and are good for you, but also because we want tosupport a local business in the Chicagoland area.

This is one product we will never buy again… so please for the love of God do not change the Coco Loco!!!

product_title: Pamela's Products Cookie Mix
review_body:
I'm always wary of gluten free stuff. But not Pamela's. Their stuff is always the best gluten free out there.

I do note that I have been gluten free since November 2013 and I am PICKY. So if it didn't taste like a sugar cookie I would not be writing this.

They mix up like sugar cookies, it's the package of cookie mix, 1 stick of butter, and 1 egg. That's it. I did have to cook them 5 minutes longer, but they look like a sugar cookie and 95% taste like one. With frosting I thought I was eating a sugar cookie and that's all I needed to know. Plain, they're doable, but they need the frosting to get the true real sugar cookie taste.

I do have to say I was surprised at the 1 star reviews. Not many, but they're there. I never discredit low reviews, but I have to note the reviewers aren't gluten free (i.e. not desperate for something that tastes close to a real cookie), one reviewer added more ingredients (which is never fair to the true product when you don't follow the recipe) and another who didn't like them listed a regular flour cookie recipe so you could make those instead... yeah... I'll leave that there for you to decide.

So get a bag and try it out for yourself. If you're gluten free and craving a cookie, you will not be disappointed. I will be buying more and recommending them to other GF peoples.

5 stars
excellent price for the amount of GF cookies you get
excellent taste
easy to make

review_body: I got this product as a free sample and tried it and it's really not that good. I'm a big fan of fancy espresso drinks away from home, like Starbucks Lattes (My personal favorite). Anyways, I was very excited to try this product but am incredibly disappointed. The product comes in a two step format where you pour a powder into your cup and then place the espresso kcup in the machine. Don't expect the liquid coming out of your keurig to dissolve the powder, you'll have to do quite a bit of stirring. The product does create some sense of frothiness as advertised, but not much more than a few bubbles. Nothing like what you would get with an actual milk frother. As for the taste, it is incredibly sweet. For anyone who truly loves espresso drinks, you typically aren't looking for something that tastes like hot chocolate. Maybe it's just the mocha latte flavor, so I'll probably give the other flavor a try. Overall, I probably wouldn't waste my money on this product and will just stick to my normal cups of coffee in the morning and a weekly splurge at Starbucks. I recommend you save your money and either continue what you usually do or invest in a milk frother and make a latte or mocha yourself at home. It's much cheaper in the long run anyways.

product_title: Ekobrew Coffee Reusable Filter, Small, Violet
review_body:
I purchased the Keurig Replacement Coffee Filter Set and the basket broke after three uses. Next I purchased the Ekobrew Refillable Cup. When used without a paper filter, grounds make their way into the brewed coffee. Next I purchased My Kap Round Filter papers. These worked well with the Ekobrew, but it takes patience to load them correctly each time.

However, after I read a tip here about cleaning out and reusing K cups, I purchased the My-kap Kaps. I now reuse K cups as follows: empty out the used grounds, clean out the cups (soap and water and rinse well)., fill with fresh grounds, cover with My-kap Kap and place in Keurig unit. I get a perfect cup of coffee with no grounds. If you are careful and place the filled cup into the unit so that the puncture hole on the bottom of the cup is always dirtily under the arrow on the Keurig unit, you will be able to use these cups over and over again - until the filter rips or the whole gets too big. Thanks to the reviewers for all their suggestions.

product_title: Nu-Salt, 3-Ounce Shaker (Pack of 12)
review_headline: The best way to reduce sodium intake
review_body: When one returns to the US from Europe or elsewhere, one of the first things you notice about foods is that everything here is too salty, far too high in sodium.  As much as possible, I avoid processed foods whenever I can prepare my own meals, and I use this NuSalt instead of salt.  It is potassium chloride, tastes almost exactly like ordinary salt [sodium chloride], and--obviously--is a good source of potassium.  My wife and I use it freely and without concern, but we are healthy middle-aged people.  It has not led to any hint of hyperkalemia.  If you decide to use NuSalt as I do, you should first double-check with your physician, but I can recommend it as a very good salt substitute for healthy people.

review_body: I have been using Stevia for many years, but have never tried this brand. I wanted to try a stevia powder with less additives and went with this one from Bulk Supplements. I also see that D-n-S-Gifts - Grocery & Gourmet Food sellers are now offering 24 cans (FOUR packs of SIX cans each) for $46.87 as well. So why are they ripping Amazon customers off by charging $21.95 for only ONE six pack?! I mean what if the customer only wanted to buy 2 six packs (or 12 cans) of this product? I guess they would charge the Amazon customer $43.90 for it! I mean the option of buying 24 cans or buying 12 cans comes down to a $2.97 spending cost difference! This makes absolutely NO sense to me!

When I had been shopping for bulk quantities of this product, (January 19, 2013) I ran into the advertisement posted here that had sounded very much as if they were selling "4" six packs for $21.95! (note: the 24 can option wasn't even listed then!) And so knowing that last October 2013, I had previously purchases 24 cans (4- 6 packs) of the Peach-Mango flavor for approx. $15.95, I thought for sure I was getting 24 cans for $21.95! I tell yeah, I'm so upset I could just spit! Amazon should be ashamed of allowing D-n-S-Gifts - Grocery & Gourmet Food to take such advantage of their customers! (sigh)

BTW- I see that Amazon Prime is once again offering 24 cans of this product (Orange-Pineapple) for $22.55! And the Peach-Mango flavor for $15.95! Seeing this price difference proves even more that D-n-S-Gifts - Grocery & Gourmet Food is a rip-off for charging $46.87 for 24 cans of Orange-Pineapple!

product_title: Dark Nebula, Whole Bean Coffee, Fresh Roasted Coffee LLC
review_headline: Dark Nebula vs Tiger Nebula - Good Value Both
review_body:
I've tried both. They both are good value for the price.

This isn't single-origin \\"snob\\" coffee, and doesn't claim to be. The Dark Nebula and Tiger Nebula state the same roast level on the bag (medium)and \\"look\\" very similar when opened, with the Dark Nebula having a bit of of an oil sheen on the beans whereas Tiger Nebula has little to none. Some espresso fans may find this roast lighter than they are used to and for me, I will stick with Dark Nebula from now on - it's just a tad darker and what I prefer in balance of flavor. The taste is how you'd expect from looking at the beans. As espresso, theTiger Nebula has a more acidic taste and Dark Nebula has less acidity and seems more balanced between acidity and bitterness. Both brew respectable Americanos and mugs in both pour-over chemex style brewing and Aeropress. I haven't tried French press yet.

The Tiger Nebula appeared to be very, very, freshly roasted but that I'd say is just due to chance - I probably happened to order just at the time a new batch was up for roasting. It \\"bloomed\\" dramatically in my Aeropress when off-boil water was poured on. The Dark Nebula was also acceptbly fresh for mail-order coffee, but did not bloom so dramatically. I've never had coffee delivered a fresh as the Tiger Nebula, but, like a say, I wouldn't expect that level regularly.

There are a lot of small, round beans in both blends and that suggests to me the presence of robusta, which is not necessarily bad. The increased caffiene buzz I get from these two blends supports the idea of robusta in the mix. What I really like is that I cannot taste anything like robusta as I have in other robusta blends from other brands. This is good because that would make this the best-roasted robusta I've had so far, and I've tried a more than a dozen brands and blends so far. In fact this is such and easy to drink high-buzz coffee that I've cut my dosage down nearly 50% without much loss in flavor and pleasure. Buzz-wise, a two-pound bag equals 3 to 4 pounds of the all arabica-blends. Additional money-saving!

At around $8.00 a pound, you really can't fault this coffee. This is my first choice now, if I want to order coffee for delivery. Try some!

product_title: Ideal No Calorie Sweetener 10.6 Ounce Baking Bag
review_body:
If used correctly, this product is excellent and will save you many calories!

Here's how I use it. Let's say I'm making pumpkin bread, or apple cake. If the recipe calls for one cup of sugar, I'll use 1/2 cup of sugar and 1/4 cup* of Ideal Sweetener. You'll never taste the difference, and you've cut your sugar in half.

*note I've substituted the other 1/2 c. sugar with only 1/4 c. Ideal.

Its also good if you wish to add a little extra sweetness to, say, a smoothie, or similar concoction, as there are so many other flavors going on - plus the natural sweetness of the fruit - you don't notice any artificial taste.

I wouldn't advise substituting cup for cup for sugar (or spoon for spoon), as you may get the typical artificial taste, like in coffee for instance. Or if using straight in baking, your product may end up dry.

As a rule I'm not fond of artificial sweeteners, but this one is great if used correctly.

product_title: Milford T - Lapsang Souchong Loose Leaf Black Tea 45 servings
review_body:
Anyone who enjoys tea will eventually switch from teabags to whole loose leaf. This review of Lapsang Souchong is among a series of mine, as I taste my way through several of Milford T offerings!

PREPARATION:
If possible, always start with clean water. Unfiltered tap water will do, but can contain trace contaminants from where the water is sourced and treated. I have found unfiltered tap water results in tea that is not as clear, and the flavor can be slightly off. My preference is filtered bottled water, or filtered tap water (I use a Brita filter). Heating water with a stovetop or electric kettle provides a rolling boil with more uniform temperature than does a microwave. When steeping and serving the tea, ceramic or glass containers work best for black teas and herbal infusions, and clay for green teas (note: rinse porous clay containers without soap).

AROMA:
It is often said that scents can evoke powerful memories or daydreams of adventure. When I opened the Lapsang Souchong tin, a campfire seemed to waft from within. After the initial burst of aroma, I smelled it again and caught the underlying fragrance of the tea leaves. Then I did start daydreaming of a campfire and hiking in the forest. This may have been influenced by my playing Skyrim at the time, and I wondered if this might be what a fire-breathing dragon’s breath smells like. The fragrance is about as pervasive as coffee, as the aroma will be apparent in the room. I don’t think you can make this tea without getting some attention from people around you.

FLAVOR:
I waited to write this review because this is the first time I’ve experienced Lapsang Souchong and I wanted to see if the initial flavor impact might change over time. The smoky aroma carries through to the flavor. There is the normal underlying flavor of the black tea, but that is combined with a rich, natural smoky taste. My wife pointed out to me that smoky flavors are among my favorite.Lapsang Souchong delivers an adventure with each cup.

If you are trying to find something tasty and fairly healthy to drink to replace unhealthy sodas or fruit juice which may have too much sugar in it for you and your diet, try this mandarin orange seltzer. It has no calories, no sugar. It has a subtle flavor combined with the fizz of seltzer. It feels like you're drinking a soft drink. I sometimes put a splash of juice in it.

Also made an amazing discovery about seltzer. You can put it in smoothies for your liquid and it tastes great. It's not flat like water would be if you added it to a smoothie. The best thing about it is it adds no calories or sugar to your smoothies like a fruit juice would. I regularly make a fruit smoothie for breakfast each day with seltzer: one banana, one cup frozen mixed berries, 1/2 cup lowfat yogurt or kefir, and just enough seltzer to almost cover the fruit. It tastes like a dessert and is only about 200 calories.

The mandarin orange is one of my favorite flavors of this seltzer. Dr. Oz says you can have a diet coke about once a week. Switching to seltzer as an alternative provides the fizz and low calories of a diet soda, but isn't harmful. I sometimes just put a squirt of juice in it, too.

product_title: Tiny But Mighty Popcorn Ancient Heirloom Popcorn, Unpopped - 20 oz
review_body:
My family and I LOVE this popcorn. It's super tiny, but the hulls are extremely fragile, making the popcorn really tender and lacking those annoying hulls that get stuck between your teeth. Yes, every once in a while you find a tougher hull, but it's popcorn…it'll happen.

The flavor is excellent -- we pop it with coconut oil and season with Himalayan pink sea salt and red peppercorns. The reason I give it four stars instead of five is that we've found that it doesn't pop well in hot air poppers or our movie theater popcorn popper. I bought a Whirley-Pop, and the problem is solved. Follow the instructions on the bag EXACTLY, and use a Whirley Pop, and you'll get amazing popcorn. But I definitely don't recommend it for other poppers.

product_title: Gold's Duck Sauce, Sweet and Sour, Cantinese, 40-Ounce Glass Bottle (Pack of 6)
review_body:
I can't swear that this is what thousands of years of Chinese culture intended as sweet and sour duck sauce, cantinese style. In fact, I'm pretty sure that it's not at all what they intended. It's about as Asian as General Tso's chicken and brown sauce.

I don't particularly love this duck sauce on its own. As a dipping sauce for egg rolls or wonton crisps it only gets about one star.

But as a sweet and sour sauce on baked chicken it gets a whopping...three stars.
(Sorry, I can't seem to work up too much enthusiasm for it).

It makes a good sweet chicken. And it's definitely easy to use. Remember Ron Popeil and 'set it and forget it'? That's basically this duck sauce. Throw it on some chicken, bake it, crisp it up at the end to get a nice golden color, and et voila! Sweet and sour chicken that's a crowd(?) pleaser.

product_title: Bulksupplements Pure Stevia Powder
review_headline: Great Stevia Product - Missing some info
review_body:
As part of my new cut, I completely cut out sugar from my diet. For the most part, cutting out sugar from my diet was really easy. I never was a big consumer of sugary foods like candy, cakes and etc, but I was guilty of having "coffee with my sugar" as my friends/family would joke. So I started doing research on a sugar substitute. After hours upon hours of researching all of the sugar substitutes on the market, I settled on the natural Stevia Extract.

There are several major brands of Stevia Extracts on the market and from what I found out during my research, most are manufactured using a potential harmful process. Based upon the ratings I saw on this product by BulkSupplements and another, I picked up both.

While I gave this product an overall rating of 4 out of 5, the actual product is a great. A little (and I MEAN a little) goes a very long way to sweeten most things like plain Greek yogurt, oatmeal and my must-have beverage...coffee. Now, the reason why I gave this product a 4 out of 5 is due to the package. There is no nutritional labeling, so I can't verify for sure how many carbs (if any) I'm consuming per serving. If BulkSupplments implemented it, I would be happy to revise my rating.

product_title: Eight O Clock Coffee, Original Whole Bean, 42 Ounce Package
review_headline: Easily one of the best coffee bargains around......
review_body:
First off, you have to understand that I drink a LOT of coffee, and have been drinking a lot of coffee for 35-plus years. I started out with brands like Folgers and Maxwell House, brands that my parents would typically buy on sale at the supermarket. As I eased into adulthood, I found myself drawn to pricier and better blends. These days I find myself buying a lot of local coffees, and living in central Texas I am blessed with several that roast and distribute in my area.

That said, I always seem to find myself gravitating to an old “off the shelf” friend in Eight ‘O Clock Coffee. The rich color, good smell, and dependable flavor provide for one of the best coffee bargains around. Is there a nostalgia factor at work? It’s possible. I’ll freely admit that the smell of a pot brewing brings back fond memories of drinking this at my parent’s table when I was younger, but the simple fact is that this is just a darn good cup of coffee. It’s hard not to appreciate this venerable brand, especially at the cheaper price points that it can usually be bought at.

There’s nothing special about it, it’s not a designer coffee in any sense. It just brews up perfect every time and produces a simple and satisfying cup of java.

This and Community Coffee are the two mass-produced commercial blends that I keep coming back to. Eight ‘O Clock coffee is a consistent and welcome visitor to my cupboard, and I’ll keep on throwing a few bags into the basket at the supermarket every year.

product_title: Oroweat Sliced Bread 16oz - 24oz Loaf (Pack of 2) Choose Flavor Below
review_body:
I had took a leap of faith to purchase a different kind of bread from the normal routine bread I and my family buy (From Wal-Mart). I'm actually not really big on bread. It's the kind of food I normally don't eat. But I have been suffering from constipation on and off throughout my life. I picked up the Nuttygrain flavor for three reasons
1) To eat something healthy
2) It was around a reasonable number of calories per slice
3) It had 20% fiber!
It's even got a grade A on my calorie counter profile after I input it into my daily calorie intake.

To give you a background on my form of constipation (not that I'm trying to be gross, but hopefully, this could help someone else), I go to the bathroom for #2 at least once a day, and that's usually in the mornings or around early afternoon. I'm lucky if I can go again. It's not that I have a hard stool, it's the fact that my body does not give me strong enough signals to push. So, sometimes I have to force myself to go and while I have some success, it still does not feel effective. I am active in exercise and have been eating fruits like crazy. Barely see a change. I have used suppositories and even drunk that nasty Lemon flavored Magnesium Citrate (if you drink this, I highly suggest you get the grape flavor).

Well, all that changed when I started eating this bread for just a few days. I was visiting the bathroom twice to triple than my usual visit. I am beyond impressed and feel like I made a new friend. Even as I type this, I have the urge to go!

As far as the taste; it's not the most delicious but definitely not the nastiest. It takes exactly what you'd expect it to taste by just looking at it. In other words, it's easy enough to eat. I eat one to two slices a day just to make it last. I had bought the 18-slice package.

***EDIT***
1/16/13
I ate two slices today and all throughout the day, my bowel movements or stools came out smoothly without much effort to push. I am beyond impressed right now. Maybe I should start making a sandwich out of these slices.

product_title: Tang Drink Mix
review_headline: 10-YEAR SHELF LIFE. THIS GANG LOVES TANG.
review_body:
Tang has a bang and tastes good too. And it's loaded in vitamins. If it's good enough for NASA....

The water we drank in Vietnam was potable but it was the same color as chlorine bleach...and tasted like it, too.

Just because water is touted as being safe to drink doesn't mean it tastes good.

I've spent time in Calabash, NC and some cities in Florida where the water tasted like it was dipped out of an aquarium full of dead squid.

Local water plant SNAFUs are common. What would happen of a problem lasted for weeks or months? The water might be safe to drink but could you tolerate the smell or unique flavor?

This is where Tang comes in.

I keep several of these 72-ounce containers in my food storage supply and consume enough to keep them rotated.

Amidst all the bangs, it would have been dang wonderful to have Tang in Da Nang in 1969.

product_title: Greek Halva Organic with Honey 200g
review_headline: Comes from Greece; takes 30 days to get; worth the wait
review_body:
I grew up having Halva.
I've always enjoyed that crystalline flaky crumbly feel of the Halva against your tongue.
It's a very unique sensation hard to describe.
Most of the local ethnic markets in Los Angeles have dozens of varieties of Halva to choose from.
Some have High Fructose Corn Syrup which I stay away from; most have regular white sugar as the sweetener which is slightly better. Also besides Sesame seed paste and the sweetener they include other ingredients. So although I like the taste I limit my consumption to a slice once every few years if that.

When I saw this Greek Halva with only two ingredients (Sesame seed paste and honey) it caught my attention, I ordered it thinking that it would be healthier than the others but probably not as tasty. Boy was I wrong. It was the tastiest Halva I ever had.
The texture was also spot on the way Halva should be.

I ate the 200gram bar in 3 days! I had to pace myself or I was going to eat it all in one day!
So if you are on a diet proceed with caution. I should follow my own advise I just ordered 6 more bars,

A 1 inch slice of the Halva, a 1 inch slice of Haloumi Cyprus Cheese with a cup of coffee. Wow what a breakfast !

product_title: Campbell's Roasted Chicken & Chardonnay Bisque Slow Kettle-Style Soups, 15.5 Ounce Microwavable Bowls (Pack of 8)
review_headline: Sometimes Bad Things Come To Those Who Wait, Too
review_body:
They say right on the container, "not made with preservatives, just patience."

I booked my tickets on this mythical flavor expedition fully expecting to saunter my way onto an imaginary Napa Valley Wine Train with my destination being simply savory Chardonnay satisfaction. I tore away the metal lid on their "microwaveable" container, lovingly ladled the contents into my trusty Rubbermaid bowl, and patiently passed gentle microwave radiation over the water molecules in the vicinity of this alleged mana from the gods for about three and a half minutes.

Imagine my immediate disappointment that begrudgingly yielded to shocked dissolutionment before firmly settling upon utter, absolute disenchantment as I tasted bite after bite of this gruel, the glowing smile of anticipation on my face being transformed through the waystation of confusion only to be ultimately eclipsed by the shadows of sadness. My night train to Napa never even left the station.

If I could give this soup a half-star, I would. The only reason I would give it even a half-star is because -- to distract myself from the existential crisis of my soul, I reckon -- I imagined that those little tiny pasta pebbles were so many edible rubber b.b.'s being shot down my throat and into the depths of my digestive system.

To be a fair and unbiased journalist, though, it's possible that this soup might have tasted better had I warmed it up a little more. Regardless, I cannot abide this abhorrent concoction and my conscience will not stand for silence here. You must be warned. Only resort to this meal if you are in very dire straits. Should you find yourself in some, I suppose this will tide you over until you are able to escape your merciless flavor captors.

Also, to that other reviewer that was disappointed that this does not taste like beef -- hello, it was chicken soup, it should not have tasted like beef, obviously.

Thanks for reading and enjoy (but don't trying enjoying the reviewed item, as it would be a pointless exercise in futility)! :)reading and enjoy (but don't trying enjoying the reviewed item, as it would be a pointless exercise in futility)! :)

product_title: Miracle Noodle Gluten-free Shirataki Pasta
review_body:
DO NOT buy these thinking they are like "real" noddles and then bash them for tasting not like the pasta you are used to. DO NOT think they can be used with tomato based sauces!!! These are ASIAN noodles made for use in ASIAN recipies. I grew up eating these noodles as I am part Asian and I LOVE them. Ok - not this brand but this type of noodles. I know them as "yam noodles". I don't know if they smell or not, I have never opened a package and been overwhelmed by any smell nor have I intentionally sniffed the package when opening one. If you have ever had sukiyaki and have had the clear noodles in that, these are those noodles.
They have a different texture from "nornal" noodles because they are not four/egg based - they are plant based. They have NO flavor on their own similar to tofu. They will absorb the flavor of what they are cooked in. I have never eaten these as a diet food, I eat them because I like them - like tofu and they have always been a part of my "food groups".

DO NOT try the food of a different culture and bash it because it is not like your beloved american counter-part. They need to be rinsed, they need to be boiled in some broth to ABSORB flavor. They cannot be drowned in spaghetti sauce! They are NOT your replacement for Italian pasta!!!!
