product_title: YS Organic Bee Farms CERTIFIED ORGANIC RAW HONEY 100% CERTIFIED ORGANIC HONEY Raw, Unprocessed, Unpasteurized - Kosher 32oz(pack of 6)
review_body:
For those of you unfamiliar with this kind of honey (only used to the honey that's been filtered), it's opaque for a reason. This honey will not pour at room temperature, so don't expect it to do so, but I'm glad it won't. This honey is so much better than any honey you can pour will be simply because making it pourable removes the stuff that makes it great.

This honey is so sweet and creamy, but there's more to it than that. The flavor builds in your mouth if you try a bit of plain honey and it has subtleties not found in filtered brands (which are more along the lines of wham, bam, thank you ma'am style of sweetness). After tasting this honey and discovering its effects on recipes when compared to filtered honey, I will never buy filtered honey again.

And this is aside from the health benefits of buying unfiltered.

I really have not tried unfiltered honey before this, so I can't really compare it to other kinds, but this kind is absolutely, 100% delicious.

Oh, and someone previously talked about organic honey not actually being a thing. Well, each certification company uses their own standards for certifying honey as organic. OCIA International is the one that certifies this honey and it uses the EU standard (if I'm reading their website right), which is a good standard to use. So yes, this honey is, in fact, organic.

product_title: YUMMY EARTH LOLLIPOP,OG2,STRAWBERRY, 3 OZ
review_headline: Delicious - I loved them as much as my son!
review_body: I was so happy to be introduced to this product by a dear friend of mine who is in the health industry. My son loves lollipops (he tries to get me to go to the bank because they hand out suckers) but I would limit them to once in a blue moon because of all of the artificial flavors and colors... The Yummy Earth Organic Lollipops are natural flavors and colors! In fact, we liked them so much, we got 200 in a variety of flavors to hand out for Halloween! The Strawberry and Watermelon are his favorite. My favorite is the Blueberry. I would recommend these to everyone! And only 25 calories each!

product_title: KIND PLUS Gluten Free Bars
review_body: Although there were more almonds than pecans I liked them really well, very satisfying and a great snack that is healthy.

product_title: Langers Cranberry Juice, 32-Ounces (Pack Of 12)
review_body:
This is a cocktail, meaning it is sugared water mixed with some amount of juice. The juice may or may not all be cranberry. And the percentages are not revealed.

This is completely false advertising. This is closer to cool-aid than juice.

product_title: DOVE PROMISES Chocolate Candy Bag
review_body: I have looked everywhere locally for a mixed package of Dove promises. Amazon was the only place I could find them. They are delicious and make wonderful additions to gifts for friends or family. I was glad to find the assorted package rather than one that was only one flavor.

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, Donut House (Pack of 96)
review_body: Meant to order the decaf,which I love. I'm sure this is good coffee if you like the caffeine.  The decaf is great.

product_title: San Francisco Bay One Cup
review_body: I have bought this coffee on a few different occasions.I love the full bodied taste and also the price.I'm always looking for a good deal and this is a great one !

product_title: Genisoy Soy Crisps, Nacho Cheese, 3.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Not the taste that I was hoping for....
review_body: I love this brand of Soy chips and have tried many other flavors, so I was happy to try \\"Nacho cheese\\".  I was hoping for a Dorito's taste, but I was very disappointed when I took my first bite. These have an after-taste that I never experienced with the other flavors of Genisoy brand Soy Crisps.  I won't ever buy this flavor again.

product_title: Cascadian Farm Organic Fruitful O's Cereal, 11-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Grrreat flavor and NO ARTIFICIAL COLORS !  No Blue 1 ! !
review_body:
Cascadian Farm has done it again with another great tasting cereal! Finally I can enjoy cereals of my youth without fear of severe GI distress (from FD&C Blue 1 which is derived from petroleum...FDA has a relevant press release...). I LOVE the fact FRUITFUL Os are made with real elderberry juice (for the purple color) rather than dyes derived from petroleum.

We mix Fruitful Os with nuts, almond, raisins, dried cranberries or other healthy bits for a healthy trail mix to snack on the run.

product_title: Bell Plantation PB2 Powdered Peanut Butter and PB2 with Premium Chocolate, 6.5 Ounce
review_body: PB2 is ammmmmazing!!!! Any peanut butter lover should get their hands on this, you can indulge without feeling the guilt. I'll never go back to regular peanut butter again!

product_title: Victorian Inn French Vanilla Cappuccino, 48-Ounce Cans (Pack of 2)
review_body: My favorite brand and flavor of Cappuccino.  Love the convenience and believe the price is reasonable.  Will continue to order.

product_title: Nestle Cerelac, Honey and Wheat with Milk (From 12 Months), 14.11-Ounce Cans (Pack of 4)
review_body: My husband and I have been ordering cerelac for a year now. We transitioned from the wheat and milk to the wheat, milk and honey after our daughter turned one. This breakfast cereal has been a God send for us as working parents, it is easy to fix, its clearly our babies favorite food and it is nutritious without all the sodium/sugars you may find in regular cereal. I highly recommend this product.[[ASIN:B001EPPBXG Nestle Cerelac, Honey and Wheat with Milk, 14.11-Ounce Cans (Pack of 4)]]

product_title: Bentley's Green Tea
review_headline: not as good as tea nation
review_body: the tea doesn't really have a jasmine taste, more like a flower I'm not familiar with,although,bentley's mango white, taste better to me than tea nation's lately..

product_title: DoMatcha DoMatcha Organic 2nd Harvest Matcha, 2.82-Ounce
review_body: I have bought this product regularly for about two years now and it is very calming and satisfying. One can lasts about six months with me drinking one bowl a day, on most days. I suggest it for anyone who loves tea. Don't forget to refrigerate it after opening for freshness!

product_title: Crystal Light Iced Tea Mix, (Makes 32-quart)
review_body: I really like this tea. It's very easy to make and it takes good. Very few calories too. Makes it a lot better if you are trying to increase your water intake also.

product_title: Licorice Scottie Dogs, Red, 5-Pound Bag
review_body: I'VE TRIED MOST OF THE LICORICE AROUND , AND THIS IS THE ONLY ONE I WILL ORDER  FOR IT'S OLD TIME LICORICE TASTE . TAKES ME BACK TO THE DAYS OF MY CHILDHOOD , ONE OF MY MOST REMEMBERED FLAVORS , AND IT'S REASONABLE IN PRICE .

product_title: Hampton Farms No Salt Roasted In Shell Peanuts, 5 lb. Bag
review_body: I had loved the peanuts that are available at \\"5 Guys Hamburgers\\". I found out that they came from  Hampton Farms and I ordered the 5 lb. bag from a merchant on Amazon. The peanuts were quite disappointing! No 2 peanuts are the same. In other words, some are roasted until they almost disappear and are hard as a rock, some shells have NO peanuts in them and somtimes you actually get some regular peanuts but they're small. The flavor isn't bad, but that too is inconsistant. It seems the quality of what \\"5 Guys Hamburgers\\" gets and what the public gets are way different.

product_title: Cranberry Pecan Fruitcake 1.5 Lbs
review_body: I'm not a fruit-cake person, but we had gotten one of these as a gift so I shared it at a dinner party.  Everyone who tried it liked it (me to), and the leftover cake went home with one of the guests.

product_title: JOLLY RANCHER Sugar Free Hard Candy in Assorted Fruit Flavors (3.6-Ounce Bag)
review_body: The product arrived in the quoted time frame.  the Hersheys Jolly Rancher Sugar Free candy is a great product for those of us that need sugar free items in our diet.

product_title: Rishi Tea Organic Silver Needle Loose Tea, 1.23-Ounce (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Midgrade to nearly poor silver needle tea
review_body:
I would say this is mid to poor grade silver needle tea. There is lots of small particles and pieces, I would say only about 2/3 to 1/2 are full whole leaves, the rest broken bits.

The quality and taste (and smell) of the tea is inferior to any silver needle tea I have ever had, by far. As a comparison I would give Teavana's silver needle tea about 4 to 4.5 stars while this only deserves 2, maybe 2.5 at the most.

product_title: Gevalia Coffee, 16-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Professional (Foodservice) Coffeemakers (Pack of 5)
review_body: The product pictured was not what was stated. The vendor was extremely responsive and handled the situation professionally to my full satisfaction, and also updated the advertisement to reflect what is being sold.

product_title: Jose's Whole Bean Coffee Columbia Supremo 3 Lbs
review_body: That's about all I can say.  If you like to grind your own coffee then try Jose's.  I was looking for a substitute for the Folger's lively colombian that my local store no longer carries.  This is a great coffee.  I think you'll like it too.

product_title: Sathers Farley Fruit Stripe Gum Jumbo Pack, 17-Count, Pack of 12
review_body: Fruit Stripe gum was always one of my favorite things when I was a kid. While I'm not as enthusiastic about the temporary tattoos as I once was, I still love the gum.

product_title: Light 'n Fluffy Wide Egg Noodles, 12-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_body: Hard to find real egg noodles at the supermarket sometimes, and these are the real deal.  The noodles came packaged in standard packaging, and arrived in good condition.  These are great to have around for a quick side dish, to use in soups and casseroles, or just to have a nice bowl of warm buttered noodles - my comfort food.

product_title: Ocean Spray Drink Mix Cran - Grape On The Go - 6 Pack
review_body: Had always carried home multiple containers of this product.  What a relief that I can make my own resulting in it being more mobile on the go, less space at home to store, less energy transporting and less money for the drink mix.

product_title: Swiss Miss Hot Cocoa Mix, Sensible Sweets, Light, 8 count,0.29 ounce, (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Great taste for my morning coffee at only 25 cal and 4 carbs.
review_body: It's a bit hard to tell from the listing, but this price $15.90 is for 48 envelopes in all (6 boxes of 8 each). The taste gives me the sweet chocolate for just 25 calories/envelope. No fat and no added sugar (the 4grams of carb come from skim milk powder). I'm very pleased with the product quality and the price which is MUCH less than at local grocery stores.

product_title: Tea Forte Kati Cup Star Magnolia
review_body: I bought this cup because I have a lot of loose leaf tea and a large jug for brewing.  However, I like making only a little at a time and I like variety.  The cup is very pretty and easy to use.  Nice for single brew and making iced tea.  To me the cup conducts heat - a little too much at first then it gets more tolerable.  Maybe I just have sensitive hands.  I just used the top (not the inside of the top but the top of the top) to rest the cup on and carry it around with a hand on the cup for balance.  Not sure if that is recommended as it would be easy to drop/spill if you're not careful.  Good purchase and just what I need for now.

product_title: Colcafe Instant Coffee, 7.05-Ounce (Pack of 4)
review_body: So good and at an unbeatable price. Will def be re-ordering this. If you like instant coffee but want stronger taste than your usual instant coffee, this is the one for you!

product_title: Baronet Coffee Donut Shop Blend Light Roast (140 g)
review_body: This coffee is just right for both my husband and me. I just wish this would still work to auto-ship!

product_title: Anthon Berg, Chocolate Liqueurs with Original Spirits, 64 Pieces / Gift Set
review_headline: 5 STARS for Anrhon Berg - PERFECTION on Earth
review_body: I L-O-V-E Anthon Bergs chocolates, they are AWSOME - no others can compare !!! so there lol. be happy, you cant take it with u --- ENJOY !!!

product_title: Mrocos Sex Olives- Anchovy Stuffed
review_body: When I have my occasional martini, I include dinner in the form of olives. Everybody knows how good fish is for you, so naturally, I supplement my martini with healthy olives with anchovies! I spear several--sometimes I mix blue cheese stuffed lives with the anchovy for the extra nutrition, of course. Recently, to my horror, BevMo was out of my favorite olives so in desperation I ordered these. Why the lurid name, I can't guess; what's sexy about anchovy stuffed olives? The olives arrived in a timely manner but there had been some leakage in the box, so I hope I don't die when I get around to using them.

product_title: Haribo Color-Rado Gummi Candy / 200g / 7.1oz.
review_body: That says it all. This is really good stuff. Better than anything that I've picked up in the supermarket. Just didn't buy enough.

product_title: Folgers Classic Roast Ground Coffee Canisters 33.9 oz.
review_body: shortly after i opened this canister i noticed moths in my house it took me a few days to realize they were coming from the coffee contained. i had to throw the almost full can out,i will probably never buy this product again.

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_body: Good flavor, easy to use. Would suggest them to anyone using this style coffee maker. Less expensive than some other per-packed coffee pods.

product_title: Oskri Fiber Bar, 1.9-Ounce (Pack of 20)
review_headline: Great Taste and a great dose of fiber
review_body:
I have been of fan of Oskri for a few years but I thought this item went away as it stopped coming on subscribe and save but happy to see it back. The taste is really great and for a gluten free snack it delivers for our child who needs this aspect in all food.

The 12g of fiber is roughly 50% of your daily need so it covers the fiber need with out a great deal of calories which is only 190 in the 1.9oz bar.

I would highly recommend this product to others.

product_title: Crystal Light Ruby Red Grapefruit Drink Mix (10-Quart), 3.4-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4)
review_body: We ordered this product because for some reason Kraft has elected to discontinue it.  It is by far the best Crystal Light flavor in our opinion.  We have always found it hard to find in the grocery store, it was always sold out.  We wonder why Kraft would discontinue producing such a great product.  I hope Amazon has a large supply so we can continue enjoying this drink.  We are certainly going to order more and hope Amazon can supply us!

product_title: South Beach Diet Good To Go
review_body: I really like these for a quick breakfast. They are high in protein so it fills me up. With a piece of fruit I am good to go until lunch.

product_title: Health Flavors! Savory Teriyaki nori Strips,  Made With Organic Nori, 50 Ct, .47-Ounce Bags,  (Pack of 6)
review_headline: GREAT TASTE EVEN MY DAUGHTER LOVES
review_body: Great for me and my young daughter.  When my daughter was just beginning to eat solid food, she reached for these that I was eating, and then kept asking for more.  And so she has eaten them almost daily all her life. Now at 6 yrs old, she could easily refuse to eat them but likes the taste!  About a year ago when my local health food store could not order enough product from the distributor and had to drop carrying them, I found them on Amazon. and voila! my daughter continues to eat this excellent food regularly.  I tried another flavored common brand but she did not like it. Since these are sold on Amazon only in packs of 6, you may want to try to buy one pack through a health food store first to try them for your taste.  But even if they are not your favorite, they are not a waste and well worth eating anyway.  I love them and my daughter loves them, and I love that.

product_title: Season Fillets of Mackerel in Olive Oil, 4.375-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12)
review_body: At  $3.33 a can, these are expensive for what they are, but are well worth it. The mackerel are of very high quality, are well packed, and not overcoooked or smoked. Also, since fish is the only meat I eat, I end up having a can almost every day.

product_title: Hershey's Holiday Kisses, Dark Chocolate Filled with Mint Truffle, 8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
review_body:
Let's just say I gave them away as small gifts to co-workers.

They were toooo flavored. The mint truffle was overpowering. Disappointing.

product_title: Frontier Co-op Organic Chili Powder Blend, 1 Pound Bulk Bag
review_body:
Make sure you realize this is a blend, not straight up chili powder. I totally missed this. It's like a taco seasoning blend w/cumin, oregano etc.

Also it comes in a foil bag, not like a container you can close a lid on and put away.

No complaints though, my mistake!

product_title: 16 Count - Barista Prima Coffeehouse VARIETY PACK ~ ITALIAN ROAST, FRENCH ROAST, HOUSE BLEND & COLOMBIA For KEURIG BREWERS
review_body: best coffee for the Keurig. It is the only brand that doesn't produce a watered down taste. Tastes strong like coffee should.

product_title: Skippy Reduced Fat Creamy Peanut Butter Spread 16.3 oz (Pack of 12)
review_body:
Skippy's reduced fat creamy peanut butter goes great with jelly for that classic peanut butter and jelly sandwich; and I like the taste of it even by itself for a small treat! True, some will say this doesn't taste quite right after they've eaten regular peanut butter for some while; but with my current weight issues reduced fat is the way to go for me. I also like the taste and the texture; and the expiration date on the jar is always a way off into the future so this will last awhile unless you eat it several days of the week as I do!

As of this time, you may be able to get this product cheaper in your local supermarket or elsewhere. Shop around for the best price.

Highly recommended.

product_title: Ghirardelli Chocolate Flavored Sauce, Chocolate, 87.3-Ounce Packages
review_body: it was what i needed

product_title: Road's End Organics Gluten Free Mac & Chreese Alfredo Style, Organic, 6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Pretty good, considering how healthy it is!!
review_body: I \\"doctor it up\\": Steam 2 cups of brocolli, then blend in our NutraBullet blender. Mix the broccoli in, with a few spoonfulls of coconut oil. Add garlic powder and salt to taste. My pretty picky 19 month old son gobbles it up, and I always have some too!! By the way, all added ingredients I use are organic.

product_title: Wonka Pixy Stix, Assorted Flavors 3.2 oz
review_body: My fault for not reading the ounces carefully but when I received the item and saw the size of the package that I can get for one dollar at any number of stores, I was so mad at myself! Needless to say I will read much more carefully now.

product_title: TSM Insta Cure (Prague Powder) #1, 8 oz.
review_body: I was pleasantly surprised that it came faster than it said but I wasn't pleased that it was only 8oz. I had thought it was a pound but was wrong. This seller should put how much the product weighs not what it weighs being shipped. Very dissapointing. I wouldn't have bought this if I knew it was only 8 oz.

product_title: Bobs Red Mill Oat Bran Gf, 1 lb 2 oz (pack of 2)
review_body: I'm very  happy to finally get the right oat bran! Bought the organic version before (showed up under "gluten free" search!), but this is the real stuff! I wish it was on the "subscrive and save" list...The item arrived promptly.

product_title: Nishiki Premium Rice, Medium Grain, 15-Pound Bag
review_headline: The only white rice my family eats
review_body:
Rice is something you simply cannot skimp on quality with. Nishki brand is THE BEST. I used to have to drive across town to an Asian market where the price was far too high and the employees were far too rude. Then I had to haul 15 pounds up to my apartment along with my two year old and whatever other groceries I had. Now I can just order from Amazon, save money, free shipping, and hey, someone else is paid to haul it up the stairs for me! It's great! I only wish Amazon would add a subscribe and save deal to this item.

EDIT: They added subscribe and save to this! Awesome!

product_title: Herbox Granular Sodium Free Chicken Bouillon, 3.3-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I need sodium free products.  Local stores don't carry these sodium free beverages.  The available \\"reduced sodium\\" still have too much sodium.  This stuff has no sodium and tastes good.  Can drink it all day.  Pricey, but I can live with that.

product_title: Broccoli & Cheese Rice
review_body: Wonder why my review wasn't posted a few weeks ago?  This is the best rice but after ordering it and receiving it I was amazed to see it was for only 1 package.  Are you kidding???  over 6 dollars for 1 package.  It was my fault for not checking better but why hasn't anyone else complained about this?  So I am here to inform you all its only 1 package.

product_title: Emeril's Big Easy Bold K-Cup Packs for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_headline: Not bad, but not the best.
review_body: This coffee is good but not amongst the best for the Kerig. I'd rather drink Coffee Lovers Donut Shoppe brand.

product_title: Douwe Egberts Pure Gold Instant Coffee, Medium Roast
review_headline: Great coffee that I could previously only buy in the UK
review_body: Great taste, instantly, in solid (heavy) jar.  A little more expensive than the alternatives but you will taste the difference!

product_title: Chuckles (Pack of 24)
review_body: these Chuckles were very fresh. Straight from the factory. Nice to have on hand as a treat at the end of the day.

product_title: Baronet Coffee Creme Brulee Medium Roast (140 g)
review_body: These coffee pods taste great and fit in my Senseo Coffee maker.  I am very happy with this product and have not experienced any issues with overflow or poor taste.

product_title: KRAVE Beef Jerky, Garlic Chili Pepper , 3.25 Ounce
review_body:
I'm a fan of beef jerky and really wanted to try some flavors outside the range you find at a garden variety grocery store. I think I should've made a more adventurous choice, because this was simply a moderately peppered beef jerky. I was expecting a more obvious garlic flavor along with the spice, so I was disappointed not to be able to distinguish it. It was a little on the drier side in my opinion, though one reviewer found it to be too moist. I've only had this once, so I'm not sure if they or I got an off/unique bag, if this company's product is inconsistent, or if myself and the other reviewer simply have different definitions of what \\"moist\\" beef jerky is. I gave it three stars because it's not a BAD peppered beef jerky; it just didn't live up to my expectations or the price tag.

Overall, I wouldn't recommend buying this particular flavor at all if you're looking for something unique. I won't be trying this brand again unless I can find it being sold for $5 or less.

product_title: Harney and Sons Sencha Tea
review_body: It certainly is a best green tea I have ever had. I would usually put two tea bags of any other green tea in a small cup and this Japanese Sencha is so strong that I typically add extra water to each cup. Taste is amazingly good as well; its quite smooth and yet very strong and tasteful. I don't buy it from Amazon though - our neighborhood grocery store Giant sells it for 1/3rd the price. I have tried tea from almost all the companies and have found Harney and Sons to be the best.

product_title: San Francisco Bay OneCup, Decaf French Roast
review_body: I had never heard of this brand of coffee before my sister told me about it.  Not only does it taste wonderfully rich and robust, it's K-cup design is most unique and really does seem to be more environmentally friendly.  If I have to give it any \\"negative\\"remarks, the only one that I come up with is that you have to store the K-cups in an airtight container (which is not included) in order to maintain freshness. (But every time I open that container, the scent is heavenly!)

product_title: Crystal Light Peach Tea Drink Mix
review_headline: very good but no savings anymore
review_body:
Of all the flavors of Crystal Light, this is the flavor that no one in our family has gotten tired of.
Especially in the summer served cool it absolutely hits the spot.
Unforntunately it seems that this popularity reflects in the Amazon price, as it has become one of the more expensive Crystal Light flavors on Amazon, and after shipping there are no more savings when compared to our local markets. I used to have in as a standing order as I got a good deal on Amazon, now it is no different than the regular markets, even more expensive than the sales that markets offer.

product_title: True Lemon Raspberry Lemonade 10-count (Pack of 6)
review_body: Good natural alternative to other powdered drinks with artificial sweeteners that can give you headaches. Any con is that it clumped up a little, but with a little more stirring, you can get rid of the clumps.

product_title: Mary's Gone Crackers, Crackers
review_body: I've been on a gluten-free diet for about five years now.  These are my favorite crackers because they are tasty, filling, and they have enough whole grain and protein that they don't cause spikes in blood sugar like most other types of GF crackers and other baked goods (many GF flours are very high in simple carbohydrates).  (I also like the Lundberg rice crackers (all brown rice and other flavors).)  I made the 'mistake' of asking my husband to try them (who isn't GF) and now they are his favorite crackers too.  We go through a lot of them so we often buy them from Amazon.  Be prepared when you buy them in the large quantity from Amazon that there is more breakage than if you buy them at the grocery store.  They ship them in a box with no padding.  However, they cost quite a bit less here.

product_title: Bella Sun Luci,Sun Dried Tomato Pesto w/ Whole Pine Nuts, 6.5 Ounce Jar
review_body: Needed it for a ladies book club and it was perfect on top of sliced cucumbers and goat cheese.  The perfect finger food..mmmm

product_title: Metromint Water, 16.9-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_body: This product is sooo cool and refreshing.  It is giving yourself a reward without a penalty of calories or guilt.  I don't know how they do it, but its magic in a bottle!

product_title: El Azteca Chileta Elote, 40-Count Candies (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Not sure what flavor it is?!?
review_body:
I don't know what it tastes like. My mouth is still reeling.

My friend Mary gave it a sniff and tore into it like a ravenous dog. She suggests biting vs licking.

I dont know if I like it or not.

Get someone to try it and have your camera ready.

product_title: Sparkling ICE Spring Water, 17 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: this is a perfect product for someone who wants to lost weight as this drink is 0 calorie and the taste is just fabulous.

product_title: ROCKLINE BASKET COFFEE FILTERS
review_body: They are bigger than expected, thicker than anything I could find locally and waaaay waaaaaaaaaay cheaper than anything I could get here in Kenya. They are packaged well, and will last a long time. It's rare a product ends up being above expectations.

product_title: Twinings Herbal Tea, Pomegranate & Raspberry, 20 Count Bagged Tea (6 Pack)
review_body: This would be a little too sweet for me to drink straight, so I double it up with a black tea bag (usually Twinings English Afternoon Tea), and it is perfect for my taste.

product_title: Five Sugar Free Gum, Flare Warming Cinnamon, 3 15-Piece Packages (Pack of 5)
review_body: Not sure what the other reviewer was upset about - I've ordered this gum from this particular seller a number of times and it tastes great. This is my favorite gum and for some reason it is impossible to find in NYC.

product_title: Baby Gourmet Organic Simple Purees Stage 1(6 Months+) Baby Food, 4.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)
review_body: The first selling point of this product is the handy squeeze pouch for the baby food. Easily squeezed out, it is easier than using a new spoon every time you take some baby food out of a jar. Still, I wonder how much remains in the pouch when it appears empty. I personally can't vouch for the taste. My daughter enjoyed the food, though she rejected it the first time. I like the fact that it is organic, so I know what my ddaughter is eating. I would certainly use this again.

product_title: Ferrero Raffaello Almond Coconut Treats in a Gift Box (Pack of 45)
review_body: I recently bought a handful at the local Lucky's, and gave them to my father as a welcome home gift. Turns out, those were rancid. Frustrated, I came to Amazon to look. I found them but hesitated buying them because a) it's a large order, and b) what if they're rancid? I have never had trouble with Amazon's return policy so I took a chance. They turned out to be perfect! I gave my father the whole box as an apology for trying to feed him rancid chocolate. He was thrilled.  They arrived in perfect condition and are individually wrapped, so that seems to keep them fresher for longer. He stored them in the fridge - so I would recommend that to keep the coconut fresher for longer.

product_title: Snickers Pumpkin Singles, 1.1-Ounce (Pack of 18)
review_body: they were not only festive but most delicious.  i am now a new snickers fan.  the combination of the chocolate, nuts and caramel are now my favorite.  thank you.

product_title: Tuscan Sun Imported  Grapeseed Oil, 33.8-Ounce Round Tins (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Tuscan Sun Imported Grapeseed Oil, 33.8-Ounce Round Tins (Pack of 4)
review_body: I have ordered this product more than once.  We love it.  It has a high smoke tolerance meaning you can use hotter temperatures without smoking and burning.  The product is also great for making home beauty care products, or just using it as a moisturizer for your skin.  It's quickly absorbed and not greasy.  We love the taste of fried foods cooked in Tuscan Grapeseed Oil.

product_title: Sugar-Free All Natural Sour Candies
review_body: Great if you like really, REALLY sour candy. Kinda' wish they'd tone it down a notch. Maybe cannot do without sugar.

product_title: Bella Terra 8 Whole Grain Penne, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: I stumbled upon this pasta and have never looked back.  Apart from being very healthy, it is truly delicious tasting.  Both of my children love it, also, which is what got it's final stamp of approval.  I have not been able to find it in my local stores, not even in Whole Foods, so I always order it on-line in bulk, but it stays & it's actually great to have something quick and easy to have around.

product_title: Horizon Organic Low Fat Organic Milk Box Plus DHA Omega-3
review_body: My daughter loves milk, but this is her favorite! I love to drink the chocolate as well!Its also cheaper buying it in bulk..

product_title: Mestemacher Organic Bread, 12.3 Ounce, 9 Count
review_body: the bread is fresh and wrapped to last a long time.  I find it good for cheese or pastrami sandwiches

product_title: Melitta JuniorCoffe Filters
review_body:
I had purchased the Melitta 200 pack Brown Filters 10-12 months earlier in my local NJ Supermarket (SHOPRITE).

So when I ordered these from AMAZON I expected the same quality.

The former filters were average thickness, like you see with the white ones. Moderately sturdy.

These are almost tissue thin. On removing the 2nd or 3rd one, because the thinness makes it more difficult to to remove and seperate it from the others; the basket shape was lost because it was so thin.

I was still able to use it and I have removed a few more from the pack since this one and it didn't lose it's shape.

So I really can't say if the thinness has actually affected it's use. Perhaps being thinner might even let more of the coffee flavor through - but it's just an assumption.

So if you want savings over buying these in the supermarket where when not on sale they are more than $3 per pack, this would be a worthwhile deal.

review_headline: Great flavor for a grated Parmesan cheese!

When I think of grated parmesan from a jar, I think of caustic tasting kind that comes in a green can. I decided to try Delallo cheese based on the great reviews on Amazon. I'm glad I did, because it's really good! The flavor isn't as deep as you would get in a freshly grated cheese, but it's pretty good for a canned cheese. The flavor is a little milder and doesn't have that harsh aftertaste that I detect from the one in the green can. It's more nutty, less sharp. I don't think it would make a good substitute for fresh grated in recipes where the Parmesan flavor should be more pronounced, but I think it's perfect for topping pasta.

Note that this isn't pure grated cheese. It contains corn flour and cellulose to prevent the cheese from caking. Potassium sorbate is added to prevent loss of flavor.

product_title: Ovaltine Malt Drink 300g Jar
review_headline: Captain Midnight, you lied to me!
review_body:
I can still remember Captain Midnight sitting there in the uniform of an astronaut of the 50's (khaki shirt and black four-in-hand tie) telling me solemnly that I should drink my Ovaltine because it tasted good and it was good for me. It was, after all, brown and that meant it had to be chocolate, my favorite flavor.

What the Uranus traveler never told me was that they were crystals that would sit at the top of the warm milk and never dissolve. Furious stirring with a metal tool called a spoon didn't do it, nor did trying to grind them up against the side of the cup. Even using a tenderizer tool didn't work as I soon discovered that as you pushed it down the cup, the warm milk came up and out. You had to compromise by trying to round up the little critters on the spoon and that offered little comfort as the crunchy buggers didn't taste all that great anyway. To top it off, all you had left was warm milk.

The jar of Ovaltine was also very resilient. It lasted a long time in our home. It was the same one. Even my father who liked the \\"old standbys\\" of Shredded Wheat and Corn Flakes we never ate, didn't go near this stuff.

I only recommend this for those who have lost their taste buds through constant sword swallowing or that fire breathing trick.

Captain Midnight, you lied to me!

Good stuff. I hope you like it.

They won't hold a candle to fresh, and also take a back seat to a good quality dried mushroom, but for dishes where the mushroom is not the star (such as a pizza topping), these are not bad.

review_body:

The T-Scorps were waiting for me yesterday when we got back from a 2 /12 week vacation. I cut the bottom tip off of one of the (as advertised) very fresh T-S peppers provided, and... \\"well nah, not that hot. Hmmm, maybe they're not \\"as labeled\\".\\" Did I pick a bum steer here?\\"

---

Fast forward to tonight -- I cut the same pepper in half and sampled some of the flesh (and a couple seeds) \\"further up\\" the fruit. ... ... Holy Criminy (note: that was not the first expletive to come to mind, but I've sanitized it for the GP) these are hot babies! I haven't had fresh Bhuts, but these are definitely in the same neighborhood, but speak in a different, and I think hotter, language. My face hurts a little bit right now, like it hasn't before with habs or Bhuts or anything else 8^) .

I'm looking forward to making some salsa with a *fraction* of one of these things!

If you Like It Hot, I can't imagine you'll be disappointed. If you're not sure if you like Hot, walk on by; nothing to see here.

Finally: If you eat a whole one, please post a video of your reaction and link it here!

cheers,

Dave
Certified Idiot

product_title: Frontier Natural Products Organic Stevia Herb -- 16 oz
review_headline: Try it as a culinary herb!
review_body:
I first learned about stevia when my local organic grower offered it in his line of herb seedlings. I bought one plant to try in my herb garden and when it got big enough to start harvesting from, I started trying it in different dishes. I loved it. Summer is over, the frosts have come, and the plant is long used up but I got so addicted to it that I went looking for dried stevia to get me through the winter. This 1-lb bag of powdered stevia from Frontier was the best I could find. It's works well as a substitute for the fresh leaves -- as long as you use it sparingly.

I use fresh or dried stevia wherever I use basil, such as pasta and couscous dishes with vegetables or mushrooms -- use both basil and stevia. Stevia complements lemon juice very well when that's one of the ingredients. For a quick sauce, I mix the dried stevia with a bit of olive oil and drizzle it on pasta or cheese ravioli. Yum! I mix the dried stevia with a bit of water in the bottom of a casserole dish, add peeled and chopped sweet potatoes, stir, and bake (spoon the juice over the potatoes a few times while they're baking). I even use the dried stevia in oatmeal (*real* oatmeal, which is rolled or steel cut oats, soaked in water, and cooked, not that awful powdery stuff that comes in a packet, contains xanthin gum, and has the consistency of glue once cooked).

Just remember that a little stevia goes a long way. It has a very intense flavor. Start with a 1/4 teaspoon and work your way up to the taste you like.

I would NOT recommend this as a \\"sugar substitute\\" for baking. It's not going to dissolve and blend like granulated sugar.

review_body:
Eat. Think. Smile. Granola Clusters, Cranberry Walnut, 12-Ounce Pouches

...hard and crunchy -- so much so, one might just use Eat. Think. Smile. Granola Clusters, Cranberry Walnut to clean the tarter off their teeth -- like a carrot.

Never one to shy away from trying something new, if a snack product boasts of being all natural and antioxidant -- on the front of the package --, it usually ends up in my shopping cart, especially of late, 'cuz that's the way I roll. :)

Eat. Think. Smile. Granola Clusters, Cranberry Walnut was an especially nice surprise, as I found it to be dry and crunchy, not messy and sticky (which is a big \\"plus\\" in warmer weather), with an extraordinarily satisfying cocoa/cranberry/walnut taste -- that did not leave me feeling bloated/over stuffed, if ya know what I mean.

The extra thick zip-lock like re sealable bag really came in handy, as I was tempted to eat more than one of the 10 portions contained in the bag. It is that good! :)

Cons: Although extraordinarily delicious, Granola Clusters, Cranberry Walnut nuggets seemed a bit hard to chew -- but that may be subjective -- as I have very expensive dental work that I tend to be overly cautious about -- , so I won't deduct a \\"star\\" for that.

You might also like to try a couple of other Eat. Think. Smile.
products that I've reviewed and thoroughly enjoyed: [[ASIN:B005BPVB9S Eat. Think. Smile. Crispy Thins, Sweet Cinnamon]] and [[ASIN:B005BPVA08 Eat. Think. Smile. Crispy Thins, Savory Sea Salt]]. I can't make up my mind which variety I enjoy more... Highly Recommended! --Katharena Eiermann, 2012

product_title: Traditional Irish Breakfast Links. 1lb x 5 packs
review_headline: Tasty Bangers, but shipping/packaging issues detract
review_body:
Our family loved the breakfast sausages that we had in Ireland, so I wanted to see if I could find them here. Tommy Maloney seems to be the leader in the States.

My family and I really enjoyed the Moloney's sausages. Made in NY, they have much the same flavor and texture of the real thing in Ireland. I couldn't taste a difference. Note that these bangers are of the skinny variety -- about finger thickness. They brown up nicely in the skillet and have a satisfying snap when bitten. If you want thicker bangers, Maloney has those as well. We ordered five of the skinny link packages and two 8oz. tubes of the black pudding (also good, if you like black pudding of course).

While we love the product, there is room for improvement in shipping. Our first shipment came on time, shipped by 2nd day air. Unfortunately, the meat arrived at a temperature of over 65 degrees Fahrenheit, not a safe temperature, so I had to discard the shipment. I should note that the temperatures in Texas at the time my shipment arrived were over 100 degrees F, and the package sat in the UPS truck all day long before being delivered to me. The meat was shipped in a cardboard box with a reflective bubble-wrap type of insulating bag. Inside of the bag were fully thawed ice packs and four fully-evaporated dry ice bags. The insulation just wasn't up to the challenge.

I called Maloney's and received friendly customer service. They promised that they would reship the sausages when they could (they only ship to Texas on Mondays). I requested that they ship with more dry ice and insulation.

The replacement package arrived as promised at a safe temperature. Still only one bubble-type insulating bag, but with extra dry ice bags. The dry ice had completely evaporated, but the standard ice packs were still mostly frozen.

Maloney's has a great product, but shipping & packaging is critical to their mail-order customers. I'd suggest some improvements. First, consider double bagging the shipments in the bubble wrap or using styrofoam. Both of my shipments had a lot of condensation on the outside of the bubble wrap which made the cardboard box soggy. A lot of condensation on the reflective bubble wrap means that the bag isn't doing a good job insulating. I've had luck getting frozen pizzas and other meats shipped to me in styrofoam boxes with no problems. Styrofoam is probably more expensive, but when shipping in the summer, especially to the South, styrofoam is the right tool for the job. Second, consider using more dry ice; the dry ice isn't surviving for the two-day trip. Third, the plastic containers on three of the five sausage packages were cracked open in shipment. The plastic containers are too brittle to be stacked in a shipping box without some other kind of protection or support (cardboard, perhaps?). The cracked containers meant that juices from the sausages leaked into the bottom of the insulating bag, which made things a bit messy and required me to repackage the sausages for storage. Ultimately though, the sausages were delicious.

Summing up, I love the product, and will order it again. If you miss your full Irish breakfast, now you can get it in the States. Customer service is great. Shipping, at least to hot parts of the country, could be improved. I hope that Tommy Maloney takes my suggestions in mind for its future shipments.

review_body:
Narnia???

I first had Turkish delight while I was in Turkey. There, shops produce Turkish delight and hundreds of other exotic treats fresh. Every town of more than a few thousand people seems to have at least one of these shops. The sweetness of Turkish delight varies by shop in its native homeland, and this confection is a fine example, so long as one doesn't eat all that sugar sifting around in the box. I think there's so much so it will act as a natural preservative.

If you can't fit a quick trip Turkey to get the genuine article hand-made fresh, then this is the best imported substitute I've tried. I wouldn't trust getting something like this from a regular retailer because of potential shelf-life issues, and I wouldn't trust confections obtained from a discount clothing outlet, but on-line through Amazon I trust.

Tangentially, if you like Turkish delight, you owe it to yourself to visit the country of origin, because there's many other delicious Turkish confections you probably haven't experienced.

review_headline: Some really great and some really really bad
review_body:
Diet Cranberry Raspberry - The BEST flavor I've tried yet. It's just sweet enough, great flavor, and calorie free. I always have at least three bottles of this in my cabinet at all times.

Orange - Very sweet but good. I'm not a fan of orange soda so that's probably the only reason I don't love this.

Lemon-Lime - Again, very sweet. It has a good sprite-type flavor though so I went ahead and tried the diet version as well to see if that would be a staple in our house.

Diet Lemon-Lime - It's not an all time favorite but it's good. I have a bottle of this usually for whenever I'm craving something different or something a bit more refreshing and I'm tired of plain water.

Cream Soda - WAY too strong. I love cream soda and so I didn't expect any issues with it but just the smell when opening the bottle was enough to make me slightly sick to my stomach. And I'm not exaggerating. I actually threw out the entire bottle after one sip. It has an almost alcoholish undertone to it that doesn't help at all. Gross.

Root Beer - Not even close to as bad as the cream soda but slightly reminiscent. I did drink the entire sample that came with the Sodastream but do not plan to buy a bottle of it even though I am a huge fan of root beer.

Cola - I bought this to act as an emergency back up for when my husband wanted a rum and coke and didn't have any coke in the house. It tastes a bit like off-brand diet cola to me, probably because of the Splenda. This is very off-putting only because there is so many calories in this and you don't even get a calorie-laden taste. Hahaha. This will continue to be held for those emergencies but we won't be drinking it by itself at all.

Grape - This one actually surprised me because I was so prepared not to like it. It's a bit on the sweet side but still much better than many others. I've been putting about 1/4th the amount of syrup in less than called for and it helps cut the sweetness a bit but after that it starts to make the flavor taste watered down. I wish I could find a diet version of this. Not sure if it exists or not but I can't find it on Amazon if it does.

I'll update this as I try more. I am cautiously optimistic about the diet ginger ale so that will be my next purchase.etness a bit but after that it starts to make the flavor taste watered down. I wish I could find a diet version of this. Not sure if it exists or not but I can't find it on Amazon if it does.

I'll update this as I try more. I am cautiously optimistic about the diet ginger ale so that will be my next purchase.

review_body: Im trying to cut back on bread and rice cakes is the solution for us.  Buying by the case is certainly a cost saver, the taste is fine but it is so crumbly that I loose a third before I can eat it.  I toast mine--always, otherwise it taste like paper.

review_headline: If I Could Turn Back Time!!!

product_title: Blooming Tea Gift Box - 15 Blooming Teas and a 12 Oz Glass Tea Brewing Tumbler
review_body: I am so happy to have bought this tumbler.  It is very handy to have around and works beautifully.  I whole-heartedly recommend this product to anyone looking for a convenient tea-making device.  I love the blooming bulbs and how you can see them while it brews! :)

product_title: Happy Munchies Apple & Kale, Organic Puffed Corn Snacks 8 (1.4 oz.)
review_body: My son is a big fan of the HappyFamily snacks, especially the Puffs and organic broccoli, kale and cheddar cheese munchies. So it didn't surprise me when I introduced to him the apple and kale croc shaped snacks that he LOVED them. He now prefers these over the puffs and other munchies! And I have to admit, I love them too! They make a great snack for the both of us. What's different about these is that the apple gives these munchies a sweeter taste, in my opinion. Like the other munchies and puffs, they dissolve very quickly in the mouth so I'm never worried about him choking. I love that he and I can eat a snack that is tasty but that has no fat, very low in sugar, and full of vitamins and choline! As a mom of a 16 month old, I definitely recommend them!

product_title: Plochman's Yellow Squeeze Mustard, 19-Ounces Squeeze Barrel (Pack of 6)
review_body:

product_title: Quaker Soft Baked Oatmeal Cookie, Raisins, 8.8 Ounce
review_body: I received the Soft Baked Oatmeal Cookie in my Influenster Mom Vox Box and I saw the cookie sitting right on top, so of course I opened it and tried it out! This cookie was so soft and chewy that I am totally buying more as snacks for my little cookie monster!

product_title: Kenco Millicano Whole Bean Instant Coffee (85g)
review_body: I found Kenco coffee when visiting the UK.  Their regular instant coffee is good and unlike any of the US instants I've tried.  But the Millicano is really, really good!  It smells like fresh ground coffee when you open the bag and for a quick coffee its the best.  Making a pot of coffee just for one person isn't cost effective so I always use the Millicano.  I'm so glad I can buy it on Amazon.

product_title: Honey New Zealand Manuka Active 6+ Infusionz, Honey Infusionz Blueberry, 1.1-Pounds (Pack of 3)
review_body: Combining Blueberries with honey creates a breakfast spread that has neither the tartness sometimes associated with blueberries or the excessive sweetness of honey.  It has a nice spreadable consistency. I bought the one jar on the shelf at a grocery outlet store.

product_title: Wickles Pickles
review_body: When i first tried these i was hooked. I love spicy food and they are the best right out of the jar. Here is a tip for when you finish them though, save the jar of pickle juice and put cut cucumber in there and put the lid on tight and leave it in the fridge for a month or so, and you just made another batch of wickles. product_title: Quaker Soft Baked Oatmeal Cookie, Raisins, 8.8 Ounce
review_body: When I first opened the package, I felt like a little kid again!  The cookie smelled just like the creamy oatmeal cookies my mom used to make when I was little!  I did not used to get heartburn as a little kid, though, and there was the drawback!  My tummy is just too tender for those crazy oats!

product_title: Nutiva Hi Fiber Hemp Protein Powder - 16 OZ
review_headline: Tastes fine but very difficult to digest
review_body: I mixed 2 tablespoons of this into my morning smoothie. I had no problems with the flavor, taste, or texture. Unfortunately my experience with this is that it is very difficult for my body to break down and digest. I would recommend getting a sample first and seeing how your body reacts to it.

product_title: Haldiram Soan Papdi(premium ,250gm)
review_body: This is one of my favorite Indian sweets & this brand is as close to a homemade taste as you can get without making it yourself. For Americans unfamiliar with Indian sweets, the best analogy I can give you for soan papdi is that it tastes & feels similar to the inside of a very soft, very fresh Butterfinger... except the nuts used for flavoring are pistachio and almond instead of peanut. It also has about 1/10 the calories and melts in your mouth. Loooove it!

product_title: Crawfords Garibaldi Biscuits, 100 Gram (Pack of 12)
review_body: I like these biscuits and will buy them again.  However, they are not as tasty as the old Sunshine Raisin Biscuits.  They are a bit dry.  You will need a cup of tea (or coffee) nearby.

product_title: MIO Green Thunder, 1.62-Ounce (Pack of 4)
review_body: MIO Energy is very good, but after a few weeks of using it once a day no longer works. I guess my body has adapted quickly to the ingredients!

review_body:

review_body: I've picked these up in the store occasionally and I've always enjoyed them. The ones I ordered on Amazon got here fairly quickly, they tasted great, weren't old or anything and overall the pricing really isn't too bad compared to buying them in the store or a gas station. product_title: Menraku Shoyu Ramen, 2.7-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_headline: One of my favorite styles of Japanese ramen
review_body: For the longest time, I've found it difficult to justify blowing $3 on a bowl of instant ramen. Sure, the stuff's imported and most of what you're paying for is the cost of shipping from Japan. You can also get pretty decent domestic bowl ramen for around $1 a bowl. But since most of the ramen bowls coming from SoCal are Korean made (i.e., spicy), it's difficult to find a decent mild flavored Japanese ramen bowl. Menraku Shoyu is mildly flavored (just soy sauce) and not painfully salty like Nongshim, so I don't have to throw out half the flavor packet. The texture of the noodles has a nice bit to it. I don't get these very often since they're relatively expensive, but you get what you paid for. Highly recommended if you want a real Japanese style ramen and want a subtle flavor that isn't spicy.

product_title: Frontier Chili Peppers Ground, Cayenne 90,000 Hu, 16 Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)
review_body: its much hotter than typical cayenne pepper and the hotness lingers longer to....the price from amazon.com is great and shipping was fast as usual,these 2 bags will last me a while!

product_title: Eight O'Clock Coffee, Bokar Blend Whole Bean, 12-Ounce Bag (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Excellent coffee.. that has been DISCONTINUED by Eight O'Clock!!!
review_body:
EDIT: Recently got a cancellation notice from Amazon. Bokar coffee is no longer available! I called Eight O'Clock and sure enough, \\"management\\" made a decision to discontinue Bokar coffee. Call, write, email Eight O'Clock and tell them to continue this excellent coffee!

First off I really like this coffee. I ordered a 6-pack in February and subscribed to have 6 sent every 3 months. That first 6 bags I received in February, 3 months ago, and expire in January 2013, \\"1/23/13\\" on the bags. This second batch I just received expires October 2012! This newly received second shipment is 3 months older than the first! This is odd since Amazon had it on back-order for a while. A friend was not able to order any a few weeks ago because it was on order. I called Eight O'Clock and they verified the dates show the shipment I just received was roasted in Oct 2011, 3 months before the first shipment that I received in February that was roasted in January 2012! (No wonder it tasted so good. Was less than a month old!) The rep at Eight O'Clock advised me to ask Amazon what their distribution is because they had no explanation. OK... Hey Amazon! What's up with your distribution causing these delays?

product_title: One Dozen Rainbow Roses (with FREE glass vase) - Flowers
review_headline: these guys suck.... save your money and go to the grocery store

i was out of the country and decided to use these guys since they advertise extensively and were here on amazon as well. i sent a mothers day bouquet for over $100 and my wife was very happy and thankful. review_body: I am not a huge fan of chocolate, so I typically purchase fruit-and-nut type snack bars. These are made with dark chocolate, though - and LOTS of it! I know that dark chocolate is supposed to be good for you, so I tried these and liked them a lot. The only problem was that my wife and daughter are HUGE fans of chocalate, especially dark chocolate, and these bars were gone all-too-quickly. Very much recommended for the dark chocolate lover!

product_title: Stonewall's Jerquee
review_body: I've tried two flavors - Pepperoni and Original Wild - and have enjoyed them both.  The texture's pretty good - nice and chewy.  The moisture level is okay, but it could be improved by being just a tiny bit more moist. There's also a little bit of an aftertaste (which I didn't find to be unpleasant, but some might).  The spice level on the Pepperoni and Original Wild flavors were perfect. The Original Wild was medium hot, so it might be a little too much for some.  I loved it though.  I recommend that people try to buy this locally before spending a lot of money on it.  I bought mine from a local vegan store online, then discovered that a large grocery chain carries it in their health food section.

product_title: McCormicks Grill Mates Seasoning
review_body: My family loves this spice mix.  It is not spicy (hot) - it is a mild flavor with a definite emphasis on sweet.  First couple ingredients are sugar.  Be careful not to burn your food - sugars burn easily.  I use pre-mixed spice rub as well as make my own.  Great on pork chops and hamburgers.  I am sure it would be great on ribs as well.

review_body: Very nice packaging. Had a strong flavor to me at first but I've acquired a taste for it after using it a couple times and I rather like it and I am quite pleased with my purchase. Would definitely order it again.

product_title: Larabar Gluten Free Bar
review_body: I was trying to find some healthy breakfast/snack options that I could throw in my bag on my way to work.  I love KIND bars and heard really great things about Larabars.  After doing a little research, I found that Lemon seemed like a popular choice that I might like best.  I went ahead and bought a box, knowing that I wouldn't be the only one eating these at home.  I opened my first Lemon Larabar for breakfast this morning and was surprised at how much I didn't like it.  I am pretty dissapointed.  Way too tangy and the texture of the bar itself is awful.  It is a really dense squishy date square with tiny bits of almond and cashew in it.  The lemon extract is pretty overpowering too.  There is a part of me that wants to just get used to these things, because now I have a whole box of them at home.  Totally a bad idea.  I don't have any desire to try the other flavors if the texture is this way with all of them.  KIND bars are way more substantial and much better tasting. I'm going to stick with those.

product_title: O.N.E. 100% Natural Coconut Water, 33.8 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Review of Amazon-Shipping=2; But O.N.E. Drink = 5
review_body:
-- If you buy this from Amazon, you'll be disappointed at the shipping. My box of 12 came in one cardboard box, with the 12 container-boxes loosely in a plastic bag. product_title: Special K Low Fat Granola Cereal, 19.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 5)
review_headline: A fan for a variety of reasons..(taste, price, health-wise), a little sugary
review_body:
My criteria for a good breakfast cereal:

1. Low fat(I usually don't like more than 3 grams of fat per serving)
2. Low price (I usually look for cereal on sale for no more than $3 per 15-16 oz box)
3. Healthy and filling (not overly sweet or chemically fruity. Also I like it oak-y (as opposed to flakes" and bulky/chunky. So I gravitate towards granola type cereals. It is a little on the sweet side for my taste, but not over-powering (I removed 2 stars for it, but it's more of a personal preference kind of thing. I'm guessing this might not be too sweet for other people).

So, this cereal is 4 to 4.5 stars for all criteria. Although I would like a little dried fruit in it, I definitely am not complaining. It has a great taste and is very filling. Also good to snack on right out of the box. If you get this on subscribe and save, it's $3/box (and each box is a bulky 1 lb + 3.5 oz Awesome)! This cereal normally goes for over $5/ box in NYC when it isn't on sale, so this is a real bargain.

review_body: Costco does sell them, just not all the Costco's. I'm in San Diego and have bought some in one location, then it disappears only to reappear in another location. They used to be $13 but now are $16 in the store (for those members who might be curious). Just bought a few 2 days ago in the store. You can also rinse them, but I found they absorb a lot of the water even if you let them sit out to dry. Others have recommmended washing them and then putting them in the oven for a few minutes. Worth the effort though. I like salt but holy cow these are consistently over the line.

product_title: Barr's Irn-Bru
review_body:
I recently decided that I wanted to try different sodas that were less common or from around the world. After seeing Irn-Bru on a few occasions, I decided to try it first. It definitely helps too that it isn't outrageously expensive like some are on here.

Anyway, I received it this past Friday while at work, so when I got home, it was sitting there, still warm. I was so excited to try it that I went ahead and drank one warm.

DO NOT do this. Not because it's bad per se, but it is much, much, MUCH better cold.

As far as the flavor goes, it's hard to describe. The label says it is citrus...yeah, so it Sprite. Citrus is as generic a term for soda as \\"rock\\" is for music. But the best way I think I can describe it is it is like a mix between citrus (a mix of orange, lime, and lemon) cream and bubble gum.

One thing I also noticed, aside from the fact that it is extremely sweet, it is a very heavy drink. Whenever I would drink it, it would make me feel full pretty quickly.

Overall, I definitely would have it again, but only as an occasional thing. I do recommend trying it if you're looking for something different.

review_body: You must taste it for yourself. It has a floral sweet scent, and the taste is creamy and rich. It's almost like the best Earl Grey with something added. It's excellent. This is now my go-to cuppa!

product_title: Lipton Tea and Honey Iced Tea Mix
review_body:
I'm sure everyone is familiar with powdered water flavoring packets. You just add them to a nice bottle of water, and you're set! It's convenient and easy! Well, that's what we have here - yet another contender in the powdered drink mix market. In terms of being a powdered drink mix, it's okay. The packets open easily enough. The only think I've noticed is that it takes longer to dissolve than some other ones I've tried in the past, but not excessively so. It's also fairly low calorie, which is nice. I'm sure you're all wondering, though, \\"is it any good?\\"

Well, at the end of the day, it all comes down to taste. This is where it goes wrong. It's got a slightly unpleasant undertone of bitterness and sourness to it that I didn't like. I mean, it's not the most foul thing I've ever drank, but it's not the best either. It sort of tastes like fake strawberries and fake honey, which is strange because it claims to be made with \\"real ingredients\\". Oh, and even though it's supposedly sweetened with honey, it has added sucralose to it. Go figure.

Honestly, I'm starting to wonder if tea is something that was just meant to be brewed like normal instead of condensed down into a dissolvable powder. In fact, the best \\"to go\\" packet drinks I've had were blatantly fake, but at least they tasted good. So, do I recommend this drink powder? Well, if you want a convenient drink powder, then I'd try some other brand. Although you might like the taste better than I did, so I guess you'll just have to try it yourself! If you just want tea, then you might be better off just making a big batch of tea and pouring it into some bottles.
