CONS:
- Packaging may be convenient, but produces a lot of waste. NOT environmentally friendly.
- Plastic cover top which seals the apple portion doesn't pull off with as much ease as it seems it would. Go slowly and carefully or you'll have a sticky apple mess all over the place.
- Can be heated to make it even tastier, but I don't like to microwave in plastic.

FLAVOR:
I was surprised at how little of an apple flavor there was. I mostly just tasted a sugary sweetness that was a little too much. There was a hint of cinnamon. The crunchy oat topping was very tasty, though. The whole oats made me feel more like I was eating something healthy. The brown sugar in the topping made it even better.

OVERALL OPINION:
For 160 calories and 20g of sugar, this isn't a snack I eat daily. It's also pricey, and for how much it costs, I wish it had a better apple flavor. Maybe if they backed down the sugar, those apples would have a fighting chance! I do still recommend this for an occasional convenience factor.

product_title: Trader Joe's Dark Chocolate Sea Salt Caramels
review_body: I wish Trader Joe's sold these dark chocolate sea salt caramels all year long because they are absolutely the best chocolates readily available at a reasonable price in America. The dark chocolate outside is thick and hard (if stored properly), so it's not just a one-pop soft truffle. The caramel is rich and thick and the sea salt is the perfect thing on top. Yum. I ordered it online for my mom's September birthday because I know it's her favorite.

product_title: Fantasicakes Large (10"/ 3 Lbs.) Gourmet Triple Chocolate Bundt Cake
review_body: The Fantasicake triple chocolate bundt cake is divine, beyond heavenly! I was not sure what the texture would be like because these scrumptious cakes are shipped to your home. When my cake arrived we put it in the freezer for a few days because we had birthday cake that night for my son's birthday. I wish now we had served this cake instead! I took it out of the freezer and thawed it. Fantasicakes triple chocolate bundt cake is rich but not over done and moist. Included is a pack of chocolate icing to drizzle on it and the portion was just perfect. I recommend this cake for any special occasion or just  because you want a great cake. I am planning on ordering one of the coffee cakes and possibly a torte too from Fantasicakes!

product_title: Black Garlic 1.27 oz (2 bulbs)
review_headline: Black Garlic: Garlic meets sweet  molases flavor
review_body: Introducing a simple food with a wonderfully complex flavor. Black garlic is sweet meets savory, a perfect mix of molasses-like richness and tangy garlic undertones. It has a tender, almost jelly-like texture with a melt-in-your-mouth consistency similar to a soft dried fruit. Hard to believe, but true. It's as delicious as it is unique.    vs. Raw Garlic  Imagine garlic without all of the annoying stuff. Bad breath? Nope. Pungent odor? Nope. Acrid bite? No sir. You know how a great wine gets better with age? That's what we're dealing with here.    It's Healthy  In Taoism mythology, black garlic was rumored to grant immortality. We can't promise you that, but there's no doubt that black garlic is great for your health--it's loaded with nearly twice as many antioxidants as raw garlic. It also contains S-Allycysteine, which is fancy talk for a natural compound that has been proven to be a factor in cancer prevention.  From [...]  Mondo foods is an amazing shipper.  They got it to my FPO/AE address (Military Postal address overseas) in less than 7 days!

product_title: No Oodles Zero Carb, Zero Calorie Shirataki Noodles Angel Hair
review_body: Tried this product and I could not get past the texture, smell or taste. Will never purchase again! Even after rinsing the fishy smell is awful. Even prepared with meat and seasonings and still could not get past the texture. I recommend to not purchase this item.

product_title: Health Valley Cobbler Cereal Bars, Strawberry, 6 Count, 7.9 Ounce Box
review_headline: Very tasty, but not a lot of fruit filling.  See my photo up top.
review_body:
I've been eating one of these apple bars every day at work as an afternoon snack for about a year now. I used to eat Special K bars, but I found the Health Valley Organic bars on Amazon, and the good reviews prompted me to try them. One bar is 130 calories and is a tasty, satisfying, and relatively healthy snack. I've gone through many boxes, and the bars are consistent in quality and always fresh.

I'm knocking off one star because the photo on the box is very misleading. The bars have nowhere near the amount of filling shown on the photo the box. In fact, the difference is significant enough that I would say that the photo bears little resemblance to the actual product. I've attached my own photo up top to show what the inside of the bar actually looks like. I would estimate the filling actually makes up about 20% - 25% of the bar, whereas the box photo seems to show around 80% - 85% filling.

product_title: Lavazza Crema e Gusto Ground Coffee, Italian , 8.8-Ounce Bricks
review_body: I am a new espresso machine owner and am experimenting to find the best (least bitter) yet strong espresso.. I tried Cafe Bustelo which is decent and an Italian brand from grocery store. This brand is so far the smoothest yet still strong which is important to me. I also use in French Press when I am in the mood for good ole regular coffee.

product_title: MIO Liquid Peach Tea, 1.62-Ounce, (Pack of 4)
review_body: I drink a ton of water anyway due to a variety of medical \\"issues\\" that require me to stay away from sodas, juice, alcohol, etc. Needless to say, water is my go-to drink whether I like it or not, and truthfully I've gotten used to it, but every once in a while I just need something to make it actually TASTE LIKE SOMETHING. I was using the powdery mixes for a while, but now I'm loving MiO. I like that you can control how much you add to the water without wasting. If you just want a little bit of flavor, you can squeeze in only a few drops, or if you're a person who really wants legitimate iced tea, then squirt away! The flavor is delicious too. It definitely tastes like iced tea with a nice helping of peach and doesn't have an artificial flavor in my opinion. I'd absolutely buy these again, particularly this flavor.

product_title: Traditional Medicinals Organic Herbal Power, 17.6 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: This tea was \\"prescribed\\" by my mom's nutritionist, and its been helping her a lot in getting a good night sleep. Highly recommended, plus it is organic!

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig 1.0, 2-Count
review_headline: Coffee Tastes Better with this than the K Cups!
review_body:
I purchased this set for myself and another one for my son and DIL as they have a Keurig also. I have found that this gizmo gives me a much better tasting cup of coffee in the morning than any of the K cups I have purchased. (I do use Dunkin Donuts coffee.)

I had previously ordered the Sol-o-Fil but that gizmo made my coffee taste very weak - the coffee was just so so. I have found that I can add a tad more water to the water cup (I have a Mr. Coffee Singe Serve K cup coffee machine) and I can not only get a larger cup of coffee but a better tasting one as well.

One tip is NOT to fill the Ekobrew to the very top with the ground coffee. Their instructions suggest you only fill it to 2/3 full and I usually fill it to the first line (below the very top) of the Ekobrew and that allows for more water to seep through into the coffee and fills up the cup or mug quite well. My son and his wife told me that they love the Ekobrew as it gives them a much richer cup of coffee full of flavor - much better than the K-Cup container that came with their machine. Kudos to whoever invented this gizmo. We also save a lot of money using our own coffee rather than the K-cups.

product_title: Watkins Pure Mint Extract 8oz
review_body: For mint enthusiasts that use a lot of mint extract, this is the product for you. It's much cheaper than buying the 1 oz. containers from grocery stores and of the same quality. I recommend using a transfer pipette to use this, though, as it's difficult to pour sometimes.

product_title: Good Earth Organic Tea
review_body: This tea tastes like Christmas! There is no other way to describe it. My co-workers love to walk by my desk when I have a cup of this sitting on the corner because it smells so good. It is my favorite hot tea bag. It is sweet and spicy just like the title says, no need to add any extra sweetener (which makes me happy).

product_title: Cameron's Colombian Supremo Whole Bean Coffee, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)
review_body: Astoundingly good coffee. Great aroma, freshness, rich clean robust flavor. What coffee ought to be, IMO. A terrific value at 60 cents/oz.

product_title: AriZona Arnold Palmer Half and Half (Iced Tea/Lemonade Stix), 10 Count, (Pack of 6)
review_body: I buy this not only for myself but also to send to soldiers currently deployed to Afghanistan.  Great stuff and well appreciated.

product_title: Baby Gourmet Organic Yummy Combos  Stage 2 (7 Months +)  Baby's Sweet Potato Pie Baby Food, 4.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)
review_body: My 12 month old devours this flavor.  I wish it was a bit thicker but overall a very good product.

product_title: Pacific Gold Original Beef Jerky, 2-8oz bags
review_headline: Good quality, good taste, price could be better
review_body: The Pacific Gold jerky is much better in terms of taste and quality than the cheaper bulk packages available on Amazon and elsewhere. The cheaper brands make heavy use of MSG, preservatives, and spices. The result is like having a chewy, spicy, chemistry lab in your mouth. Pacific Gold tries to balance cost and quality and does a pretty good job of it. The packages I bought state that the jerky is made of beef that comes from one or more of five countries: U.S., Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and Uruguay. The Pacific Gold label says there is no \\"added\\" MSG, but it does not say there is no MSG. The Pacific Gold flavor is credible -- you can taste beef (and like it) as well as brown sugar and hickory flavoring and there is no distracting chemical taste. The only product I have found so far on Amazon that is in a similar quality/price bracket is Golden Valley's non-organic line. Golden Valley is a little less expensive than Pacific Gold, especially if you subscribe. The last time I read Golden Valley's package it stated that the jerky was made of U.S. beef raised without hormones. Golden Valley recently raised the price of the product I like substantially, but even after the price increase it is competive in its quality bracket.

product_title: Sweet's Champagne Dark Chocolate Wine Gels, 3.5oz Box
review_body: As a dark chocolate and champagne lover, I found the Sweet's Champagne Dark Chocolate Wine Gels to be the perfect compliment of two delicious flavors, if you like champagne and dark chocolate like I do I would highly recommend this product.

product_title: Bare Fruit 100% Organic, Gluten Free, Bake-Dried Apples, Fuji, 1 Pound Bulk Bag
review_body: These taste wonderful and as long as you look before popping bits into your mouth, you can avoid the additional roughage of core parts and stems.  Sadly, I need the dried fruit for making up fried pies and the work of separating, core, stem and skin from the fruit makes this a product I will not be a repeat customer for.

product_title: San Francisco Bay One Cup
review_body:
Great stuff! Tastes fresher than all of the other types of k-cups; and I've tried all the major ones including Starbucks.
It looks like you save ten cents over everyone else as well. The only negative; because of the way they are packed and manufactured, my 30 cup k-cup carousel is now useless.

product_title: Marich All Natural Zoo Animals Candy, 8-Ounce
review_body: My dad picked these up for me on a trip and as soon as we finished the bag, we went to order more.  They are the perfect cross between candy and fruit snacks.  Great real-fruit taste, not too sticky or hard to chew.  Delicious!

product_title: Amy's Light in Sodium Organic Spicy Chili
review_body: This chili is very tasty.  It's got a nice thickness to it, and it tastes just great.  Spicy but not too spicy.  I think this is the best of Amy's low sodium line.  I'm going to buy it again.  It's an easy and satisfying meal on those days when you get home too late to cook and don't want to do take out.

product_title: Rumford Baking Powder -- 4 oz
review_body: Tried this and compared with other brands and it does'nt work any better then the cheaper supermarket brands. save your money and go cheaper.

product_title: Oreo 100th Birthday Cake Sandwich Cookies
review_body: These oreo birthday cake cookies are simply divine. I could eat a whole box lol but i know i shouldnt and cant.!! :) They do taste exactly like a birthday cake. Very yummy.

product_title: Happy Tot Organic Baby Food Pouches (Pack of 16)
review_headline: An organic option that my kids loved!
review_body: I have 4 kids and I do try to offer them healthy options as much as possible.  I was happy to find this product at my local Target and my kids really liked this flavor.  Now I keep them on hand in my purse and in the car so in a pinch I can offer them an organic snack.  Plan on checking out the other flavors as well.

product_title: Pickapeppa Hot Sauce Original, 5 oz
review_body: Very good flavor with heat

product_title: Nutiva Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, 15 Ounce
review_headline: Best coconut oil buy for your dollar
review_body: I have ordered this product numerous times and will continue to do so. This is by far the best price for pure organic coconut oil. I use it for everything cooking, hair, nails and skin.

product_title: Quaker Soft Baked Oatmeal Cookie, Raisins, 8.8 Ounce
review_body: As soon as I opened my Mom Vox Box, I pulled out this cookie. I LOVE oatmeal raisin and so does my 2 year old daughter, Lily. She started screaming, \\"cookie, cookie mama, cookie\\". So naturally I gave in. She liked it. She decided to eat it over her mac and cheese which is unusual for her! I did manage to steal a piece and it is amazingly good! I will definitely be buying these regularly!

product_title: Crazy Cups Premium Sampler
review_body: I got this because it seemed like it had a lot of variety, but my husband doesn't drink decaf and we had to give away about 7 of the cups to a neighbor because they were decaf.

product_title: Kennys Licorice Twists, 1 Pound
review_body:
I bought these as a gift for my chocolate-licorice-loving Mom.

First, a Twizzler addict she, I wanted something a notch above and this came highly recommended. When I got them they were soft and fresh. Upon opening them they smelled great, and they tasted, in my opinion, better than the name brand.

Second, a Chocolate addict me, I never find \\"chocolate\\" licorice satisfying, and my Mom who as stated above practically lives on the stuff is herself NOT a chocoholic.

So the assessment: if you love chocolate, this is not a chocolate fix for you, but if you love chocolate LICORICE, this is ideal.

product_title: Sweet Home Farm Blueberry and Flax Granola, 20.5-Ounce (Pack of 2)
review_body: Sweet Home Farm Blueberry and Flax Granola..  this is a great buy and it taste very good.  I will buy this product again.

product_title: Quaker Chewy Granola Bars Sixty Bar Variety Pack (.84 oz each)
review_body:
I don't often eat breakfast before I leave for work, which means that I'm usually pretty hungry by about 10 AM. I have begun taking these to work with me for a mid-morning snack, and they help to tie me over until lunch. They have a surprisingly decent amount of taste, rather than tasting like cardboard or having a single chocolate chip or raisin in them. For the price, it is a good deal. You might be able to find them cheaper elsewhere, but keep in mind that there is a bit of a \\"convenience charge\\" when buying online because you didn't have to get in your car, drive to the store, spend the money on gas, get what you wanted from the shelf, stand in line to check out, drive home, spend more money on gas, and lose time that you could've been doing something else. To some, this isn't a big deal. For me, buying them on Amazon is the way to go, and I will continue to buy them for the taste.

I should also mention that I have tried other products, like NutriGrain bars, Special K Thin Crisps, and Newtons Crisps. The NutriGrain bars, in my opinion, are too dry. The other two are alright, but there is very little flavor to them. As such, I will stick with these.

product_title: Allen's Golden Hominy, 15.5000-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: This is a very difficult item to find on the East coast.  I ordered the case for south-western dishes that I make frequently in the Winter.  Excellent product.  Good color and flavor.  Exactly what I needed for ethnic soups and stews.  Thanks.

product_title: Crazy Cups Premium Sampler
review_body: I understand that some of the coffee in assortment sampler packs with be decaf but a third of the pack was. I would not have bought it if I knew so much Decaf would come with it. Decaf in my house is unused coffee and thus a waste. Thanks for wasting my money.

product_title: Tea Sampler, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body:
I ordered this thinking I would get a variety of different teas. Here's what I got:

1 Celestial Seasonsings India spice chai
1 Bigelow Mint Medley
1 Bigelow Pomegranate Green Tea
2 Celestial Seasonsings Sleepytime herbal

3 Celestial Seasonsings English breakfast black

8 Celestial Seasonsings Green Tea

REALLY! 8 green teas. I will not order this again, in fact I am returning for a refund. The teas were not packaged well, they were just tossed into a paper bag.

product_title: GF Soy Protein Powder
review_body: After trying other similar products, I found Bob's and and am delighted to say it not only is a good buy, but its quality is superior.  It mixes much better and provides the protein I need, having given up dairy products.  Recommend very highly!

product_title: Campbell's Chunky Soup, Chowder, 18.8 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: Appears to be older stock - dented cans with a bit of rust.  Expiration date about 9 months out.  Flavor is fine, nothing to write home about. 3.5 stars.

product_title: OLZA Prince Polo Hazelnut Milk Chocolate Confection, 32-Count (1.2-Ounce) Bars
review_body: If you like waffles, hazelnut, and milk chocolates then you will love these. I tried these once and fell in love. Yummy! Delicious!

product_title: Salt Water Taffy - Assorted, 5 lbs
review_body: I got a wild hair for taffy and ordered this five pound bag. The taffy was all very enjoyable with many flavors: watermelon, root beer, melon, peppermint, grape, etc. My only complaint is there was a bit too much red/black licorice-flavored pieces (just not my particular favorites). Between me, my kids, and my husband, this lasted only two weeks! I would recommend this brand of taffy -- it was a delightful treat.

product_title: Barney Butter Almond Butter
review_body: I thought this would be the best idea for an energy snack yet.  It tastes great, for that I may have given it four stars; but the packaging is terrible.  How do you get the almond butter clump stuck in the bottom third of the packet?  It will not roll-up from the bottom and whose mouth is big enough to eat it using your teeth like eating an \\"artichoke\\" leaf?  The point is to be able to eat this on the run which you cannot do with this package unless you have your dissecting kit with you.  Someone needs to post a video on how to eat this.

product_title: Namaste Foods, Sugar Free Gluten Free Pizza Crust Mix, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is an excellent gluten-free pizza crust.  When I decided to go gluten-free I knew I would miss pizza the most, but this crust is a great replacement.  I'm quite picky and I highly recommend it.  The ends seem to curl up quite a bit, but that is minor.

product_title: Spicy World Peppercorn (Whole)-Black Tellicherry, 16 Oz. bag
review_body: used this pepper 30yrs ago when I was in india and I loved it because it grinds very nicely and it is delicious.

product_title: Quaker Soft Baked Oatmeal Cookie, Raisins, 8.8 Ounce
review_body: I recieved a sample of this product from Influenster to try-then immediately went out and bought 2 more boxes, which are now gone also. These cookies have such a great homebaked consistency and just the right amount of spice and sugar. My kids love them too, especially when we cut them in half and put a little ice cream between the halves.

product_title: Kraft American Cheese 2 lb - 2 Unit Pack
review_body: For the past 42 years, I have always loved to cook for multitudes of people, including a birthday lunch for over 100. When I was turned away at two stores telling me that Kraft was no longer carrying Kraft Delux American Cheese, I was skeptical so continued to search.  I cannot locate it anywhere and have learned on your site that this product is indeed no longer available.  So many recipes must have this 2 lb block of cheese.  Substitutes simply are not acceptable.  Other products, including your sliced American Cheese, do not taste the same in various casserole dishes and grilled cheese and tomato sandwiches.  BRING BACK KRAFT DELUX AMERICAN CHEESE in the 2 lb box. If you can't get the item into stores, make it available on line for those of us who are more than willing to pay the price for this unreplaceable cheese.

product_title: Brooklyn Bean Roastery Coffee, Cyclone, Single Serve Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 36-Count
review_body:
Great product. Great packaging.

I ordered this from amazon a last week and got it two days later, I have prime. It was well packaged. I also have to say I loved the packaging from Brooklyn Bean. I like that the Cardboard box isn't flimsy. I also like the opening, makes it easy to move around without worrying about all the k-cups falling out and having to pick them all up. I love the flavor and think this is a great coffee for my tastes, I like bold and extra dark roasts. The thing I like the best is that the packages come in 36 packs instead of 12-24 packs. This way I only have to order 1 time every 2-3 weeks instead of every other week. Great product. Can't wait for more flavors.

product_title: Starbucks Cappuccino Primo, T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers, 8 Count Packages (Pack of 2)
review_body: I don't care how good a product is, but unless the price goes down, I will walk on by it. $150.00 for 16 servings is ridiculous!

product_title: Nutella Hazelnut Spread, 13-Ounce Plastic Jar (Pack of 5)
review_headline: What can you say about Nutella?
review_body: At first I was apprehensive about purchasing so many jars of Nutella at the same time, but I soon realized how reassuring it is to have Nutella available anytime I need it. No more late night visits to the grocery store only to be disappointed when it was sold out. There are few perfect things in life at a great price. Nutella yourself in quantities. You deserve it.

product_title: Roasted Garlic Juice by Garlic Valley Farms
review_body: This spray is great on salads, meats and especially added to my homemade chicken soup! If you love garlic, it is such a simple way of adding it to any recipe. Easy and convenient to have handy for many months in the refrigerator,it adds garlic to any meal.  I found this product years ago in a gourmet fish store, but found it is too difficult to find now so I order a few at a time on Amazon.

product_title: Zevia All Natural Soda, Rainbow Case, 12 Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: My order arrived in a very timely manner and was in great condition.  It has been so nice to try the various flavors without having to purchase large quantities of them.

product_title: Original and Sour Sample Pack - Original Honeystix - Pack of 47 Stix - Honey Sticks
review_body: Bought these to fill a beehive pinata, and the kids loved them! Very tasty - just like I remembered having as a kid. I highly recommend them.

product_title: Just the Cheese Rounds, Nacho, 2-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I like these little cheese chips. They satisfy my craving for something crunchy. And who doesn't like that last little bit of crispy cheese from your toasted cheese sandwich. That's what these are like. Just beware - I didn't notice right away that one bag held four servings, not just one. They are pretty rich so it would be hard to eat the whole bag, but I could see munching on half of the bag, which would be 150 calories.

product_title: Bigelow Keurig K-Cups
review_body: I selected this item for the price per unit, and got the same quality bigelow tea i am accustomed to. a satisfied customer!

product_title: GREEN'S Chocolate Babka, 24 oz.
review_body:
Anytime I am back in New York, I head to Zabars on the UpperWest Side and buy at least
3, or usually 5, cinnamon babkas. No other babka is as heavily loaded with cinnamon
sugar swirl. None of the funky cheese filling in this babky, just layers and layers of flaky
dough and tons and tons of dense delicious cinnamon stuff. Worth bringing an extra suitcase
home just to stuff it with these babkas. They are $7.99.

product_title: Maxi/Tuna Fish Crackers, 8.7 Ounce
review_body: Worked to transfer all photos from SD card to my iPad 1.  I was even able to connect a standard  USB keyboard to the iPad. Just remember to flip the switch from  SD card to USB.

product_title: PG Tips Black Tea, Pyramid Tea Bags, 240-Count Box (Pack of 2)
review_headline: PG Tips, warms the heart of any ex-Brit
review_body:
There really isn't much I can say. If you've had PG Tips you know the difference. If you haven't you don't know what your missing.

I'm from the UK originally and for years in the States I drank Lipton as it was the only brand I could readily find. But along came Amazon and restored my access to my favorite tea.

If you're used to drinking Lipton, PG TIps has a stronger flavor and if you brew it real strong it can get bitter on you. However I used to use 2 Lipton bags to get the strength I like and just one PG Tips bag does the job nicely.

If you're not sold, wait until it goes on sale or special and at least try one box. Its particularly good if you brew it in a proper ceramic or china teapot rather than making it directly in a cup.

Actually that is one thing to note. These tea bags don't have little strings so make sure you've got something handy to fish them out with.

From an Eco-friendly perspective I also like the fact that you only have the tea bags and the main box they come in. Only the plastic shrink wrap is not recyclable. If you drink a lot of tea using individually wrapped tea bags you are going to be generating a lot of unnecessary waste. Particularly for those teas in plastic envelopes. At least in Lipton's favor they do use paper wrappers you can recycle.

product_title: Foods Alive Flax Cracker Variety Pack (6 flavors), 4-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_headline: I like the idea of these, but. . .
review_body: I do like the idea of these crackers for gluten free eating, but I can't bring myself to enjoy them. I bought the 6-pack variety and have tried the Maple Cinnamon and the Onion Garlic. I generally like flax, but these just aren't setting well with me even when I use them as a carrier for dips. I feel I wasted my money. I'll probably give the unopened packs to a friend's family that are gluten free.

product_title: Torani Syrup, Classic Caramel, 25.4-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 3)
review_body: I completely agree with the other reviewers on the fake flavor. It taste synthetic! And not just as an aftertaste, but also while you're drinking it. What stinks is that I now have 3 full bottles of a product I have no use for. It's a waste of space and money!

product_title: Kala Brand Madras Curry - 500g
review_body: This is my favorite curry from Trinidad that I use to make goat, chicken, channa, and just about any Trinidadian/West Indian recipe that calls for curry.  Madras curry tends to have a little bit more kick to it and it smells up the whole place.  Highly recommend it.

product_title: Small Upright Panoramic Sugar Easter Eggs - Amazing Handcrafted Candy, Perfect for Easter Baskets and Egg Hunts!
review_body: I bought four different colors for my four granddaughters--they loved them!  My children had similar in their baskets when they were small and I was thrilled to find them!

product_title: Walden Farms Calorie Free Fat Free Gluten Free Sugar Free Fruit Spreads
review_headline: Walden's has some good products...this is not one
review_body: I have really enjoyed walden farm's calorie free barbecue sauces and salad dressings, so I ventured forth into the realm of fruit spread -- it was a mistake. The spread hardly spreads at all, and tastes extremely artificial. If you are looking for a healthier blueberry spread, I recommend simply using frozen blueberries with truvia. This stuff is truly awful and a waste of money.

product_title: Rose Buds Organic 1 oz loose tea sample
review_body: these came perfectly packaged and are beautiful. but are waaayyy too expensive. i thought i would get much more than i did for the price.

product_title: The Spice Lab Hawaiian White Papohaku, Fine Grain Sea Salt, Molokai (Pack of 4)
review_headline: TASTES  LIKE SALT..... GOOD QUALITY SEA SALT
review_body: I probably won't buy again, but it is quality sea salt.  My husband likes it in particular.... he says it has more taste than regular table salt.....I find the holes a little too small for the sea salt to come out easily.... requires a heavy shake to get it out.  Nice glass container too.  I may re-use it for spices after it is empty.

product_title: M&M'S Pretzel Chocolate Candy
review_body:
Once you start chewing on this, hard to stop.
Great for movies, ask your girlfriend/wife to sneak these into movie theaters...

product_title: Chef Paul Prudhomme's Magic Seasoning Blends ~ No Salt & No Sugar Seasoning Blends: Lemon & Cracked Pepper
review_body:
I love this Chef Pauls NO salt NO Sugar Lemon Pepper
Usually when you see Lemon Pepper in the store it has too much salt
By the time I have it tasting enough of Lemon Pepper it is too salty
This one does the trick.
Would recommend it to anyone.

product_title: Arizona Iced Tea, Diet Green Tea, 128 oz
review_body:
I've spent a lot of years drinking diet drinks, and while I did get in better shape by cutting out the sugar, I realized something: Carbonated diet drinks tend to make my stomach burn, which feels very similar to hunger. After converting to drinking this, I'm finding it a lot easier to avoid snacking and the drink doesn't make me feel like reaching for more snacks.

I've had other diet green teas, and if you've had Lipton with lemon, this is entirely different. Calorie free and a slight honey taste, it's made with Splenda and don't have the high acidity or aftertaste that I've had with other diet green teas. It doesn't taste like regular tea, but it doesn't have the telltale green tea taste that some others do have.

I drink this stuff and it helps satiate my thirst and curb my hunger. Problem solved.

product_title: Keebler Bistro Crackers, Multigrain, 9.9-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: A great cracker! Tasty and they are perfect for snacking and for toppings. Why can't these be in stock??????????  We check the local stores and can't find them either. Pare these with cheese or dips or even shaved turkey and you have the perfect snack.

product_title: Super Ostrim Sweet Pepper Nuggets, 3-Ounce (Pack of 5)
review_body: I bought these based on the single review. I've been an Amazon shopper for many years and this is the first product that I felt absolutely necessary to write a review on. It taste like plastic covered in some powder flavor. The texture is definitely \\"structured vegetable protein\\" as it feels nothing like real meat. I only got this because I am a fan of the Ostrium jerkee sticks. This is nothing like those sticks, which I don't think taste the best but they're healthier than most of the other meat snacks and filling.

product_title: Non-GMO Project Verified Pardina Lentils (Small Brown Lentils) | 100% Non-Irradiated | Certified Kosher Parve | USA Grown | Field Traced (We tell you which field we grew it in)
review_body: These are really good tasting lentils. The first thing I notice was the lack of that shinny coating you see on store bought lentils. When you open the big you can tell right away there is something different about these. They cook easily and hold their shape and taste great.

product_title: Vosges Haut Chocolat, Mo's Bacon Bar (3oz Bar)
review_body:
I bought one of these chocolate bars at Whole Foods for $6.99. I thought for that much money it must be really good. It's not that good. It's not $7.00-for-a-candy-bar-good, that's for sure. You can't really even taste the bacon. If you gave a piece to someone and didn't tell them there was bacon in it they would likely never guess there was.

Now on Amazon it's 12 dollars!? That is a very bad deal. It's not that I don't make unadvised purchases, I do, but this one, 12 bucks for this chocolate bar, is beyond the pale.

product_title: Chebe Bread Pizza Crust Mix, Gluten Free, 7.5-Ounce Box (Pack of 8)
review_body: We have found that if we don't put in the optional 1 cup of cheese the crust is crisper.  We roll the dough as thin as we can (if it sticks to the counter we rub a little olive oil on the counter) and then put it in the oven for 5 minutes before adding the toppings.  Then add the toppings and put the completed pizza in the oven for 15 minutes.  Chebe bread makes great pizza crust!

product_title: Mrs. May's Trio Bar Variety Pack,  1.7-oz Bars (Pack of 20)
review_body: I think this is one of the best snack type products that I have ever tasted. Unfortunately I wish it was made in the USA and not China, since there some questionable food products that come from that Country.

product_title: JFG Coffee Filter Packs,  1.5 oz. , 42-Count
review_body: This coffee is really, really good and the filter packs are super convenient. The only thing that would make it better is if it were available in decaf.

product_title: Ovaltine Chocolate Drink Mix, Rich Chocolate, 12-Ounce Container (Pack of 4)
review_body: The original glass jar of Ovaltine has vitamin and mineal content approximately 4 to 5 times the current receipe.  Not only do they reduce the nutritional content, they increased the price and put it in a cheap plastic container.  So this is progress?  Get less for you money and the smile all the way to the bank.

product_title: Happy Tot Organic Baby Food Pouches (Pack of 16)
review_headline: Love the HappyTot Organic pouches- tasty and HEALTHY!
review_body:
These organic pouches sell out FAST at the store, and with good reason! We love these fruit pouches-- they are portable, sized perfectly for kiddo hands, and offer a perfect, wholesome snack. Ingredients are organics and gives a healthy dose of omega-3. All organic with 100% natural ingredients, no pesticides, no chemical fertilizers, no genetic modifications, and no preservatives. The pouches themselves are are BPA and phthalate free.

Compare the ingredient list on these snacks to the other fruit pouches and you will quickly see why these are so popular:
Contains: Organic Banana, Organic Peach, Organic Mango, Salba

That's it! Simple, pure, and healthy.

product_title: Yumpeez Barbecue Roasted Veggie Snack, 1.1-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I attened the allergy expo locally and was able to sample the product.  Ever since then I have continued buying this product.  Being a gluten free vegan its hard to find good snacks that are healthy and taste good.  This is the perfect snack and low calories so you have no guilt when you have them.  I hope they come out with more flavors in future.

product_title: Maxi/Tuna Fish Crackers, 8.7 Ounce
review_body:
product connected and worked as expected, only can read though and i needed it to write also
Received product as advertised.

product_title: Nestle Toll House Dark Chocolate and Mint Morsels, 10-Ounce (2 Unit Pack)
review_headline: If you like Thin Mints then...
review_body: These chips were available for a limited time in stores around Christmas. I bought them and made the chewy chocolate cookie recipe on the back and they came out just like a chewy version of thin mints. If you like mint and you like dark chocolate and you want to make your own chewier, healthier version of Thin Mints then buy these chips.

product_title: Kellogg's Frosted Mini Wheats Bite Size Maple Brown Sugar, 15.5 Ounce
review_body: I've been a consumer of the mini-wheats products for many years though I've also bought the malt-o-meal variety of this and it's excellent too. But this product brought me back because you can't find this flavor among the other brands. An excellent flavor it is too, with just enough blueberry sweetness without being over powering. The portions of mini-wheat are also very nice as you can fit two or three on a spoon without it over flowing. Enjoy with a cold bowl of milk and you've got a nice start to your day or a tasty snack before bed time.

product_title: Methi (Fenugreek) Seeds 7oz
review_body: I recently started using methi seeds after doing Web research. I cook with the seeds, make tea with the product, and use methi paste on my hair and skin. My hair is very tightly curled, but using methi paste on my hair once or twice a week makes my hair look as if it's been flat ironed (and I never use heat on my hair). If there is a concern about the smell, I simply use strongly fragranced shampoos and conditioners such as Pantene or Suave to neutralize the smell. For me this product works better than any straightening serum I've tried, and I don't anticipate returning to chemical straighteners. Thanks, Mother Nature, for methi!

product_title: Sam Mills Pasta Rigatoni Gf
review_headline: Best Gluten Free Pasta Out There
review_body: This is the best gluten free pasta that I have found to date.  I first tried it at a local restaurant that has a large gluten free menu and loved it!  It has a much firmer consistency than the rice pastas do.  Even my middle son, the pickiest eater I know, cleaned his plate.

product_title: Larabar Jocalat Gluten Free Pure Organic Food Bar, Chocolate, 16 - 1.7 Ounce Bars
review_body: These bars look and taste like they fell out of a monkey's butt.  Perhaps it's an acquired taste that I'm not sophisticated enough to appreciate.  OR....the monkey thing.

product_title: Silk Almond Milk
review_body: I drink this all of the time and find it as satisfying as a small meal.  Added to Ensure, a healing additive also with low calories, gives it a true value to your daily diet.

product_title: Marmite 250g
review_headline: The classic English yeast extract spread
review_body: I ordered some of this basically just to try it. I found that yes indeed, it is really salty and very strong flavored. You don't need much of this stuff to add some real flavor to whatever it is you are putting it on. I found that compared to other similar products, this one has more of a beer flavor. I ended up using a lot of my jar to make Marmite pasta which was really different and good enough to make a couple times afterwards. Unfortunately the pasta uses up a lot of a small jar quickly, and given the expense it makes for some pricey pasta. But I'd recommend it if you want to try something pretty alien to American taste buds. All I can think is it reminds me of beer, soy sauce, and salt, but not exactly. I guess you will just have to try it. If you have sensitive taste buds this might be too much for you. Try a little on saltines with some cheese, or smear it on buttered toast like the English serve it. I just deduct a star because it should be cheaper IMO.

product_title: Organic Dark Chocolate Pretzels (6/4oz)
review_body: I was very happy with these pretzels! Not only did they taste great, but the packages came shipped with a special ice pack thar kept them from melting. 5 stars!

product_title: Silk Almond Milk
review_body: After loving the taste of the vanilla, I had high hopes for this, which were quickly dashed upon trying it.  It had an alkaline taste to it, bitter.  It also had a similar strong aftertaste.  Would not recommend to fans of chocolate.

product_title: Santo Domingo Ground Dominican Coffee 1 Bag / Pound
review_body: Will definitely order again from this seller.  I received the product very quickly.  This coffee is wonderful.  First tried it while in the Dominican Republic and can't live without it since then.  It has a natural sweetness and lack of bitterness while also having a great chocolaty depth of flavor.  Makes fantastic espresso, which is how I use it.

product_title: Brooklyn Bean Roastery Coffee, Cyclone, Single Serve Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 36-Count
review_body: I bought the 36-count Brooklyn Bean Roastery,Cyclone, for Keurig,got the product in the mail,The coffee pods where packed ok,made the 1st cup= blow out,2nd cup= blow out,3rd cup received coffee that tasted very old,So I brewed acouple more cups got the same taste,All togather I had 22 cups which brewed ok,Still tasted like the coffee was scraped from the bottem of the barrel,and 10 blow-outs,also had a 4 that did not puncher.Now I realize that some may say that my maker was at fault,BUT I did check my maker,No Problems.I also bought coffee from another maker (Jet Fuel)which was very good,so I kinda now what stronger coffee tastes like.So I will not buy this coffee ever again.Thanks  Update= Brooklyn Bean sent me another box of coffee,It was far better than the last one. Only 2 blow outs,the taste was ALOT better than last time,alot smoother and taster,so I will be buying this coffee again.THANKS Brooklyn Bean.

product_title: Country Choice Organic Snacking Cookies Ginger Snap(Pack of 2)
review_headline: YOU WILL NOT EAT JUST ONE ONCE YOU TRY THEM.
review_body: I buy these by the case and now some of my coworkers like them also, they are the best I have every had.

product_title: Amoretti Premium Chai Syrup (750mL)
review_headline: Does not taste good at all
review_body:
This tastes like sugary syrup with some weird flavor (it also leaves a nasty aftertaste). It doesn't have the depth and variety of chai. I wish I'd had a better understanding about the flavor beforehand. I also hadn't realized that it was made with \\"natural flavor\\" (as the LAST, and therefore smallest, ingredient), rather than the actual spices used in chai. It is not bold or intense. It's actually pretty mild. I tried it with the 1.5 pumps and it was like I hadn't put anything in. I added more pumps, hoping to find a good balance, but it didn't matter. I'll just go back to brewing chai by hand. I'd hoped this would be close enough :(

Update: While I still don't care for this syrup, I did find the company that makes it to be very serious about customer satisfaction. They followed up with me to get details on my experience with their product and seemed very sincere about making sure all of their customers have a positive experience.

product_title: Lavazza Italian "Grand Espresso" Whole Beans (2.2 lb bag)
review_body: I was really looking forward to trying this espresso blend and was very disappointed, the beans were very dry, unlike most espresso lenses we h ave purchased before. Usually the beans look oily or wet and have a nice crema on top where this blend did not. We won't purchase this brand again.

product_title: Solofill Reusable Single serve cups for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_headline: Poor design destroys puncture prong in receptacle
review_body: The design of this insert is terrible. I bough quite of few of these inserts and they bent the prong in the black receptacle to the point that it would no longer puncture a K-cup. There is another brand with a flat bottom and a space to accomodate the puncturing spike.

product_title: DoMatcha DoMatcha Organic 2nd Harvest Matcha, 2.82-Ounce
review_body: I've tried many varieties of green teas -- including various matcha teas -- and this is the best that I've found. Some people drink it for its health benefits. I drink it for the taste -- no added sweetener needed. Its very smooth, pleasant taste blends well with instant ginger cystals (I use the brand from Prince of Peace).

product_title: MTR Mixed Vegetable Curry, 10.58-Ounce Boxes, (Pack of 5)
review_body: I had really high hopes for MTR products, given the high reviews I've seen on Amazon. I bought a 5-pack of this vegetable mix, and it's just disgusting. I am very passionate about Indian cooking, and cook Indian food at least 4 times a week (and am an Indian myself). Firstly, MTR seems to use the exact same sauce base for all the curries (I bought the Paneer Makhani and it has the same revolting flavor base), and the sauce is just not right! If you tell me that it has Indian flavors, I won't disagree with you. But Indian spices need to be used better - they must be matured properly by cooking them off in hot oil, adding aromatics in the right amounts, etc. And the vegetables were semi-raw, with no flavors inside the veggies .. all in all, it can be a poor man's emergency meal, but no way on earth does it even REMOTELY deserve the number of stars it has! Very very bad food indeed .. =(

product_title: Cadbury Crunchie British Chocolate Bar 26g x 24 Bars
review_body: Crunchie bars are my favorite candy.These came well before I expected them and were wrapped in bubble wrap.None of them were broken and I was very pleased when I opened the package.

product_title: Quaker, Quakes Rice Snacks, Sea Salt and Cracked Black Pepper, 6 oz. (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Quakes-sea salt and cracked black pepper
review_body:
I am a big fan of Quakes as they are low in calories and pack a mean flavor punch. I usually stick with the cheddar cheese flavor because they are my favorite, but my local store was having a sale to benefit the USO, so I bought 10 bags of different flavors. This was one of the new ones I am trying out. I have to say that my first rice cake was extremely like a sour cream and onion flavored potato chip, which I don't mind at all because I like that flavor- I was just not expecting it! There is definitely a onion-y powder used in this. I found it to be nice and subtle throughout the serving. I like to keep myself at 10 rice cakes per serving, and the first rice cake was heavily flavored, while the rest imparted a more pepper and salt type of flavor, with the onion as a side note. I suspect the reason for the first cake seeming so powerful is because it was the first to hit my palate, and not because of over powdering. As the palate acquires the onion flavor, it will bring itself down. This is my observation anyway.

Overall, I was not expecting much from the flavor, but was pleasantly surprised! I would recommend this to people who enjoy sour cream and onion flavored items. I am happy with this flavor.

product_title: KIND Bars, Pomegranate Blueberry Pistachio + Antioxidants, Gluten Free, 1.4 Ounce Bars, 12 Count
review_body:
May 15th, 2012 9:04 am
I bought this product[KIND PLUS, Pomegranate Blueberry Pistachio + Antioxidants Gluten Free] for my grandchildren for a healthy snack at school!
When it came I tried it, it was very tasty, but very very sweet and it had something in it that was so hard to bite, that I thought it would chip my tooth! I told my daughter my concerns, but she said she would try it and let her children try it as well!
They found nothing wrong with it!
It was very tasty as I said, but I can not of good conscience recommend this as a healthy snack! It is extremely sweet and children should be where they can brush their teeth after eating it! Which they would not be able to do at school! I would not want whatever that tiny hard thing I bit on[maybe a hard grain] to chip a child's tooth. The adult should try it first to see if they want their child have this either as a for snack for school or for outside playing!
As I said it was very tasty, but it was hard and just to to sweet! I first gave it 5 stars, but I felt I was not being honest when I am trying to eat as healthy as I can! I will not buy this product for my grandchildren nor for me again! And I love nuts/grains/fruits and all the Antioxidants this product offers, but it is just too sweet and that out weighs any nutritional value you gain! If The maker would not have it so sweet as it is, then I would try it again and then could give it a better review! Not everything that sounds healthy is healthy! We see all the healthy stuff and then think wow this is good for us, but we neglect to notice the larger amounts of fats or salts or sugars that has been added and then it is not as healthy as we thought! It is the fats/ salts/ and sugars that is destroying our bodies from the inside out!
Polar2[Eya-Andrea]

review_body:
6 boxes were ordered.
Out of the six 4 boxes had multipl containers that were broken open and had leaked all over.
The 4 boxes needed to emptied and the remaining containers rinsed and dried since they were covered in the creamer and were sticky and gross.

product_title: Frozen Sushi Grade Scottish Salmon - Sake ~ 3.5lb Piece
review_body: Salmon is one of my favorite fish and this particular order had a great flavor as well as color (unlike the whitish looking salmon that is a real turn off). A really high quality product, I look forward to ordering from them again.

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Maca Powder, 1 Pound Pouches
review_body: I enjoy taking Maca.  It has a nice earthy taste to it, I always describe it as \\"exotic dirt\\" - I eat it in my smoothies.  I have noticed that my butt is rounder, even though I haven't made huge strength gains on my squats.  I can also say it DEFINITELY increases one's sex drive.  Be prepared for that, since it's kinda shocking.

product_title: Davidson's Tea Bulk
review_body:
I was really looking forward to this tea, having purchased it as a juice replacement for my two young children. I regularly order Davidson's English Breakfast, as well as tried other offerings of theirs in the past, and have never been let down.

Upon opening the bag, I was met with the overwhelming scent of cinnamon and discovered an abundance of cinnamon stick pieces in the mix. The presence of cinnamon is so prominent that I believe it should be stated clearly in the ingredient list. Unfortunately both of my kids won't touch cinnamon with a ten foot pole, so as a result of the misrepresentation of this item, they sadly won't be enjoying Davidson's Spring Fruit and Flowers tea.

product_title: Reserve Du Chateau 4 Week Wine Kit
review_body: Makes OK wine. but is really easy and has everything you need.  I have made several of these kits.  Let them age for at least 6 months

product_title: Prince Of Peace Tea Premium Pu-erh Tea, 100 teabags
review_body: the tea is great...however NEVER BUY FROM THIS COMPANY SUPPLEMENT WAREHOUSE...HORRIBLE HORRIBLE HORRIBLE TOOK ELEVEN DAYS TO SHIP!!! NOT RECEIVE...SHIP. I LOVE THE TEA AND WHEN THE TIME COMES WILL ORDER AGAIN, NOT FROM THIS PLACE THOUGH. THE TEA IS SMOOTH AND TASTY. I DEF FEEL ITS EFFECTS...VERY CALMING.

product_title: Cinnamon Tea 20 Tea Bags/boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: We have an Acupuncture clinic and serve a varity of hot teas to all of our patients and this is by far their and our favorite.

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Cacao Nibs
review_body: I was supposed to receive three different items, the Cacao Nibs, Gogi Berries and Macca Powder.  Instead I received two bags of Cacao Nibs. They are inedible.  They taste horrible.  They cannot be returned and I did not receive what was promised to be shipped.

product_title: Maxi/Tuna Fish Crackers, 8.7 Ounce
review_body: The only thing it does is cause the iPad to display \\"This accessory is not supported by iPad\\".  Why was I not surprised?

product_title: Amy's Organic Refried Beans
review_body: I just love these refried beans. They are delicious, not too spicy, and a perfect addition to tofu rancheros (a great vegan brunch dish).

product_title: Hansen Beverage Soda, 8 Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body:
This is one of the best soft drinks I have tasted in awhile. Why is it not in Grocery stores for easier access. The Price per can I found to be a bit to high is my only complaint.

I would highly recommend to any one who likes a nice Zingy/Zangy flavor that tantilizes your tongue's receptors

product_title: Kashi TLC Chewy Granola Bars
review_body: I was allways a big Big Kashi Fan.But the Dark Mocha Almond Granola Bar simply blew me away. These are Fantastic. They are just the right Size Snacks. Have it with Green Tea or Skim Milk and You will Feel Fuller for a long time. Its a darn good Pre Work out Snack (also Post work out). Go For it...

product_title: Nutiva Organic Chia Seeds
review_headline: Lots of extraneous non chia bits in my bag
review_body: The chia seeds themselves are great. However, there was more than just chia seeds in my 3 pound bag. Hard particles of ?sand and other unknown detritus made these a challenge to eat, especially in pudding where the unsettling crunches ruined an otherwise decent product. The auto delivery subscription price of less than $10 a pound made this bag a decent value, but not when you factor in the non chia particles. Not sure I'll be keeping my auto delivery of this because I don't want to risk getting another bag of chia and mystery matter.

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_body:
Just read the reviews that said it had a chemical taste - I totally disagree. I think it tastes wonderful! I guess its all a matter of personal preference. I love it so much, I cant go back to the regular unflavored coffee. The only thing that's too bad is that it's artificially flavored. I care not because of the taste, but because artificial flavors are probably not too good for me. But I love the taste anyway! Senseo could easily use natural vanilla flavoring, it is probably more expensive, but they should do it anyway to give their customers a better product. Unfortunately too many companies today use non-natural ingredients in the quest for larger profits, which is a sad commentary. Senseo, you need to start using natural vanilla flavor instead of artificial for the health of your customers.

But I still love the taste and cant drink any other coffee! The Senseo coffee in general is so wonderful. I've gone through two machines already. The frothiness of Senseo coffee is so delightful...its like cappacino froth only better. I use Silk Vanilla creamer too which gives it an even better taste (their product DOES have the natural vanilla flavor so maybe that is helping with the taste.) Then I always top off my coffee with cinnamon sprinkles which makes it even more wonderful!

All in all, a great coffee and coffee system, just please start using natural flavor Senseo, for the health of your customers! You would probably have even more customers if you did. :)

product_title: Enjoy Life Chocolate Cookies
review_body: These are great tasting chocolate chips!  My family enjoys the same recipes without the allergy!  In fact, they are so good, I eat them right out of the bag!

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig 1.0, 2-Count
review_body: I bought the 2-count pack and we use them both on a daily basis. We've had them both for a little over a month and the plastic \\"hinge\\" on both of them is broke, meaning the lid is no longer connected to the cup. For 20 bucks I feel like they should successfully last more than a month. Right?

product_title: VOSS Artesian Water (Still), 330 ml Plastic Bottle
review_body: I work at CVS and whenever someone buys this water bottle, it's because of how appealing the bottle actually looks rather than the water. These come in two different types of bottle, one being glass and other being plastic. This one is a plastic bottle. Don't get me wrong, the plastic bottle still looks beautiful and is very sturdy, it's not your average poland spring bottle. Aside from the looks, the taste of the water is no different than Poland Spring or Nestle bottled water. These usually sell for $1.60 at CVS so, this price online is kind of high. If you really want to try this water, or just want the bottle for the look and future use, just go to a local drugstore or grocery and pick one up. It will be much cheaper and you will get to see and feel the bottle in person to see if it's for you. Overall, it's a good buy and offers a very appealing bottle but the taste is pretty much the same as any other bottled water. I personally bought a bottle because it is so sturdy and I can refill it for everyday use, plus the appealing presentation of the bottle doesn't hurt either.

product_title: Newman's Own Vanilla Almond Cereal, 13-Ounce (Pack of 5)
review_body:
I came to Newman's Own Vanilla Almond cereal only because I was obsessed with another cereal: Kellog's Smart Start. However, I finally realized how much sugar I was eating and was wondering if I could still have a somewhat sweet cereal but one that wasn't so sugary -- he organic part is a bonus. While Smart start has 43 g carbs (14 g sugar), this cereal only has 24 g carbs (7 g Sugar) -- half the sugar! And it's sweetened with some sugar, but some honey as well, which is a healthier sugar and doesn't cause your blood sugar to spike so much. And no high fructose corn syrup, which I'm not that against, but it some really try to avoid it.

I don't think I'll ever get rid of my sweet tooth, but I'm sold on this cereal. My favorite way to eat it is with 1/2 a banana and a hand full of blueberries. Yum.

And by buying bulk, I can save $1-1.50 of what they charge in the store; for some reason you can't save any $ by buying Smart Start in bulk.

product_title: Stacy's Bagel Chips, 8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: This one is not the recent style. But still good. Will not recommend this one since the new one is better. Thanks!

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Green Tea
review_body:
I've been drinking green tea for ages and Celestial Seasonings is some of the best. I especially like the fact there are no little strings on the bags.

The taste is great and I can easily drink it without sugar.

product_title: Let's Do Organic Creamed Coconut, 7-Ounce Boxes
review_body: I thought I would use this like coconut milk but OH NO, I didn't. It is like a coconut butter (along the lines of peanut/almond/etc).  Please be prepared to enjoy it and have to stop yourself. FYI it is too firm if put in the fridge like the package recommends. When I got it it was soft and separated like oil and coconut. Just squish it all together and  go for it.

product_title: Sunflower Oil - zvijezda, 3L
review_body: Post office held for my ispection, arrived in a oil wet box, 1/4 of product leaked out during transit. Since ordering I have learned that oils in plastic bottles leach chemicals into the oil that can mess up your hormones. Not good. Need to go to a better container.

product_title: Golazo Caffeinated Electrolyte Drink
review_body: Golazo is the best energy drink out there, especially the Mandarina flavor. Gives me energy but doesn't have a lot of sugar and doesn't contain any artificial ingredients. Love it!

product_title: Junket Ice Cream Mix Dutch Chocolate, 4-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body:
tasty rich chocolate flavor cant wait to try vanilla & strawberry
Fast delivery well packaged easy to make
depending on machine is how to get a best cone

product_title: Tabasco Pepper Jelly, Spicy, 10 Ounce
review_body: Bought this on some screaming deal quite awhile ago.  But in the end it wasn't very good, it wasn't spicy (i mean really it's tabasco brand and called \\"spicy pepper...\\", you'd expect spicy) and had High fructose corn syrup as one of the ingredients.  Wouldn't order it again and not even sure i'd take it if it were free.

product_title: Davidson's Tea Bulk
review_body: This is an excellent  herbaltea which taste very similar to Rooibos, yet it has a slightly sweeter taste to it which makes it linger a little longer on your taste buds. I often times drink this with no added sweetener. There isn't much more to say other than I am very please with the quality products from Davidson's Tea.

product_title: Baronet Coffee Fair Trade Organic Small Village Blend (140 g), 18-Count Coffee Pods
review_body:
Several of the packages had broken pods inside making a mess... then when trying to brew, the loose coffee plugged the Senceo machine and caused a bigger mess!!
Would not purchase product again.

product_title: Chincoteague Seafood New England Clam Chowder, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: This is the very best clam chowder by far!

product_title: Torani Syrup, Strawberry, 25.4-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 3)
review_body: Purchased this to add to my sweet tea... Taste Great!  I had the idea after having strawberry sweet tea at Bob Evans & wanted to recreate the drink at home :)

product_title: Donut House Collection Coffee, Cinnamon Roll, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_headline: Just the right touch of sweet
review_body: I recently purchased a Keurig and have been very disappointed the the availability of different types of coffee in my local stores, so I came to Amazon. The Cinnamon Roll coffee is AMAZING! Just enough cinnamon to make it different but not to take away from the reason I drink coffee- the flavor. I can see myself keeping this one in stock.

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee Decaf Dark Magic, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: We have tried many different brands and found Green Mountain Coffee products in general to provide the boldest, richest flavor. We prefer decaf coffee, but most large retail outlets selling Keurig products only offer a very small selection of decaffeinated K-cups. We are so excited just to be able to find our favorite, impossible -to-find coffee at Amazon, and to be able to purchase in quantities larger than the standard 18 ct. box. Even factoring in shipping costs, Amazon's unit price is less than most retail outlets, Walmart included!

product_title: Pure Jalapeno - This is the most widely used pepper in the USA. A fine culinary addition to fish, chicken or steak.
review_body: FOR MYSELF, THIS WAS TOO HOT. BUT MY HUSBAND JUST LOVES IT. HE PUTS IN ON ALMOST EVERYTHING HE EATS NOW. I'LL HAVE TO ORDER SOME MORE SOON. GREAT PURCHASE. IF MY HUBBY IS HAPPY, SO AM I. THANK YOU.

product_title: Fillo Dough Thin (Athens) 1lb
review_body: loved it but it arrived thawed but still good. I have difficulty finding it in this part of Texas so it was a real convenience.

product_title: Crystal Hot Sauce Louisiana's Pure Hot Sauce - 12 oz
review_headline: Greatest mild Louisiana style hot sauce
review_body:
Crazy Uncle Jester's Louisiana Firestorm is the best pure Louisiana style hot sauce, but Crystal is my favorite of the original style, milder Louisiana style hot sauces that I can buy in a supermarket. It's about twice as hot as the original Louisiana style hot sauce, which still is not all that hot but the extra cayennes add a lot of flavor and are the difference between being 99% vinegar (like tabasco) and hot sauce IMO.

I buy this one mainly for my 8 year old son, who hasn't yet migrated up to the hotter Louisiana style sauces and he loves it. I'll use it myself from time to time as well, although I usually opt for something hotter. It's still good tasting.

product_title: General Toy Mix 1" Round Capsules
review_body: I work in a dental office and we have a prize machine for the children after they have a good visit. The dental suppliers sell the same thing for so much more!! Great customer service, fast shipping. And best of all, the kids seem pretty happy with their toy!!

product_title: Davidson's Tea Bulk
review_body: I really enjoyed this tea,  I'm not sure if all the batches are exactly the same, but mine was quite tart. I find that I like to add some stevia to mine to make it a little sweeter. It smells wonderful and has bits of fruit and flowers that you can identify.  I don't care for tea that is mostly dust.  What a nice large bag for the price.  Of similar quality to those found in \\"tea\\" stores that are much more costly.  A great find!

product_title: Wonka Sweetarts Chicks Ducks and Bunnies Easter Bag, 12.0-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body:
LOVE this CANDY. They changed the product this year and it was terrible. The original chicks, ducks & bunnies are the BEST!!! So glad you still have them.

I don't know what I'll do when they're finally gone....

product_title: Jack Link's Smokehouse Beef Jerky Strips
review_body: Over the past two years, thanks to Amazon, I have been sampling jerky from literally all over the U.S. I finally found a tasty, jerky that doesn't give my jawbone a workout. Great meat flavor, an excellent snack.

product_title: Melitta Coffee Pods, 18 Count (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Does not fit in Senseo coffee maker
review_body:
With a lot of cautious effort it is possible to lock the Melitta pod in the Senseo coffee maker's holder area.
Once you have done that without breaking the lever handle the coffee brew comes out regularly. The taste of the Melitta coffee is Excellent; better
then the Senseo (dark roast) I used to order through Amazon. Unfortunately the Senseo pods -dark roast- are not available anymore. That's a good thing though,
because once you taste the Melitta you don't want to go back to Senseo!
I still give it a five star despite the bad fit for the Senseo coffee maker. The package says that it will \\"Fit All Coffee Pod Brewers\\".
Once again, be careful closing the lid of your Senseo brewer.

product_title: 6 Madagascar Vanilla Beans
review_body: I am so so happy about the quick service and delivery. I am making  many wonderful things with the yummy vanilla beans. The homemade ice cream was much better with a vanilla bean added! Thank you and I will definitely order again from this provider.

product_title: Ancient Harvest Organic Quinoa Pasta
review_body: I have tried many gluten free pastas and his one is the best I have found! it is a combination of rice and quinoa flour. tastes very similar to wheat pasta!

product_title: Eight O'Clock Ground Coffee, Colombian Peaks, 33 Ounce
review_body: This is the first time I have tried the Eight O'Clock brand and I was pleasantly surprised. I've tried several other Colombians (Coffee Bean, Starbucks, Nabob, and a couple others). I think this is my new favorite. It has that typical citrusy nuance of a good Colombian without the actual roasting smothering the flavor. I'll order another as soon as my current coffee inventory is depleted. I am currently drinking the Eight O'Clock  Original roast which is also good.

product_title: Two Leaves and a Bud Organic Orange Sencha Green Tea, 15 Count (Pack of 6)
review_body: I debated a little about whether or not to order just because the reviews are so split down the middle. But I'm a big fan of other Two Leaves and a Bud varieties so I decided I had to give it a fair try. I'm glad I did! I prepared it with warm water, just the same as I do with all green tea, and it turned out really nicely. It's got a light smooth flavor & just a hint of orange. With just a little bit of stevia, it was perfect. I am not a sencha aficionado, so I cannot make a thorough comparison to other sencha teas. But I have been drinking a variety of green teas for a long time and can definitely say it stacks up to the other nice greens that I've had. It's also really refreshing iced so I recommend giving it a try that way this summer as well!

product_title: Gimbals Sour Lovers, 11 oz bag, 6 count
review_body: I ordered these, as a sour candy addict would, expecting 'gourmet' sour gummies. What I received was a wet globby mess. The coating on the outside of this type of candy is what makes them sour and tasty. These were a mass of soupy, gummy, wet ickiness. I have a feeling that the candy is probably tasty, but mine (all SIX bags) were inedible. So disappointed. Should have asked for a refund, but for some reason I felt like it was my fault for not knowing that they'd get nasty in shipping when it's warm. Thinking back, I now think the company should have known and either not shipped them, or found a way to counteract humidity. :(

product_title: Albanese Wild Thing Sour Bears, 4.5-Pound Bags (Pack of 2)
review_body: This product tastes delicious, I loved the different flavors and the snappy tartness. A wonderful product, I would buy again.

product_title: Godiva Dark Chocolate Hot Cocoa Can, 14.5-Ounces, 2 pack
review_headline: Nice to be able to get a pack of 2...
review_body: Godiva dark is my absolute favorite cocoa. It has a rich, complex flavor without the harsh overtones of Swiss Miss-style cocoas. It's also super-smooth and velvety, and dissolves perfectly in hot milk. It was very nice to be able to get a two-pack; the first time I bought this I bought a single, and since there are only ten servings per cannister, this is an expensive cocoa (although worth it now and then for real chocoholics!). Although prices change so make sure you check, when I bought the dual-pack it definitely saved some money.

product_title: Sugar Free Shortbread Cookies
review_body: I found these cookies to be very disappointing, especially for the price.  Since my husband is diabetic, I've ordered a variety of sugar free dessert treats over the years, and these are near the bottom of the list.  They taste of artificial sweetener, quite frankly, and do not have the buttery flavor that a good shortbread cookies should have - not even close.  I would not buy them again.

product_title: Sam Mills Pasta D'Oro Gluten Free, Conchiliette, 1-Pound (Pack of 6)
review_body:
My one complaint is the package clearly indicates the pasta cooks quickly...in 8-9 minutes. Well, I've prepared it twice now and both times took a minimum of 20 minutes to get the middle to soften up. Keep that in mind when making dinner because it definitely is not going to cook nearly as fast as the bag indicates.

On a positive note, the product tastes fairly good. It also works well as a cold pasta for salads and, of course, the fact that it is gluten-free is a healthy choice for those with gluten intolerance.

I gave the product 3 stars because it's a middle-of-the-road review for me. Good points and bad...so it's about average.

product_title: Kashi TLC Crackers
review_body: The item arrived on time and in the condition they stated in there column. If you want a healthy little cracker with a little zest to it this is the cracker for you. Would recommend the cracker to all. Thank you.

product_title: Come With Me Kitty Harness and Bungee Leash
review_body: My cat doesn't let me walk him like I seen some videos of people walking cats.  but he will let me put it on him and lead him to the back yard and back inside the house.  If he sees it in my hand he will go sit by the door.  so he lets me put it on him and take it off with no problem. I use to have this in medium but he has outgrown that so I had to purchase it in large.( i hope he doesn't get any bigger. he is only about 2 years old)  I couldn't find this at local pet stores. and so they suggested a small dog harness. needless to say the dog harness does not fit like the cat harness. I am very pleased with this purchase. and definitely would recommend it for anyone who doesn't want their cat to roam outside unattended.  I cannot walk and guide him like as if I was walking a dog but He does know that when I tug on the leash he has to slow down if he's trying to run to the back yard 2 fast or if he's trying 2 go to the back yard in a different direction then I want him to go. I'll pull him in the other direction so that he starts walking that way. He is still stubborn in it as that is his personality but he does love going outside in it.

product_title: Glutino Gluten Free Pantry Perfect Pie Crust Mix, 16 Ounce
review_body: Product had good flavor but was extremely difficult to work with and cooked WAY too thick! It really would've been more in my best interests to find a home made recipe & create a pie shell by scratch if I knew I would've had this much trouble baking for my mother on Mother's Day! If you have tons of delicate time on your hands to slowly piece together a pie by hand then this is for you, if not... You're like me (just look a recipe up).

product_title: Oatfield Liquorice Toffee 170g (6oz) 3 Pack
review_body: I loved Callard & Bowser's Licorice Toffee, but I guess it's been gone a long time, now.  I found a bag of these in a little store in Fredericksburg, and got a bag to try.  Now, mind you, I haven't had the C & B version in years, but these taste every bit as good as I remember the C & B ones were.  (Maybe even better; I can remember getting a STALE box of C & B ever so often.)  This is the best of both candy worlds; soft, creamy, buttery toffee with just the right amount of licorice flavor.  Jeesh, the bad thing is, I can so easily eat the whole bag...they're expensive, but, like the L'Oreal ads say, I'm worth it:) **Update July 30, 2013 Oatfield's Liquorice Toffees were gone from Amazon for awhile, and I just noticed they were back.  I was afraid they had gone out of business along with C & B when I couldn't find them after my earlier review.  I tried Gustav's, hoping they were as good, but I was SOOOO disappointed, I ended up throwing most of the Gustav's out.  Welcome back Oatfield Liquorice Toffees!!!**

product_title: Arriba! Fire Roasted Medium Variety Pack (2 Red Salsa & 1 Chipotle Salsa), 16-Ounce Jars (Pack of 3)
review_body: I just ordered this for my brother for his birthday. I love Arriba, and so does he. He moved to the northeast about a year ago and lamented the lack of salsa, peppers and anything to make salsa up there. Though he appreciated the gesture, one of the three salsas exploded on the way from Texas to NYC. He was left with two jars of salsa, rather than three, and a box that leaked red salsa goop. Needless to say, it was not the most successful birthday present.

product_title: Yogi Teas Woman's Mother To Be, 16 Count (Pack of 6)
review_body: I have seen other reviews that say that this tea is really strong. For me, the flavor that stands out the most is cinnamon, however, I put quite a bit of honey in my teas. Being from the south, I'm used to pretty sweet tea. I can only say, that I wish I had started drinking this sooner. From what I have read, because of the Dong Quai in it, it is really not good to drink if you are trying to conceive. Seriously though, delicious. It reminds me of Christmas or Thanksgiving.

product_title: :Mother Earth Products Dried Mixed Bell Peppers, Red And Green, Quart Jar, Net Wt 9oZ (225g)
review_body: I have used these a couple times since I purchased and really like that I can have bell peppers to add to meatloaf, meatballs or to soup without having to stock fresh ones, which can spoil if not used quickly enough.  Just add some to ground meat with bread crumbs and spices, along with some dried onions, and you have the best meatballs ever!  Then you can add your meatballs to soup, spaghetti, stew or freeze them for adding to meals later.

product_title: Peacock Brown Rice Vermicelli, 7-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I got one package of Peacock Brown rice Vermicelli free from the Amazon Vine program, in exchange for writing a review of the product.

I thought this product would be a healthy way to eat pasta, and it reminded me of Asian rice noodles when I removed it from the packet. We like brown rice and try to eat whole grain pasta, to add complex carbohydrates to our diets.

I soaked it for a minute as directed, then added it to a hot wok, along with sesame oil, shrimp, chopped green onion, precooked chopped bok choy, a little soy sauce and ginger. I tossed it gently for a minute and thought perhaps it would soften up a bit with the oil and heat, but all it did was turn into a clumpy glob. We did manage to eat some of it, and pick out the shrimp and vegetables, but none of my family liked this product at all. It was basically tasteless in addition to being gummy.

I've never seen any type of noodle go from crunchy and breaking into pieces, to a gummy wad of glue so fast!

I won't be buying this product in the future.

product_title: Sunfood Almonds, Certified Organic, Vegan, Raw, 2lbs
review_body: These are hands down the finest almonds I have ever had.  I soak them in clean filtered water for a few hours and the outer skin comes off with a single swipe - inside lies a tender, sweet, fresh morsel full of life.  My kids adore them as well.  Thank you Sunfood!

product_title: Wild Planet Wild Sardines in Spring Water, 4.375-Ounce Tins (Pack of 6)
review_body:
I've been eating Wild Planet sardines for about a year now and they have never been anything but high quality. Every pack contains 4 to 5 large firm sardines. Much more flavorful than the type I would typically purchase in the super market. In addition to that I love the fact that the company cares about sustainability and putting out a high quality product. I highly recommend them.

I like getting the \\"in water\\" variety, draining the liquid and pouring in my own choice of olive oil or mustard... delicious snack!

product_title: Metromint Water, 16.9-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_body: So refreshing and crisp especially when cold. Such a great palate cleanser and minty treat! Peppermint Metromint is so delish!

product_title: Numi Organic Tea Mint Puerh
review_body: I bought this after seeing Puerh tea taste tested on Dr. Oz. Luckily for me this was the only version stocked by a local store because I simply love it! The mint simply serves to \\"freshen\\" the taste, it doesn't overpower. The tea is smooth, and easy to drink it doesn't need sweeteners of any kind. I buy it on Amazon because it's more convenient. I live 15 miles from that \\"local\\" store.

product_title: Delallo Tomato Paste, 6 Ounce (Pack of 24)
review_body:
It's very good tomato paste. It combines three virtues: It's cheap. It tastes strongly of fresh tomatoes. It's low in salt.

Sadly, DeLallo isn't always available, but if you see it in stock, give it a try.

product_title: Crystal Light Pitcher Packs
review_body:
I can't find this in stores anymore, I never thought to look on Amazon...don't know why not they have everything right??? Found this in the store once and couldn't find it again. Love the flavor for summer goes nice with Vodka and a splash of club soda.
Nice cocktail for me for the summer.

product_title: Classic Gourmet Food and Snack Gift Basket
review_body:
I sent this basket for a birthday present and the recipient was very pleased.
The items looked and tasted great. I was impressed on how fast the delivery was. Thank you.

product_title: Miracle Noodle Variety Pack 2 of Each - Shirataki Angel Hair Pasta, Shirataki Fettuccini Pasta and Shirataki Miracle Rice (Pack of 6)
review_body: This product (shiritaki noodles) is good for diabetics and dieters alike with low carbs and calories.  Takes some getting used to, but takes on the tastes of the combined ingredients in the end.  The noodles are just too expensive.  I would use them more often if the cost were lower.

product_title: Popchips 11-Flavor Variety Pack, 3-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love these.  Finally some healthy chip options.  Plus I have a friend who is a vegan and this seems to be the only thing we can both eat and enjoy together.

review_body: Reader works for upload of pictures, but a pop up is received during upload stating the device is not supported by Apple
