product_title: GoPicnic Tasty Treats Gluten-Free Care Package, 1.76-Pound Package
review_headline: LOVED everything in this package and wound up buying them separately
review_body: I didn't realize I had not yet posted a review on this product. Trust me on this: once you order it you'll likely respond as I did. I had not had many of these products before and each and everyone of them was absolutely delicious. I was on a national road trip that lasted many months and I wound up looking for these products individually and and buying them. Don't think for a minute that \\"gluten free\\" means there is any sacrifice for taste here. the Tasty Brand Organic Assorted Fruit Snacks (were about as good as I have ever had. I had never had Cassava Chips before and was VERY pleasantly surprised how great they are as a potato chip substitute -- in fact, better. The Banks Cracked Pepper Cassava Chips started me as cassava chip fan. The Cinnabon® Almonds were as good as a cinnamon bun at a mall. The Annie's Homegrown Cocoa & Vanilla Bunny Cookies didn't last long: even though I am on a perpetual diet I had one, and inhaled the rest. The St. Dalfour Gourmet on the Go Salad proved that you could carry a tasty salad that can be eaten at leisure. T  GoPicnic Turkey Stick, Old Wisconsin Turkey Snack Stick, Barbeque Popchips, Mariani Dried Apricots, Sweet Perry Orchards Baja Blend Fruit & Nut Mix, and Terra Nostra Organic Dark Chocolate  -- etc. The point is: you may not have tried any of these but individually are GREAT and in a convenient package like this it can be a Godsend. The advertising is correct on this as well: it's ready to eat, you don't need a fridge, don't need a stove, and every item is healthy.  Sometimes I order a product I don't know much about and am disappointed. The GoPicnic Tasty Treats Gluten-Free Care Package, 1.76-Pound Package will introduce you to products you'll order and look for over and over.

product_title: Newman's Own Organics Organic Raisins, 6.0 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_headline: what -- hard and dry?  no way!!  MOIST and DELICIOUS!!!!
review_body: These prunes are extraordinary.  I see a reviewer says they're hard and dry, but that's not been my experience at all.  I'm on my fourth case of these precious little gems and have greatly loved them.  True confessions:  if you keep them for a while after the pack is opened, they DO get a bit hard and dry -- but they NEVER are when you first open them.  And frankly, usually they're gone before they have a chance to harden up.  I find the ziploc bags a great idea but a little awkward in practice, as the moist gooey prunes are a little sticky and the stickiness from the bag tends to wear off onto my fingers as I dig in for another -- so I just transfer them into a small lock-n-lock container just barely large enough for a whole bag, and then pick each prune right off the top with ease as I work my way through the whole bag's worth.  These are so good, I actually have an extra container full for travel, so that they're easily at hand on trips.  Great snacks, great go-to when you want something sweet and can easily make yourself settle for one of these delights.  Try them -- you may be surprised at how totally wonderful they are!

review_body: I've tried different teas before. But this dragonwell tea has a nice fresh grassy smell. You can whiff it and know how really fresh it is. I look forward to my tea moments. This dragonwell is a simple pleasure and a comfort to the psyche which dreams of peace.

review_body: I have dietary restrictions, so almond flour is about the only flour I can use.  Trader Joe's sells a pretty cheap one, but it's not blanched, which is not as easy to digest for me.  This one was affordable and blanched.  I am happy with my purchase!

review_body: A little high in sodium if you keep eating package after package like I do. Very nutritious a great healthy alternative to chips!  I buy them at Costco too for $10 + tax. review_body: I prefer M&Ms, these have no candy shell.  I suppose they're \\"as advertised\\" but it seems to be a simple candy and lacking the enjoyment I get from M&Ms and other small chocolate candies. product_title: Haribo Gummi Candy Gold-Bears,
review_body:
I loved gummy bears as a kid...and for those nerds, like me, out there, not just because of Dr. Who. I saw these on sale and ordered a small (5 lb!) bag. They are great for movies. product_title: Bull's Eye Original Barbecue Sauce - 18 oz (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Thought I'd found my BBQ sauce for life!
review_body:
I love the taste of Bulls-Eye! I found out that I was on my last bottle of the 'original' - I like the other flavors as well - so I went by my local grocery, and I don't know why I looked on the ingredient list, but there at the top of the list, the main ingredient was High Fructose Corn Syrup! I was shocked. Didn't buy it of course, because besides the taste, I also love that I don't have to eat HFCS. I then checked the bottle I had at home. Unbelievably, my older bottle had no HFCS in it at all. So I'm savoring it for as long as I can until I can find a suitable replacement. What genius at the company took a ridiculously fantastic product and decided to ruin it?! Almost every BBQ sauce out there has HFCS in it, which is why I was so happy when I found Bull's-Eye. If you love Bull's-Eye as much as I do, please let the company know how much you enjoyed their original non-HFCS formula.

Bullseye originally didn't use HFCS so....

I wrote a note to Kraft extolling the virtues of their great decision to keep HFCS out of their sauce.
Well, I got a note back saying this:

Thank you for visiting [...]

The formulation of BULL'S-EYE Original Barbecue Sauce has indeed changed and I'm sorry you were disappointed with your most recent purchase. Your experience is important to us.

BULL'S-EYE Original Barbecue Sauce is committed to bringing the flavor you enjoy, while minimizing the impact of rising commodity costs to ensure we're providing the best possible price to consumers. To continue delivering the barbecue sauce you love we are now using high fructose corn syrup in all BULL'S EYE Original Barbecue Sauce.

Product made with high fructose corn syrup can be identified by the ingredient statement on the back panel of the bottle.

Our staff works very hard to provide the best tasting and satisfying products to the preferences of most consumers. Your opinion about the product is important to us as well and I will share your comments with our product development staff.

Thank you again for taking the time to share your thoughts.

Kim McMiller
Associate Director, Consumer Relations

I went to my local Shoprite and culled the HFCS bullseye sauces out of the group, and bought all the others. That will give me time to find a new bbq sauce. You'd think Kraft would be smart enough to charge more for the HFCS-free sauce for the folks who really want it, instead of loosing us as customers altogether.

review_body: I tried Stoats bars at a Scottish themed race a couple of years ago. I love the taste and flavors. They are hard to find so I was really glad that Amazon carried them... that was until they arrived. I opened the plastic wrapped box of 12 to find only 9 bars!! I purchased a box of 12. I did not know that the product I was getting was a previously opened, partially \\"used\\" product. I was not willing to return and pay for shipping, but I will not be purchasing this product through Amazon again.

product_title: Bell Plantation PB2 Powdered Peanut Butter
review_body: I was dubious about dry peanut powder when we first encountered PB2 but it is delicious and convenient for making up small quantities of fresh peanut butter.  Our vegan teen loves it.

product_title: P.A.N Harina Blanca - Pre-cooked White Corn Meal 2lbs 3.3oz
review_body:
For anyone looking for a gluten free arepas flour: I bought this item because a lot of gluten free web sites recommend this as a gluten free product. The label on the product does say \\"may contain wheat\\". I called the company to make sure and they confirmed it is NOT gluten free.
I rated this a two star not so much for the product as I am sure it is very good, but because there are a lot of gluten free web site claiming this is a safe product for those who cannot eat wheat.

product_title: International Delight French Vanilla, 192 Count Single-Serve Coffee Creamers
review_body: I read several of these reviews that state how often this product arrives damaged.  I decided to chance it and order it anyway hoping to be one of the lucky people who wrote good reviews.  The box arrived and I could see and smell the leaking creamer from the porch.  I had not been one of the lucky few.  Several of the containers had ruptured and leaked all inside the box. product_title: Fondarific Buttercream Yellow Fondant, 2-Pounds
review_body: I bought the red, blue & yellow colors of the Fondarific buttercream fondant.. It tastes better than other fondant & the 2 lbs seems to go alot further than other fondants.. Would totally buy this again!

Doesn't fool my hubby (or our houseguests) like XyloSweet does, so I won't be buying this again...

review_body: In writing this review, I must preface by saying not everyone loves truffle oil.  My husband nearly gags everytime he smells it and others have said it smells like we have a gas leak!  Fortunately I beat to my own drum and inspite of the comments I love this stuff! So I decided to make my own at home and this oil is perfect for it.  I also use it on salads and potatoes but you need to make sure you like it first as it may be an aquired taste!

review_body:

review_body: Bought this to grind my own flour and to make my own hot wheat cereal. These are perfect for this. It's great having 4 individual bags to help maintain freshness. I have ordered multiple times.

I have been to the factory store in Vermont (all the way from Ohio) a couple of times...the last one after the floods that caused a temporary move of the store. After that it starts to taste differently, such as more acidic.

product_title: Kefir Grains - Living Probiotic Enriched "As seen on TV"
review_body: I don't normally write reviews, but feel compelled to this time.  I received my Kefir grains the first time, but they were destroyed during the power outage that affected so many across the NE U.S.  I believe it must have been the heat/temperature inside the mail box, plus the fact that I was so busy trying to save the contents of my freezer that I did not check the mail for a few days! product_title: San Francisco Bay One Cup
review_body: These K Cups provided strong coffee without sediment in the bottom of the cup. I think the taste was deeper then the usual K cups and I felt better about not having the plastic on the bottom.

product_title: Lindt Swiss Premium Milk Chocolate
review_headline: Wanted to love it but found it a little to salty...
review_body:
I read the reviews and had to buy it. At my local drug stores it sells for $10 each, so this was a steal. It came, I opened and I was disappointed. It was overly salty and the worst part is, why does it include something artificial, specifically, Vanillin?

For the price it usually costs, how can they use something artificial. I expect this in cheaper chocolates like Milka but not Lindt Swiss Premium Milk Chocolate. I actually accepted the salty taste and thought it just not to my specific taste, but I couldn't let the artificial ingredient go.

I have to give this two to three stars depending on my mood, it was disappointing.

review_body: I use this to mix with other hot sauces to add real habanero flavor & heat to others that only have flavor.

review_body: Never can go wrong with any of Bobs Red Mill products..Always best quality with fast shipping...Use wheat germ as a breading for chicken or fish or add to any baking for a nutrition boost..l.

product_title: 100% Natural True Lemonade & True Raspberry Lemonade, 1.06 Oz/Each, 10 Ct (Pack of 4)
review_body: I really like this product.  It is wonderful to have a drink mix with no carbs-no cane sugar that contains only natural sweeteners.  I really don't like the aftertaste associated with \\"diet\\" products--and I really cannot detect any in True Lemon drinks...it just tastes like lemonade!  It comes in those little packets like another well known crystal diet drink.  This is really convenient because you can carry it around in your purse-dump it in your waterbottle, make individual servings or, if you like, make a pitcher-full.  I like the raspberry one the best-can't wait to try their iced tea mix.

product_title: Now Foods, Fructose Fruit Sugar
review_body:
Fructose is fructose. It's a simple sugar found in plants, both fruits and vegetables. Buying fructose is like buying salt. Brand names don't matter much. I'm sure there are conspiracy theories about fructose, but as an old woman I'm tired of hearing \\"The sky is falling! The sky is falling!\\" First it's \\"Don't eat butter.\\" Then it's \\"Butter is good for you.\\" Etc. Etc.

Getting away from health issues, I have to say that if you want to buy fructose, this Amazon item is a bargain. You get a LOT of fructose for the money. I think it's less expensive, pound for pound, that the fructose I get from Publix.

product_title: Kikkoman Soy Sauce Gluten-Free 8.5 oz.
review_body: My daughters gluten free boyfriend appreciated this purchase. We were happy how quickly it arrived so we could get cookin'!

product_title: Bell Plantation PB2 Powdered Peanut Butter

review_body: Finally a horseradish sauce with some kick! They now sell this stuff at Sprouts in the cheese section, but if they stop carrying it I'll go back to buying it online. Its that good.

product_title: Coffee Bean Direct Decaf Whole Bean Coffee, 5-Pound Bag
review_body: This looks great in the bag, very oily, and smells fabulous. It just isn't a bold enough dark roast for me. I am still looking for the perfect dark roast decaf for espresso. The price is quite fair.

product_title: Almond Meal Flour, 1 lb. by Barry Farm
review_body: Why are other cooked almond meal products labeled as such, but this is not? I did not want cooked almonds. I wanted raw meal! This has been blanched. Beware, the living essence of this product has been killed off by heat.

product_title: Heinz Baked Beans in Tomato Sauce
review_body:
This is the first time I have ordered canned groceries from Amazon and having read some of the reviews about the less than satisfactory packaging, I was a little concerned what condition my order would arrive in. However, the price for these beans is a little lower than our local store, shipping was free with Amazon prime and it is easier to lift a 12 pack of beans off my doorstep than in and out of my cart, then from cart to car and car to kitchen, so I decided to give this a try.

I placed my order on the Sunday of Memorial Day weekend and was promised delivery by Thursday. I then received an email on the Monday saying my order had been shipped and updating delivery prediction to Wednesday. So I was very happy to find my delivery on my doorstep this lunch time (Tuesday) - very impressive for a holiday weekend order!

With a little trepidation, I opened up the package, fully expecting at least a few dented cans. But I was very pleasantly surprised - they were packaged in a cardboard tray, then wrapped tightly in plastic and surrounded by plastic 'pillows'. Not a single can was dented so I will definitely order again.

Oh, and as for the beans themselves? What can I say, I am British and was practically weaned on Heinz Baked Beans! They are pretty much our family's only 'must-have' since we have lived in the US - a real taste of home. We eat them on toast, with a cooked breakfast, with pies, quiches, practically anything!

product_title: The Spice Lab Smoked Chipotle Sea Salt, USA
review_body: Used these salts to treat my steak before cooking and it was worth the wait, the flavor came through to the very last bite.

product_title: Wild Planet Wild Albacore Tuna in Extra Virgin Olive Oil
review_headline: This is the only tuna I buy now
review_body: DELICIOUS!!!  I pay more than the stuff at the grocery store, but I feel better eating it and giving it to the kids.  It has less mercury than other tuna

product_title: K-Cup Variety Pack, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 50-Count
review_body: I am very happy with this. Came simply packaged and shipped before it said to expect it. I did not receive double or even x this, x decaf this. I received about 30 coffees (maybe 4-5 are decaf), 10 teas, 5 cappuccinos, and 5 hot chocolates. Love the variety. Definitely ordering again altho now I noted that the price has increased by $5!! :(

product_title: Vino Italiano 4 Week Wine Kit, Valpolicella Style, 15.5-Pound Box
review_body: This is a great wine kit value. I hope Amazon continues to make this product available in the future. Wine snobs who think less of these kits should pay $100 plus for over priced kits and send their reviews to those companies. This is a fun hobby and should be looked at as such. Successes with these kits have given me the confidence to even try Welch's grape juice concentrate batches, but believe it or not, the Amazon kits are a lot cheaper to purchase than the concentrates (along with all the other components)at the store. Have fun!

product_title: Inn on the Creek Potato Soup Mix 2lbs.
review_body: I was not a new customer to Inn on the Creek, having ordered potato soup mixes, cheese/broccoli soup mixes and assorted pasta mixes from them often in the past 5 years.  I always considered their products superior in taste and quality.  However, when I received these (several) potato soup mixes, I was disappointed in the taste, quality and amount. The cans were about half full and the potatoes were skimpy.  I use their soup mixes as a base for larger soups and found these so different from what I have received in the past.  To top it all off, when I went to Costco shortly after receiving these, I noticed the price was very much lower for the very same product, same can, etc. than what I paid for the product and shipping.  Very disappointed.

product_title: Liebers Tomatoes, Peeled, Diced, 28-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body:
Good for cooking sauces/etc. Not good for eating straight from the can or cooking items where you want the tomato to hold up.

I like to put these into a salad sometimes, and they are too mushy to do so. I also make a tomato ragu to put over polenta where I like them to hold shape and they do not work for that either.

review_body: $5.99 for one, $23.95 for 4 in this size. If you like this flour, it can be found for less elsewhere.

product_title: Roland Black Lumpfish Caviar, 2-Ounce Jars (Pack of 2)
review_body:
ok - my brother used to work in Russia and every few months he would come visit with a few POUNDS of Beluga which he purchased at the airport's Duty free. i would fast for 4 days before his arrival.
no - just kidding.
but that was top notch caviar. my parents eat them on little crackers with some light butter and chopped parsley on top. i think it destroys the taste. i ate them with a spoon with nothing else (yea i know it sounds \\"Warren Buffetty\\" but it's the truth; i have a very sensitive palate). and i kept eating them morning, noon and evening until there was nothing left. long gone are those days because bro now lives in Amsterdam.
but i still crave caviar and no i wont pay hundreds of $ for a little jar.
i thought some cheapish thing would curb this craving. so i found Roland's.
i got the shipment today and the first jar is gone. ok it does not MMMMMELT in your mouth like Beluga does, it is not subtly salted like Beluga is, the grains are tiny and are not as juicy as Beluga's, but HEY! it is $11 for 2 jars and it is totally acceptable. i couldnt eat it with a spoon because the taste is not as supreme as Beluga's, so i poured some over a cracker with some SmartBalance butter spread and it was just fine for me. i added some magic to the moment by sipping some Riesling.

tip for your guests:
you can very easily serve this as a glamorous appetizer over crackers with some parsley on top, along with some smoked salmon on brown bread and peeled lemon slices on top. this mix is delicious (and a great aphrodisiac too lol), and if you have a nice platter, they would look very nice. even though scottish smoked salmon is the best, Costco's ALASKA salmon is absolutely delicious and just $15 for a huge pack.

btw, in response to some other reviews: even the best Beluga comes with some black liquid. this doesnt have to do with the quality of the caviar.

review_body: I really had my doubts that any light pasta packed with fiber could possibly be edible.  What an amazing surprise.  This pasta is fabulous with great taste and texture. product_title: Eat. Think. Smile. Baked Nutrition Bar, Orange Cranberry, 1.8-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Good taste, crumbly consistency, good on fiber, OK on protein and fat
review_body:
There are broadly three types of nutrition bars. One that attempt to emulate baked goods (cookie like), those that emulate candy bars (chewy, chocolatey) , and fruit & nut bars. These fall in the first (baked / cookie) category. In that category it is very tough to get protein content very high, so at 4 grams per serving, these bars do alright. Here is the rundown
- 200 calories
- 6 grams fat (1 gram saturated)
- 34 grams carbs
- 12 grams sugar
- 7 grams fiber

So with the decent fiber, and low saturated fat, these are a good choice among the baked/cookie bars. You'll need to supplement your protein intake elsewhere however.

I like the taste, and think the chocolate brings a lot to the game here.
The consistency is generally OK when eaten fresh out of the box, but if you throw these in a bag and they get any rough treatment you will be eating crumbles.

These are a good choice. However if you are carb conscious I would instead recommend [[ASIN:B00623HOEE Kind Fruit and Nut Bars Kind Plus Protein, Almond, Walnut and Macadamia 12 - 1.4 oz (40g) Bars]] (fruit and nut category) or [[ASIN:B000V0QW3S Betty Lou's Almond Butter High Protein Balls, Gluten Free, 1.75-Ounce Packages (Pack of 18)]] (\\"candy bar\\" category)

product_title: Oberto All Natural Original Beef Jerky, 3.25 Ounce Bag (Pack Of 4)
review_headline: Shoe leather. Does not keep well.
review_body:
Very nice flavor and some pieces were easily chewable. Yup, you know what I'm going to say next: some were quite a challenge even after sawed up. It didn't take long for the phrase "shoe leather" to pop into my mind. I was a little scared for my teeth.

The package claims "Premium Steak". Somehow I would expect this, even jerked, would be more easily chewed. So I'm not at all sure that this is in fact premium steak. I wouldn't mind WHAT cut of beef it is as long as I could eat it.

There are several other things I like about this beef jerky beside the flavor. It says it is "minimally processed, no artificial ingredients, no preservatives added". Ingredients listed on my package are:

beef
sugar
water
beef stock
salt
spices
natural smoke flavor
vinegar

In case you care to know, in fine print, the bag says "contains beef from one or more of the following sources - the United States, Australia, Brazil, Canada, New Zealand and Uruguay". It also says that for consumer inquiries, you may call 1-877-453-7591 weekdays 8-4 Pacific Time. I give you this extra information in case you (who are wanting to take a chance that I just got a tough bunch) need to check before ordering online due to dietary restrictions.

And here's the warning you were expecting from my review's title: I opened a package, intending to have the occasional taste treat, then restored it to the refrigerator where it had been kept since it arrived, carefully resealing the ziplock bag. And was surprised to find decay - green and white fuzzy growth - on the meat after some weeks...and here I always thought jerking beef was a way to preserve it without refrigeration. Guess not, at least not with this brand. If you open a bag, it should be consumed quickly. Scary thought that I don't know how safe it is.

review_body:

product_title: ABB Performance Pure Pro 50 Shake, Milk Chocolate, 14.5-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_headline: A good deal outside the gym
review_body:
I bought these protein drinks because I'm saving over one dollar per bottle compared to the price at my gym. I don't really like the taste, but I think that most people who consume protein drinks on a regular basis for muscle gain sacrifice a little comfort for what they get in terms of nutrients. 50 grams of protein which is not just milk/caseinate protein (cheaper and less efficient than whey), but a mix of milk and whey protein. At the same time, and even more important in my opinion, only 9 grams of carbs and 3 grams of sugar, which means a very low glycemic index compared to tastier protein drinks which are sometimes full of sugar (this drink has 3 grams of fiber which helps counteract the effect of the 3 grams of sugar). Carbohydrates and sugar in particular make your insulin level rise, make you hungrier and lead to more fat storage.

So this drink doesn't taste great, but is an excellent and relatively cheap choice for muscle gain (complementing training and good diet). A much healthier option than cheaper or better tasting alternatives out there which are full of carbohydrates and sometimes full of sugar.

product_title: Jack's Harvest, Stage 1 and 2, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body:
I hate to say, but I was a little disappointed. I have placed a few orders with Yummy Spoonfuls and have been completely satisfied, BUT in an effort to have more variety for my baby I tried Jack's Harvest thinking they would be a great choice since they had a 5 star rating.

I actually ordered Yummy Spoonfuls variety pack the same day I placed my order for the Jack's Harvest Little Lumpy Sampler pack. The estimated ship date provided was several days away, but both orders arrived super fast.

Butternut squash-ed apples was the huge disappointment for me. This was first flavor I tried. My baby did not like it at all. I tried it and I did not like it at all either which shocked me as I am used to sampling her Yummy Spoonfuls baby food and it always tastes great to me. It was super tart and just not an enjoyable taste. I did not give up after the first try. I have tried this food at least 4 times now and I get the same reaction. I have tried mixing with other foods, but that flavor is very powerful and hard to mask. Today, I officially gave up on this flavor as I tried it again and my baby took one bite, made the \\"I don't like this\\" face and then started to cry as I tried to get her to eat more. I took a taste again and had to agree with her. Then I felt guilty...why do I keep trying to get her to eat this if I don't even think it tastes good? So down the drain it went as well as my $$$ :-( My Yummy Spoonfuls variety pack also had a Butternut Squash and Apples flavor included so after seeing my baby's reaction to Jack's Butternut Squash and Apples, I thought for sure that she was not going to eat the Yummy Spoonfuls as well BUT to my surprise, she did great with the Yummy Spoonfuls Butternut Squash and Apples. I too noticed a huge difference...much better flavor. Is it possible that I got a bad batch of Butternut squash-ed apples...some really, really tart apples in my batch???

Goin' back to cauli - my baby did not like this flavor at first, but I think it has grown on her. Perhaps Jack's Harvest has a little more \\"flavor\\" than she was used to with the added herbs and spices. I think this one tastes decent. I like that is is a unique flavor as I have not seen anyone else make a cauliflower flavor.

Sweet on Broccoli - a winner in my book! My daughter has done well with this flavor and I really like the \\"dash of cinnamon\\"

So bottomline, Jack's Harvest did not work out too well for us. It really bothers me that 1/3 of my order is going to be wasted. However, to you parents out there who want to offer frozen organic foods, I would not say don't try Jack's because who knows what my baby did not like, your baby may like. As for us, we are going to stick with Yummy Spoonfuls as that is what works for us.

One last thing...I think the Jack's Harvest hearts are cute, but being used to Yummy Spoonfuls, I found the hearts to be a little inconvenient. I am used taking plastic container from freezer to fridge, then opening a plastic container and spooning out what I need then putting the container back in the fridge. With Jack's I first have to find tupperware containers to put the hearts in then put in the fridge to defrost. Not a big deal, but if I had a choice, I prefer to have in a container so I can just take directly from freezer to fridge.

product_title: Wild Ride Zero Carb Beef Jerky
review_headline: It's OK enough, but not something I'd buy again
review_body:
I'm a huge fan of jerky and if not for the high sodium content in it (among other things), I'd probably eat this every day. I wasn't expecting a miracle from this jerky, just something good enough that could help tide me over as far as jerky went.

Here's the thing, though: it's just not that good of a jerky. It's a very soft jerky and the meat felt like it'd been processed a little too much before it'd been dried because it had that mushy texture to it. This in itself isn't enough to put me off entirely, though. It's not an unforgivable obstacle.

What got me was the taste. There's definitely a pepper taste here, but it's pretty bland overall and it's not really all that satisfying of a jerky experience. I remember eagerly ripping into that first bag and kind of giving a \\"eh, it's not great but it's not awful either\\" shrug. I gave some to my mother to try, who ended up saying the same thing.

If you're looking for a low sodium jerky, this is probably one of the lowest sodium pre-packaged jerky products out there, but it's just not all that great. I'll finish what I bought, but this just wasn't something I'd consider buying again. I've discovered that Jack Links has a low sodium beef jerky, which is actually not that bad. I'd absolutely recommend that over this.

product_title: Heartland Food Products Belgian Waffle and Pancake Mix, Malted Vanilla, 5 Pound
review_body:
I ordered the Heartland Blueberry Waffle Mix, the Heartland Malted Vanilla and the Carbon's Malted Original. This is by far better than the Carbon's in my opinion. The batter tastes like cake batter. I was expecting the waffle to be sweet like cake, but it was just a really good waffle. My 15 year old and I liked the Blueberry mix the best. My 11 year old and 17 year old liked the Vanilla better. I know others have mentioned liking the Vanilla better so you are just going to have to try them both.

The mix could not have been simpler. 3 parts mix to 2 parts cold water. Mix. Let sit for 15 minutes. One thing that I've seen mentioned here and it bears repeating. After it sits for 15 minutes, you are going to have to add a bit of water to the mix as it sets up too stiff. Just a tablespoon or so should get it to waffle consistency. Another thing mentioned is that your go to ladle is probably going to put too much on the waffle iron. My first waffle spilled out of the iron. (That is when I tasted the batter.) The next waffle, I was careful to put a few tablespoons less on the iron and I got a perfect waffle.

3 cups of mix yielded two Belgian waffles.

I am using the Waring Waffle Maker Pro. Setting 3 1/2. Cook until only the faintest wisp of steam is coming from the iron. You don't want to leave too much moisture in the waffle in case you want to freeze them. Moisture creates water crystals that damage the waffle.

review_body: This cider isn't too bad, but it doesn't really have enough spices in it for my tastes.  I think next time I may put a cinnamon stick in the cup before brewing to see if that helps any.

product_title: Frito Lay Munchies Peanut Butter on Toast Crackers, 1.42oz Bags (Pack of 24)

product_title: Boulder Canyon Natural Foods Kettle Chips

product_title: Go Raw Freeland Super Cookies, Ginger Snaps, 3-Ounce Bags

review_body: I try to eat right, and I keep hearing that raw foods are so good for you. I love ginger, but I won't eat traditional cookies that have flour and other junk food in them. I'll have to see what other flavors they have.

product_title: 9GreenBox - Bonsai Juniper Tree
review_body: Arrived well packaged and healthy with a tip sheet.  It's a fairly smallish plant in a decent looking blue clay pot. Worth the money I spent and a great starter for bonsai beginners.

product_title: Celtic Sea Salt Bag, Light Grey, 5 Pound

review_headline: taste good... but the boost isn't needed
review_body:
I realize this is an \\"energy drink\\" type product. I thought it would give me a nice boost mid-day. Instead it's like drinking another mug of coffee in that I start the feel the effects of too much caffeine.

Just a little dab on a saltine cracker will turn you into a fire-breathing dragon!  What's nice is when you first taste it, you actually get nice flavor since the heat won't kick in until a few seconds later. review_body: I bought these because I am pregnant and have been having a hard time with calcium supplements. product_title: Albolene Moisturizing Cleanser Fragrance Free 12 oz
review_body:
I didn't know Albolene was so versatile (after reading other reviews)! Mine is based upon the manufacturer's jar directions (as a make-up/cosmetic cleanser). There are very few products I've used for decades, but this is one of them. As a mom raising girls, our house was always full of different brands of make-up remover. Many were expensive; most were ineffective (especially at taking off waterproof mascara). The kids kept experimenting, but I always returned to tried & true Albolene. It's the only make-up remover I have found that takes off all stubborn mascara traces, and does not hurt my eyes or lashes.

The kids are long gone, but Albolene remains. Being in my late fifties, skin dryness is a big issue. Albolene does a superb moisturizing job, especially during harsh winter. A thin layer of Albolene applied nightly takes away any dry patches, and it is still used as my only make-up remover. A 12 oz. jar may seem a little expensive, but it will last for years (that is, if used my way...no idea how long if used as other reviewers suggest)! Albolene will not disappoint anyone who uses it for whatever reason.

review_body: My grandma introduce this brand to me as a kid and I've always enjoyed the thicker noodles of udon over ramen. The nice thing about this soup base is that is has a tad bit of spice. product_title: Maxwell House International Coffee Pumpkin Spice Latte, 9-Ounce Cans (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Smooth strong flavor and disolved well in hot water
review_body: This was pretty good as instant coffees go.  It dissolved well in hot water, and didn't clump up overly.  Some similar coffee mixes require sprinkling, then stirring, then sprinkling a little more mix, then stirring, and so one to prevent most of the mix going into the water in the form of powdery bubbles.  That this dissolved easily was probably the best feature.  As for taste, this was good.  It is creamy and has hints of nutmeg and other spices that go well with pumpkin.  The nutmeg and the creamy taste and texture contribute to the pumpkin taste, since pumpkin is a texture as much as a taste.  This drink does a good job at conjuring pumpkin and fitting into that family of seasonal products and foods.  Some of the other reviews are negative on the creaminess dominating and say it doesn't taste like coffee.  To me, it tastes like coffee, but very milked and sugared up.  Then again, that's how I drink coffee - milked and sugared up.  This drink mix is pricey (right now almost 10 dollars a canister after shipping for the 4 canister bundle).  I'm not sure if it's worth so much.  It's a solid beverage, but much cheaper for similar - maybe even for the same thing - at the grocery store.  Oh, and here is the nutritional information off the food label:  Serving size is 6-8 fluid ounces.  60 calories (20 of them from fat), 2g fat (both grams are saturated), 60 mg sodium, 11g carbs, 8g sugar.  Ingredients:  Sugar, nondairy creamer (corn syrup solids, partially hydrogenated coconut oil, sodium caseinate (from milk), dipotassium phosphate, mono-and diglycerides, artificial flavor), whey, maltodextrin, instant coffee, contains less than 2% of cinnamon, ginger, natural and artificial flavors, cellulose gum, sodium citrate, modified cornstarch, silicon dioxide.  Overall, this is a solid hot beverage in taste, texture, and ease with which it dissolves in water.  However, it's very pricey.  I recommend trying this if you have a sweet tooth and the price doesn't phase you.  Avoidthis if you like strong coffee or are price conscious when grocery shopping.

review_body: I've been buying this when I can find it at the store and am thrilled to see it here for 0.60/cup! review_body:

The consistency is also spot-on, they are soft and not overly sticky like a lot of fruit slice type candy. product_title: Bar Harbor Wild Smoked Kippers, 6.7 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love smoked canned fish.  I eat kippered snacks and sardines quite regularly. I was pretty excited when I saw these kippers for sale. I promptly ordered a dozen cans because I was attracted to the high quality packaging and the eco friendly lingo on the cover.  The interior of the can leaves much to be desired. The fish seams to be over cooked and falling apart. The flavor is pleasant but was greatly aided by a couple of turns of my sea salt mill. The smoke flavor is very mild and not at all what I expect from a kippered snack. The smoke flavor is there but not nearly as strong as I would desire.  In all honesty I prefer the $1.00 cans of Brunswick kippered seafood snack I pick up at my local Big Lots. They are firm, smokey and correctly seasoned.  For a truly divine kipper experience I would recommend trying the Appel brand of kippers available here on Amazon.

review_body: Dr. McDougall's soups are perfect for the vegan on-the-go! Like the cup of soup everyone else eats, but better for you. Just take my advice and buy 2 packs on auto-ship every month.   This is great convenience food. We're a mixed family (vegan and non-vegans can peacefully coexist!), but we both like this soup. product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 3-Count
review_body:
I have a Keurig B70 platinum. I bought the ecobrew when it first came out. I had 2 solo k cups, but I figured I would try this one since it looked like it held more coffee and it had a flat bottom. Well I really liked it so I bought 1 3 pack for me and 1 2pack for my son. Since I started using the new ones, I have had a problem with the water and coffee grinds overflowing. When I picked up the lever on the Keurig, I found that the top of the ecobrew cup had opened. This has been happening most of the time now. It never happens with the solo k cup. I would have preferred the ecobrew because it holds more coffee,and it's easier to store, but I really don't want the mess. I warned my son about this and told him when it happens to push the top back, then since it interrupts the brew, you have to do another brew on a small size and switch to an empty cup for the coffee that won't fit in the original cup. I think the top has to be a tighter fit for a better seal and less of an indent so it's held in place better. When you close it, there is some play in it and I think that's the problem. I was going to return them, but Amazon said I can't so I'm stuck with them. The manufacturer should really do something about this. They have a good product when it works right.

LATE UPDATE: A couple of days after my first review Ron D. asked me to get in touch with him and he did send out 3 new cups. They all work fine, but close a little differently. One clicks closed, the other 2 have to be pressed a little harder to close completely. The overflow problem is solved. The ecobrew cups are really good when you get a good one. It seems that the quality is very inconsistent. I have to say that to date, they are still good and do not leak. If I had these before I probably would have rated them with 5 stars, but it seems to be a hit or miss whether you will receive a good one. I do give their customer service 5 stars for backing up their product.

As far as cleaning the grounds out, I just use the spray on my sink and let the grounds go down the drain. I have been doing this for over a year. My drain works fine and the cups are a breeze to clean that way.

I am a \\"keep-the-sweet-off-the-meat\\" kind of person for the most part with some exceptions. However, I may try marinating some bird in this for the grill which I think will work well flavor wise; savory taste of the char from the grill with the subtle sweet background and a good comino pop.  I did try it over some posole and it was a good complement.  You will have to make your own judgement if you have not had it before, but it will be interesting to experiment with beef and fish dishes as well as chicken.

product_title: Wrigley's Extra Dessert Delights Mint Chocolate Chip - 10/15 Stick Packs
review_headline: Gum that Tastes Like Ice Cream - thank you New Jersey!!
review_body:
The first time I had this gum, I was taken aback by how much it tasted like chocolate chip mint ice-cream. People I have shared this with had a similar reaction, saying, \\"Oh, this is quite good!\\"

It is minty enough to freshen your breath. Though this is clearly NOT an all-natural feel-good about the earth product, it is relatively normal tasting -- not oddly chemical like some gums. I have no idea how they captured the creamy taste of ice-cream as well as they have. This is a winner.

This gum makes an excellent alternative to dessert. The packaging is good -- it is the kind that has the top that bends back to open but you can tuck it back into a slit to close it. I did not buy it through amazon.com, but at convenience stores on the east coast. I've seen it in North Carolina too. My first pack was a bit shy on longevity of flavor, though it remained very chewable a long time. Luckily, it is not expensive, so you can always pop another one if you want to continue your 'dessert'.

review_headline: Tasted great but gave me HORRENDOUS gas!
review_body: Anyone who's well-versed in sugar-free products probably knows what \\"sugar alcohols\\" are.  Products like this mix put \\"Splenda\\" prominently on the label, but if you read the ingredients, that is not the only artificial sweetener.  This mix contains maltitol, which just does not agree with me at all.  If I eat even a small brownie for lunch, there's no living with me for the next several hours (and my belly gets bloated, too).  If I eat one at dinner, I wake up in the middle of the night with horrendous gas pains.  If maltitol doesn't bother you, you're lucky.  But I won't buy these again, even though they taste great.

review_body: Years ago, they used to sell packaged brownies at the dollar store, dime stores, etc. They came 12 or so to a flat. product_title: Plum Organics Baby Second Blends, 4.0 Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Hard to believe this one gets 5 stars, right?  My daughter loves this!
review_body:
My daughter started out not really digging food. She warmed up to pears right away and was really particular about what else she liked. Mostly fruit (mango, pineapple, pear, blueberry) she would eat and peas on their own, forget it! I was a bit reluctant to try this flavor out seeing as my daughter absolutely refused to eat peas after trying them once. To my surprise she loved it! Loved it so much she ate nearly the entire packet in one sitting (unheard of for her). This is now a regular staple in our rotation and she simply can't get enough. As a Mom, I'm delighted she is so into veggies, I am happy to spend any amount of money on these little suckers as long as she's happy eating them.

Convenient pouches last for days in the fridge once opened. Easy to take anywhere with us, including traveling. The spoon attachments are really handy for these, but my little one enjoys eating straight from the bag. Slurp slurp slurp!

Messy with the green, so be sure to use a bib. Otherwise, hands down one of my favorite baby foods on the market.

product_title: Two Snooty Chefs Sea Salts Sampler 3 Pack, 11-Ounce Container
review_body: The alder-wood salt mixes well with the NZ sea salt for a more delicate flavor. Love this brand of salt and the neat containers it comes in. High quality salt.

review_body: Good quality berries with an excellent fragrance.  Offered at a very good price.  Nice, airtight container.  I'm a satisfied customer.

product_title: OTC Wine Crackers, Snack Packs, 1.7 Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I tried these at a wine tasting and immediately went home and searched for them on the internet. They are sweet little crackers, good with wine or anything else in my opinion.

product_title: Santa Fe Bean Co., Instant Southwestern Style Refried Beans, 7.25-Ounce Pack (Pack of 8)
review_headline: Contains the preservative TBHQ and Soybean Oil
review_body: When I lived in Arizona, I used to buy dehydrated Refried Beans from the bulk section in New Frontiers, and it was great!  I'm living in Chicago for the moment, and so I needed to find a good substitute for my New Frontier's refried bean mix.  I am writing this review to WARN you that I DID NOT find a good substitute with this product.  The consistency is good, thus the 2 stars, but that's about all that's good about it.  First of all, the prepared beans have no taste.  But the worst part is that Amazon and the product listing don't tell you that one of the ingredients is TBHQ.  I only discovered this because I started to have a reaction about a half hour after eating the beans.  I got itchy joints, waves of nausea, weak muscles, sleepiness, voracious thirst, cotton mouth...  I thought I would find MSG on the side of the package, because those are symptoms I get after eating MSG.  But then I saw that the preservative was TBHQ, which I had not heard of before.  I did some research and found out that many people have MSG-similar reactions to TBHQ.  This product also contains soybean oil, and I do my best to avoid anything with soy.  You may not be sensitive to these ingredients, but I wish someone had written a review mentioning this because if they had, I wouldn't have ordered the product.  I am now stuck with 7 more allergy-inducing packages of this stuff.

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_body: I enjoy using the Senseo pods.  One pod contains the perfect amount of coffee, and is so easy to use.  Since the Dr. recommended decaf instead of regular coffee, I have been very pleased with the \\"real coffee taste\\" of the Senseo pod.

product_title: V8 V-Fusion 100% Juice, Strawberry Banana, 8 Ounce (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Surprisingly enjoyable - perfect blend of nutrition and sweet flavor
review_body:
I've always heard about the many healthy drinks that V8 has made in the past. Many of the vegetable drinks (particular with tomato) made me go \\"blah.\\" But, the V8 fusion is a brilliant selection of nutrition drinks. Now, I can snap open and enjoy a refreshing drink, but also have a full serving of vegetable and fruits in every can. I am thoroughly impressed at the improvement that V8 has made. I'm convinced, and so are my family and friends whom have tried this drink at gatherings.

Some other thoughts:

* No Sugar, not preservatives, just 100% vegetables and fruits.
* Actually tastes good. I feel this is in part with the fruits. In the past, putting vegetables in drinks alone didn't work for me. The fusion of vegetables and fruits is a perfect match.

Be careful with how many you drink! Before you know it, you'll be chugging these things like water. But, that's not such a bad thing anyway. Highly recommended for craving for a sweet drinks, parties, and a drink with nutrition on-the-go.

product_title: Ethical Coffee Company Espresso, Cremoso for Nespresso Capsule Brewers, 10-Count (Pack of 5)
review_body: My office recently bought a DeLonghi Espresso machine, along with many varieties of espresso capsules to try out.  I was very excited as my love (and pickiness) of coffee and espresso has gone back many years since my first trip to France.  My definite favorite is the Cremoso from Ethical Coffee Company.  My mid-afternoon treat has quickly become a Cremoso double latte.  The aroma and the taste are wonderful, and it is the perfect pick-me-up to get through the rest of my day.  I have ordered a box of Cremoso to have at my desk as my own personal \\"stash\\".  My co-workers like several of the other varieties of Ethical Coffee, but my hands-down favorite is Cremoso.  An added bonus is that Ethical Coffee Company (the name says it all, doesn't it?) makes their capsules envinronmentally-friendly and biodegradable. I have been concerned about the millions of plastic capsules that are mounting up in our landfills. I will always support a company that combines great quality with integrity, and Ethical Coffee Company seems to be the only company in the coffee genre that does.

product_title: Nestle Nido Fortificada (Instant Milk), 3.52-Pound Container
review_headline: Was excited to order powdered milk for the first time...
review_body:
So I was so incredibly excited for this powdered milk to arrive. I looked at the reviews for this product and they were generally positive. I saw one dissenting review from a person who said they switched the manufacturing plant from Chile to Mexico and it was horrible now. I thought he was wrong and was just some bitter man with time on his hands.

Boy I was wrong.

I never tried this product when it was made in Chile, but I can tell you that it now tastes horrible and nothing like regular milk. It tastes like cheese, really old rotting cheese. It smells terrible, and all my buddies who I had try it agree with me. I have a friend who picked up powdered milk from Albertsons and his is substantially better. It's a store brand I believe, but I can't order that on Amazon.

I want to request my money back from Nestle. This is probably the worst product I ever ordered during my time here at Amazon and on prime.

product_title: Flufftastic 3 Flavor Party Pack Premium Cotton Candy Floss w/50 Cones, Pint
review_body: This sugar has great taste and wonderful color. The texture was top notch and the sugar produced beautiful cones. We love this stuff!

review_headline: Flavor okay - but not gluten free!
review_body: [[ASIN:B001IHWDX6 J&D's Original Bacon Salt 16-Ounce Bottle]] I purchased the large bottle of this, and used it a few times. It is what I would say so-so on the bacon flavor, but okay. However, my daughter read the ingredients, and we found that is has wheat in it, which is a no-no for gluten free diets. Bacon salt speaks to me of bacon flavored salt, not something made with wheat. Ergo, most of the bottle is in my cupboard, and I will not be re-ordering. Disappointed, because who doesn't love bacon?

product_title: The Ghost Hot Sauce
review_body: This sauce is very hot despite not containing any pepper extract. I have tried several sauces with pepper extract and not only are they ridiculously hot, but they tend not to taste very good. The Ghost Hot Sauce does without the extract and tastes excellent, without sacrificing too much of the heat!

product_title: The Spice Lab's 2 Pound - Himalayan Kosher Unprocessed Cooking Fine Grain Salt
review_body:
Up until now, I had only ever used koshering salt in my cooking. I really felt kind of silly making what felt like an extravagant salt purchase. I added the item to my shopping cart and then removed it several times. Eventually, my curiosity got the best of me and I pulled the trigger and bought this salt.

It truly does taste wonderful, especially as a 'finishing salt' added right before serving. On really ripe tomatoes, it is AWESOME! I have also learned that this salt is not really an extravagance when it comes to yeast bread baking. Apparently, yeast LOVES trace minerals! This salt has elevated my breads (both literally and figuratively) from pretty good to outstanding! And just like \\"that,\\" I no longer felt silly buying expensive salt, because, I have spent a LOT of money on natural additives to enhance my yeast bread baking. (This one was cheap in comparison and can be used for other things!)

I held back one star because I am very finicky about textures, and in very few applications with this salt, you can experience a very slight grittiness (from the undissolved minerals, I guess).

product_title: Haribo Gold-Bears Minis, 72-Count, 1 Pound 9.4 Ounce
review_headline: Perfect for someone who can't control themselves!
review_body: I lived in Germany for 8 years and became addicted to Haribo Gummi Bears.  Haribo and only Haribo.  All the other brands have a different texture and consistency, not to mention taste.  I returned stateside and found that World Market sold them in 5 lb bags.  I was thrilled!  Unfortunately, once the bag is open, I can't seem to stop eating them.  I would hate for them to go stale.  So these individual bags allow me to eat an entire bag at a time without the guilt.  The packaging is perfect for helping you assert your self control.  That's not to say that I haven't sat down and ate 6 bags (or more) at a time, but I figure with all the opening of the little bags, I am burning off almost as many calories as I am ingesting.  Anyway, shipping was quick, packaging was great and the gummi bears inside are delicious as ever.

product_title: Maeda-En - Sweet Green Tea Powder 4.23 Oz.
review_body: Bought this so I can make green tea cake and cupcakes.  When I opened the package, it was a smaller bag than i thought it was going to be but I guess a little goes a long way?  Great price.

product_title: Sanders Woodward Milk Chocolate Sea Salt Caramels, 7-Ounce
review_body: This is the first time I have purchased chocolate covered caramels with sea salt, so I can't say whether these are better or worse than any others.  I think they taste good but not great and not as good as I would have expected after the rapturous descriptions of sea salt caramels I have heard from friends and family.  The packaging of this product left a lot to be desired.  They came in an attractive flat cardboard box, with the candies placed in a molded plastic tray inside.  However, there were four empty spots in the plastic tray.  Upon further investigation, it seems that there were not empty spots, but that the candies shifted around to one end of the tray, making it look partially empty.  Also, due to excessive jostling during shipping, the candies looked all beaten up and most of the sea salt had been knocked off.  I think what is needed here is a better molded plastic tray that minimizes movement of the candies during shipping.  I contacted Amazon customer service and they gave me a 50% discount on my purchase price, which satisfied me.  After all, the candies were still edible.  I don't think Amazon can be held responsible for the damage.  The manufacturer should have packaged the product better.  However, given the shipping issues, and the fact that the candy was only good and not great, I'm not sure it is worth the price they are charging.

review_body:

product_title: Pomegranate Molasses (Sultan) 9.5fl.oz
review_headline: Don't use this in place of regular molasses!
review_body:
So I bought this pomegranate molasses to make Fattoush, the delicious middle eastern salad of greens, cukes, tomatoes and torn up bits of fried, leftover pita bread. Wowee, Fattoush is now my favorite salad, I've eaten so often lately that the tart lemon-y dressing has made the corners of my mouth turn a bit pinkish and raw, youch. I tend to do that, find a food I really like, then eat it so much I almost make myself sick on it.

Anyways, the Fattoush salad dressing, with it's complex blend of Sumac, olive oil and various herbs and spices required one half teaspoon of pomegranate molasses. I was lucky enough to find it at a Russian grocery store (YAY!). But the store is far away and so I had to look around online to buy more, thank God for Amazon.

Now, granted, my bottle will likely last years if all I do with it is make Fattoush, one goopy half teaspon at a time, so I've used it in a few other things. I added a teaspoon to a Lemon Chicken Marinade, a tiny glob to a bowl of greek yogurt (had to add honey too cuz it was sour!), a tiny amount added to Christmas Salmon cream cheese log, I used it in Fesenjen, a persian stew of chicken and walnuts, I used a few tablespoons of the sticky stuff in a garlicky barbecue sauce and it was the best barbecue ever.

Just don't do what I did and try to replace the molasses in molasses cookies with pomegranate molasses, what a horrible mess, the cookies looked normal, slightly lighter than normal, but the smell! And the taste! Ewwww!

review_body: I make most things from scratch at home and at work.  Watching the cooking show \\"Good Eats\\" which is my favorite....Alton Brown was using agave in his recipes. product_title: Lior Jelly Sour  Fruit Slices Candie, 5-pounds
review_body: Wow, what to say? These are delicious, fruit flavored candy. They have the taste and texture of Swedish Fish, not too rubberly gummy like gummis, but nicely chewy. The five flavors are lemon, orange, strawberry (I think) and Cherry (I think). The green one's flavor is indistinct: is it a very weak lime or something else? Who knows, but it's as tasty as the others.  The problem, and it's pretty insurmountable, is that these are NOT SOUR IN ANY WAY. The Amazon description is correct; the manufacturer label says 'Sour Fruit Slices.\\"  That's kind of like selling a product and naming it sugar-free even though it's made with sugar, isn't it?  So if you like Swedish Fish, get these and you will love them. If you're looking for sour candy, you'll have to pass these up or you will be totally disappointed.

review_body:
This Emeril's Jazzed up Decaf taste very good. My only reticence is that I'm wondering if it has some caffeine in it. When I have caffeine, I get a sort of a increased blood pressure buzz. I had that type of buzz after having this coffee. My wife had the type of feeling in her stomach that she gets when she has caffeine. I have no way to test the ingredients to be sure. But I wonder if this coffee is so \\"jazzed up\\" that it has a little caffeine. It would be interesting to see what other people's experience is.

UPDATE: - I've now tried this coffee a dozen times...I think it is safe to say that it has no caffeine. I haven't had the \\"buzz\\" I described above. But the coffee sure does taste good, so I increased my rating to 5 stars.

product_title: M&M'S Dark Chocolate Candy
review_body: I have no idea when M&M came out with the mint flavor.  But these are yummy.  I love all things mint.  I also Love Love Love dark chocolate.  Put them together..... Perfection.  These are perfect because they are bite sized.  I don't even mind sharing one or two pieces. LOL.  M&M got this one right.  I also like the peanut butter ones.  But the mint ones are amazing.  The combination is just right.  Sometimes when mint is combined with dark chocolate, one flavor tends to overpower the other.  Not with these.  The dark chocolate is rich and tastes like quality dark chocolate. Not all dark chocolates are created equal.  If you are a fan of the chocolate and mint,  you will love these.  I highly recommend.

product_title: Dark Chocolate Orange Fortune Cookies 3.5oz
review_body: Ok, I said great cookies and I mean it. I got a box for Valentines day. I love orange flavored chocolate and these have a wonderful chocolate coating. Not a cheap chocolate, a really nice lightly orange flavored chocolate coating over a very crisp fortune cookie. Not a stale fake vanilla flavored one like you often get from restaurants. A nice crunchy not too sweet cookie under just the right amount of smooth dark orange flavored chocolate. You will have to stop yourself eating more than one at a sitting. The fortunes are simple, \\"you will travel far away\\", or \\"The sooner you start the faster you finish\\" that sort of thing but who needs a fortune with they have these lovely cookies with their tea or hot cocoa? I am looking forward to trying the other varieties from this company.

product_title: KIND PLUS Gluten Free Bars
review_body: I ordered the Dark Chocolate Cherry Cashew bars and I was pleasantly surprised how good they tasted. My husband likes them and so does my daughter. The only thing is I wished they had a little less sugar. The nutritional facts say they have 14g of sugar. Now 14 grams of sugar is not bad if you are comparing it to a candy bar but for a nutritional bar I would ideally like 10g of sugar or less.

product_title: Ekobrew Coffee Reusable Filter, Small, Violet
review_body: We use this all the time.  All you have to do is put the grounds in (about 2/3 full), close it, and pop it into your keurig the same way you would with a k-cup.  It is SO much easier than the refillable cup that keurig makes itself - with that one, you have to remove part of the insides of your keurig.  I like saving money by using my own coffee instead of spending 50 cents or more per k-cup, and I like the way this is so much better for the environment than throwing out a container for every single cup of coffee you make.

product_title: Heinz Spotted Dick Sponge Pudding, 9.4-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_headline: This is the Best Dick I've ever had
review_body: Some may think it's a funny name but it is what it is. The best dick in a can you can get. You should go to your local market and ask for it by name. Don't try to make it at home it just isn't the same. I can tell you good dick is hard to come by.  Jolly good then just ask for it by name Spotted Dick.

product_title: Tisano Organic Chocolate Tea - 8oz Pouch
review_body: Some chocolate teas don't actually taste very much like chocolate. This is an exception, probably because it actually IS chocolate rather than chocolate flavor sprayed on tea leaves. I enjoy it by itself or blended with strong black tea.

product_title: Scharffen Berger Chocolate Bar, Markham Valley Semi-Sweet (68% Cacao), 3-Ounce Bars (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Complex, some off flavors when eating out of hand
review_body: I jumped at the chance to review Scharffen Berger Markham Valley Papua New Guinea Semi-Sweet chocolate...I've been a fan of Scharffen Berger for years. I used the Markham Valley in several baked goods, including a flourless cake, cookies, and fudge, as well as sampled some of it straight. At 68%, this is a bold semisweet bordering on bittersweet that is easily one of the most complex dark chocolates I've tried...there are fruity, wine-like notes with a somewhat sour finish when eating it plain, but when used in recipes this is not a notable characteristic. The chocolate is visually appealing and snaps cleanly; however, chocolate is scored in large triangles, which can make it awkward if you're attempting to break off a small piece. When melting it in a double boiler, it did not melt smoothly and remained a bit grainy despite low temps and regular stirring. Verdict: I found the flavor a bit too off-putting when eating it plain, but it makes an interesting (if pricey) addition to baked goods.

product_title: Bob's Red Mill Old Country Style Muesli
review_body: I \\"discovered\\" this product about 6 mos. ago; however, our local stores only sell it in 18 oz. packages.  Wasn't sure I would actually use it in such a large quantity; however, after working out the per oz. cost (very much less expensive than the small packages), I decided to purchase it.  I really love it....either hot in the microwave or cold with Greek yogurt and fruit.  And, I'm almost through the entire first bag.  If it's something you enjoy, would definitely recommend purchasing it via Amazon in the larger quantity.

product_title: Reese Fancy 15% Leg Crabmeat, 6-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: Title say it all. About 90 percent of the content is just the little bit salty messy tasteless tiny crab meat. I can garantte even water boiled chicken taste better than this. Avoid at all cost since they come with Pack of 12, and I think I will never touch the second can.

product_title: Vandevi Hing (Asafoetida) 100g (3.5oz) - Pack of 2
review_body:
Asafoetida is sometimes called \\"Devil's Dung,\\" and the name is appropriate (and explains why \\"foetid\\" is a part of its proper name). If you're not prepared for the use and storage of this product, you may be surprised by just how pungent and vivid the smell is--but the flavor it lends your curries and other dishes is totally worth the exposure. As the Asafoetida interacts with butter or fat, the odor disappears and the flavors really come out to play.

The only downside about this product is that the container is somewhat difficult to open. I actually cut a new hole in the plastic in order to get the product out, and even when I re-sealed the container the smell permeated the whole kitchen. I ended up resolving this issue by sealing the container within a second--glass-container. Glass seals the smell in and saves you the embarrassment of having to explain to your housemates why the house reeks of something devilish.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee, Colombian Decaffeinated Medium K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50)
review_body: I enjoy this brew in the evenings when I'm not interested in more caffeine. Wolf Gang Colombian in the AM, This one in the PM. As I have stated in other such reviews, I think all of the K-cups are over priced but I am satisfied with ordering from Amazon. Competitive price, timely delivery and overall good experience.

product_title: Natural Value Coconut Milk
review_body:
We bought this brand at our little health food store in Idyllwild, CA never having heard of it before. By the name I was wary, thinking it might be a high-priced but cheap product. Wrong! It was absolutely delicious, very creamy and fresh tasting. Completely recommended and now I am ordering it on Subscribe and Save. One caveat: I made coconut milk tapioca pudding in both chocolate and vanilla. While both were wonderfully delicious, but I thought I would point out that a slight graininess was obvious in the vanilla version. This was not really a factor in the chocolate. Perhaps I just don't notice with chocolate because a certain graininess often shows up in chocolate puddings anyway - because of the chocolate itself. And I would say that the extremely fine graininess is also a sign that the product is pure coconut.

March, 2013: they now have a BPA-free can and no guar gum. Just organic coconut and water. And yet it is so thick I spoon it into coffee (which I love) and it makes such a creamy addition to soups.

product_title: Farm-fresh: 100% Kona Coffee, Dark Roast, Whole Beans, 1 Lb
review_body:
My husband loves medium blends. I love dark roast, I heard that this was the \\"best\\". So I bought it for him this past Christmas. Husband thought it was fantastic, I was expecting the \\"best\\" and was disappointed, I got him the medium roast. I really liked it, but wished for a darker roast. Coffee really is subjective. Recently someone told me to try a particular Sumatra, said it was the \\"best\\" and it was nasty, I tossed it out. Very bitter, it should never be bitter.

His birthday is tomorrow and I had to get him another medium pound, but I also added this dark roast. WOW. I am in love!

It's the best. Now that I understand how subjective coffee is, we all like diffrent beans, blends,roasts, some in my family like added flavors (shudder), i think good coffee has enough flavor by itself and only inferior needs additives.

I love darker roasts, creamy, chocolately, luscious. This is all you'd expect.

Having now tried both, all I can say is you will really enjoy both types, but love the roast you normally prefer.

The price can't be beat and they don't charge you high S&H rates, that's a nice feature.

I hope this helps.

product_title: Stash Tea Jasmine Blossom Tea
review_body: Stash is by far the best company for jasmine tea. I love this stuff! The only thing I would say to a new customer is don't reuse tea bags. Other than that, enjoy! It doesn't get better than this!  I don't understand why you would buy it from this vender though. The shipping is outrageous! You can get this tea at many grocery stores, and there are many places online were you can get free shipping.

product_title: Native Forest Organic Coconut Milk
review_body: This is the best coconut milk I've tasted.  It has a really pleasant coconut flavor, and absolutely none of that horrid sulfite taste that almost all regular brands have.  We've been using Trader Joe's coconut milk for some time because it is readily available and also without sulfites.  But there is no comparison on the taste.  Native Forest is tremendously tastier.  I'm switching for good.  Based on the fat content, it is cheaper than TJ's by about a third as well.  TJ's is really watered down in comparison.  And Amazon's free shipping keeps the cost low.

product_title: Melissa's Fresh Young Coconuts, Set of 3
review_body: wow! almost $60 including shipping for just 3 coconuts? you people must be insane! 10 sales on here and id have enough money to go to the caribbean and sit on the beach and have thousands of trees with 100's of coconut for free and enjoy a nice vacation at that. WOW

product_title: Barbara's Bakery Snackimals Animal Cookies
review_body: I notice that the most positive reviews are from a few years ago, and the most negative reviews are more recent.  We used to buy these in larger containers at the local \\"healthy supermarket,\\" and my family really liked them.  That was a few years ago.  Now, they sit in the back of the pantry and no one touches them--either the recipe changed or my family's tastes changed.  They are dry, about half of them are broken, and they taste like sweetened cardboard.  (We have the vanilla variety.)  The individual packs are handy for hikes and portable snacks, but I've noticed that they frequently come back unopened.  Guess I'll look for an alternative.

product_title: Cheech Hot Sauce, Smokin Chipotle, 5 Ounce
review_body: I bought this as a gift to my daughter (and myself).  Somebody gave me a sampler as a gift a few years back.  This one quickly became my daughter's absolute favorite.  It's not too hot, but has heat, and it's just plain yummy. Can't seem to find it in stores.  This company wasn't the cheapest per bottle, but they only charged 1 shipping price for all 4 bottles I ordered.  Everybody else wanted to charge shipping per bottle.

product_title: ST. DALFOUR Organic Tea, Vanilla, Tea Bags, 25-Count Box (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is the most flavorful tea I have ever had. I use chocolate vanilla stevia to sweaten it with a tiny pinch of cherry stevia. It is the most yummy drink in the Universe, and it is organic!

product_title: Iveta Gourmet Biscuit Mix, Dill Shallot, 7.7-Ounce Units (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Biscuits that a southerner would love
review_body: This biscuit mix is divine. I made two packages of biscuits for a Holiday luncheon. They were a big hit with the attendees. Several people asked for the recipe. I had to come clean and tell them about the mix. :+( The biscuits are very delicate and flavorful.

product_title: Inka Crops Inka Corn - Roasted, 4-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: Rarely eat corn nuts but these are large kernals, just right amount of salt and big crunch.  bag is generous and I saved and ate corn for a day or two.  Flavor like frito stuff.  Fair price for me.  Gotta' try this!

product_title: The TeaSpot Steeping Lime Mug with Infuser & Lid (16-Ounce Cup)
review_headline: Arrived broken, continued to slowly break over the course of a week.
review_body: Opened this on Christmas morning to find the infuser shattered. Amazon cheerfully refunded the full cost of the item and told me not to bother returning the rest. The third or fourth time I filled it with boiling water, it cracked all the way down the side.

product_title: Cream of Rice Hot Cereal, 14 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: Odd that you cannot find it anymore in stores.  Anyhow, I just love this because it reminds me of my childhood and it's just a simple breakfast with versatility - mix in some fresh fruit, or with a dab of butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon (my personal favorite).  It tastes so much better to me than cream of wheat.  I also ordered from Amazon when I saw it there.  I was talking to a friend of mine who's husband was recently diagnosed with colon cancer and I thought this would be something he could easily eat.  Plus, I am sure it's perfect for babies even though I enjoy it so much myself.

product_title: Mexican Coca Cola, Drink Cola, 12 Ounce (24 Pack)
review_headline: What I didn't know before buying Mexican Coke  on Amazon
review_body: I love Coca-Cola & have for decades. Mexican Coke is it for me. I live in Chicago and can find bottles sold in stores. But I wanted to get cases which I only found at warehouse stores some times. So I purchased Mexican Coke on Amazon. The Coke came in a large box. Each bottle was individually wrapped in bubble wrap. Over that, the bottles were individually wrapped in brown paper. I don't know if the cost of 24 pack Mexican Coca-Cola is expensive because of the wrapping product, the labor cost, both, or neither. I suspected both the wrapping and labor cost drove the price up. Now that I saw how the Coke got delivered, I will avoid buying it online again but I am enjoying it.

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig 1.0, 2-Count
review_body: No regrets for this purchase!  Functions exactly as it should.  I love my coffee, but hated having to change out the keurig insert when not using a K cup.  This product solves the inconvenience.  I have had the product for over a month and use them multiple times each day.  I highly recommend these for serious coffee drinkers!!

product_title: Grove Square Cappuccino, Single Serve Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: There's only one word to describe this.............. Yummy!  You won't be disappointed if you love latte type drinks.  It is a \\"sweet\\" drink.

product_title: Zola 100% Pure Coconut Water, 17.5-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: I was very please to have been introduced and found this wonderful, refreshing healthy drink.  One of my ongoing problems right now is trying to get my 93 year old mother to consume more  fluids, as she has taken a dislike to water.  Well Zola......thank you, thank you, thank you!  She absolutely loved it, as did I and I do not think i will have a problem anymore with her fluid intake.  She can drink to her hearts content with my having the comfort of knowing she is putting a high quality, delicious product in her system.

product_title: Delverde Linguine, 16 oz
review_headline: This is the best little pasta in the whole wide world!
review_body: DELVERDE Linguine Fini No.11 made in Majella National Park,Italy cooks in 6 minutes and is the smoothest most delicious pasta in the world!This pasta is produced with pure, natural spring water and slowly dried the old fashion way.
