Trust me if you can get this pasta you will be spoiled for life and want to smile with every succulent strand!I'm gonna grab some right now,saute a little garlic, onion, tommato and oregano and have the best six minute meal money can buy! I'm FFUNY on twitter!Give me a tweet and tell Amazon to get you some DELVERDE! I could use a couple of cases right now!

product_title: Grove Square Caramel Apple Cider
review_headline: Loved the Sugar Free Hot Cider
review_body: I plan to order some more of this cider. It is a bit more sweeter than I typically like, however, I like the taste very much. The caramel flavor is blended well with the apple cider flavoring. Great buy!!

product_title: Santa Cruz Dried Fruit Tray with Savory Nuts Gift Tray
review_body: Received excellent product on time and as described.  Will definitely use the same vendor when time comes.  Excellent customer service.  Highly recommended.

product_title: Oskri Fiber Bar, Cashews and Cranberries, Gluten Free, 20 - 1.5-Ounce Bars
review_body: The bars arrived amazingly fast.  They taste good and have a large amount of fiber.  I plan to order these regularly.

product_title: Concord Candy Blox, Build'Em & Eat'Em- Assorted Fruit Flavor, 1 Lb
review_body: came as described but in a bag so many of the tops notches were broken off. none of the kids could bite into them without chipping a tooth but all of us adults really enjoyed the taste after sucking on them for a while. Used them for sons lego party and they were mainly a cute decoration. I would buy again..

product_title: Nescafe Alta Rica Instant Coffee 3.5oz/100g
review_body: Because I love this particular instant coffee I searched the Web and found I could get it from amazon. Great!  What I didn't expect was a parcel from the Bronx in New York, especially when I opened the parcel and the coffee was covered with a Polish label.  Anyway, well done Amazon

product_title: Twinings Organic and Fair Trade Certified Green Tea with Jasmine Tea Bags, 120(6 packs)
review_body: After experiencing \\"soapy\\" tasting flower-enhanced teas before, I was apprehensive. I usually prefer loose-leaf teas, but I tried this because I received a sample (and loose-leaf can be difficult to manage at work). I absolutely loved the scent as the tea steeped. The taste is very mild and I can see it pairing quite well with good Asian food, or just as an anytime treat. The scent stays fairly strong and it seems as though you're sitting amongst jasmine in full bloom with every sip. I usually have a teaspoon of sugar or honey in my tea but, while you could give it a hint of sweetness, you really don't need it. Great job, Twinings!

product_title: Seaweed Confectionery Noriten Kankoku Ajitsuke Cracker
review_body: Can't have just one or two. Seaweed lovers must have. It is a bit pricey but hey, if you don't have an Asian store around carrying this brand, you MUST order from here. Fast delivery service.

product_title: Jack Link's Beef Jerky
review_body: Great product. Great tasting, low fat, high protein, just right for mid day snack so that you have the energy to finish out the job of the day.

product_title: Ice Breakers Wintergreen Tins- 8 ct,1.5 oz each
review_headline: Quite Good Mints, Even For Coughs.
review_body:
Some time ago, I purchased some mints in a little round box. I used them as breath fresheners and they worked quite well. As I was going through the usage, my three-year-old son developed a mild cold with a cough. I was out of cough drops so when he was coughing, I gave him a breath mint for soothing. That seemed to solve the problem just as well as a cough drop. Well, his cold is long gone but it seems as if he's developed a little fake cough in order to get another breath mint. Kids can be so funny! In any case, I finally ran out so I picked up a couple more little boxes of Ice Breakers in the wintergreen and coolmint flavors. They're sugar free, which probably suits both of us well. They're quite good mints for my purposes and they seem to overcome his little cough too.

Gary Peterson

product_title: Hoosier Hill Farm Wasabi Peas, 5 lbs. (80 oz.)
review_body: These are the best wasabi peas I've ever tasted and I've tried tons of brands. Zestier than Hapi, tastier than Trader Joe's, these will leave you coming back for more!!

product_title: Nature's Best Bouquet
review_body: I ordered these on 2/14 in the afternoon.  They were delivered 2/15 before noon.  I almost fell out of my chair!  My mother called and said that they were extra-nice blooms and that they looked like a premium bouquet, not something standard that you'd get from a carryout florist or anything, but extra nice and almost exotically big blossoms.  I've never heard her rave about flowers so much and I've sent her flowers on lots of occasions.  I'm doing this one again.  Beats spending $75 or more on something she is not as happy about.

product_title: Plastic Popcorn Tubs for Movie Night! - 1 Jumbo Tub and 4 Individual Tubs
review_body: Many stores sell heavy duty plastic popcorn logo'd containers. I thought that's what I ordered. Be advised that these are very flimsy plastic similar to what you would get with a Big Gulp cup. Definitely not worth the price and not worth the time of a return.

product_title: Yogi Tea Snack Tea Bags, Caramel Apple Spice, 16 Count
review_body:
I LOVE Yogi Tea. To be quite honest I'm crazy about it. A coworker gave me a few varieties and I was just astonished how tasty a simple herbal tea could be. I'm fond of nice wine, Belgian beers, excellent espresso, black tea, yerba mate, and other very interesting, flavorful things. I never tasted an herbal tea like these. All of this is to say, these are some wonderful, high-quality teas. The caveat is, almost every one has one very prominent 'base note'. I should also note that while I'm interested in the effects of homeopathic or 'traditional' herbal remedies, I'm really not any more than curious. I'm a skeptic. I'm just interested in how each recipe actually helps me feel. My interest in these teas is primarily for the fantastic flavors from their high-quality ingredients.

Relaxed Mind is predominantly sage. Some bags have a sweet twinge, some are really a dry sage mix that seems more like a solution of Italian cooking herbs. It is pleasant but not my favorite. I do think it has some positive, calming effects. I would like it better if the sage was more balanced with other flavors.

product_title: Cadbury Roses Carton - 331g
review_body: As expected, it was  excellent. It arrived in. 2 wks which was around 10 days earlier than its expected time. Satisfied

product_title: Plum Organics Baby Second Blends, 4.0 Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)
review_body: My son, who is 8 months, loves this flavor.  In fact, he really likes all of the Plum organics flavors.

product_title: Kirkland Signature European Cookies with Belgian Chocolate, 49.4 Ounce
review_body: I bought several tins of these as Christmas gifts, plus one tin for ourselves.  They are excellent cookies, and totally irresistible.  All our friends who received them thought they were wonderful.  It's a good thing I only indulge in these during the holidays, as they are almost too good!

product_title: Made in Nature Dates Figs and Apricots
review_body: I thought that these figs were produced in the U.S. because Made in Nature is headquartered in California and because one of the types of figs commonly grown in California is Calimyrna.  However, I just received my order and found out these figs came from Turkey.  They taste okay (no significant differences from dried figs that I have purchased in the past at local grocery stores), but I will not be buying them again because they are not produced in the U.S.

product_title: Arcor Butterscotch Buttons, 1.5 LB
review_body: The taste is strong and these hard candies last a while as they melt in your mouth.  There are plenty in a bag to last you a while.  If you like butterscotch, these are the real deal.

product_title: Pastariso Instant Rice Mac and Cheese Meal Cup, 2 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Great texture and flavor Mac & Cheese
review_body: I was really happy with the texture that came fromt his mac & cheese. I've tried others that turn mushy after cooking and this stays in a great noodle shape. I do recommend letting it sit for about 3 minutes after cooking because it's so hot you'll burn yourself and also the flavor with absorb into the noodles a little more and make it less soupy.

product_title: Raw Shelled Sunflower Seeds Kernels
review_body:
Simply put...these are raw sunflower seeds and nothing else. They dont have the 'organic' tag, so be aware of that if it will be a determining factor for your purchase. However, they are simply just clean, unsalted seeds, that for me, are both a perfect snack and a useful ingredient. Although not on an exclusively plant-based diet, i mostly adhere to that philosophy, and am vegan regardless. So...i look for ways to avoid using oil and such in my foods, and raw sunflower seeds make a great substitute for oil in salad dressings and such. Anyways, four big bags of sunflowere seeds such as you would receive if you order this, will go a long ways in your kitchen. Whether as a snack, ingredient, or both, i figure one order will last you two months on average. A very good product at a very reasonable price, especially with subscribe & save.

Enjoy!

product_title: Prince Pasta Pastina 12-Ounce Packages (Pack of 15)
review_body: Good comfort food.  So simple but so good.  I like to use 3 parts water to one part pastina for a no-drain method.  Stir in some butter, salt and pepper and it's heavenly.  Get creative, but go gentle. You don't want to overpower the simple goodness of this stuff.

product_title: Alsa - French Cake Baking Powder, 0.38 Ounce, 8 Count
review_body: My husband was stationed in korea and I could not find this product anywhere to make my vietnamese sausage. For a minute I thought i was getting a good price....When I came back to the states I bought this item in a asain market for only $1.09! I was so mad when I realized I could have gotten 35 sachets for the price that this person is charging for 7! So my advice is if you really need this product and cant find it anywhere then I guess you gotta buy it...but if you have access to a chinatown or a asian market they will have this prduct and sell it to you for 4x less money! WHAT A RIP OFF!

product_title: Ritter Sport Bars, Peppermint, 3.5 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_headline: A bit expensive but worth it for a once a year treat
review_body: In 2010, the stores around me stocked this but not this past year so I purchased it here. These are very good. Even so, I am hoping and planning to make this box last a while because they are a bit expensive for me.

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body: This is the story of how I stopped drinking milk.  I was out on a stroll to the grocery store, just minding my own business.  Suddenly, I heard a rustling in the trees.  Before I could realize what was happening, a jug of Tuscan Whole Milk, 1 Gallon, 128 fl oz flew out of nowhere and lodged itself in my knee.  In conclusion, I used to be a milk drinker, until I took a gallon of Tuscan Whole Milk to the knee.

product_title: Andes Creme De Menthe Cookies 7 Oz Net Wt
review_body: These cookies were very good!  Everyone enjoyed it!  I first tried it when a co-worker brought it for the office during the holidays.  i looked all over and couldn't find them.  I was pleased to find it on Amazon and bought 3 boxes.  i wish they were available in the stores all year round, i'd buy then all the time!

product_title: Sir Anthony Dinosaur Egg with Chocolate Dinosaurs, 8.0-Ounce
review_body: This item was ordered for a dinosaur themed birthday party.  It was out of stock for awhile or we might have ordered two before we opened it.  We were glad we didn't.  The egg was already cracked and broken, as were the TINY chocolate dinosaurs inside. It wasn't easy to give each of the children anything resembling a complete dinosaur, but they were so tiny it didn't even matter.  I would definitely not order this item again.

product_title: Monin Lavender Syrup, 25.4-Ounce (750 ml) Glass Bottle
review_body: I must admit that I love all floral flavors (Violet, Rose, Lavender & Jasmine)so this syrup did not disappoint me.  I have used it mainly in Italian Soda's, because it is so refreshing in the summer, but it's also lovely in tea. It has a beautiful color (it does have a little food color in it) and flavor when used just with soda/seltzer water, or as an unusual ice cream topping for a plain vanilla.  I am going to experiment with it some more in my dessert recipes(& I am also going to buy the rose & violet flavors as well). I feel the aroma is sufficiently lavender and while the flavor is sweet (because of added sugar), it is clearly marked a SYRUP, not just an essence, so be careful when ordering if you require the flavor for a certain recipe.

product_title: Pure Bar Organic Variety Pack, Fruit & Nut Bars, 1.7-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_body: I was very dissapointed witht he condition the bars came in. I opened the factory sealed box only to find 1 of 12 of the bars packaging was open and growing fungis. So i guess i paid for 11 bars instead of 12.. How does an open package bar get in a factory sealed box?

product_title: Marutomo Katsuo Bonito Flake Hana, 16-Ounce Units
review_body: We buy this as a topper for when our cats decide to be finicky.  They love bonito flakes.  It's much less expensive to buy it this way than the little containers that are \\"for pets\\" in pet food stores.

product_title: Raw Revolution Organic Live Food Bars, 1.8-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_body: I absolutely love these bars. Not too sweet. Lovely texture. Great flavor and aroma. Please don't change a thing! I'd like to try some other flavors.

product_title: MDH Amchur Powder (Dehydrated Unripe Mango), 3.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 10)
review_headline: Add an acid note to a dish
review_body: The difference between a chef and a good cook is that a chef seems to put vinegar into everything.  Not the same type of vinegar, to be sure.  The acidity of lemon juice or vinegar seems to add a sparkle to every dish.  I frequently substitute amchur powder for these ingredients when I am trying to liven up a dish.  It's cheap enough and lasts forever.  I first tried it in a lentil dish and got sold.

product_title: Regal Walnut, Raw, 7-ounces (pack of 8)
review_body: Regal puts out the closest thing to a fresh walnut I have yet to find, and without the mess in the bottom or a plastic smell or taste from packaging. My only trouble and complaint now is that they are out of stock :(

product_title: Lipton Tea and Honey Iced Green Tea To Go Packets

review_body: Not being able to get cashew turtles in my area Amazon came to my rescue.  Not only are they a most delicious delicacy but the cashew turtles arrived beautifully presented in a delightfully attractive box.

review_body: We receive several gifts packages every year due to family being scattered through out the US. The description does not go into the actual contents of each basket and from the other reviews I see there are similarities, but there is no theme in this package. review_body: Another successful Christmas in \\"farin\\" and I still got to have my traditional Jamaican Sorrel rum punch. This is a good deal, and the 2 packs made me about a gallon of sorrel. product_title: Yehuda Matzo (Kosher for Passover)
review_body: Can't say that we've found a better matzoh for Passover, but we use it all year round, makes a good addition to breakfast sometimes with butter or margarine and honey or jam.

product_title: Albanese Wild Cherry Gummi Bears, 5-Pound Bags (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Like an Old Fashion Cherry Lollipop!  Juicy and Very Cherry.
review_body:
I am so in love with Albanese Gummi Candy. The consistency is not too soft and not too hard. It is definitely a little softer than Haribo, but is much, much juicier and has more flavor. It is not as soft as a Fruit Slice by any means. There is a good chew to this gummi and the flavor releases as you chew. I do like Haribo, but, sometimes it feels like chewing and sweet rubber; you will not have that feeling with the Albanese brand. The Wild Cherry flavor is very cherrylicious and just sweet enough. My husband favors the Wild Cherry over most of the other flavors, but he does love a lot of the other flavors as well. This Wild Cherry flavors compares best to a cherry lollipop like you ate as a kid. It's got a pure cherry candy; not artificial. The kind your doctor would give you for being good at your check up.

So, if you are a gummi bear lover and a cherry candy lover, get this candy. The price is phenomenal. You get two bags of five pounds each for a total of ten pounds! That's a lot of candy. I always have candy out in pretty clear containers at my home so that my friends will feel comfortable taking what they want. They all seem to gravitate to the Albanese Gummi Bears. I seem to love most of the flavors.

The gummi bears are really cute too! They were shipped in perfect condition and there was no melting and I am in Florida. They were a bit warm, but they quickly come to room temperature and are perfect.

These would be cute for a red themed party, Fourth of July party, wedding treats and a candy bar too. This is a candy everyone can enjoy, young and old!

product_title: Cadbury Caramel Chocolate Eggs: 48ct Box
review_body: Cadbury's caramel eggs are simply perfect in my opinion.  I have been eating them every Easter for several years now.  I love to put them in the fridge and gnaw on the chocolate like a mouse would.  Then I let the caramel drip onto my tongue....Makes me crave one just by talking about them!  The chocolate is smooth and rich and the caramel is the perfect consistency.  Together they make a treat to die for!  About four years ago I was in my local WalGreens drug store a few days after Easter and they had a lot of leftover holiday candy.  There must  have been 2 or 3 HUNDRED caramel eggs leftover.  They were selling the 4-pack for a dime each!  I bought them out!  The candy lasted until Christmas when I gave quite a few as stocking stuffers to all my nieces and nephews.  Funny thing is: I never gained any weight when I ate them.  I think the trick was to pace myself.  Only 2 eggs every other day.  But I sure wanted more!

product_title: Pez Candy Dispenser: Star Wars LE Glow Emperor Palpatine Blister Card
review_body: I am a serious pez collector. This was just the thing for my collection. It glows very well and looks very cool. I am more then happy with this purchase.

review_headline: Versatile snack bar with solid nutrition
review_body: I really like these Chewy bars by Enjoy Life.  I first purchased a few boxes at the local grocery store, but figured I could shave off some of the cost by going through Amazon.  I noticed a lot of other customers have complained about the small size.  Yes, the bars are small and, therefore, are kind of pricey.  But you get a good texture and flavor - difficult to find on a gluten-free diet - and a decently portioned snack for on-the-go, all with the benefits of useful nutrition.  Certainly a good balance for a snack or to round out a meal.  I recommend giving these a try by buying a box at the grocery store to make sure you like them.  The \\"Cocoa Loco\\" flavor is excellent too.

review_body: All products from Pilao are excellent, including the regular coffees but the Reserva Especial is truly special in its purity and taste, from the moment you brew (it will fill the place up with a fantastic fresh aroma) until the last drop. product_title: Frontier Chili Peppers Ground, Cayenne 90,000 Hu, 16 Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Exactly what I wanted, you wont find this at your local mart
review_body:
First off I thought I ordered 2 bags that equaled out to 1lb but was pleasantly surprised that it was actually 2 1LB bags for a total of 2LBs of surprisingly hot and flavorful cayenne. The stuff in the grocery store is reportedly 30,000 SKU or less and this powder knocks what I have bought in the past, out of the park.

I bought this mainly for cayenne's rich health benefits and am making a tincture with it as well as eating 3tsps a day. Cayenne pepper especially at 90,000 SKU can really help lower your blood pressure, improve circulation, stop profuse bleeding, gives energy, increases metabolism, can stop a heart attack in its tracks, and many other benefits. Google it if you don't believe it, some see it as one of the most beneficial foods to cook with and have in your house. Anyways enough homeopathic babble.....

Bottom line is this stuff has GREAT flavor much better than other store bought kinds I have purchased and really packs the heat! I put half a table spoon in my chicken noodle soup as I have done in the past with store bought brands and boy did I regret it haha if you don't have a heat tolerance and are taking this as a daily supplement I would suggest starting with 1/8 of a tea spoon in 8ozs of warm water and working your way up to 1 tsp 3 times daily for max effects. In comparison to fresh pepper heat I would rather nibble down a habanero or Thai dragon chili both ranking around 100,000 SKU than a table spoon of this stuff like I did in my soup, not to say its bad cayenne but just that a little powder goes a long ways and that's what makes this such a GREAT deal!

If you are looking to spice up dishes, watch out for your health, or use it for any number of other uses then this is the cayenne for you. This stuff is HOTTTT and you will not be disappointed or find a hotter cayenne pepper powder for this price on Amazon!

product_title: LUNDBERG RICE BRWN WILD BLEND GF, 16 OZ
review_body:
First off, we all love rice at our house. I also love wild rice and rice pilaf,
although the others are not all that big on those dishes.

So, when I read the descriptions on this, I thought it sounded really tasty, but
had some real hesitations about buying six packs of the rice. I wondered how we'd actually
manage to use six bags before it went bad.

Well, the bags are not all that huge. Each bag is one pound of rice. I guess I had a hard
time visualizing it, but the bags are fairly small. I don't have one in front of me, but they
are maybe 6\\" square.

Anyway, we made the first bag this weekend, putting it in a crock pot and letting it cook
on low for 2 or 3 hours. Hubby is the chef in our house, and he used beef broth with the rice.
We had it with some sausage for dinner. Let me say - WOW!
This is really tasty rice! Between the four of us, we managed to wipe out the entire pound
of rice (yes, it was that good!), and were figuring out what the next meal with the rice would be!

Watch your prices on this - they vary widely, even across Amazon.
Try to stay under $3 a bag.
Seriously, this stuff tastes great! It was tasty, filling and actually easier to
chew than I thought it might be (I have troubles with crunchy foods).

Thank you Lundberg for a really great blend of rice. You've converted us!

product_title: SToK Caffeinated Black Coffee Shots, 264-Count Single-Serve Packages
review_body: This little container turns my morning coffee into a burst of energy for me. It has a rich smooth taste and blends in well with whatever coffee brand I choose to use. I enjoy the convenience of having my coffee at home when I want it. I save so much money by using this product instead of outside vendors.

product_title: Spicy World Madagascar Bourbon Vanilla Beans,  1/2 - Pound Bags
review_body: These have good flavor. Plenty of other reviews address that. I also like the thick zipper bag they came in. My only real issue with these is that mine grew mold. I've never had vanilla beans do that before. These seemed unusually moist, so maybe that contributed to the issue. It started as a small spot, but grew so that it was on the ends of most of the beans. I finally got them all out, trimmed off the moldy bits, and froze what was left.  It took 2-3 months for the mold to start, so if you use them quickly maybe that won't be a problem. But, I don't go through them that fast. I've had beans dry out in the past, but this is the first I've seen of mold. If you don't plan to use them within 2 months or so, I recommend keeping them in a fridge, freezer or coming up with some other way to stop the mold before it starts.

review_body:
PGPR

December 27, 2009

tags: a new ingredient, chocolate, cocoa butter, health, hershey's, low end chocolate, messing with my chocolate, nestle, pgpr

by crazybengal
.

Aww. What a cute little acronym! So tiny and innocent. What are you doing in my chocolate, little PGPR? You wern't there a few years ago. Let's find out what you are.

PGPR is known in the candy industry as polyglycerol polyricinoleate.

Wow. Cool! Wonder why they put you in my Hershey's chocolate bar. Could it be because it makes the chocolate better?

Of course not. PGRP is used to replace the expensive cocoa butter that is normally found in chocolate.

Well, is it better for you?

Of course not.

What you need to know:

The 1996 study conducted by Andrew Waterhouse of UC Davis which discovered the phenols (potent antioxidants) in chocolate also revealed that these antioxidants come from cocoa butter and the stearic acid it produces. It demonstrated that the phenols prevented LDL cholesterol from building up in arteries. Another study had subjects follow diets in which the majority of fat calories came from either chocolate or butter; only those with the butterfat diet showed an increase in LDL cholesterol.

This is why dark chocolate, which usually contains between about 30% and 50% cocoa butter, is touted for its antioxidant properties, and a bar of Hershey's milk chocolate is not. Unfortunately, Hershey's in particular - one of the biggest users of PGPR - has also moved to take advantage of the new healthier perception of dark chocolate. Not only have they begun buying small high-end chocolate producers like Scharffen-Berger and Joseph Schmidt Chocolates, but they have also expanded their dark chocolate line and begun marketing it heavily as a healthy treat. Besides the irony of their simultaneous replacement of antioxidant-filled cocoa butter with PGPR in theircheaper chocolates, they have put corn syrup in many items from the more expensive and supposedly healthy dark chocolate line.

This is the kind of behavior that buying PGPR-enhanced chocolate supports. Dishonest; unscrupulous; pulling the wool over consumers' eyes. Read your ingredient listings carefully, and research the unfamiliar, and you can feed your mind as well as your body.

product_title: Kellogg's Krave Chocolate Cereal, 11.4 Ounce
review_body:
I was excited when I saw the commercial for Krave. Being a genetic chocoholic (my entire family as far back as we know) I knew I'd try it as soon as it hit the shelves in spite of not being truly satisfied with *any* chocolate flavored cereal - ever - even as a kid.

I purchased a box of each variety and tried the \\"plain\\" one first. Of course the first thing I had to do was bite one in half to see the chocolate center. I had to really look to see the very small, thin strip of chocolate on one side of the inside of the hollow pillow. Nothing like the box photo which seems to show a full chocolate center (could that be considered false advertising?). I ate a few dry. They were \\"just OK\\". The outer shell is somewhat bland but the chocolate seemed to come through a bit, however nothing as strong or full as I'd expected. Considering the size of the strip I wasn't totally surprised at this result. So out comes the milk for a bowl full. It works OK with milk but has a very odd mouth feel. Somewhat grainy but the chocolate stood out more and presented a more chocolate flavor than when eaten dry. It's not a *great* chocolate, tasting much like a chocolate syrup mixed with a chocolate spread, but acceptable for a breakfast cereal having a bit more chocolate flavor than most. Then the side effects hit. The chocolate didn't really melt as much as it combined with the shell turning into a paste that stuck to my teeth much like a gummy snack. Bummer. Then, after only a few spoonfuls, the shell began to get soggy. The mouth feel was a bit better when soggy (not as grainy) but the gummy effect seemed to intensify. I was very disappointed with the cereal and couldn't wait for the box to empty so I could move on to something better. The sad part is I still have a box of the chocolate outer shell variety that I just can't bring myself to open.

I *did* cut the product coupon off the box just in case the chocolate outer shell version is better than the \\"plain\\" version. I have a strong feeling that coupon will expire.the \\"plain\\" version. I have a strong feeling that coupon will expire.

review_headline: Gluten free or not?! Check their website!

After going to their website and looking up the Q&A's, I found that the company says it has been tested and MOST people don't have a reaction but admit that some people do. Sorry, but I think that alone should be enough to take off the claim of being gluten free.

Thankfully I did not buy this product, but I want to put this review up because when I was first diagnosed, I didn't know that barley was a no-no and and only when with companies claiming \\"gluten free\\" and did myself a lot of harm. I am trying to save others the same harm, or better yet, have the company remove the Gluten Free status!

product_title: Nutiva Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, 15 Ounce
review_body:
Marvelous product this Nutiva OEV Coconut Oil. I can highly recommend it as part of a balanced diet. It SHOULD however be consumed in moderation. The health benefits will likely include both an increased feeling of energy as well as the potential for excess calorie burning. Benefits are primarily due to the medium-chain trigycerides, or MCTs. (COMPRISED OF caproic acids, caprylic acids, capric acids and lauric acids)

While I am a doctor specializing in the cardio-vascular system, you should not solely rely on my advice, nor anyone else posting comments for this product. You should, instead, talk to your own personal physician about your diet. He or she is in the best position to assist you since, regardless of the number of people who believe to the contrary, one size does not fit all.

Returning to MCT's... it should be noted that while they appear to aid in the metabolism of proteins, diabetics and those with known liver problems or suspected liver conditions should not consume daily amounts unless directed to do so by a physician. As this Nutiva coconut oil and others are high in MCT's (roughly 67 percent!), you should consult before beginning a daily \\"dosage\\".

One reviewer who claimed to be a 'Herbie, who doesn't like to make toys', stated that saturated fats are not harmful. This is untrue. All saturated fats have the potential to be harmful as they assist the corruption of artery walls and plaque in those walls when consumed in quantities beyond what your PERSONAL metabolism will handle. As I noted previously, and this point deserves a caps-lock... ONE SIZE DOES NOT FIT ALL.

Herbie additionally made claim that butters and plenty of red meat should also be eaten. Unsure what his definition of 'plenty\\" is, but again, medical doctors who you can personally visit and discuss your diet with will suggest moderation. If they don't suggest moderation when it comes to saturated fats, they are either in denial or sat-fat stockholders in some way.

Lastly, there are NO studies which suggest a direct link between the consumption of large amounts of coconut oil and vastly improved exercise performance. You will likely feel increased energy, but it won't translate directly into being able to do twice the number of push-ups, lifting twenty percent more weight at the bench or biking up that steep hill you've always dreamed of trying. You can reach those points but it's a slow process that will be dependent on all the factors within your lifestyle.O studies which suggest a direct link between the consumption of large amounts of coconut oil and vastly improved exercise performance. Another benefit of the ekobrew is that it is the same size as a k-cup, so no adjustments or alterations need to be made to the machine between using it and a traditional k-cup.  In short, if you have a Keurig and want to brew your own coffee grounds, one cup at a time, this is an excellent option that does what it is supposed to.

product_title: Summit Tea - Tie Guan Yin - Superior Grade Organic Oolong "Iron Goddess of Mercy"
review_headline: An excellent example of floral Tie Guan Yin - delicious
review_body:
I'm a big fan of green wulong (oolong) teas - the kind where green chunks unfurl into large broad leaves in the cup. The best of them have an intense lilac floral quality that is lacking from lesser green wulongs - which can have a grassy/hay-like quality I don't love. Better wulongs can stand multiple infusions. As of 12/11, the Summit Tie Guan Yin is the real deal. The tea is bright and dark emerald in color with a lovely floral nose right in the can (this item comes in a nice resealable metal tin). It infuses into a lovely yellow infusion with a rich powdery-sweet lilac nose; complex and fresh and pleasing. Tanins are moderate. The flavor is pure Tie Guan Yin - fresh and vegetal with sandalwood notes in the long finish. Multiple infusions are fine; this works for gong-fu tea ceremony style serving. This is an expensive item at $12 for 2.5 oz of tea - but this level of quality is worth it. Recommended for people who like big complex floral green wulong teas.

Be aware, this is from Fujian, China - not the mountains of Taiwan where this level of wulong usually comes from. Green wulongs are totally different that toasted \\"champagne\\" or \\"orchic\\" wulongs which are much more fermented. Those trade floral freshness for toasty notes.

review_body: This is by FAR the best tasting protein bar/brownie/dessert type food I have ever tasted. I only wish it provided a little more than 20 grams per brownie (a brownie actually counts as 2 servings, and it's 10 grams of protein per serving).  Will definitely be buying it again.

review_body: great garbanzo beans... was very pleased.. I have cooked some and used them in salad as well as making some hummus.. I have also sprouted some .. I will definitely re-order them . I am glad that they are gmo free and grown in the U S A.

product_title: Wolfgang Puck Coffee K-Cups for Keurig Brewers
review_body: When I feel that I do not need more caffine, I have found that the Wolfgang Puck Decaf is a great substitute.  I really can't tell the difference, taste wise.  I had been having trouble finding a good decaf.  I think this one is it.

review_body: This Red Salmon is quite tasty, I combined a can of this salmom along with a can of Pink salmon to make some salmom croquettes one day and the results was heaven.

product_title: GalloLea Pizza Kits Whole Wheat Pizza Kit, 11 Ounce

product_title: Traditional Medicinals Organic Herbal Power, 17.6 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: This tea is good for the liver and cleanses your system. I love and support this brand because their teas are USDA organic and the packaging explains all you need to know about the tea and its healing properties. This tea, in particular, is one of my favorite. You may find the nutty, smokey taste off-putting at first but you will get used to it after a few days. I can honestly say I now enjoy the flavor.

product_title: HoneyTree's Strawberry Honey Gel, 12-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)
review_body: Daughter really likes this ... honey, jelly ... squeezes out easily until 3/4 empty - but just keep the bottle upside down.  No processed sugar, just honey and strawberry flavor.

review_body: We love linguini and clams and have always used Doxsee (Snow's) canned minced clams. The juice has a pleasant and very \\"clammy\\" taste. We order by the case through Amazon as this is the best price I could find for it.  The price in the local stores are double that here.  Would be a 5 star rating if the product consistently arrived without damage.  Have had two shipments arrived damaged due to the way they were packed.  Amazon worked with us to make things right, but it's still a nuisance.

product_title: Indus Organics Real (Sri Lanka) Cinnamon 3" Sticks, Premium Grade, Hand Selected, Freshly Packed
review_body:
Most of what we call cinnamon in the US is actually cassia, which is not only more bitter than real cinnamon, it contains high levels of coumarin (which might not be a problem for most people, but it does have adverse effects in some).

product_title: Extravagonzo Infused Olive Oil
review_body: I use the Garlic and Chili oils regularly. The quality of the olive oil itself if excellent, and the flavors added are neither too bold or too subtle. Just right for my taste.

product_title: Sanchis Mira Turron de Alicante 200 grs. (7oz.) pack of 2
review_body: Don't waste your time with inferior products, go straight to the traditional taste of hard nougat candy and get the Sanchis Mira brand, it's the best there is.[[ASIN:B005OCWYY4 Sanchis Mira Turron de Alicante 200 grs. (7oz.)]]

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig 1.0, 2-Count
review_body: I have a Keurig B31 (not on the list of *unapproved* devices).  So far, I'm not too happy with the Ekobrew cup.  I'll experiment with it a few more days, but I think it's destined for the trash heap.  Contrary to what the directions say, a fairly fine grind is required for any extraction to occur at all.  Unfortunately this slows the flow of water and causes a lot of pressure to build up.  It seems to strain the machine and makes a mess because coffee runs over the top of the cup.  Other than than the fine-ness of the grind, I followed their instructions to the letter.  I am in possession of a professional burr type grinder which produces a very consistent grind.  So far there isn't much to recommend about this thing.

product_title: Raw Organic Honey for Women rich with Calcium, Magnesium, Boron & More
review_body: I bought this product and could not have been happier with it.  I am  recommending it to everyone!  It is unbelieveable and absolutely amazing.  I purchased it because I have seasonal allergies and read that eating locally made honey could help.  My problems with allergies and sinuses are now almost non-existant.  I feel that my health has improved overall and that I have more energy than I did before.  I will definately repurchase this incredible product!

product_title: Yogurt Burst Cheerios Strawberry Cereal, 12.2 Ounce  (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Price is right and product is consistently good
review_body: I began ordering these using the \\"Subscribe and Save\\" program while we were posted overseas, and now that we are back in the States, I will probably continue to buy from Amazon.  The price is way better than any grocery store around, and the only place that can compete is Wal-Mart, which is a bit of hike (not literally!) for me. review_body: Tastes great, but MSG? Really? I will have to make my own stock or find a company that does not use this unhealthy ingredient. C'mon Knorr, you can make a fantastic bouillon without it!

review_body: This is a tasty snack for those of us that are trying to loose weight but still want something to crunch on that is not celery or lettuce. I like the price and it was packaged very nicely. I will be buying more soon.

product_title: Schladerer Pear Brandy with Pear Pieces Filled in Dark Chocolate, 3.4 Ounce
review_body: this brand is just ok, Lindt is better.  I love the flavor and will get this again, pear brandy is great, I wish we had more of  here in the US.

product_title: Yummy Spoonfuls Creamy Yummy Pureed Organic, 4-Ounce Tubs (Pack of 12)
review_body: I have nothing but great things to say about Yummy Spoonfuls.  I have purchased the creamy variety pack several times and am now purchasing the Mushy stage foods.  In our area, it is very hard to find fresh/frozen organic baby food.  I really wish I had the time and knowledge to make my own food, but I don't and I truly feel Yummy Spoonfuls is the next best option to making your own food.  My baby has done very well with their food and I feel like I am offering healthier choices for my baby.  I have tasted everything that I have given my baby and everything tastes great.  At first, I was discouraged because I was going to order directly through Yummy Spoonfuls site and the cost to ship to California was extremely expensive.  Then I saw on Amazon and although the cost for the food is significantly higher, you can get free shipping which brings the cost to about $3.75 a container.  I have no problem paying $3.75 a container for frozen, healthy, organic baby food versus $99/$1.25 for jarred food.  Once you compare, you will never want to feed your baby jarred food again.  Also, Yummy Spoonfuls is flexible and willing to work with their customers.  When I place an order for a variety pack, I send them an email with the flavors that I want...so you don't have to go with the flavors that typically come in the variety pack (you have to choose at least 3 of the same flavor).  Bottomline, I highly recommend this product.

product_title: Hawaii Roasters 100% Jamaica Blue Mountain Coffee, Whole Bean, 14-Ounce Bag
review_body: This company is top notch. Why I say this is because I was not satisfied with a particular product, left a comment, and was responded not only in only a matter of hours, but by the president of the company stating what he would do for me.  I am in the retail business and the customer service I received, will continue my purchasing from this company. Again, thank you for your quick response to resolve my issue and look forward to doing business with this company in the future.

product_title: OliveNation Dried Whole Cascabel Chiles 2 oz
review_body: Ordered these for a family member. My only regret is I have to keep eating the salsas and chilis made with these, i'm catching some extra pounds. I was told they were dried correctly and that they taste great. So this gets the full 5 stars.

product_title: GOLD MINE ORGANIC RAW SAUERKRAUT 34 OZ
review_body: I love this product. It's RAW, organic, and super delicious. Apart from the taste being fantastic, I love the texture. It has the perfect fresh crunch to it. If you're not making your own homemade kraut, this is the one to buy.

product_title: Fresh Flowers- 10 White Dendrobium Orchids
review_body: These were sent from the UK to Texas and I quote from recipient - \\"Oh, what a wonderful  suprise!! Thank you so much!! It is a huge bunchof orchids in perfect condition and will last forever!\\"

product_title: Alessi Caffe' Espresso Decaf, 8.8oz
review_body: All I drink is decaf and I've tried several brands; Alessi is right at the top of my favorites list.  It's full-bodied, rich and smooth. A nice espresso that tastes wonderful.  I have tried Illy and do like that coffee, as well, but it isn't as full-bodied as Alessi, for me.  Different strokes for different folks and this brand strokes my palette, wonderfully.

product_title: Quaker True Delights Wild Blueberry Muffin Instant Oatmeal, 11.2 oz (Pack of 3)
review_body: Very yummy flavor of Oatmeal.  Hard to find in stores.  If you want something sweet, but not too sugary this may be for you.  The oatmeal flavor is very true!

product_title: Texas Pete Tex Pete Chptl Hot Sce 6.00 OZ(Pack of 12)
review_body:
First, this is not a review of the seller but the sauce. My husband bought this at the grocery store to try. I'm not a fan of hot sauces but he offered me a bite of chicken tender with this sauce on it. Oh my goodness was it good. Not hot at all, just that low smoky chipotle flavor followed by warmth. The taste was amazing. I immediately started mentally thinking of things I could put this stuff on (after begging for another bite of chicken with it on there), tacos being my first thought.

I picked more up at the grocery store for $2.59 a bottle, much cheaper than the $4+ a bottle being charged here.

Additional note: If you like to dip chicken tenders in ranch dressing, try putting some of this sauce on the tender first, then dipping in ranch. Tastebud heaven!!

product_title: Popchips Potato Chips, Snack Size
review_body: These are little airy and delicious nuggets of goodness...except of course, they aren't nuggets, lol. Really though, these chips are nice and crunchy while also being light and airy. However we did expect to at least receive ONE of each flavor shown on the photo, and we did NOT expect to receive SEVEN pumpkin spice, FIVE eggnog, and FIVE Gingerbread (none of which are in the display photo) when placing our very first order with Amazon in January! Seriously, give a little credit to the intelligience of your customers, or in our case \\"first and only orders\\".

review_body: The 5 lb. bag of crystalllized ginger arrived very quickly. It is so good! It's fresh, chewy, worthy of great desserts or just as is. I highly recommend this one!

product_title: Robinson's Fruit Drink, Apple & Blackcurrant, No Added Sugar, 1-Liter Plastic Bottles (Pack of 4)
review_body: I was practically weaned on Robinson's products as a child. I can't tell you what a treat it was to find them available on Amazon, and at such a competitive price. Using the Subscribe and Save, makes this stuff cheaper than i would pay to purchase it back in the UK.   I'll be the first to admit Robinson's isn't the greatest thing since sliced bread. However, nobody could accuse this beverage of being a chore to prep, or drink. Personally, i love this product mixed with hot water during the winter months. Nothing quite like a hot drink of Blackcurrant on a chilly day. It's pretty good to drink cold, too. And this is my product of choice when making homemade ice pops (I increase the cordial ratio when freezing). Yes, i know there are better options on the market (Ribena), but as a cheap alternative, Robinson's is pretty good. product_title: SunButter Sunflower Butter, Delicious, Organic Alternative to Peanut Butter, 16 ounce plastic jars, Pack of 3
review_body:
I use SunButter as part of a program to lower blood pressure, and it works, but I'd eat SunButter anyway simply for the taste of it! If you love sunflower seeds, this is a product for you. Many people need the nutrients of sunflower seeds but can't digest seeds (folks with Crohn's Disease, ulcerative colitis, diverticulitis, for example). They can, however, enjoy the taste and nutrients of sunflower seeds with this product. I but this in multiples because so many friends and family members become hooked after trying a jar at my house! It tastes best (in my humble opinion) on toast.

It is richer in healthy oils than other spreadable products, but I stir it up as soon as I open a jar, then refrigerate it. The oil doesn't separate again (although I do give it a quick stir with a knife before spreading it on toast).

Highly recommended.

product_title: Ekobrew Coffee Reusable Filter, Small, Violet
review_body: I received a mini Keurig last Christmas and just broke out the machine a few weeks ago.  After using the sample pack that came with it, I went searching for more refills.  That is, until I saw how much they wanted for a small pack.  They want way to freakin much for those K-cups!  Total rip!  I just could not spend $48 on a 50 variety pack of those little things!  It's still hard for me to pay $10 for a package of Dunkin Donuts coffee, and I love that stuff!  So, I thought that was it for my little Keurig.  It reminds me of what they do with printers now; you can pick up a decent printer for $30, but the stupid ink cartridges cost just as much or more than the printer itself!  People are banking off of these rip-off ideas at the cost of the consumer.    I then heard there was a refillable cup for the Keurig, so I was all on that option.  After seeing some of the same problems from the actual brand name Keurig refillable cup, I was debating whether if it was worth the trouble or not.      (Removing the cup area or something on the machine?  People were saying it was hard to remove, but supposed to be removable?  I could see myself snapping something on that little $100 machine!  Also the leaking problem, then I read one person's advice about putting the filter in a used K-cup to prevent leaking?  I was thinking too much of a pain!)    The ekobrew cup came up as well when I did a search for a refillable cup for the Keurig.  With all the rave reviews, and minimal trouble to get it to work, I decided this was the one for me.    Shipping through Amazon was fast.  The packaging is cute and simple; you can't beat cute and simple!  I washed it, popped it in right away and in minutes had a cup of my Dunkin Donuts coffee brewed.  Clean up was simple, rinse it and it's ready to go again.  I love this little thing and would recommend this brand to anyone.

product_title: Cafe Escapes Cafe‚ Mocha - 16 ct
review_body: Again, I purchased this primarily for use by my young-adult son. He likes it. I, however, prefer real brewed coffee and then mix in my own chocolate and cream. But, good for something quick while running out the door - and it doesn't cost $4!

product_title: Brain Toniq, Grapefruit, 4 x 12.00 OZ (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Less like grapefruit and more like...
review_body: ...lemon-lime!  Now I love me some grapefruit, and I was very impressed with Izze's take on a grapefruit soft-drink, so I was really excited to taste what oogave had in store for me.  Sadly, this isn't very grapefruity at all, but the other plus is that this makes a great substitute for Sprite or 7Up beings that it has a strong citrus flavor that calls to mind the wonderfully bubbly refreshment that comes from a glass of Sprite.  It's sharper than the other oogave drinks, a little more abrasive, and so I guess it would be a better comparison to Squirt or something of that nature; not quite as `clean' as a Sprite.  I wanted grapefruit, sure, but I'm not upset with what I got.  If you let it sit on your tongue a bit you can get a small aftertaste of bitter, which plays into the grapefruit claims.  It's not much, but it's enough for me.  I'm happy with this one, even if it wasn't exactly what I was hoping for.

product_title: Altoids Curiously Strong Mint, 1.76-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12)
review_body: I LOVE Cinnamon Altoids.  I go through at least 1 tin a day, and so buying online - at a better price than local retail - is a must.

product_title: Ultra Pet Little Pearls Litter Scoop, 1 Count Scoop
review_headline: best scoop for clay clumping litter
review_body: ignore the \\"little pearls\\" litter type specific item name - this scoop is perfect for rice grain size 1-4mm Oil-Dri type clumping litter (like Tidy Cats Scoop or A&H Super Scoop).  this hard plastic scoop has a 5\\"x5\\"x2\\" hopper and a 6\\" handle, which i find is the perfect \\"man\\" size for scooping out 4\\" deep of litter in my 2'x3'50gal bin that i use as a litter box.  this deep hopper allows me to comb the box biweekly instead of daily after my two 8 pound cats, and this large deep scoop makes the job easier.  like most cat owners, i have a collection of other scoops i no longer use, and will tell you why i will never by another type:  the round holes on this scoop not only allow good litter to sift though, but also keep clumps from breaking up while rolling around in this scoop.  you'll notice this scoop is more hole and less screen, which allows the good litter to sift through it quickly which really helps when you are racking 30-40LBs of litter at a time.  the handle is perfectly angled for comfort and to prevent you from touching the litter even while deep scooping, especially since there are no holes on the sides of the hopper to get litter on your hands, like most other scoops.  the only downside is all the heavy lifting you may do after 2-3 years with this scoop wears out the plastic where the handle connects to the hopper - you could superglue it, but i opted to just replace it.  I would argue it's better to buy 6 plastic scoops so you have replacements in case of misplacement, breakage, or regifting, then spend the same money on a steel scoop which won't be any better, and if you misplace your steel scoop you are back to square one.  i prefer plastic because a metal scoop cuts wear and tear into a typical plastic walled litter box, while plastic on plastic will not.  you can buy a single [[ASIN:B0002AQQNS Litter Scoop for Litter Pearls - 11 in. x 5 in.]] here, but I think you'll be better off buying a few, since your cat loving friends will want to \\"borrow\\" yours as soon as they see it in use.

review_body: Having made specialty cakes throught the years for family events this was my first time using fondant frosting. My oldest granddaughter and her best friend turned 16 on the same day, and planned a big party, 125+ people were invited. The theme was black and white with silver accents. It was quite an experience, but fun. It was nice to be able to purchase the frosting in this large quantity for such a good price.

product_title: Mallomars Pure Chocolate Cookies, 8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Great stuff, but get it locally.
review_body:
I know how Mallowmars taste. They are the truly splendid fall treat I have looked forward to around thanksgiving for as long as I can remember. So what I really was checking via this order was how well they ship.

The answer is, terrible. The over long, Two weeks of delivery time turned the cookie part to crumbs on almost every one. The chocolate was melted to the plastic tray on half of them (only half?). Overall a fail, and certainly not something you would want to open up in front of guests.

Get them locally or find a replacement. Splurge on faster shipping perhaps? I can not vouch for that option having not tried it though. As is, the standard shipping makes for sad mallomars pandas.

The second star is for the two in the box that had part of a cookie left and were somewhat edible.

review_body: since this particular flavor of Bigelow tea seems so difficult to find in the stores, i have ordered it twice on Amazon.  it is the only cinnamon tea my daughter likes since it has such a lovely cinnamon aroma & flavor.  if you are a cinnamon lover, this should work for you!

product_title: Eden Organic Black Beans, No Salt Added, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I have always loved black turtle beans and eat them often. I was happy to learn of Eden Organic and the no-BPA can. As others reported, the shipment arrived very badly dented. Wasn't thrilled with that, but okay. Stuff happens. The real disappointment came when I opened the first can. I actually thought I had opened a can of kidney beans by mistake.

These are not traditional black turtle beans. I don't know what kind of bean they are, but if you are looking for the traditional black turtle bean, this is not it. And it's not just the reddish brown color that gives these away - even the taste is unlike traditional black beans.

They don't taste bad, just more along the lines of a kidney bean taste instead of a black bean. I know there are other types of black beans and maybe this is one of those. But the can says black turtle beans and those they certainly are not.

beats anything I've bought at the supermarket (including KA all purpose). Haven't tried KA's 00 since I'm happy with Caputo and KA's is no cheaper after shipping.

review_headline: Citric Acid overwhelms Brine. Processed with Lye
review_body: Castelvetrano are some of the most delicious Olives around. The Roland Castelvetrano Olives, while delicious, are not high grade. During the initial brine Lye is used. Although the Olives are later rinsed the olive is permanently altered. Additionally, the brine in the can contains citric acid and is a little bit overwhelming for those individuals not used to preservatives. Discard the brine and the can and soak the olives in water in glass jars to remove the excess citric acid and unwanted flavor. Replace water with a home-made brine for longer storage.

product_title: Pure Natural Bars, Peanut Butter, 1.7-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I was looking for a less-unhealthy-than-usual breakfast or snack that I could carry with me and eat on the go or at my desk, and so I gave these a try. I have nothing to compare them to as far as similar bars are concerned. I am not a health fanatic - - the words \\"chocolate\\" and \\"almonds\\" appeal to me much more than any health claims. I want the good stuff, and I want it now. I like rich tasting foods, but dislike sweet foods. As you've probably guessed by now, I will not be reviewing these bars based on grams of this or that or energy levels or any such, just taste.

Before I ate my first Pure Naturals bar, I had no idea what to expect. I found the dense texture a little surprising and the taste okay, nothing great but certainly not bad -- definitely not sweet. Then the next day, I ate a bar for breakfast with a cup of tea. After that I started craving them and have had one most mornings since then. I find them a good alternative to other on-the-go breakfasts and very satisfying. I really enjoy them now and would recommend that people give them a chance.

I might add that I find a full bar good for a light breakfast, but a full bar is too much for an afternoon snack at my desk. I cut them in half for a snack and save the second half for the next day.

product_title: Swanson 100% Pure Trehalose 16 oz (1 lb) (454 g) Pwdr
review_headline: May not be what I am looking for
review_body:
I have read much,(maybe by people who want this item to be used more than it is),and it is very hard to find credible information on the web sometimes.

I will say, the claims made about it being a sweetner and food enhancer are probably true, I think it is less than 49% as sweet. Splitting hairs, I would say 40% is closer. I have no doubt it is a good food taste enhancer, although I have not used it as such. This is not why I bought this item.

I bought it because of the claims of it's alleged \\"medicinal\\" qualities. I am familiar with the claims that it helps retain water in cells under harsh conditions. It also was reported to be a target of study for alzheimers and several other diseases. The most noteable thing for me is the idea that it enhances cellular communication which would denote an efficiency gain in many areas. That is what interested me. Also, with me testing it, my wife has lupus, I had hoped that the efficiency gain might help her immune system recallibrate itself or some unseen gain that might not even be thought of.

So, for me, I have noticed no change in any metabolic activity nor any other system efficiency gain. It did not produce any results.

But as a sugar subsitute, I am sure it will do quite well. And as a food perservative, the food industry has been using it as such for a long time...if my information is correct. It also would be good for diabetics as it doesn't produce an insulin spike because it doesn't digest until it gets into the colon. That is a biggie. If that is true, it would be a very worthwhile purchase!

product_title: Barista Prima Coffeehouse HOUSE BLEND 48 K-Cups for Keurig Brewers
review_body: This is most definitely my favorite regular coffee K-cup (at this time).  I would agree with their text that states complex and perfectly blended.  The claim is that this is a premium line for those who expect a premium coffee more like a coffee shop.  I tend to agree, except you just don't get as much per cup.  I absolutely love the house blend, which matches my preference for medium or medium-dark house blend roasts from coffee shops, but not the very dark roast of Starbucks.  I really feel this is a complex blend that has well more than one note.  Most importantly, it doesn't taste burnt like a dark french roast.  I have tried so many K-cup flavors, most of which I liked at varied degrees with a few exceptions, but this one is currently my favorite.  What is nice about K-cups is you can easy switch blends per cup or over time without having to exhaust a whole bag of beans or grounds before moving on.  And preferences change as you have the same day in and day out.  So I can say that at present, I absolutely love it over previous favorites (of non-flavored) which in descending order of current preference are: [[ASIN:B003VXHGPK Wolfgang Puck Chef's Reserve Colombian]], [[ASIN:B001CHFUDC Coffee People Donut Shop Medium Roast]], [[ASIN:B004779XNW Green Mountain Dark Magic]], [[ASIN:B0045IO37Y Emeril's Big Easy Bold]], [[ASIN:B000X1GFN2 Caribou]], and a number of other decent ones.  I am just saying I prefer this over those right now.  But I will still have the others for variety.  Within this variety, I really like the [[ASIN:B004OLIL6Q Barista Prima Colombia]] second and ahead of the rest.  The Barista Prima tends to be more expensive, and depending on the sale price, can be only a little more expensive than other varieties.  For a little bit more, it is worth it to me.  For a lot more, maybe not.  Paying about 12% more yields about 30% more in value in flavor to me.  But paying 50% more is costly when there other flavors are plenty good too.

product_title: Three Ladies Spring Roll Rice Paper Wrappers (Square 22cm)
review_headline: Item is excellent, pkg count is incorrect
review_body:

You don't need to place them in water. I like this shape better than the round. I place them with a corner facing me and use that corner to start the wrap. Then I fold in the left and right corners and roll the whole thing up - gives me a little more control than the round size. But you can also wrap them using the straight side to start. I have a new recipe for fried vietnamese summer rolls using this type of wrapper and I'm looking forward to trying it. I haven't been able to have egg rolls since going GF, so if this new recipe works I'll be one happy puppy :o}

The description said 50 ct for the pkg, but there were only about 28 per pkg. This is quite a difference.

product_title: Ritter Sport
review_headline: Savoring the food grade shellac wax
review_body:
Anyone who's read my review of [[ASIN:B003TXT5I8 Remembering Smell: A Memoir of Losing--and Discovering--the Primal Sense]] knows that I acquired a taste disorder several years ago. Briefly stated, since mid-2007 I'm unable to taste \\"sweet\\", and all foods and most drinks (with the exception of water and milk) taste over-salted, even when they contain no salt whatsoever. However, I can still enjoy flavors, and I've always loved chocolate. So, what chocolate candy comes near to be as satisfying as it used to be?

The dark variety probably comes as close as any chocolate ever will. Because it's not as sweet as milk chocolate, there's less sweetness for me to miss, and the slightly bitter taste of the confection somewhat counteracts the saltiness I now endure. (I've had to learn to like things as they now are, not as they once were.)

The DARK CHOCOLATE WITH WHOLE HAZELNUTS bar by Ritter Sport is a wonderful treat that I habitually wash down with non-fat milk. The bar is a manly 3.5 oz chunk chock full of whole hazelnuts. If I was the hardy sort to climb Mt. Everest's North Face, I'd take along a supply of these bars to keep up my energy and morale. However, as the 3-serving sized bar contains 210 calories and 15 grams of fat per serving, an entire bar may not be a couch potato's prudent dessert to chase down the chips with nacho-cheese dip and Meat Lover's pizza while watching the football game. And it doesn't go very well with beer.

The hazelnut content is exemplary; I can count at least fifteen whole nuts in half the bar in front of me now. (OK, ok. So I already ate 1.5 servings. Just don't tell my wife, an honorary member of the Food Police.) According to the ingredients list, the nuts are coated with \\"food grade shellac wax.\\" The result of an Internet search reveals:

\\"Food grade shellac wax is made from 'lac', the red, hardened secretion of the insect by the same name ... simply scraped from the (insect's) host tree, dried to a powder, melted down and then treated with a neutralizing alkali, which is a nitrogenous vegetable substance, so it will dissolve.\\"

Hmm. Well, I don't think the source of the shellac will deter me from future consumption of the bar; it's just too good.to a powder, melted down and then treated with a neutralizing alkali, which is a nitrogenous vegetable substance, so it will dissolve.\\"

Hmm. Well, I don't think the source of the shellac will deter me from future consumption of the bar; it's just too good.

product_title: Orgain Organic Nutritional Shakes, 4 Flavors, 11 Ounce, 12 Count
review_headline: Vanilla has odd note in the flavor and is pretty "watery"...just okay
review_body:
I bought this in the vanilla cause the nutritional profile seemed good for hubby (who has trouble keeping weight on since we ditched most starches). He's not much into chocolate-milk type things. I got the case today, chilled a few, and tasted it.

There's that weird aspect to the taste--first kinda like bacon, then sorta green. It's really unpleasant in the first sip. Fortunately, after a few more sips, you start to get used to it and can get the vanilla vibe better. I'm assuming it's the veggie component in there making me cringe at first--since I don't normally have veggie smoothies masquerading as vanilla shakes. I like my veggie smoothies overtly, unapologetically veggie-green. I like the taste of the Green Magma or Green Goddess type smoothies that have spinach, celery, cucumber, parsley, etc. :) (Don't know why my first sip of Orgain hollered, \\"bacon!\\" at me, but there it is. Offputting.)

The shake is thin--watery even. NOT creamy or thick.

I could drink this if I needed unto. I've had some protein shakes that made me gag. This did not, it went down easily, no weird slimy texture, no weird chalkiness, just that odd smoky/then/green vibe. It's not something I could say was tasty.

Maybe the chocolate flavor hides that weird taste thing going on better than the vanilla. I like the Amazing Grass that has the cocoa, so I could see that working. Still, I doubt I'll order it to find out. I hope hubby likes this flavor. I don't really want to finish this case.

product_title: Shark's Fin Cake
review_headline: DO NOT BUY SHARK FIN PRODUCTS
review_body: I was recently alerted to this product being sold on Amazon.com.  I am an Amazon Prime customer and an avid scuba diver.  If you are unaware of how shark fins are \\"harvested,\\" it involves collecting any shark that the \\"fishermen\\" can find - adult or baby - and cutting the fins off the still living sharks.  Then, because shark meat doesn't bring good money, but the fins do, they dump the bleeding, still living sharks back into the ocean, unable to propel themselves through the water, to die - to suffocate, to bleed to death and to be eaten by other animals, completely unable to defend themselves.  It is absolutely barbaric.    Sharks are an extremely important part of the ocean's ecosystem and without them, the balance will tip and affect all other species - including those we humans depend on for food and our economies.  Shark populations are already under tremendous stress from overfishing and bycatch in longlines and this barbaric practice risks our shark populations worldwide.    Amazon touts themselves as an environmentally responsible company.  They cannot allow this product to be sold and remain environmentally responsible.  Those are incompatible things.  Amazon - do what is right and remove this product.  Do not allow ANYONE to sell shark fin products on your site - either directly or through your auspices.  Until this is removed, I will no longer buy from Amazon.com and will make sure that every diver and environmental group I can get to listen to me will hear about your support of this barbaric practice.

product_title: Earl Grey Lavender Tea, 30 individually packaged nylon Infuser Bags
review_body:
Revolution Earl Grey Lavender Tea is a blend of Ceylon, Darjeeling, and Formosa oolong teas scented with French lavender buds in addition to the usual oil of bergamot.

This tea comes in a pyramid-shaped bag with fine mesh that allows the leaves to bloom to make two pints of strong tea. There were only a few lavender flowers in the bag but they lent the tea a pronounced lavender flavor and mild lavender scent at the expense of the bergamot, which I had trouble detecting either by smell or taste.

Now, I am a big fan of both lavender as a scent and Early Grey tea as a beverage but I don't generally appreciate floral flavorings. Rose water taffy or rice pudding, lavender risotto, candied violets, anything of that sort always reminds me of soap, and not in a pleasant way. Even vanilla is not a favorite, although I do enjoy hibiscus.

However, the acidity of the tea balances out the floral qualities and after the first few sips, I began to enjoy the flavor and then was able pick up on the lavender scent when sipping. I now appreciate this interesting, almost exotic taste in the way that citrus-scented Earl Grey tea must have been received when it was first introduced to England. Definitely worth trying if it sounds interesting to you. I may even get some food-grade lavender buds and make my own blend.

product_title: Leonidas Belgian Chocolates: General Assortment

review_body: I ordered a Leonidas Belgian Chocolates: 1 lb General Assortment. I had to pick up the box at a local UPS outlet one day after the first attempted delivery.  The weather here is mild, not very hot or very cold.  When I opened the box and sampled the chocolates I immediately noticed a stale and unpalatable taste.  I recognized this taste from what occurs when chocolate is frozen or exposed to refrigerated air.  I responded to an email from Amazon asking for a review of my purchase.  I recounted my experience.  I received an email from Leonidas claiming that to their knowledge the product was not sent damaged.  Leonidas stated they would replace my order.  They have not.  I emailed Leonidas again asking about their intentions to replace my order.  I have received no reply.  Amazon attached a statement to the email I received from Leonidas disavowing any responsibility for Leonidas' product or the delivery of it.  So, here is my response: I will make no more purchases of food stuffs from Leonidas until a refund or replacement is forth coming.  I understand Amazon's position, but as a consumer of many items purchased via the Internet, I think that Amazon needs to review their policy regarding 3rd party vendors. review_body: I found this product while searching for MCT oil - a high calorie food additive that I used 20 years ago.  I've bought a total of four cases, and may buy one more. product_title: SunSpire Dark Chocolate Almond Butter Cups, 1.2 Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)

There was hardly any almond butter within the cup itself, and that was what I was really excited about.  I would estimate that by volume, the cup is 80% chocolate and 20% almond butter.  So, in the end, it's not your Reese's-caliber cup, with a light covering of chocolate on the outside and a generous helping of nut butter on the inside, but it will definitely satisfy a sweet-tooth in a pinch, and the product appears less processed and even a bit healthier than the more popular alternatives. review_body: I used to buy this in Canada on vacations, but haven't been back in a few years. I couldn't find this in any U.S. store, so I was thrilled to find it here. This stuff is amazing. product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig 1.0, 2-Count
review_body: I purchased this to try out a different sort of re-usable filter for my Keurig machine. I'll start with the one negative I have - the ekobrew sometimes doesn't seal as tightly as I'd like. It doesn't happen often, but there are times I just can't quite get it to stay all the way closed. (not overloaded - just push closed and it springs back up a very small bit)  Other than that small issue, this filter works really well. It's got a fill line for the grounds so you know when to stop. It goes deeper than similar re-usable filters due to the way it's shaped on the bottom. I find it easier to clean than other re-usable filters. The biggest win over the Keurig brand is that you don't have to remove the K-Cup insert from the machine to use this. Just fill with grounds or loose tea leaves and use as you would any other K-cup. I also love the fact that this sits flat on a surface when you fill it, unlike the Keurig brand that requires you to hold the insert upright until you're ready to insert it into the machine.  Highly recommend if you want to use your own leaves or coffee in your Keurig.

product_title: Keurig, The Original Donut Shop, K-Cup packs
review_body: Much cheaper to buy in the 50 pack.  Delicious coffee!  In my opinion, this is the best K-Cup that is available.  Will continue to buy more!

review_body: I got these at the 'Starbucks' in my college. I very much liked these. I'm into \\"healthy chips\\". i.e. sensible portions veggie straws. These actually tasted good. I liked the variety. And it's a healthy version of a tortilla chip without tasting like cardboard.

product_title: Boyer Candy Company Peanut Butter Cups
review_body: There is a candy company in Pennsylvania which makes an OUTSTANDING peanut butter cup.    But that company is located in Altoona, PA - not Herhsey, PA.      That company is Boyer.  Boyer is better known for their delicious Mallo cups, and to a lesser extent their Smoothies.  But Boyer makes a terrific peanut butter cup.    First off, these peanut butter cups are not oily or greasy like a certain other well known peanut butter cup which shall remain nameless.  The chocolate is solid and a bit on the dark side, and tastes delicious.  Not soft and runny and wanting to meld with the peanut butter.  The peanut butter is not overly sweet - you can actually taste some real peanut flavor.    Sure, these will cost a tad more than what you might pay at a warehouse store for a box of those other well known peanut butter cups which shall remain nameless.  But IMO, they are worth it.    I also want to add that the shipping on these was outstanding.  I ordered my box in late July during a 100 degree heat wave and was a bit worried that they would arrive all melted.  No worries.  They packed them in a little styrofoam package with some dry ice and they arrived at a perfect temperature and consistency.    Highly recommended.

product_title: Crown Prince Natural Brisling Sardines
review_body: When I went on a totally crazy elimination diet to sort out some food allergies, I started looking for foods that I had never eaten before (that I definitely wasn't allergic to) to round out my menu.  I got the sardine idea from Dr. Mark Hyman, who touted them as a healthy addition to any diet.  I was sooooo scared to eat these things that I let the first sample box (from the health food store) sit in my cupboard for over a month before I worked up the courage to try a bite.  I actually think I started with the regular old sardines in olive oil.  The more bites I took, the more I liked them. Then I got brave and bought a box of these (with mustard) from the store.  Wow, even better.  They tasted so good, I went ahead and ordered the 12-pack on amazon.  I have also tried the other mustard sardines by crown prince (not sure what the difference is) and they are not as good.  Since my crazy diet ended (well..I'm still gluten-free, dairy-free, egg-free..slightly crazy!) I've had these things on toast (gluten free) with tomatoes - mmmm..., with rice, and in a salad.  Very good.  I find the mustard to sardine ratio to be perfect most of the time, though some boxes seem to have slightly too much mustard.  While I was pregnant (had a baby 2 months ago) I did not want to even look at a box of these, but I plan on getting back to sardine-ville again soon.

product_title: Kefir Grains - Living Probiotic Enriched "As seen on TV"
review_body:
I got into the store bought Lifetime brand and was a total noob to fermenting prior to ordering my grains. The instructions got me going in the right direction but I must say this seller fielded several noob questions and was extremely helpful and friendly. Those who left bad reviews because \\"it's too small\\" I think just don't understand the nature of kefir. The amount is more than sufficient to start your colony off with. Personally, the 'healing stage' (1st week of babying your kefir) greatly contributed to my understanding of kefir so I am thankful for that.

Just follow the instructions the first few batches and don't spill it or use metal utensils. It really is simple but there's alot to learn if you want to. The straining was odd to me at first but found out my strainer holes were a bit too small, so make sure you get the right size strainer (I went with the 7\\" plastic here on Amazon works great) and tap it when straining (there's a video of technique at Doms site). When it starts to look like pictured above, you're doing good! I'm surprised how simple it is and how much tastier the homemade stuff is, not to mention beneficial! I don't see me buying more of the store-brand stuff anytime soon!

If I manage to screw mine up, I'll be buying again!

product_title: Nutiva Hi Fiber Hemp Protein Powder - 16 OZ
review_headline: Very good natural ingredient for protein smoothie+ good value
review_body: I'm not a health nut but trying to exercise more without resorting to synthetic protein more than the occasional nutrition bar.  At it's core, this tastes like rope with a slight nutty edge.  There is no way to expect this to resemble artificial products and yet it can be made quite edible in a smoothie with vanilla and other ingredients without adding a lot of fat.  My experiments reveal the worst thing to do is put blackberries in a smoothie.  So get Strawberry and Raspberry packs, the Blackberries have big seeds in them.  However, 4tbs of powder in one cup of water is not drinkable for me.  I've settled on this.    The chia is to conduct the protein as it has some fat.  You could also try almonds.  6-10 ounces liquid;combination low-fat milk and water to desired thickness.  1 tbs chia seeds--pre-soak in liquid.  2tbs hemp powder  2 drops vanilla  1/2 cup frozen berries  2 tbs non-fat plain yogurt  Opt:1 teaspoon acacia powder   Opt:Natural non-cal sweetener   Very filling, keeps calories low and low cost compared to packaged.  Seriously about 100 smoothies for 50 cents each.  Good value.

review_body: The highest form of ignorance is when you reject something you don't know anything about. This is directed at SalVetUSMC.
