product_title: Nacho Mom's Ultimate Vegan Queso! 12oz Jar, All Natural, Gluten Free!
review_body: We bought 4 vegan dips to have along with our regular appetizers at our holiday office party. But we also wanted to have some diet dips so I bought a few jars of this one since it crossed over for a few different needs for a huge office with loads on some kind of special diet or another.  I had to go get the jar because my vegans didn't believe me that this one was meant for the vegan table as it really is good and does NOT taste like fake cheese or weird stuff.  It's kind of a medium heat and is thick enough to use as a cheese if you are serving other dishes. We had several things that could be served with regular cheese on the main line that lots of people (even non-vegans and all our dieters) used this on to replace regular cheese. Just enough heat in my opinion.  It is now on request for our breakfast meetings and future luncheons. We did breakfast roll-ups that had eggs and onions and potatoes and salsa for my non=vegans or non-dieters and we had this option for vegan cheese, onions, and potatoes and salsa for the others but pretty much everyone regardless of diet used this or used it instead of the salsa even if they also had eggs.  I keep trying to find it on Amazon so we have no sales tax and free delivery here but so far just at Whole Foods. I have signed up to be notified but I HAVE YET to hear from anyone.  I see verified purchase stamps on other reviews of this dip so obviously it's sold here sometimes but I keep checking and NOTHING.  We also really liked Daiya cheese but it doesn't melt as creamy as this does or have quite as much flavor, but it's also a great back-up on the fly for anyone looking for vegan cheeses. Daiya is really good if you make something Italian like pizza or pizza rolls. We buy Daiya mozzarella also and have been for over a year.  Also I like this better heated than cold.

product_title: Gefen 100% Natural New York Deli Style Mustard, 12 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I bought this just over a year ago as a simple remote control for our living room Media PC. Back then we were running Windows Vista, and it worked perfectly without a driver. Since then I converted the same PC to a 'Hackintosh' running Snow Leopard and again it worked perfectly with no drivers needed. The only major quirk for us is occasionally when the remote is turned on the trackpad will not initialize properly and the mouse pointer will fly erratically about the screen. Simply turning the remote off and on again usually clears this up; sometimes it needs to be shut off and on a couple times to fix this problem.

Other than that, I don't have much to add for pros and cons of this device that others haven't voiced accurately already, but I can vouch for its durability. When I bought this a year ago our son was just 1 year old and pretty harmless. Needless to say things have changed a lot since then. In the past three months the remote unit has been thrown, stomped on and smeared with all manner of food stuffs numerous times but still functions as it did the day of purchase with narry a scratch on it; the serial/model number label has worn off, but that is about it.

The clincher happened just two days ago. While my partner was uploading pictures from her camera to the PC she unplugged the small USB receiver dongle for the remote to plug in her camera and set the dongle on top of the PC. Somehow our son saw this and unbeknownst to her made off with it and deposited it somewhere in the house. We spent half a day turning the house upside down looking for the dongle; boy we looked everywhere including the all the trashes and the dryer, to no avail. Today, while doing the laundry she found the dongle in the dryer. Apparently the thing went through a full warm wash and then full-heat dry cycle; it had grooves on it from some part of that process, most likely in the washer. It was dry though, so I gave it a shot and plugged it in. To our surprise THE THING STILL WORKED! Props to the manufacturer for making an amazingly durable product. Both parts are so lightweight it seems 'cheap' but it definitely is not.

PS: Prior to finding the dongle today, last night I did some serious research on Amazon and the web to find a superior yet similarly affordable PC remote that would provide the same functionality and couldn't find anything even close that wasn't a full-on keyboard/trackball combination, something we wanted to avoid. This was the only thing that came up, so until something else comes along, this product seems to be the best choice. Normally, I would rate this product 3 stars for average functionality and quality, but I'm giving it 4 stars now for it's amazing durability.STILL WORKED! product_title: Element Natural Caffeine & Theanine Water - 24 Pack
review_headline: This caffeine junkie may never drink soda again!
review_body: I have one great vice in life.  Sweet, sweet caffeine.  Oh, how I love it so.  For a man who has a habit of burning the candle at both ends way too often, caffeine is like a breakfast essential (as well as lunch, dinner, and several other times during the day)!  However, coffee really irritates my stomach, and I'm not a big tea fan.  Until I found Element, my only previous answer for this problem was soda (because I am also not exactly the No Doze or Vivarin type - \\"Look, I'm wide awake!  Boy does my stomach hurt and I've really got to go to the bathroom, but after that, it's go time!\\").  For those of you soda lovers out there, I understand your struggle.  \\"Do I drink the diet soda that tastes like crap because of artificial sweetener, and lie to myself that it tastes good just long enough to get that sweet, sweet caffeine into my system?\\" OR \\"Do I drink the regular soda and gain 5 pounds...today?!!\\"  Folks, your search for a solution is over.  I give you Element Caffeinated Water!!  And, if you are super Amazon-savvy like me, you were smart enough to search under caffeinated water and discover Water Joe as well (ha ha).  I'm not going to lie, they taste almost identical - in that they are both water!!  Once you purify/distill water, there can only be so much variance in taste without added flavors, which make it less pure.  However, there is one added difference.  Element includes an extra ingredient in their water, along with the caffeine, to help improve focus and concentration while the caffeine does its job of keeping you awake and amping you up for whatever it is that you are trying to confuse your exhausted body into doing!  I realize that I can get down from my soapbox (podium for those of you who need a younger reference) after complaining about adding things like flavors to water, making it less pure, while meanwhile the caffeine itself is an additive - even if it is a naturally occurring source of caffeine.  However, HELLO!!!  Which part of \\"caffeine is my one great vice in life\\" did you not understand?!!

product_title: Ekobrew Coffee Reusable Filter, Small, Violet
review_body:
Using an ekobrew cup will save money, save the environment and expand your choice of coffee for less than the cost of one box of K-cups.

The refillable cup is not quite as convenient as just dropping in a fresh K-cup and getting your brew, but when you are in less of a rush to get out the door, the extra time spent to fill and clean the ekobrew cup is worth the effort. Any bean can now be made into a K-cup, without being limited to the selection of Keurig ready boxed coffees. I still use regular K-cups, but will often use the ekobrew instead.

I was initially disappointed with the weaker brew, but discovered there are two factors that affect how strong a coffee you get:

* size of the grind - smaller is better, seems to take the hot water longer to travel through the grounds and hence extract more flavor. Open a used K-cup to see the grind size used in the pre-packaged product, and aim for a similar size when grinding at home or the store.

* density of the load - if you tap and bump the ekobrew cup to settle the grind, then fill it a little more and do the same thing, you can get quite a densely packed cup which will make for stronger coffee. A loose fill by contrast will give a weaker coffee.

DO NOT OVERFILL! There is a line on the inside of the cup that should still be visible when you snap the lid closed. Make sure the sealing ring is clear of grounds before closing the lid.

These things are easy to clean: tap against the side of the trash, then rinse and let dry. They even go through the dishwasher.

If you love your Keurig but hate the cost of the K-cups, then this is EXACTLY what you need.

This product should be pulled immediately from the shelves. Smells: the smell is so strong the second you open the pouch and VERY much like a can of cat or dog food. Tastes: I taste all of the baby food I give my daughter.  It was pungent and metallic, where the banana and coconut were, lord only knows.  If you must try it, I get it I would too, just buy a packet or two and see how it goes.  Do not buy a case.  On a side note, my dog loves it! So no a total loss.    In general the sprout meals are delicious and the texture on the level 3's are chunkier than Plum or Happy Tot.  You can see bit of veg and grains.  Holiday Veg w/ Turkey is a big hit as is the Pumpkin Peach Graham (I serve together but not mixed).  Roasted Banana Mango is really yummy and she LOVES the Yukon Golds with Squash and Parmesan.    Beyond Sprout, we prefer:    Fruits and Veg: Ellas for a richer consistency and better flavor than Plum or Happy Tot.  Parsnip, Carrot, Apple is a surprise hit. Plum fruits are watery and water is even listed as first ingredient on some. However, the Plum Mish Mash line is much better and my daughter eats all of it.    Breakfast: Happy Squeeze (tot) Organic Super Smoothies are awesome, in fact, I'm going to start having them for breakfast myself.  ALL of them taste excellent! Have 100% adult dv of vitamin C, 1/2 vitamin A. 6 grams or so of protein and under 100 cals.  They are thick, and creamy.    Dinner: Plum Training Meals seem to be her favs along with the Sprout brand (other than the curry chicken) We have yet to try the salmon but have a case of it ready to go.  Shelikes the potato and turkey with rosemary (tastes like an herby mash potato) and the chicken pasta (not something an adult would like but I think she likes the texture of the visible chunks of pasta).  My girl has never been able tohave abottle more than 100ml but can eat a whole 4oz training meal.  GO figure!    We have landed on plain cherrios vs the canisters which she lost interest in.  Straeberry mum mums NOT caramel or plain and teething bisuits above those.    I cant beleieve how much baby food has evolved in a year.  I heat up breakfast and dinner and serve lunch icy cold.  She seems to like the changes.  I got the plum spoon that screws on for when we ar on the go but as a rule, the playtex spoons with silicone are THE BEST!!!! and I have a drawer full. I hope this helps, we really have tried all the snacks and foods we could get our hands on in store and online.

product_title: Dunkin Donuts K-Cups, Dark Roast,  K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 14)
review_headline: Great Coffee but Amazon Price is Out of Line
review_body: Excellent dark roast coffee.  It has teeth but it is smooth at the same time.  Now as for price, Amazon is way out of line here.  I purchased the same 14 count box at a Dunkin' Donuts shop for $11.99!  I guess there are some distribution issues that need to be worked out.

product_title: Boulder Canyon Rice & Adzuki Bean Snack Chip, Chipotle Cheese, 5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_headline: My 2 Year old LOVES these chips.
review_body: We originally purchased these chips at a big box store and my son, who is a very picky eater, loves them. We actually use them as a \\"treat\\" if he tries other, less desirable food. The fact that they are Gluten Free first attracted us to these chips and we did not have to sacrifice taste for health.  Thank you for making these and please, don't stop any time soon!

product_title: Vlasic Kosher Dill Pickles, 32 fl (Pack of 3)
review_body: I didn't use to eat pickles, but when you get older, your taste buds differ.  I now enjoy pickles a lot.  Especially with some tortilla chips they are fantastic.  Anyways, I picked up a jar of these Vlasic Kosher Dills.  They had 3 different kinds all priced the same and the word Kosher just sounded like they tasted good.  They are a little on the sweet side for me and I will probably change to a more mild pickle, but if you like a little tangy pickles they are great.  I just won't eat them often.  But Vlasic makes good pickles for a very good price.

product_title: PEZ Disney Mickey, 0.58-Ounce Assorted Candy Dispensers (Pack of 12)
review_body: By looking at the picture, the Mickey Mouse face looked a little weird but I took the chance and ordered anyways.  Glad I did.  I had a candy table at my sons Mickey Mouse party and these went fast.  I am pretty sure all of them were taken by adults.  Anyways, the Mickey face was perfectly normal, not like the one in the picture.  Loved them!

product_title: Hungarian Paprika (Bende Hungarian Sweet Paprika), 8 Ounce Tin
review_body: This product SUCKS I don't belive that this a Hungarian product It looks and taste like the cheap Spanish paprika.Do not use it tossed in to the garbage can,it will ruine your dish both yhe taste and the color.i tried to contact the company SPICECO Avenel NJ with no succsess

product_title: Bai Antioxidant Infused Beverage
review_body: I loved the flavor of Costa Rica Clementine. I usually avoid fruit juices because of the sugar and calories, but you can't beat Bai's 10 calories a bottle! The fact that it is all natural and with natural caffeine is also a big plus. A nice way to revitalize without the jitters that energy drinks give.

product_title: Butler Soy Curls
review_body: I ordered a case of these from Butler and they are amazingly good. Wonderful meaty texture and no strange off taste. They can be seasoned/sauced a million ways and they pick up the taste of the seasoning. They are dehydrated and last a long time. And in larger quantities they cost about 2 bucks a pound. The best food find of the year for me.

product_title: Dilmah Exotic Collection, Peach Flavored Tea, 25-Count Individually Foil Wrapped Teabags (Pack of 6)
review_body: Far better than any tea I've ever head.  And that goes for all the Dilmah teas as I purchased 4 kinds.

product_title: See's Candies 1 lb. 5 oz. Cafe Latte Lollypops
review_body:
Just received my order for See's Candy lollypops and was impressed
with the shipping and costs for these items (cheaper through Amazon).

packaging was excellent and secure,boxes were well insulated (esp.with this

I am enjoying these lollypops (in favorite flavors, 1 box chocolate, 1 box
latte)that are hard to find in Northern Va.

product_title: Guayaki, Yerba Mate, Loose Leaf Tea, 16 oz (454 g)
review_body: Have been using this product for several years - never have been disappointed in what it promises.  Was so pleasantly surprised to see that Amazon carried the product.  And at quite a substantial savings.  Thanks, Amazon!

product_title: Gluten Free Brownie Mix
review_body: These brownies are okay. I added choc chips, which I think was the savior for the adults. They did not, however, go over with the kids. (ages 7,5, and 2) They are more \\"cake like\\" and weren't as fudgy as the real thing. This was the first time I threw away a batch of brownies in my house.

product_title: Widow - No Survivors Hot Sauce, Bottle, 5 fl oz
review_body: This has become my daily hot sauce. The flavor is incredible and the heat can be dangerous even to the daily users. I've seen the results of a brave soul taking a teaspoon full on an empty stomach and no food with it. Damn that was funny to watch! It's a great hot sauce and a must for all of us peppr heads...

product_title: Lays Classic Potato Chips - 50/1 oz.
review_body: I got this for my husband but my grandkids love it also.  The small bags are the perfect size for kids and adults alike.  When I make a sandwhich it's easy to add a bag on the side by the sandwhich to make the perfect lunch.  These are good to have if you've got lots of kids to feed a quick snack to.

product_title: Amish Salsa - 2-16 Oz Jars
review_body: This is excellent salsa.  I recommend it if you like smooth, piquant flavour with a hint of heat; with soft, distinct chunks of ingredients.

product_title: Endangered Species Bat, Puffin, (72%) Dark Chocolate with Cherries , 3-Ounce Bars (Pack of 12)
review_headline: BEST CHOCOLATE EVER... but hold the soy lecithin please?
review_body: This chocolate is rich, creamy, bitter and every bit satisfying.  I like to refrigerate it then eat a couple squares (read: half the bar) chilled and crunchy jagged.  Most Americans will find this chocolate too bitter for their taste, at only 5g sugar per half bar serving.  But if you're the type who likes your espresso straight up, and bitter flavors in general... you will HEART this chocolate!  It also may not be as bitter the 2nd and 3rd time you try it... so hang in there and at least eat up the entire bar.  I just reallyreally wish they'd find a better substitute for the soy lecithin.... which is the only reason why I took away one star.  Pretty please???

product_title: Blue Sky Soda, 12 Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_headline: BEST tasting of all the natural, Stevia sweetened sodas BY FAR!
review_body: The wife and I must have tried all the Stevia sweetened, 0 calorie sodas on the market. This is, by far, the best tasting brand (and possibly flavor?) hands down.  There is no aftertaste, and the sweet flavor is perfect.  We will be trying all the other 0 calorie, Stevia sweetened soda flavors from 'Blue Sky'. product_title: Hawaii Roasters 100% Kona Coffee, Dark Roast, Whole Bean, 14-Ounce Bag
review_body: I've always loved Kona coffee! This is a gift for my sister. I hope she likes it!!! Received the beans vacuum sealed and will last forever.

product_title: Pamela's Products Gluten Free Whenever Bars, 6 Count
review_headline: Excellent taste... and good for you!
review_body: There's nothing to dislike in these Pamela's Products Whenever Bars. They have a wonderful spice-cake flavor & consistency that's augmented by a delightful mix of oats, raisins and walnuts. Everything is natural-no junk or fillers. These lightly sweetened bars are great with coffee, tea or even the ever popular tall glass of cold milk. A great, healthy between meal snack that can be enjoyed anytime of day. They're individually wrapped, so they can be taken along just about anywhere. Great for the kids lunch box/bag so that you'll be confident at least one snack each day is a healthy one!

product_title: Green Mountain Naturals Keurig K-Cups, 72 Count
review_body: My wife, kids and I liked this hot apple cider so much that we've practically gone through our first order of 24 in less than a week so I am reordering.  As opposed to some of the hot chocolate k-cups, you can set the Keurig for mug size and still get a good tasting cup.

product_title: Keenan Farms In-Shell Pistachio, Naturally Tree Opened, Roasted with Sea Salt,  28-Ounce Jars (Pack of 2)
review_body: This pistachio is just great, with reasonable price and good taste. I will definitely buy more. The only drawback is that it has several empty shells.

product_title: Teas' Tea
review_body: The tea is unsweetened which is kind of rare in America. The flavor is pretty mellow like green tea should be like in general.

product_title: Pamela's Biscotti
review_body: These are great but be careful ordering as they are in bulk and you can order too many by mistake.

product_title: Keenan Farms Pistachio, In-Shell Natural, 32-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)
review_body: I ordered UNSALTED Pistachios.  You sent me SALTED Pistachios. This product is not what I expected, especially when this very same Brand has the Salted variety clearly stated in the same section of your website.

product_title: Honey Stinger Protein Bar, Peanut Butta, 1.5 Ounce (Pack of 15)
review_headline: One of the Best Tasting Protein/Energy Bars I Have Found
review_body: I just found Honey  Stinger Protein bars at a local supermarket and bought the Dark Chocolate coconut almond flavor, out of curiosity. review_body: This is instant coffee!!  Overpriced and nasty!  I threw mine out after one cup.  They should not be selling this without making it clear that all you're getting is a teaspoon of bad instant coffee.

product_title: Blue "It's a Boy" Milk Chocolate Coins, 1 lb. bag, 91 coins
review_body: These coins were a bit hit.  Party goers loved snacking on them and also taking some home.  They were mighty tasty! Nice addition to the baby shower.

product_title: Organic Creamy Peanut Butter
review_body:
If you want real peanut butter with nothing else, than that's the one to get

Ingredients: Dry Roasted Organic Peanut and salt. (that's what the label says, and I pretty much believe in Kirkland brand)
No sugar or sucrose, fructose, xxxtrose or hydrogenated crap or any other junk (sodium : 2%).
Yes you have to stir it, since the oil separate and float on the top, and be ready for some mixing, but it does not bother me.
The taste is much better than any other brand I tried. I eat 1 jar every week, and does not spike the blood glucose level at all
(actually it stabilize mine) I mix it with coconut oil,
The same item sell at Costco for ~eight dollars.

product_title: Arrowhead Mills Organic Oat Bran Flakes, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_headline: NATURAL - NEW YORK BUGS AND ALL!
review_body:
Sad to report, upon the first bowl of this flavorless \\"organic\\" cereal, we witnessed what my mother used to call mealy bugs? Up close they look more like tiny cockroaches.
And unfortunately, before one of the little buggers came swimming up out of the milk, I got to give the cereal a taste test. It was perhaps the worst example of food I could imagine. I instantly wondered if this is what Soylent Green will taste like when our Prez is done fixing everything and every one?
It's BAD STUFF ALL AROUND and I noticed some saying it was like Fortified Oat Flakes from the 70's? They must have very bad recollections of that wonderful cereal.
I also noticed they are warehoused and shipped out of New York, which is another reason I would never buy them again - to make sure my money never supports anything from that state who recently attacked Christianity in the worst possible way.
Well, we'll see how the return process goes via Amazon.
FYI - the boxes of cereal were dated for expiration Dec 2011 less then half a year away. This is not really contrary to norms on popular selling cereals where the death date is almost always a year or more off, rather, it's because, they don't sell as quick so they have time for these bugs to manifest, and because, if it truly is organic cereal, it is something that will naturally occur more than in the boxes of UN-natural sugar chunks we feed ourselves.
So, even though it should NOT be so, it is something that will happen with ANY cereal, flour etc. if given enough time.
The only way around it would be shorter (smaller) factory runs tuned to the number of sales which is not done anymore because of inefficiency, shortages of product on the shelf, hence,(loss of of sales) and so, you'd have to know when they're going to make the next run and somehow get your hands on them right away, then you can freeze them to keep the bugs from maturing.

product_title: ZICO Natural Coconut Water,11.2 fl. oz. (Pack of 12)

product_title: Tropical Traditions 1 Organic Coconut Flour - 2.2 lbs.
review_body: I was a little hesitant to try this new coconut flour, but shipping was so fast and it's a fantastic product, arrived fresh & smells soooo good :)

product_title: Florida's Natural Sour String, Variety Pack, 8-Count (Pack of 12)
review_body: These things are addictively delicious. I've been eating them since high school, which makes it about 5-6 years now; that's how good these gummies are. Unfortunately, they're not housed everywhere (anywhere at all) near me, despite my being in Florida. So sad I have to buy them online now.

product_title: Elephant Seasoning by Chef Carlos - All Purpose Seasoning Blend
review_body: This is a great savory seasoning to use on everything. I really like it for fish but it's also great for red meat and all kinds of veggies. It's a new label design from what they used to sell at Joe Patti's Seafood but it's the same stuff.

product_title: Fresh Whole Rabbit
review_body: But unfortunately there's only one way to eat a brace of coneys.  Good thing I had lots of Po-TA-Toes! Boiled, mashed, stewed and fried to a crisp!

product_title: Sweet and Smokey Cattle King Sweet Texas BBQ Sauce
review_body: If you are like us and you love having friends around and cooking BBQ for everyone, then one of the things in your mind is that you always want to cook the best and most tasty food for your friends. We love cooking good food and with a good BBQ you need a special sauce to go with it, Cattle King is exactly that, a magnificent tasty sauce.

product_title: Popcorn for a Movie Gift Set
review_body: This variety box is a great gift for someone who is hard to shop for. I bought it as an extra gift for someone who had just bought a fancy popcorn machine.

product_title: Snak Club Apple Rings, 10-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: Packaged well.  Taste great - very fresh.  Best pricing I could find (better than buying the 5lb bags).  Large enough bag to share with others, or you can save some for later using the included sticky strip to close the bag.

product_title: Polaner 100% All Natural Strawberry Fruit Spread 10 oz (Pack of 12)
review_body: Absolutely delicious! I have tried four different varieties and cannot tell the difference between this and regular jam.  My son and I both love it and we both get a little fiber boost when we have toast and jam.  Just wish it was a bit more affordable here on Amazon.

product_title: Complete Coopers Brewery Irish Stout Beer Kit Package
review_headline: Was hoping for Guinness - not what we got
review_body: This beer had a very dry nutty flavor and was not anywhere compareable to Guinness. I have purchased other Coopers kits and like them for they simplicity, but if you are looking for a Guinness beer this is not the kit for you.

product_title: Bubble Yum Gum 5-Piece Packages (Pack of 36)
review_body: This is a pretty good amount for the price. This gum is really only good for the bubbles, not the flavor. After a while, it fells if you are chewingg a tire. Still a great gum, though.

product_title: blk Premium  Alkaline Water Infused with Fulvic Trace, 16.9 Ounce Bottles (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Great after a day of food and drink binging!
review_body: I'm on a low-carb diet where, once a week, there's a binge day where I'm allowed to overeat from dusk till dawn.  The morning after I binge, I don't feel lousy, but not the best, either.  Anyway, I picked this black water in a health food store on a whim, as the label states that the fulvic acid and added minerals will help to normalize the body's PH level.  Zero calories, so why not give it a try?  It really made me feel better, like I didn't even binge the day before.  Good stuff!  As for the taste, it's very much like plain water.  A very faint taste, much like very weak coffee.  Imagine a cup of water, and you put a couple tiny pinches of instant coffee.  Something like that.  I'm buying more of this today and having a bottle a day!  When you drink the water, the words \\"WELCOME TO THE DARK SIDE OF WATER\\" appear on the bottle (the words are black so you can't see it when it's still full).  Nice touch!  Anyway, if you try a bottle of this, give it a try when you have a bout of indigestion, heartburn, etc.  You should feel better.

product_title: Maxi/Tuna Fish Crackers, 8.7 Ounce
review_body: The service was excellent. I was looking for a card reader for IPad for a long time. I found it and am very pleased with this product. I ordered 3 as Christmas presents for my friends. The price is very reasonable too.

product_title: Ekobrew Cup, Refillable Cup for Keurig 1.0, 2-Count
review_body: This refillable k-cup is better than the solofill.  However, the name and the packaging are at odds.  The cup works VERY well, but it is delivered in a huge package that is at least twice the size needed.  They lost a star due to this fact.

product_title: Bobs Sweet Stripes Soft Peppermint Balls
review_body:
I'm wondering whether they forgot to put the peppermint oil in this batch. It's just soft, sugar candy with the faintest hint of peppermint. I've used Bob's peppermint sticks for several years for my favorite peppermint pie and never been disappointed before.

Well, I made the pie according to Paula Deen's recipe, but after mixing the \\"peppermint\\" balls with the other ingredients there is not a hint of peppermint. Wish I could exchange the balls for sticks just to see if there is a difference.

I sure don't recommend these for peppermint lovers.

product_title: Revolution Tea, Dragon Eye Oolong Tea, 16 Flow-through Infuser Bags in a Stay-fresh Container
review_body: I love Dragon Eye Oolong tea!  Hard to find locally, so bought it Amazon.  Seemed to be fresh from what I can tell.  Enjoy!

product_title: Fiesta Seasoning Fajita, 7-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is a great seasoning for meat, eggs, popcorn and just about any other ssavory dish. We use it on so many different things and it just lends and great onion and garlic flavor along with other seasonings!

product_title: Back To Nature Granola Chocolate Delight
review_body: I tried this at my daughter's house recently.  Her husband couldn't find it in the grocery store so is now purchasing through Amazon.  I put some in my yogurt and a smile came across my face:)  I didn't read the nutrition label before ordering some for myself but not sure if that would have changed my mind.  It's high in calories - fat and carbs, especially for only a 1/2 cup serving.  However, protein and fiber is a positive for me.  I love the flavor and crunch.

product_title: DogsWell Breathies Duck Jerky Treats 15oz
review_body: Great product for stinky breath.  Great transaction and fast shipping.  I love the Breathies (especially the duck) for my little doggie.  And super price.

product_title: MOCAFE Frappe Toffee Mocha, Ice Blended Coffee, 3-Pound Bag
review_body: I bought this to use with my Mr. Coffee Frappe maker. The package doesn't state how much to use other than \\"two scoops\\". It doesn't say how much two scoops is, so it takes some experimentation to get the right amount. I finally found what works good for me:  ice to the fill line, 1/2 cup milk, squirt of Torani chocolate syrup, and 5 TBSP Mocaffe powder. The frappe maker uses 3 TBSP of coffee and 1/2 cup water to add the coffee to the frappe mix. The result for me is just as good as what I used to pay $3-4 dollars for at coffee shops. I bought this hoping to save some money at work on coffee drinks, and I absolutely love the results. Soooo good.

product_title: Organic Valley, Ghee, 13 Ounces
review_body: This product is good for cooking. It is a solid at room temperature but easily scooped out and into dishes.

product_title: Dove Dark Chocolate Promises Family Size, 12.60-Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_headline: Dark Chocolate is Good for YOU !!!!!
review_body: I have been on a strict diet and these are recommended not as a staple, but as a once a day treat for me. They do add to my protein  and help me.

product_title: Cornucopia Fruit Wine Making Kit, 17.5 Pound Box
review_body: This is my third wine kit and it's going so fast I should order another.  We took samples from all three kits to a Thanksgiving get-together.  More than once, I heard, \\"Who's going to finish off this bottle so we can open another pear?\\"

product_title: Keurig, The Original Donut Shop, K-Cup packs
review_headline: donut shop coffee for Keurig brewer
review_body: the coffee, as usual is good.  however, i am having problems with coffee grounds escaping the pods into my coffee.  if this continues i will switch to another brand of coffee.

product_title: Organic Dark Chocolate Ginger (6/4oz)
review_body: This is one of the yummiest chocolates on the planet!! You can often find single packs of these at your local health store if you want to try them out first, but this is SO GOOD I don't think you'd be amiss to go ahead and buy 6 packs at once!!  They also help if you're feeling sea-sick or feeling slightly nauseous from eating too much, thanks to the ginger.  I just finished eating all mine, I'm sad they're all gone and I hafta wait for my next paycheck so I can buy some more. :(

product_title: Jose Cuervo Margarita Mix, 1000 ml
review_body: The new classic lime is not as good as the old premium the photo shows that it is the old premium but it is NOT it is the new classic lime that sux large. Save yourself some money and keep looking for the old stuff.

product_title: Assortment of Gluten Free Gourmet Handmade Biscotti (12 Sticks)
review_body: I've tried these gluten free bicotti made by the Biscotti Goddess. They are delicious. I couldn't taste a difference. They are crisp and not too sweet. I definitely recommend them.

product_title: YummyEarth Organic Gummy Bears, 5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_headline: overly chewy, not soft, but tasty
review_body:
I bought mine at Whole Foods. They're organic gummies but they're too sticky & too chewy and hard and not soft like the nonorganic Black Forest gummi Bears. As far as taste, they taste like dehydrated fruit snacks - sweet and tasty, much tastier than the usual mainstream nonorganic gummies. One good thing is unlike the usual mainstream gummies, you're not putting fructose corn syrup into your body.

I bought them again at Marshall's to see if it just wasn't a quality control issue since I had bought the last bag at Whole Foods. Well, the ones at Marshall's were ALSO hard and chewy. If you like haribo's gummy bears which are also chewy, then these will be fine, but I prefer the corn syrup laden Jelly Belly's VERY soft gummmy bears[[ASIN:B000IKCQ86 Jelly Belly Gummi Bears, Assorted Flavors, 3-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24)]] or even [[ASIN:B000JZEABG Black Forest-Gummy Bears, 6lb. bag]].

A better alternative to YummyEarth is Surf Sweets gummy bears [[ASIN:B001HTIVCW Surf Sweets Gummy Bears, 2.75-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)]] which has the soft consistency of Black Forest and Jelly Belly but is
\\"Organic fruit juice, natural colors and flavors, free of Corn Syrup and GMO's, nut free, and gluten free.\\"

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee Wild Mountain Blueberry, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: This is my new favorite K-cup!  Smells and tastes delicious without being too sweet or overpowering.  Amazing with sweet cream creamer.  Yum!

product_title: Grand Ghirardelli Chocolate Gift Basket
review_body: Received the basket quickly but was very disappointed with the product. The basket I received is much smaller then the one pictured and is missing many of the items pictured. Not worth the $40 I spent.

product_title: Santa's Sweet Spot Candy Sampler
review_body: Bought these for several members of my family at a great price. Everyone seemed to love it. Big smiles on their faces. Really clever graphic on the box. Will be re-ordering again this year.

product_title: New Orleans Famous Praline - Box of 10 Original Pralines
review_body: These really are the best ones you can buy. I moved out of NOLA due to Katrina and have always missed the cultured candy New Orleans has to offer. I was surprised when I stumbled upon these on Amazon, remembering the brand when I lived there and it brought me back to the days as a child when I would to sit out on my porch with a sweet tea and praline. They tasted great and had a variety to choose from.

product_title: Spitz Dill Pickle Sunflower Seed, 6-Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: These are very addicting! They have a great dill pickle flavor and are not too salty. I highly recommend them if you enjoy sunflower seeds and love dill pickles.

product_title: Premium Tea Bags
review_body: Brought some back as gifts and for myself from Kenya.  Glad I did! You don't find this tea everywhere, glad Amazon had it.  This black tea won't bite back.

product_title: Cardini Original Caesar Dressing, 20-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)
review_body: We eat this dressing more often than we probably should. I have yet to find a bottled caesar that even comes close to comparing. Hands down, the best.

product_title: Kar's Original Trail Mix 1.5 oz Single Serving Bags - An Unsalted Blend of Peanuts, Raisins, Almonds and Sunflower Kernels (72 Pack)
review_body: I buy this in bulk so I can hand them out to students as incentives or rewards. It's a great healthy choice over candy or other snacks.

product_title: Hershey's Snack Size Assortment (Whoppers, Kit Kat, Mr. Goodbar & York Peppermint Patties), 40.6-Ounce Bag
review_body: I purchased this as a convenient means of getting halloween candy.  The candy came in perfect condition, unmelted and edible.  I will likely purchase candy the same way for next year using 2 day, I'm not sure if it would be a good idea to order these and ship using super saver shipping.  It would heavily depend on what carrier it ships through to the quality of the candy once you get it.

product_title: Numi Organic Herbal Tea, Tea Bags
review_body: Although I love Numi teas, the flavor from the tea bags is very weak for aged earl gray. I will keep this first shipment though will look for a brand with more flavor.

product_title: Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Vegan Split Pea Soup Gluten Free, 2.5-Ounce Cups (Pack of 6)
review_body: Delicious, filling and nothing artifical.  Makes a geat quick and easy to fix lunch (or dinner for that matter)  Saw a few people complaining about the flavor packet- takes a second- keeps it fresher- no complaints here.

product_title: Haiku Japanese Kukicha Twig, 100% Organic, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: Kukicha twig tea is one of my favorite teas. It goes further than conventional tea because it's brewed differently (simmer a teabag in a pan of water). It has a mellow  woodsy rich flavor, not bitter at all. No sugar needed. Excellent change  from coffee or regular tea.

product_title: Doctor Kracker Culinary Crisps, Fire Roasted Crisps, 6-Ounce Tubs (Pack of 6)
review_headline: The Best Tasting Health Food Snack
review_body: Healthy crackers don't normally knock me over with flavor.   Not true with these. What an outstanding taste. I've never had anything like these before.Great product

product_title: Red Rain Energy Drink, Berry Pomegranate, 16-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body:
Red Rain products are typically good (like the red rain energy shots - no sugar)

BIG ISSUE:

The color of this drink is not good for a person wearing anything but black (purple - yikez) if you spill a little of this beverage on yourself at work (as I did - it dries purple). This was very odd color choice for a drink.

I think the drink is better than most energy drinks still! plus you can not beat the price. Its not worth the sugar in take to drinks these since I know red rain offers the shots with no sugar and easy ingestion (in my opinion).

avalonpayments.com Exclusively

B+ (Shipping was on time!)

product_title: Grove Square Coffee, Dark Roast, Single Serve Coffee Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 18-Count (Instant Coffee) (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Why isn't this labelled instant coffee...Disgusting!
review_body: Absolutely disgusting. CVS and Walmart should be ashamed. Did this company never test the product? It stops your coffee maker. I've never seen this happen before. When you remove it you have coffee drippings all over the place. It leaves coffee grinds in your cup and tastes like crap. We threw the box away. What a sad waste of cardboard and plastic. I can't believe I have to give it one star or my review won't be accepted. Shame on you for selling this!  And shame on you Larry Hamwey and Sturm Foods of Wisconsin. You bring shame to your state.

product_title: Hershey's Halloween Assortment, Snack Size Assortment Bag
review_headline: Not Melted -- and good for Trick or Treaters
review_body: I ordered this to use on Halloween for Trick or Treaters. There are quite a few Whoppers in the bag; since it's for handing out, that doesn't really bother me. It also arrived in perfect condition (not melted) -- though I am in Wisconsin. Overall, I'm pleased. Good price and a good value for us.

product_title: Mallomars Pure Chocolate Cookies 8 ounce box (Pack of 3)
review_body: Although this item did taste okay, the real fact is one 8 ounce package is only 18 cookies.  I thought this was overpriced and not a good value.  I will not be purchasing this again.

product_title: Red RoseTea Bags, 100-Count
review_headline: Red Rose tea is the b-e-st!
review_body:
My mother loves red rose tea! I actually thought that my store stopped carrying these large boxes with the ceramic figurine inside, but it turns out I was just going to the wrong store. So unfortunately I purchased it here on Amazon (price point of about 7 dollars) when they were at another local grocery store for 2.37.

The tea is fantastic, though. I wish it was in sealed wrappers, but it does taste fresh regardless and very good.

product_title: Arnott's Tim Tam Double Coat Biscuits 200g
review_body: My vet of over 30 years has a mom that still works in the hospital. I adore the woman and one day she shared one of these cookies. She told me another patient's \\"person\\" brings them to her from Australia. I knew I could find and probably at a nearby deli that I use often. It has a great international selection. Since they never bothered to return a call or answer my email, I went to my old friend Amazon. Sure enough, there they were!  I bought my friend some more and also some for my Mother ( actually mother-in-law) who loves sweets. They are delicious. Worth every penny.

product_title: Heartland Gluten Free Spaghetti 12 oz. (Pack of 5)
review_body: My husband and I loved this pasta. It was our first experience with gluten free and we really could not tell the difference. In fact it might even have better than regular pasta. Also we didn't have the heartburn that usually accompanies pasta. I am thrilled that I don't have to give up pasta because I can't eat wheat. I highly recommend this product!

product_title: Walden Farms Mayo, Sugar Free, Calorie Free, Carb Free, Fat Free, 12 oz.
review_body: My husband was on the HCG diet and needed this for one of his phases. Worked fine for deviled eggs, dressings and as a spread. I taste tested and it was fine!

product_title: Raw Oregon Hazelnuts / Filberts (1 Pound Bag) - Sincerely Nuts
review_body: We only find these around Christmas time and even then, they are not as good as these nuts. My wife loves them above all other nuts. They are Very Fresh and even I eat some, in spite of the fact that I never cared much for filberts before.

product_title: Low-Carb Bread Mix
review_body: I have been experimenting with many different low carb bread recipes and been disappointed with all of them (horrible texture, flavor, etc).  I've been off my low-carb diet since Thanksgiving and have become addicted to the local bakery's jalapeno cheddar bread (VERY high in carbs), so I decided to experiment with Bob's Red Mill low-carb bread mix.  I had this item in my pantry for months before I made it and decided that yesterday was the day to finally give it a whirl.  I was amazed at how well it turned out!  I added in some diced canned jalapenos and a half a cup of shredded cheddar and cooked in a 2 lb bread machine (FYI - the bread did rise to the top and barely lifted the top open).  The texture is AMAZING!!!  The flavor isn't bad but still seems like its missing something.  I think it definitely needs some more flavor.  I'll probably add in a bit of splenda and a tsp of salt for starters....then maybe some garlic, basil, sundried tomatoes and maybe parmesan cheese.  It makes a great sandwich bread for the carb conscious.  I highly recommend you give it a try.

product_title: Nature Valley Roasted Nut Crunch Gluten Free Bars Almond Crunch (Pack of 6)
review_body: These are some of my favorite nut bars, and are very cost effective compared to some of the alternatives.  These bars have just the right amount of sweetness and saltiness for my palate.  Lots of almonds and peanuts.  I also enjoy the sunflower seeds.      I've purchased a 36-pack (6 boxes of 6 bars) of these three times now, and I'll undoubtedly be purchasing more.  I eat several of these each week for either for breakfasts or an evening snacks.  Totally hooked.    Great job, Nature Valley!  Thanks, Amazon.

product_title: Now and Later 48 Packs & Other Flavors
review_body: I used these in a candy buffet & they were great! Everyone loved them & they were very affordable. They came in a sealed case and were packaged perfectly.

product_title: Ray's Chilli Original Chilli with Beans, 15-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I grew up in the Springfield, Illinois area and Ray's was the best.   I'm glad that Amazion has it now.  I did find Ray's webstie and I will order the Cony Island Hot dog sause from them

product_title: SeaBear Wild Alaskan Smoked Salmon, 16-Ounce Unit
review_body: SeaBear Smoked Keta Salmon, 16-Ounce Unit  I really like the flavor of SeaBear Salmon. My favorite way to eat it is with real butter on french bread, and a piece of sharp cheddar cheese. It's not a strong salmon. It has good smoked flavor. I ordered three more today. YUM!

product_title: Donut Shop K-cups | Coffee People | 24 Kcups (Pack of 2)
review_body: Love the flavor but the quality of the k cups has gone down, down, down.. the grinds fall into the cup time after time.. have to throw it out and try a fresh one.. today went through 3 kcups before I got one without the grinds in it!

product_title: Texas Six Shooter West Texas Dust, 2.3-Ounce Plastic Jar (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Bring your grilled meats to life!
review_body: This is the most versatile meat seasoning that my friends and I have run across.  However, it would appear that the company that makes it might have been purchased by another gourmet company in Texas that, for whatever reason, is not making this sensational product available on the open market any longer.    If anyone runs across where to buy this item, please let me know at cyndi@catapulsion.net.  This is the single most useful seasoning for all meat items in my kitchen.  It's phenomenal!  If we can figure out where to buy this product again, we'll all be very happy.

product_title: LU Biscuits
review_body: I like so much these biscuits. They're so great but there was a little space of time (I think) where heat caused cookies were pasted each other. Is not a good idea to ask for chocolate or something like that.

product_title: Krusteaz Oat Bran Muffin Mix
review_headline: Poppyseed Muffins With Great Crunchy Texture
review_body:
This mix produces a poppyseed muffin with great crunchy texture. All you need is the mix, a cup of water, and an egg (although you can make an \\"extra rich & moist\\" version by adding 1/3 cup vegetable oil to the mix). The box contains a large packet of poppy seeds, which you fold into the batter. The finished muffins look exactly like the photo on the box: lots of poppy seeds!

The muffins have a strong almond flavor, which must come from almond extract, because it has a slight \\"chemical\\" or \\"medicinal\\" edge. This is fine with me, but some might not like it. Each muffin has 240mg of sodium per muffin, so the mix is okay for persons on a low-to-moderate-salt diet, as long as they don't eat too many!

The box also has instructions for using the mix to make almond poppyseed quick bread or pound cake. I've tried several of the Krusteaz muffin mixes, and they're all good, but this one is probably my favorite.

product_title: Happy Baby Organic Stage 2 Baby Food, Simple Combos, 3.5 Ounce Pouches, 8 count (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Used to be the only way I could get veggies down my baby!
review_body:
Before trying these pouches, I would attempt to hide veggies in my daughter's baby cereal and fruit puree. I could put the tiniest bit in her bowl and she would always detect it. I'm sure she would have survived without veggies, but it still bothered me that she wasn't eating any. (It's a mom thing I guess!) I saw these in the store and thought that the combinations of fruits and veggies in these looked \\"interesting.\\" I picked up a few, not really expecting my little one to like them. However, she really liked them - a lot. Maybe it has something to do with the fact that they come in a pouch that she can feed to herself.

Not only were these great to give her as an infant, she still enjoys these as a toddler. These are great to take with on outings - when it's otherwise difficult to give her produce. She can eat these without making a mess and we don't have to worry about spoilage. So far, she has liked all of the flavors. I like the fact that these aren't stored in plastic or in jars with BPA. I wish that these would have been available years ago. :)

product_title: Kirkland Signature Macadamia Clusters
review_body: I bought these because my brother LOVES them and they stopped selling them at our Costco.  So, since they were a gift, it was important that at least look okay... they looked terrible!  I understand that they were shipped, but the chocolate was cracked in places and chunks of it had stuck to the container.  Ah, well... I'm sure he'll still be excited because he likes them so much, but still pretty disappointing since I paid over twice what they used to cost at Costco.

product_title: Arrowroot Starch/Flour
review_body: Arrowroot was recommended to us as a \\"paleo\\" alternative to cornstarch. We have used it in an amazing pecan pie as well as various soups and sauces. A great addition to our pantry!

product_title: Ekobrew Coffee Reusable Filter, Small, Violet
review_headline: ekobrew Cup surpasses Keuring's brand K-Cup substitute Insert
review_body: While Keuring has found a place in my heart forever with it's wonderful, easy to operate K-Cup Machine if your income is not in that six figure plus range you have to agree that the K-Cups can get pricey.  This is the ideal \\"do it yourself\\" K-Cup substitute if you want to save money or you have some unique coffee/tea/warm beverage that doesn't come readily packaged as K-Cups.  Unlike the Keuring substitute K-Cup insert which does not make a full tasting brew in my opinion, the ekobrew has screens for distribution in all the right areas so that the hot water doesn't just pass through it has an opportunity to actually brew with the bonus plus of fitting directly into the brewer instead of having to remove the centerpiece as you do with the Keuring made product.  Plus you can feel good that it is recyclable and made of recyclable material and is 100% BPA free.  I use it for a delicate herb tea called Blue Eyes but I am planning on buying several to branch out to some Costa Rica coffees not available in K-Cups.

product_title: Starbucks Caffe Verona Dark K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: Taste is GREAT! but it is very expensive.  It is the best K-cup coffee that I have ever had! So dark and rich, but not bitter.

product_title: Fritos Original Corn Chips, 9.25 Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_body: These are fritos, what can i say?  If you like Fritos, this is it.  Yes, they were well packed and fresh.

product_title: Roman Instant Premix Masala (Spice) Tea Unsweetened Twin Pack - 20 Single Serving sachets 18g Each.
review_body: This is better than Chai Gold as the flavor is intense.  If you prefer a kadak (strong) chai this is better than other instant chais.  Used in correct proportion leads to a frothy appearing cup with the right flavor.  I doubt any instant mixes are going to substitute for the real thing but given the convenience and ease of preparation this is among the better ones.

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee Spicy Eggnog K-Cups
review_body: I will miss this flavor once the holidays are over.  Tastes and smells wonderful.  You won't be sorry.... order yourself some!

product_title: Yogi Teas Woman's Mother To Be, 16 Count (Pack of 6)
review_body:
I've had this product for just over 2 weeks and first of all, I hate the taste of the tea. It's pretty vile to me and tastes spicy and like licorice. I am a serious unsweet tea drinker, I love testing them out, and usually love them all. Despite that, I find myself having at least 2 cups a day because it makes me feel so calm and relaxed. I've tried many teas and herbs to help calm my mild anxieties, and this one surprised me at being the best of all!

If I drink it during the day, it relaxes me and makes me feel at peace but still able to function at top level. If I drink it at night, it helps me fall asleep and sleep well. When I wake in the morning, I am not groggy, I just feel ready to start my day and refreshed from the great sleep!

I find it also helps reduce pain with headaches, so I'm taking less Advil than normal. I received this tea when my cycle just started. I found I was still in a lot of pain, however, I did feel more relaxed while drinking this. I'm hoping if I keep drinking during my whole cycle, it will have an even better effect, but we will see. Even if it just makes me feel more relaxed during that time of the month, and keeps helping with the headaches, it is so worth it! I highly recommend this product to anyone

product_title: Casbah Couscous Mix
review_headline: Fast starch side dish - need more recipes!
review_body: Made this using tigerpaws suggestion from her review of this item (she called it her \\"lazy woman's risotto\\"). I toasted the cous cous with [[ASIN:B001XUM9B4 Nanak Pure Desi Ghee, Clarified Butter, 28-Ounce Jar]] and minced garlic. Then I added two cups of chicken stock made with [[ASIN:B00016LA7K Chicken base]]. I didn't have cojito cheese so I used shredded parmesan, tossing it on top when the cous cous was cooked through. Whole process took about 17 minutes. Everyone in my family had seconds. I have been searching the internet looking for other ways to make it more interesting, but this is a very good pantry item for me since it goes from cupboard to plate so fast!

product_title: Betty Lou's Fruit Bars
review_headline: Check bettylousinc.com!  These are gluten free & wonderful!
review_body: Simply the best.  My daughter and I love these fruit bars.  They are definitely gluten free per the manufacturer's website and the ingredient list.

product_title: Gallolea Pizza Kits Gluten Free Pizza Kit, 11 Ounce
review_headline: Delcious Flavor, Great Texture, Satisfying All Around
review_body: I had a group of friends over for dinner to taste test this gluten free pizza and the Gallo Lea gluten free pasta and sauce. I was incredibly impressed with the texture of the dough (one of the best gluten free varieties I've had) and the ease of preparation. It took very little time and effort to produce a beautiful and delicious pizza.     This crust and sauce are a great base for any array of toppings - we had ours with black olives, artichoke hearts, mozzarella cheese, mushrooms, and zucchini. :)    Enjoy!

product_title: SweetLeaf Sweet Drops Liquid Stevia Sweetener, Vanilla Creme
review_headline: Great flavor, concentrated Stevia is expensive though
review_body: I like this flavor, the dry Stevia doesn't taste good as good as the concentrate. In stores the basic price is $14.99, so besides shipping this item is priced right, only place I found flavored Stevia was a local health food store, it wasnt easy to find, so this may be a good option.

product_title: Prince Of Peace Organic Oolong Tea
review_body: There were some issues with the initial order, but it has been resolved.  This product is important to my health and am glad to finally receive it.  This tea is good for my blood pressure and energy.

product_title: Crazy Cups Flavored Coffee Sampler
review_body: I was disappointed with the selection that was sent to me.  25 were Green Mountain(7 French Van, 5 Country, 4Hazel Nut, 5 Extra Bold, 4 Breakfast Blend). The others were:4 Newman Spec. Decaf, 3 Caribou, 2 Emeril Jaz up, and 1 Gloria Jean.  I thought by the description and picture that I was going to get a couple of each variety, so I could try each one to see which one I would like best.  It seems like this was thrown together with what ever was left over, the packaging on the Caribou and Emiril were pushed in.  I've been getting my coffee K-cups from Amazon for a few years now, this is the first time that I have been let down.

product_title: Sugar Twin Granulated Brown Calorie Free Sweetener, Box, 2.85 oz
review_body: We are pleased to find tghis product since in our small town of about 100.0-0 the markets do not have it in stock!  So are grateful to get it on line!  Thanks Makranczy

product_title: Durkee Steak Seasoning, 26-Ounce Containers (Pack of 2)
review_body: This was marketed in conjunction with a \\"big box club\\" and a manufacturer of an outdoor grill.  Upon subsequent visits to the \\"big box club\\" we could not find it!  I contacted the manufacturer of the grill and they said it was a \\"label over\\" product by Durkees.  Yeah!   This is the best steak seasoning you'll ever use.  Product is coarse ground.  I also use it sprinkled on salads and steamed veggies a few minutes before serving to reconstitute the herbs and seasonings.  It is delish! An excellent value for the money.

product_title: La Preferida Rice Long Grain, 10-pounds (Pack of 4)
review_body:
we bought this la preferida rice long grain in a pack of 4 10lb packages. weve eaten 1 pkg already but im saving the other 3 bags for emergency backup. placed inside a 5gal. watertight bucket. in a few months(or less)ill buy some more.
do you recall the japan tsunami?? anyway, their foodsource to stay alive was eating RICEBALLS. now, i dont know what they added to the riceball for flavor, cause i know they all love fish, but if you get into a rationing situation to stay alive, water and salt with this rice would taste like a delicacy in itself.
no matter what the emergency is whether from tonado, hurricane, tsunami etc... riceballs will work

product_title: Celebrate Good Times Gift Basket by ig4U
review_headline: Pretty basket with practically nothing in it!
review_body: I got this basket today and it was the biggest waste of money.  There were two small truffles, 1.43oz and 1.60oz. 4 thin small biscoffee .85oz, almonds 1oz, peanuts 1oz. Bag of ginger snaps 2.13oz. Chocolate napolitan milk and dark chocolate 6 pieces each at 1oz each. Stoned wheat wafers at 1/2oz. nuts and fruit 1oz, carmels flear de sol 6 pieces, and Italian herb cheese 3.5oz that was overpowering garlic flavored.   Basically what you paid for was a basket and cellophane with samples inside.   The price was outrageous. DO NOT ORDER THIS BASKET FOR A GIFT, YOU WILL BE EMBARASSING YOURSELF.

product_title: Amy's Organic Thai Coconut Soup (Tom Kha Phak), 14.1-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: This was just awful. Upon opening the can, it had a grainy looking texture to it. After heating up, it had oily pools on top. The liquid stock was bland until a sour aftertaste hit. The vegetables were so mushy and tasteless, I just spit them out. I found nothing redeeming about the soup. And I so wanted to like it.  I love soup, and I put off trying Amy's soups for a long time because of their price. But I finally tried the Chunky Tomato Bisque, and it was out of this world. So I had to try the other offerings. So far, every other Amy's soup that I've tried has been mediocre at best. But we go through a 2-3 cases of the Chunky Tomato Bisque each month.

product_title: Vandevi Hing (Asafoetida) 50g (1.75oz) - Pack of 2
review_body: Be forewarned.  This is not the pure spice but a watered down mix for the export market.  I suppose I can live with that but I would have liked to have known it when I purchased it.  I had never heard of this Indian spice before until a recent recipe book by Madhur Jaffrey kept demanding its use.  I guess it adds a certain subtle flavoring to the dishes but my palate really isn't that discerning.  I think you have to use more than the recipes demand since this is adulterated with a filler.

product_title: Quinn Popcorn: Microwave Popcorn Reinvented {Mixed Case: Parmesan/Maple/Lemon}
review_body: Let me start off by saying that I seldom write reviews for products, even if I think they're terrific. This has more to do with the fact that I generally wait to see which way the wind is blowing before I jump in. Not so with Quinn Popcorn. I was one of the lucky group that happened upon their Kickstarter campaign and I couldn't be happier about it. We received our mixed case about two weeks ago and every time we want a snack we have to weigh the desire for an amazingly tasty treat with our limited supply. Is it really a \\"popcorn worthy\\" movie/episode/? Now that it will be available through amazon we will no longer be forced to resort to less tasty or more processed options. I think you probably get the idea by now that we are fans. Let me finish with some actual critique of the product. The flavors are excellent and the preparation is simple. Truly a great product well worth your snack money.

product_title: Oskri Dried Fruit, Cherries, 3.53-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: I have really enjoyed every Oskri Fruit/Nut item I have tried. I like them for their great flavor & texture, Natural ingredients & preperation. I feel very comfortable about the healthful & dietary appropriate ingredients / nutritional informtion supplied. I love fresh cherries, and these were the first dried cherries I have enjoyed by themselves -- not an adjunct to salads, baking, & other recipes.

product_title: Crystal Noodle Soup, Spicy Sesame Paste, 2.47 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I got hooked on the spicy sesame Crystal Noodle soups when my grocery used to carry them, but now the soup can't be found anywhere in town so I have to order online.  And boy, is it worth it.  This soup is made up of thin, almost clear crystal noodles that comes with a block of dehydrated bok choy and paste, plus a little envelope of sesame paste. You put the block of bok choy and paste on top of the noodles, pour boiling water until it reaches the fill line, then put the lid on and let it sit just a couple of minutes.  Then you add the sesame paste, which tastes a little like peanut butter and pairs with the spiciness of the broth wonderfully.  The paste is a little difficult to get out sometimes, requiring some finesse with a butter knife, but it's worth it.      The noodles are filling and taste better than the kind you get in the usual ramen soups.  The broth is a medium spice that builds, and the bok choy rehydrates well with good flavor.  The calories are quite good, only 280, but the sodium is high as you would expect.  I pair a bowl of this with an egg roll or two and am full for hours.

product_title: Simply Shari's Gluten Free Cheese Pizza, 8-Inch, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: As with most gluten free products you try a lot of bad ones before you get to a good one. This one tastes like real pizza. Love both toppings and crust. Also love that it's healthy. Finally a pizza I can love and eat!!!

product_title: Zotz Fizzy Candy Grape Flavored 2lb 170 Pieces
review_body: Never had this product before last Wednesday on a family trip when my hubby gave me one.  These fizzy hard candies are awesome and have now become my favorite hard candy.  Will always keep these on hand!

product_title: Virginia Diner Unsalted Virginia Peanuts, 36-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
review_body: these nuts are large, crunchy and totally addictive. We used to buy the salted variety but were happy to find the unsalted version which are just as good and much better for a low sodium diet.

product_title: Naturally Nora Cake and Frosting Mix Variety Pack (3 Cake Mixes, 3 Frosting Mixes)
review_headline: Great mix of mixes and frostings!!
review_body:
I use these mixes mainly for cupcakes - they come out wonderfully, and honestly, all her cake and frosting mixes are delicious!

They are a HUGE hit with my kids, and it's nice to know the ingredients are all natural and no UN-pronounceable chemicals!!

Great job, Naturally Nora!!

product_title: Libbys Libbys 100% Pure Pumpkin, 29-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Libby is quality product, and this was the best way to order
review_body: we ordered 2 cases because they were on sale, cheaper than local stores have been (Pumpkin shortage raised prices big-time). we did get a couple of dented cans, but I don't see how that can be avoided. we just made sure to use those first. Libby is my wife's preferred brand of pumpkin, as she bakes lots of pumpkin muffins and cakes. All in all, it was a great purchase

product_title: O.N.E. Coconut Water with a Splash of Passion Fruit, 8.5-Ounce Aseptic Containers (Pack of 12)
review_body: I have been drinking ZICO coconut water at $2.49 a piece. They were just ok. These are so much cheaper and the flavor is wonderful! Free shipping and with the subscribe and save (PLEASE bring back the subscribe and save option for this product!) I payed around .80 a piece. product_title: Pamela's Ultimate Baking and Pancake Mix
review_body: I've tried tons of GF pancake mixes.  I could choke on most of them or just decide not to ever eat pancakes again.  These are so moist and delicious.  My 92 year old grandmother was just diagnosed with celiac disease.  She loves them too.  My wife and children who are not GF also love them.   m

product_title: Masdevallia Beth Cox
review_body: I was really looking forward to receiving these orchids, I can not find the masdevallia orchid anywhere here at home.  When I received it, the orchid was almost dead the leaves were nice but the two buds on it were completely dried out. It only took another 3 days for them finally to fall off. I do have other ones so I know how to properly take care of them although by the time I received them it would not have made a deference if I did or not. For the price of the orchid I should not have received one with dead buds. I'm very disappointed because I was looking forward to buying more from this company, as their picture makes them look nice. I tried to email them as amazon recommended and heard nothing back from them.

product_title: Twinings Green Tea, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-Count (Pack of 2)
review_body: Green tea is a favorite for me and to find it for K-cups is awesome. The flavor is great and the strength is perfect. Love it.

product_title: Kitchens Of India Ready To Eat Dal Bukhara
review_body: My husband and I really like these meals.  They are so convenient when you're in a rush and we love the taste.  Have to say that the serving size is a little off, or maybe we're just overeaters.  We use 2 boxes with rice on the  side, cucs and yogurt, a little chutney and naan (or pita if we don't have any). High in fat so don't have as often  as we'd like.

product_title: Great Northern Popcorn, Portion Packs (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Great popcorn! Just like the movies!
review_body: I have been searching to find that perfect movie theater popcorn that I can make at home; well, I found it! I recently purchased a Stir Crazy popper and this popcorn works great with it. The seasoning and oil combines to make a perfect and delicious batch every time. At first I was concerned about buying such a large quantity of popcorn without knowing how it would taste, but I can already tell that I'll be going through this box fast. A+ recommended!

product_title: Inka Crops Plantain Chips
review_body: I bought these at my local supermarket and I had to throw them away. You can feel a burnt oil taste, very disappointing.

product_title: English Ivy 4 Plants - Hardy Groundcover - Great Bonsai
review_body:
I put these in 4 separate pots around my office and home. I really like the look of the leaves and they are fun to keep track of how much they have grown. All 4 plants are doing well and look nice.

They are poisonous to cats, so be careful.

product_title: Cool Colada Trident White Sugarless Gum, , 12-12 Piece Packs (144 Pieces Per Box!)
review_body: The flavor really lasts a long time, but isn't too fruity. And the best part is--- there is NO mint flavor!

product_title: Elki's Gourmet Black Olive Tapenade, 10 Ounce
review_body: Used this for a recipe and then with the leftovers, I warmed it up on some cream cheese and dipped with crackers. Very yummy!

product_title: O OLIVE OIL & VINEGAR Organic Crushed Blood Orange Olive Oil, 8.45 Fluid Ounce
review_body: Best used for a dinner party or family dinner, you can use it on a salad, but it that salad better be pretty darn special. I think the best meat would be chicken (white meat). Flavor of the oil will expllode in your mouth!

product_title: Dunkin Donuts Ground Coffee Original Blend - 1lb
review_body: Great coffee. BUT, I purchase it two pounds at a time at Dunkin Donuts for 6.99 per pound. Much less expensive if you can get to a DD.

product_title: Crystal Light On The Go Hunger Satisfaction, Strawberry Banana, 7-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I really like this product but have been unable to locate it in local retails this season. I hope this product has not been discontinued.  The flavor is pleasing and the added fiber does help with hunger.  Much better than just drinking water.

product_title: Bahlsen Biscuits & Cookies
review_body: I grew up eating these cookies.  Got a case for a great price.  Will be looking for them again this fall.

review_body: C*stco is selling this stuff for 97 cents per box... Its a rip here but get to C*stco ASAP because they are purging this product from their inventory. My location only had about 20 boxes left and I bought 8 of them!

product_title: Campbell's Soup on the Go, 10.75 Ounce (Pack of 8)
review_headline: Very Convenient but still Too Salty
review_body: Classic tomato soup in a great package.  Nuke it, sip it, enjoy.  But I do think they could have used even less salt.

product_title: B&M Brown Bread with Raisins, 16-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_body: Just had some last night. I thought I'd check to see if Amazon stocked this product so I can order when I'm out of state. I am not sure what people are doing to cook this that have it with bad reviews (perhaps they are NOT cooking it at all?)  but I always just slip it out of the can cut off what I need for the meal (In this case half a can) wrap in foil and bake the last 20 minutes in the oven along side of a can of beans in a casserole dish topped w/ scored hotdogs. Taste as good as ever... steaming it in the foil makes it moist! I freeze the unused half and will thaw and cook the next time around.

product_title: Knorr Sopa Pasta Soup Mix, Alphabet Pasta Tomato 3.5 oz (Pack of 12)
review_body: This a good soup.  It is a different tasting tomato soup, but good.  The price was great!  Thank You.

product_title: Woeber's Supreme Wasabi Mustard, 10-Ounce Squeeze Bottles (Pack of 6)
review_body: I couldn't find this mustard anywhere so searched online.  Had to buy a case, but went through it fast with gifts to others who never had used it.  Good deal, also.

product_title: Archer Farms Monster Trail Mix 16oz
review_body: I love this stuff, it has a great mix of sweet and salty.  But the other reviewer is right, buy it from Target!

product_title: Fisher Starlight Chocolate, 5-Pound Package
review_body: A local restaurant in my town always had Chocolate Starlight mints at the counter and I loved them.  But they are hard to find.  I was pleased to find them on Amazon, but when these arrived I was disappointed once I tasted them.  They are clearly not the same as the ones the restaurant had.  Many of them tasted like there were burnt pieces of chocolate in the candy.  I can't recommend these.

product_title: Holly's Au Natural Oatmeal, Goji Berry, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I love oatmeal, but I've struggled to find a kind that was easy to fix and not too sugary, but not your basic boring oats either.  For a while I used Quaker instant Low Sugar packets, but they just add artificial sweetener to it, which makes it still waaaay too sweet for my taste.  That's why I LOVE Holly's oatmeal... it has just a hint of sweetness, and you can always add more (a little syrup or brown sugar) if you need it.  Just add milk and it cooks up on the stove in less than 10 minutes.  The website has instructions for the microwave, though I haven't tried it yet.  The goji berries are an interesting addition, though they are extremely mild in flavor.  I catch a hint of green tea taste when I bite into them.  Really, all the flavors are great.  This is my go-to snack!

product_title: General Foods International Viennese Chocolate Cafe Drink Mix, 8-Ounce Tins (Pack of 6)
review_body: We really enjoy the General Foods International Viennese Chocolate Cafe and fervently hope that you will start selling it again.  Also, the Amazon Auto-ship is great.

product_title: Jenny's Honey Teriyaki Beef Jerky, 3-ounce Bags (pack of 4)
review_headline: It's true!  Love at first bite!
review_body: We tried Jenny's Honey Teriyaki Beef Jerky and have to agree with their marketing slogan \\"Love @ 1st bite\\".  This jerky is delicious!  The honey teriyaki is sweet and salty.  A really nice savory seasoning that appeals to adults as well as a couple of 10 year olds that practically devoured the whole bag.   The consistency of the jerky is chewy but not tough.  The slices of jerky are easy to bite off (some small pieces break off easily but there are also some larger pieces that you can chew a little longer). It's one of those addictive snacks that after you finish the bag, you can't wait to get your hands on more!    [[ASIN:B004NVVVMS Jenny's Honey Teriyaki Beef Jerky, 3-ounce Bags (pack of 4)]]

product_title: Swanson Chicken Mixin', 4.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Great chicken to eat out of the can!
review_body: I love Swanson's Mixin Chicken.  I eat it right out of the can for a quick meal on-the-run.  It's in a lovely natural tasting chicken gelatin which is heavenly.  The other Swanson chickens may be fine for others, but they are too dry for my purposes.    Last time I ordered a case, I popped a number in the fridge, and then, when I'm hungry, it's a ready-to-eat meal for me.    I'm frustrated that Mixin isn't available at my local stores often. And now, I come to reorder, and again, it's not available.  I hope I can get it soon as I just ate the next-to-last can I have on-hand.

product_title: Zoe Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 25.5-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
review_body: For some reason I like this oil much more for cooking then straight on salads.  This Olive Oil is very good and a much better priced than at my supermarket. I like the idea that it is from Spain but originally thought it was from Italy. This gives you a different variety of nutrients and omegas that are healthy and nutritious.

product_title: Nature Valley Chewy Trail Mix Fruit and Nut Bars
review_body: These Nature Valley bars are one of my favorite granola bars. They taste great, don't have tons of calories, and are just the right size for a quick snack. Much better than the \\"crunchy\\" variety of Nature Valley bars.

product_title: General Foods International Coffee, 32-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)
review_body: This has been my favorite hot beverage for years, and I was so disappointed when it was no longer being sold in my local grocery store.  I had given up finding it; then I ran across it on Amazon!  It has coffee flavor with chocolate, so it is like a mocha.  I do like it stronger than the directions.  And sometimes I mix it with some hot chocolate.  Yummm!

product_title: Hodgson Mill Wheat Germ with Cinnamon & Flaxseed, 11-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I love to put this in my vanilla yogurt. It has a good flavor and it's good for you.  We can't find it in any local store, so I'm glad Amazon sells it.

product_title: Food For Life Ezekiel 4:9 Organic Sprouted Grain Cereal, Golden Flax, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)

However, a 41% price increase since November 14, 2010, for their flax cereal is extreme.  The current price $41.54 for 6 boxes comes out to $7.00 each for a small 16 ounce box.
