product_title: Ice Breakers Gum PTP Cool Mint 12 Packs
review_body: This is my favorite gum! Thank goodness you can still get it on here. I chewed this gum exclusively when it was available in the stores. Stride has nothing on this gum! I miss the original formula though.

product_title: Keurig, Celestial Seasonings, K-Cup packs
review_body:
I love the Celestial Seasonings Tea Sampler.
It has a good assortment of tea from a name that you can trust.
I also found that you can get Tea K-Cups at your Grocery Store too.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee, Colombian Decaffeinated Medium K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50)
review_body: I have to admit, these K-Cups make an out of this world cup of coffee.  However, in my most recent shipment, I have had more than a dozen of these cups clog and send coffee grounds everywhere.  I am thoroughly displeased and am looking for Amazon, or Timothy's, to make it right.  The quality of the coffee is second to none, but the quality of the manufacturing in this last batch was horrible, thus the \\"2 stars.\\"

product_title: Manischewitz Whole Grain Matzo Farfel Canister, 14-ounces (Pack of 6)
review_body: My regular matzo farfel was out of stock so I decided to try this whole grain version as a healthy alternative. Big Mistake. Before you order this stuff, make sure you taste some whole grain matzo first --- if you like the flavor than go ahead. It comes out much darker and more fibrous than regular matzo farfel. In our family this stuff was a big flop. My wife decided to throw the other five cans in the garbage as she didn't want to try and save this purchase by mixing it with regular matzo farfel --- so for me this product was a total loss.

product_title: Dave's Gourmet Sauce, 5 Ounce
review_headline: not as hot as expected but awesome flavor
review_body: ok, so I bought this stuff after reading a few review. I found it at cost plus (world market).  Went home and decided to be a big boy and just put it straight on my tongue to really get the flavor of the sauce without it being hindered by any food. I gotta say it really wasn't that spicy. It has an initial tingle on your tongue/heat that starts to creep up but is gone within a min or 2. Has awesome flavor and I'm excited to use it more but I gotta say, my homemade hot sauce is wayyyyy hotter!

product_title: Keurig, Newman's Own Organics, Newman's Special Decaf, K-Cup Portion Packs
review_body: Newman's Special Blend Decaf is a very enjoyable cup of coffee anytime of gthe day.  Good flavor and very smooth.  Ordered from Amazon and delivery was sure and quick.

product_title: Chex Rice Cereal, 12.8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 14)
review_body: As a Canadian, once going gluten-free, my domestic options were bad. I tried out every good-looking gluten-free cereal at my grocery store (and there were a lot), and out of those, only Nature Path's Crispy Rice was good enough to eat every day. Tired of poor-tasting organic brands, my only other option was to order from the U.S.    To my knowledge, the only low-sugar gluten-free major-brand cereals are Rice Chex and Corn Chex. I was apprehensive ordering a 14-box pack of Rice Chex without having tried the cereal, but I couldn't be happier with the taste. It's actually superior to its competitor Crispix (available in Canada but not gluten-free), since Crispix tends to stick in teeth and Chex doesn't have that problem. Crispix was already one of my favourite cereals before going gluten-free, so I rank Rice Chex among my favourite cereals even disregarding gluten-free-ness.    Later, I was visiting the U.S. and had a chance to try Corn Chex, and it was also great, maybe even better.    My choice to order a 14-box pack was based on shipping cost--at this volume, the shipping (while still significant) is a reasonable percentage of the price, something that isn't true of smaller packs. I wish Chex were available in Canada, given how bad the gluten-free options are here and how good the cereal is.

product_title: Breadtopia Sourdough Starter (Live)
review_body: We have had active starters in the house for most of the last 30 years in all climates and altitudes.  Most were started from scratch and a few used starter \\"kits\\".  After my mother-in-law A)asked me to make some sourdough bread for an upcoming family get together, and B) proudly stated that she had \\"tossed out that stinky, sticky stuff in the jar\\" we decided to give this starter a try. Turns out this has the best flavor without a doubt of any of my starters over the years.      Our experience is that all starters seem to have \\"personality\\" and not just the flavor.  This one is easy to care for, smells and tastes great and activates really quickly.  I can't recall a starter producing this many of the bubbles and holes that help make sourdough distinctive.     The seller's videos, recipes and advice are straight forward and practical.     In summary, can't say enough good things about this cost effective way to get a starter.

product_title: Better Than Milk Vegan Beverage Mix, Rice, Vanilla, 21.4-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 2)
review_body: I am vegan and found this powder milk great for travelling, in particular when travelling by air. With the latest flight security restrictions for liquids, I cannot take rice milk in liquid form with me into the airplane cabin. All I have to do is to buy a bottle of water after passing security and mix it with the rice milk powder. It is also great when I go to places where is hard to find milk substitutes.  The vanilla version is much better in taste than the original. Both have a creamy texture.

product_title: Community Coffee Private Reserve Ground Medium-Dark Roast, 100% Chicory, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Not what I thought it was...
review_body: The product description is deceptive, unfortunately I ordered 6 bags of chicory, not 6 bags of Ground coffee medium-dark roast with chicory. I had wanted to try it, guess I have plenty now!

product_title: Chef Boyardee
review_headline: not as good as the canned
review_body: These are quick and easy. They are also the perfect size for my little ones. The regular size ones are just a little too big for my three year old. So I like these because he can eat them without me having to cut them in half for him. They are also the perfect size for my one year old. They both like them. However, they don't taste the micro bites in the can. To me they taste a little more bitter, but the kids like them so I guess that's what matters. There is kind of a lot of sauce, but I just drain a little before I serve it to my kids. It's not too much.

product_title: Hodgson Mill Honey Whole Wheat Bread Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I thought I was getting low sodium bread and it wasn't.   I made 4 loaves for some friends but haven't used the others because my husband is on a very low sodium diet because of his heart.

product_title: Fire & Flavor Gourmet Grilling Planks, Maple, 2-Count Packages (Pack of 3)
review_headline: These maple planks are not good for bbq.
review_body: No fragrance,just smell like burning wood, turn to charcoal too easily.  We've been successfully using cedar planks for years, when I inadvertently ordered these maple planks.  Tried a few, then threw them away.

product_title: 9GreenBox - Lucky Bamboo - Heart Style with Tall Glass Vase
review_body: great gift idea for our anniversary, my husband always says he's used all his luck finding me...so i bought this gift for his office

product_title: Antica Tostatura Triestina Organic Drip/Filter Coffee Grind, 8.8-Ounce Containers (Pack of 2)
review_body: Without doubt my absolute favorite coffee at the moment. Strong, beautifully nuanced flavors combined with excellent aromas. Tastes like coffee should!

product_title: Tilda Legendary Rice, Pure Original Basmati, 10 Pound
review_body: Love this rice. I eat quite a bit - and this stuff is very, very good. I use a rice cooker mostly, and this stuff just comes out perfectly - light, fluffy and almost sweet. The bag is a little weird to use - but I usually transfer it to a airtight container once I open it anyways.

product_title: DoMatcha - Summer Harvest Tin, 2.82oz
review_body: Very smooth tea. Can drink plain. Make a latte nearly every day. It has bright green color (see photo), and very solid, reusable packaging. The internal bag the tea comes in is about 1/2 the size of the canister, which is misleading. I keep it in the bag along with a small bamboo spoon.    Tip: If your matcha clumps, try adding the tea to cold water, stir, then heat. Be careful as it can boil over easier. As with flour and lumps, if you add it to hot water there is risk it will form a clump. The bamboo chasens really help to stir up the tea. They are 10 times better than a spoon. This brand rarely clumps.    Made in Kyoto, Japan.

product_title: Gluten Free Corn Grits / Polenta
review_body: I knew the grits were excellent.  I am amazed that the direct order via my favorite store - Amazon.com - was so much more reasonably priced than actually going to a local store!

product_title: Gloria Jean's Coffees, Flavored Coffee Variety, 22-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2)
review_body: I found these kcups to be really good! Not too weak or bitter. I got the full variety and love every one so far. Definately would recommend!

product_title: Koppers Traditional Dark Chocolate Malted Milk Balls, 5-Pound Bag
review_body: ZERO stars (if I could)! Chock full of trans fat and high-fructose corn syrup- everything that is bad for you. Steer clear of this. Very disappointed in Koppers for producing this! Got a refund from Amazon- they were very responsive.

product_title: Mighty Leaf Tea Mighty Leaf Variety
review_headline: Variety pack provides a nice assortment to choose from.
review_body:
Discovered this tea after my wife had it in a higher end restaurant. She actually brought the wrapper home so that she could order some. After a quick bit of on-line research discovered that Amazon sold the Mighty Leaf brand and at a very good price. As for the price this is an expensive tea but in my opinion (and my wife's) well worth the price. If you are used to getting 100 tea bags for $1 at the dollar store then you will be in for sticker shock but you will also be in for a taste shock. This is what real quality tea tastes like.

The tea comes in sewn nylon? bags. No chlorine bleached paper bags here. The hang tag lists the name of the tea and the recommended brewing time. If you want to try Might Leaf tea for the first time I recommend this variety pack as it gives you seven different varieties to sample. We have tried all the varieties and some we probably won't be buying individually and some we definitely will.

product_title: Junket Ice Cream Mix Chocolate 12 count
review_body: I received a Cuisinart ice cream machine for Christmas and have been enjoying creating different flavors of ice cream.  Junket ice cream mixes are difficult to beat for ease and taste.  For a real treat, add a half cup of Nutella to the Junket chocolate mix for chocolate-hazelnut ice cream.  You won't be disappointed!  I just wish both Junket and Nutella made sugar-free!  THAT would be true heaven!

product_title: Starbucks Cappuccino Primo, 16 T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers, 8 Coffee & 8 Creamer Sets, (Pack of 5)
review_headline: Excellent Starbucks Cappuccino at Home or Office
review_body: Incredible quality & taste. I add a Gevalia Swiss Hazelnut and two small spoonfuls of sugar to this to fill my 16 oz travel mug. Excellent overall. Good value on Amazon for 5 boxes (40 Cappuccinos).

product_title: Coffee-mate Special Edition Vanilla Chai Spice, 15-Ounce Units (Pack Of 6)
review_headline: I miss my Vanilla Chai Spice
review_body: This was absolutely the best creamer they have made, I just don't understand why out of all the different ones they have they had to do away with this one.  I wish I could just make it myself.

product_title: Back To Nature Golden Honey Oat Grahams, 10-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body:
I love graham crackers and try to get whole grain versions of products whenever possible, so these Back To Nature crackers are a win/win.

Alot of people think whole grain makes bread or crackers \\"heavy\\", I disagree. Especially in this case, the whole grain really improves the taste of the crackers. They taste richer and more complex than regular graham crackers, a little heartier but not heavier. I used some of them in mini cheesecakes and everyone raved about the crust, asking what I added to it to make it so good.

A couple of reviews felt these were a bit drier than regular crackers. I compared them to the store brand I had in my cabinet and really didn't find them to be drier than the store brand. They are richer but have more flavor than the store brand.

This is a great healthy version of a comfort food snack, I highly recommend!

product_title: Funky Monkey Snacks Carnaval Mix, 0.42-Ounce Bag (Pack of 12)
review_headline: I think it's OK, but my kids don't like it
review_body: I think this snack is okay, it healthy and not too sweet.  But my kids (1, 3, and 7) don't like it.  I thought they would since they usually like any kind of dried fruit snack but for some reason this just wasn't a big hit at our home.    I might try their other flavors to see if those are more popular with the kids :)

product_title: Alaska Smokehouse Salmon Jerky
review_body: Having had the opportunity to purchase salmon jerky while in Alaska, it was great to be able get the same great taste through Amazon.  If you truly enjoy jerky, you will enjoy this product.  It was delivered fresh, moist, chewy, and very tasteful.

product_title: Barbara's Bakery Shredded Wheat Cereal, 13 Ounce (Pack of 4)
review_body: I give it 4/5, losing one star for decreasing the ounces during the recession. An old trick, but still reliable, I guess.

product_title: Horn & Hardart Ground Coffee
review_body: If you want a satisfying, stalwart coffee for your everyday brew, this is it. You can make it to your taste: stronger without it becoming bitter, weaker without losing any flavor.

product_title: Stevita Stevia Supreme Sweetener 2000 Packets bulk
review_body: This is the best (and lowest priced) Stevia sweetener I've found.  No aftertaste, no bitterness, just sweet & natural!

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_body: I found this to be a very close version of the Douwe Egberts Columbian coffee that I've had at a nice country club.  If only it came in regular grounds so I could more easily share it with others in my office......

product_title: Tuttorosso Traditional Pasta Sauce - 12 Pack
review_body: This is one of the best traditional pasta sauces around. Usually I would mix some oregano, some basil and some garlic powder to give my gravy some taste but this doesn't need any additional items. It's great just out of the jar!

product_title: FruTons Apple Cinnamon Coffee Cake (6 oz)
review_body: OMG, these are the best thing ever! I love them because they are a quick, easy, delicious and healthy snack. I have tried the Banana Bread and Apple Cinnamon Coffee Cake Frutons and they are both excellent. My next order will be the Lemon Poppy, can't wait to try them! My kids and husband love them too which says a lot because they are very picky. I keep them in my car to have handy for after-school and after-sports snacks. Fruit goes bad, chips and cookies are unhealthy, so these are perfect for the on-the-go Mom and Dad. The transaction was simple and shipment was speedy. I will be putting in another order soon because these go fast in my household!

product_title: Starbucks Dark Espresso Roast Ground Coffee, 12 Ounce
review_body: It's been fine.  Rich, but not very bitter.  I sometimes mix this with one of the milder ones like Columbian.  I meant to order the beans, but must have ordered the ground by mistake.

product_title: HERSHEY'S Kitchens Baking Pieces, Cinnamon Chips, Gluten Free, 10 Ounce Bag (Pack of 6)
review_body: These cinnamon chips are simply amazing! If you like oatmeal raisen spice style cookies use these for a little kick.  My whole family loves them.  You can use them as an allternative to chocolate chips or in combination with other chips.  There is also a great recipe on the bag, just try them!  You will not be disapointed.

product_title: Ghirardelli Chocolate Premium Hot Cocoa Mix, Chocolate Mocha, 16-Ounce Cans (Pack of 4)
review_body: I've been a fan of Ghirardelli Triple Chocolate brownie mix for a long time. And I also like Ghirardelli chocolate candy. So when I came across this chocolate mocha hot cocoa mix I wanted to give it a try cause I love cocoa and coffee. I'm glad I bought it because this stuff is delicious. I love the combination of chocolate and coffee. The coffee in it is very subtle and definitely not overpowering. It's rich, very flavorful, and bold. And as others have pointed out this is the best mix you can buy. I'm very impressed.

product_title: Happy Baby Organic Stage 2 Baby Food, Simple Combos, 3.5 Ounce Pouches, 8 count (Pack of 2)
review_body: We tried this flavor when my son was almost 6 months and he wouldn't eat it. It is too sour even for me. I have talked to customer service and they had complains from other people and the next batch will have more sweet potato in so it should taste better. I will give it try again when the new batch is out. Otherwise my son loved all the other flavors we tried so far ( pear, mango&spinach&pear, Pear&peas&broccoli, apple&cherry, banana&beat&blueberries ). So try one before ordering bunch on Amazon.  The pouch idea is great, so easy to travel with! Some of the flavors are little runny but I am using Boon spoon and it works great. I am also going to try out the Plum organic Boon spoon for pouches, should fit Happy baby pouches as well.

product_title: All Natural Foojoy Wuyi Oolong (Wu Long) Weight Loss Tea 100 Tea Bags
review_body: I absolutely recommend this tea!!!  I love this tea, I enjoy it every morning... I've been a coffee drinker most all of my adult life, and since I started drinking this tea, my coffee pot hasn't been used... lol I've also made sun-tea with the bags, and was surprised at how much my family liked it over ice.  The only reason I gave it only 4stars, is because some of the staples on the bags on not on securely.

product_title: Taste Nirvana Real Coconut Water, 9.5 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: I have tried so many coconut waters, and they are okay, but none of them have bottles with caps or a great taste. Well, this lacks that weird coconut water taste, almost more what youd expect coconut cream to taste like! They have one ingredient: natural coconut, a bigger/sweeter coconut from  a part of thailand. It is expensive, but the bottle/cap and taste make up for it completely. These are cheaper on amazon than at my local store and its easier to buy in bulk anyway, since coconut water has electrolytes.

product_title: La Tourangelle Avocado Oil, 16.9-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
review_body: I recieved this oil last week and it is rancid. It smells and tastes like rotten tomatos or avacados and there is no way I could eat this on any type of salad. Both cans arrived in perfect condition and neither are near the expiration date on the bottle. I recommend purchasing from a local retailer so it can be taken back if its rancid. Its too much of a gamble buying from Amazon when you cannot return food items. Lesson learned.    UPDATE 04/05/2011: After reading so many reviews about how good this product was I contacted La Tourangelle through their email system and told them about the situation and asked how this avocado oil was supposed to taste. I wasn't sure if it was supposed to taste the way it did or not. I didn't ask for replacements or anything because I know a lot of companies will not back their product if sold by Amazon. That is not the case with La Tourangelle. I was contacted by Diane through email about a week later asking for the batch numbers. I gave them and didn't hear anything back, until today. About an hour ago UPS delivered a box that contained two large cans of oil; one can of Avocado oil and one can of Hazelnut oil. I was so surprised because I didn't even remember giving them my address, but now recall it was required on their email submission form. At any rate La Tourangelle went above and beyond and they will be getting my business in the future, but only in a B&M store or through their website. That is the only place I can recommend anyone buy these products because Amazon will not take back food items.    As far as the oil, the new Avocado oil tastes like real Avocados with no rancid taste or smell and the Hazelnut is out of this world. I plan to try them all out now, from the La Tourangelle website. Companies that go above and beyond will always get my business because they actually care about their product. Thank you La Tourangelle!

product_title: Re-use K-Cups Brew-Savers Stainless Steel Lid 5 Pack, for Use with Keurig Machine
review_body: I've tried a few \\"solutions\\" to the K-cup price dilemma, including cutting the top and most of the bottom of a K-cup and inserting it into the My-Kcup to slow down the water flow through the coffee grounds. Works OK, but messy to clean. Also tried Kaps, but gave up after a filled K-cup flew out of my hands while I was trying to push the Kap in. Coffee grounds flew everywhere! The K-Savers aluminum lids don't always snap on, despite my best efforts, but I haven't had any issues with leaking. I like strong coffee, so I've been grabbing used Extra Bold K-cups (largest capacity) from work and keeping the ones that I can easily remove all of the foil top. Makes for interesting conversations at the coffee station, but my goal is to get a good supply on hand. Since we have a big office model Keurig the punched hole at the bottom takes a little maneuvering to line up with my machine the first time, but it does line up. As long as you remove all of the foil and don't have any coffee grounds on the top lip the lid will compress when in use and prevent leaks.

product_title: Just the Cheese Mini Round Snacks, 0.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 16)
review_body: Got this product and just love it. Protein, good cheese taste and the right size for my gastric pouch. Low carb, crunchy. Ordering more. Thanks

product_title: York Pieces Resealable Pouch, 10.5-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: If you like mint chocolate, or York Peppermint Patties for that matter, then there's no reason you won't like the taste of these.  They're just like eating M&Ms but with minty freshness added to them.  4 stars because I think these candies are overpriced for what they are.

product_title: Grove Square Coffee, Dark Roast, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: The flavor was OK but I didn't like the way the cups leaked after taking them out of Keurig. I have never had this problem with other Keurig cups. Dripping on the counter and on the floor.

product_title: Carnation Breakfast Essentials, Classic Chocolate Malt Powder, 1.26 oz, 10-Count Envelopes (Pack of 6)
review_body: Yes just like other reviewers say, this chocolate malt flavor is great!  The texture of the powder is a bit smoother than it was years ago and I like the coarser texture it used to have. Still can't have everything. Since my local stores no longer carry the chocolate malt flavor, Amazon is doing  us all a real favor by stocking it! way to go!

product_title: Koppers Colorwheel Malted Milk Balls, White, 5-Pound Bag
review_body: I purchased this to go on my daughter's candy buffet at her wedding reception. The candy was very good.  Made for a very nice looking container of candy. I also purchased RAZZ ones as well.   Would definitely purchase again.

product_title: Gringo Bandito Hot Sauce
review_headline: Amazing hot sauce, you won't regret
review_body:
Like many people who have bought this sauce, I decided to pay the extra nickel to try the hot sauce created by none other than one of my favorite singers from one of my favorite bands growing up, The Offspring.And like many of those who have purchased online, this sauce isn't available in stores near us.

First off, I am a native of New Orleans. I'd like to think I know a thing or two about hot sauces. Tabasco, Crystal, and many other hot sauces that have had heart and soul put into them have made their way onto my plate. But man........Dexter hit the money on this one. This sauce is truly amazing, for lack of better words. You get a burst of flavor when you first bite into your dish covered in Bandito, then a nice after rush of spice hits the tongue for a great ending. I really haven't found a dish that it doesn't go good on.

I was skeptic at first, as I knew going in that I was only buying it because I was a fan of The Offspring. But I can tell you now, that this sauce is officially a household staple in my home. This is literally the best hot sauce i have EVER had. Try it!

product_title: BEER NUTS Original Peanuts, 7-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_body: at two bucks a can this was a rip off and I can't return them, the day before I received these in the mail I was at the 99 cent store and saw this item selling for a buck a piece. This rip off makes me feel like a chumps chimp :((

product_title: OrgraN Gluten-Free Molasses Licorice, 7-Ounce Package (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Fantastic real licorice flavor without the gluten...
review_body: Licorice was one of the things I especially missed after going gluten free nearly 12 years ago but, OrgraN Gluten Free Molasses Licorice has changed all that. A few gluten free licorice products are available but I found them to be too hard or lacked that yummy black licorice experience...not so for this product. These soft and chewy little nuggets are packed with the black licorice flavor explosion that is reminiscent of a treat I had as a child in the 60's. A shopping mall high end candy store carried a black licorice product that was shaped like a 2' smooth rope, it was heaven for a little kid who loved soft black licorice, and the taste of OrgraN's licorice reminds me of that prized mall treat so long ago. I can sink my teeth into the OrgraN Gluten Free Molasses Licorice yet not feel like I'm eating taffy. To me, the mothwatering licorice taste is also similar to the gluten laden Panada licorice product that I used to enjoy. Furthermore, I like that I can avail of Amazons Subscribe & Save program as it saves me piles of money over my local gourmet store price. My non restricted husband says this is his favorite licorice and we frequently swipe at each other due to my refusal to share...

product_title: Bigelow Flavored Tea
review_body: As other reviewers have said, this tea is not quite as strong as other black teas. While I do enjoy a very strong cup of tea much of the time, when I'm looking for a mellower black tea with a rich flavor, this Darjeeling is one of the first I turn to. This tea doesn't tend to get much of the bitter flavor that some teas will have when it has steeped a bit longer than it should, and it generally just tastes great. I highly recommend it.

product_title: Fisher Walnut Pieces, Small, Light, 30-Pound Package
review_headline: Nice small bits for cookies, muffins, pancakes or topping but poor packaging.
review_body: I had some problems with packaging and unlike the picture this product comes in one large box inside a blue food grade plastic bag. Mine was not twist tied or sealed in any fashion and the nut oils had penetrated through to the outside of the box. Aside from that issue the nuts themselves were of a perfect size for baking.They are nice light nut meats and are of a very good quality. The reason for the 4 stars instead of 5 is the fact that my case was not sealed properly and could have led to possible contamination as well as oxidation and rancidity issues.

product_title: Tabasco Chipotle Pepper, 5 Ounce
review_body: Never seen this version at the Local Super Markets. Both my wife and I think it's a great change of taste!

product_title: Dubble Bubble Gumballs, 20oz Carton
review_body: I think we've all experienced those gum balls that lose their flavor after about 10 seconds, then turn so hard that your jaw starts to get tired.  These are a step above that.  First of all, they are the smaller gum balls, which I didn't expect.  Second, they lose their flavor pretty quickly.  I would eat one, then pop another one in a few seconds later to try to elongate my chewing experience but after about 30 seconds, I had to spit it out.  They're not bad tasting, but I probably wouldn't order them again.

product_title: Bragg's Liquid Aminos, 6-Ounces (Pack of 6)
review_body: Bragg's gives the impression that it is somehow better than soy sauce but the sodium levels are about the same, as is the taste.  The only advantage is the spray bottle, which makes it easy to use less.

product_title: Lavazza Tierra! 100% Sustainable Ground Coffee, 8-Ounce Cans
review_headline: Gotta use it correctly for this fine grind!
review_body:
This is NOT a grind for a drip machine, but if you're lured by the low price, take a chance and mix a 25% to a drip grind and it will be fine. The problem with a fine drip will be clogged grounds and murky coffee, if used in an auto-drip machine. However this is terrific for a Chemex or Melitta. It is a lighter roast, fairly smooth without a lot of complexity. I bought 3....then bought 3 more that became happily received gifts. Personally I really like this coffee, and while NO coffee can please all people, the price makes it painless to try. Never disappointed with Lavazza's coffees.

UPDATE: So happy to see cans of this in a local specialty store! Happy Java Junkie here!

product_title: Harry Potter Bertie Bottes Every Flavour Jelly Beans
review_body: Exactly how I always pictured Bertie Bott's beans would be. I have the generation before these and they've been spot on since movie 1 (GOD, the HORSERADISH flavor was AWFUL. UGH.). The generation before these has a single flavor that literally made me retch. The fish flavored jelly beans are SO AWFUL that you will gag.     You will.     Trust me.    These, on the other hand, only have a few really awful ones. Avoid vomit if you can, because that's probably what you'll be doing next.     whoever makes these is awesome.

product_title: Yogi Sweet Thai Delight, Herbal Tea Supplement, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: I decided to purchase this tea after reading the review here at Amazon.  I am enjoying the tea.  It is a sweet mild tea, so for me, I do not need to add any additional sugar or sugar substitute.  So easy to brew, just remove tea bag from the cup and drink. Yummy.

product_title: Eight O'Clock Coffee, Decaffeinated Whole Bean, 12-Ounce Bag (Pack of 4)
review_body: If you are used to an organic water processed french roast decaf, don't try this coffee!!  I tried the Eight OClock Decaf beans based on good reviews here (and elsewhere admittedly) and was completely disappointed.  I felt that it lacked taste, body, aroma and that it had what I can only describe as a slightly bitter, metallic taste.  I drink my coffee black with no milk or sugar.  I guess coffee really is an individual thing!

product_title: Honey Stinger Organic Energy Chews, Fruit Smoothie, 1.8 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: These energy chews have a great flavor, will give you good energy before or during a workout, and are a reasonable price. I would recommend this to any endurance athlete such as a cyclist, runner, triathlete, etc. [[ASIN:B002ZF6Q38 Strength Training and Sports Nutrition for Cycling]]

product_title: KIND PLUS Gluten Free Bars
review_headline: The Best KIND Bar...NetRush Not The Best Seller Though
review_body:
We love these bars...they make a great snack for my preschool daughter who has multiple food allergies. No soy, hooray! I have been buying them for about a year and a half.
This box we got from NetRush, though, tastes \\"off\\" and \\"old\\"...perhaps they were not properly stored. I will not buy from this seller again, although Cranberry KIND bars will remain a staple in our pantry!

product_title: Amy's Organic Cream of Mushroom Soup, 14.1-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: Since i began doing everything organic specially with our food.  I was having a hard time looking for an alternative for campbells cream of mushroom.  So glad im able to find an alternative that is so much better and healthier for my family

product_title: GoPicnic Ready-to-Eat Meals, Steak Nuggets + Cheese, 3.-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Better than a McM's Happy Meal at about the same price.
review_body: Packed w/ a variety of very edible items (beef jerky chunks, crackers, pepper cheese spread, trail mix, and a chocolate candy). At about $3 to $4 a meal (when bought in the 6 pack), this is actually rather affordable compared to taking 20 min. and using your car (which has to cost about $1 in gas) to run to a fast food joint for lunch. While not a complete meal (in the sense of 3 meals a day), if you eat 4 to 5 times a day, its plenty enough to keep you going. Very handy and superior to most of the frozen lunch meals I've bought at regular supermarkets. Highly recommended.

product_title: Healthy Choice Soup Traditional Lentil, 14-Ounce Cups (Pack of 12)
review_body: I work nights and there often is not anything to eat. I keep one of these in my locker, you don't need a bowl or plate...you don't need a can opener. Easy open lid and a microwave cover so you don't have to clean your microwave if it bubbles! Tastes great.

product_title: Glass Carboy 23 Liter, 1.9-Pound Box
review_body: It did take a while for my two carboys to be delivered but they were packaged well and both arrived intact.   The quality was everything I had read from the other reviews and I look forward to using these for many years.

product_title: Emerald Harmony Dried Deluxe Mixed Fruit, Plums, Apples, Apricots, Peaches and Pears, 14-Ounce Tubs (Pack of 3)
review_headline: Dried? No .... moist and wet , Yes.
review_body: I bought this thinking it was dried. You know ... D R I E D. Dried.     It is not 'dried'. It is 'slightly dehydrated'.     The prunes are fine. Like Large raisens, they taste as you would expect. The rest is horrible, so bad you might think you got a spoiled shipment or something. The apple slices taste like chewing through wet apple flavored cloth. They tear like cloth too. Everything else tastes like your chewing on wet wallpaper that has been flavored with fruit : pear, apricot and so on.    AVOID.

product_title: Earth's Best Organic Fruit & Whole Grain Combo, Variety Pack, 4-Ounce Jars (Pack of 12)
review_body: We bought this recently and was disappointed because Earth's best in general is a good at giving variety in their bulk packs. The main point for us purchasing jarred foods is for variety. Yet, 9 out of the 12 jars in the pack has banana. I'm not sure how that can be considered a variety.  I would not buy this again. Mainly because bananas are cheap and easy to feed your toddler. Why would you want to be gouged for the mark up?    Also, I don't see how they can label them stage 2 when they have the consistency of stage 1 food.

product_title: Zoe Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 25.5-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
review_body: This is a good tasting light olive oil, unlike others that are very heavy it is great on salads or for cooking. Would buy again.

product_title: Minor’s Ham - No Added MSG - 16 oz
review_body: If you are making Portuguese Bean Soup, Hawaiian Style, this is the stuff you need. There is no substitution. Once opened it lasts a long time in the fridge.

product_title: Skittles Bubble Gum
review_body: This gum is great. Sadly hard to find. Wish they sold it everywhere again.. Maybe it will come back..Much better than some of the garbage gum out there..

product_title: Green Giant Whole Spear Asparagus, 15 oz, 12 Pack
review_body:
And although these do not taste as great as the fresh, they DO taste good -- and perhaps because they have been in liquid, in the can, they are softer and more of the stalk is edible (as contrasted with fresh-cooked, where the stalk usually gets tough once you get to the middle.)

My simple tastes require nothing more than mayo and lemon on these tasty bundles. I pour the liquid into a glass and add some lemon there too-- yum.

product_title: Grove Square Coffee, Light Roast, Single Serve Coffee Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 18-Count
review_body: This product had an awesome price, so I thought I'd try it out.  Got it in the mail in about the same amount of time as other k-cup products.  Instantly noticed it was much lighter package than the normal k-cups I usually order.  When I opened them up to put them in the holder I shook a few.  They felt and sounded like there was almost nothing in there and the grounds sounded really big.  But I figured I'd give it a shot.  Put one in the coffee pot and ran a cycle.  Halfway through the cycle the water coming out was totally clear.  The other ones I use will get lighter, but never clear.  The coffee looked and tasted okay...nothing special.      I decided to open up the k-cup and what I found is that there is no filter and no left over grounds.  The other k-cups I use I can usually run a second cup of weaker coffee...not with these.    I equate these with heating a cup of water in the microwave and then adding a scoop of instant coffee to the water.  I'm not a coffee snub and drink instant when I have to...so this isn't necessarily a bad thing but not what I wanted from a k-cup.  However, it is probably what I should have expected for $12 for 36 k-cups...

product_title: Maxwell House French Roast (Medium Dark) Ground Coffee, 33-Ounce Jugs (Pack of 2)
review_body: The packaging is great.    I keep coffee upside-down in the refrigerator. That is supposed to keep it fresher. Usually, when you open a container that was kept upside-down, the contents spill from the cover. Not with this container. I'm very impressed!    Of more importance, the coffee is delicious!

product_title: Nettle (Stinging Nettle) Herbal Tea - 1 Pound - Loose Bulk
review_body: first try of nettle loose leaf tea. tried it in tea bags but flavor was lacking. this tea is full flavor. try it with a little honey and you will me satisfied with the results.

product_title: Nutiva Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, 15 Ounce
review_body: I ordered this product and just got my box today 4/21/2011.  When I opened the box there was another box, so I opened the next box and there is cocunut oil all over the 2 jars, bubble wrap and all over the box!  I will never order this again, as today I received my box and they already close the return date!  There is a major problem here and I do not recommend anyone ordering this product.  I want my money back.

product_title: Big Turk (Turkish Delight) -10 Bars
review_body: I love Big Turk! Not only is it low in fat, but the combination of the gelatin with the chocolate is terrific. I especially love them frozen!

product_title: Zevia All Natural Soda, Ginger Root Beer, 12 Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: I like the fact that it uses stevia (how much of it vs. the other sugar alcohol sweetener though?? I think stevia is not toward the top of the list of ingredients) and I have used pure stevia extract before, and I can tell you they are not using very much of it. It basically tastes like a fountain drink where the syrup was running out. I would not pay regular soda prices for this product, let alone the higher retail prices at places like Whole Foods. It seems to me they are basically jumping on the stevia bandwagon and it has more to do with marketing than actually using it to make a good product.

product_title: Sweetleaf Stevia Extract Clear Liquid 120ml (1x4 OZ)
review_body: This stuff is not tasty. I used two drops in my 8 oz. coffee. Unpleasant flavor, weird lingering aftertaste. Perhaps just not for me, perhaps it's an acquired taste.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_headline: the more chocolate the better right. If so, you need a hot chocolate k-cup.
review_body: You would think that the more chocolate the better right. If you do, you need a hot chocolate k-cup and not a coffee. This is a perfect blend of a medium roast with a good chocolate and slight coconut flavor. Some of the other chocolate k-kups that I have tried have been chocolate overload.

product_title: Chef Erics Best Spicy Tamarind Ball Candy
review_headline: If you like sour and sweet then you are in for a TREAT!
review_body: These really are DELICIOUS! My favorite sweet of all time. Chef Eric's in a nice brand, it's popular in Jamaica among other places. Not everyone likes Tamarind but I love it. This sour, tangy fruit combined with some sugar is a great combination. Furthermore it's real fruit! But I won't pretend it's a health food; it's got plenty of sugar!   Still it doesn$27t taste too sweet and has a great flavor and texture.

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee Revv, 22-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2)
review_body: The coffee itself tastes great if you can actually get one to brew that doesn't explode the coffee grinds all over.  I should have listened to all the other reviews.  I gave up when about 70% of them make a complete mess instead of being able to enjoy a nice cup of coffee.  DON'T BUY!!!

product_title: Nestea Instant Decaf Unsweetened Tea, 3-Ounce Unit (Pack of 4)
review_body: I have no idea what is wrong with this tea but it has such a very strong bitter flavor that no matter what I do you can't get rid of the horrible bitter taste!    I drink iced tea all day long for years, never has this happened before, there is something seriously wrong with the first jar I opened. I havn't tried the other three jars yet and I'm not sure I will since the first was so awful.  I sent back the other case of four I ordered becasue this one was so bad.    I also had 4 other people try it and even my daughter who is a huge tea love of many kinds of teas said it was horrible and extremly biting bitter taste no matter what you added to it to make it less bitter!    I wonder now if that is why such the good deal on it, did  the company know it was a bad batch or what?  Perhaps I'll send off a note or call the company as I'm curious to know why this tea has the strong bitter taste it does.    I was so excited when I found this deal online so I bought two cases, now I'm very dissapointed and curious as to why it is so bad.

product_title: Eden Organic Quinoa, Whole Grain, 16-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6)
review_body: This quinoa is the best. You don't have to rinse it and it tastes great. I just made a jambalaya with quinoa instead of rice and it's delicious.

product_title: Doctor Kracker Culinary Crisps, Cherry Semolina, 6-Ounce Tubs (Pack of 6)
review_headline: They are a bit too thick to be considered crispy.
review_body: Just a few of them fills you up.  They are more like little bricks instead of crackers.  Crackers are light and crispy, these are dense and almost rock-hard.  Their taste was good.  The cherries offset the flavor and made them edible.  I couldn't imagine eating them without the added tartness/sweetness of the cherries which made them edible.  I really liked them thought, because eating them made me feel like I was doing my part to try to eat healthy.  If they were thinner and crunchy they would be a lot more palatable though...I almost felt afraid I was going to break a tooth, but we all have to take chances when it comes to eating healthy.  lol

product_title: Octavia Tea Pomegranate (Organic White Tea) Loose Leaf Tea, 1.63-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
review_body: I have a Breville tea maker (an expensive but worth the money Amazon purchase) and this is a soft, smooth tea. I love the fruity overtones and it holds up well with ice as the days get warmer.

product_title: GG Scandinavian Bran Crispbread, 3.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 5)
review_body: I bought a pack of these crackers at Whole Foods Market.  The cracker tastes awful by itself.  I honestly could not have ate a whole one dry.  I covered the remaining part of the cracker with a thin layer of peanut butter and it became tolerable.      I agree with the other posters that you need to drink water with these crackers after every bite because they're dry.  As advertised, they do help tame the appetite, so that's a plus. However, I'm not sure if it's the cracker alone, if it's the cracker in combination with all the water or if the terrible taste tricks the body out of hunger.      Because I already have a package, I'll continue to eat the remaining crackers with peanut butter as long as they haven't passed their expiration date.  But at this point, I don't think I'll buy another package (but stranger things could happen).

product_title: Twinings Prince of Wales Tea
review_body: I prefer Twinings. Loose leaf tea allows a better infusion than tea bag. The tins are a convenient size for the shelf over my sink.

product_title: Eight O'Clock Coffee, Hazelnut Ground, 11-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
review_body: I generally prefer to grind whole bean coffee but I decided to give this a try since it was on sale. I really like it. In fact I'm drinking a cup of it while writing this review. It has a definite yet subtle nutty flavor to it. Just the right amount of flavor. I would like to try the whole bean but I would certainly buy this again.

product_title: Earth's Best Organic 2nd Wholesome Breakfast, 4.5 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_headline: A nice step up from plain rice cereal
review_body: Our nine-month-old daughter is ready for a more substantial breakfast than plain cereals.  We want her to get the nutrients and vitamins she needs (especially iron), so plain fruit or vegetables aren't enough.  This blend of fruit and grains (and, in some cases, yogurt) provides everything she needs for a good breakfast and keeps her full for several hours.  Plus, the flavors are not overly sweet.  One note:  at least two of these flavors include yogurt.  Some babies younger than 1-year may have a reaction to yogurt and other dairy foods, so just watch out for that.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee, Midnight Magic, Extra Bold, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50)
review_body: The foil comes off the plastic too often and I have to filter it before being able to drink it.

product_title: Ova Easy Egg Crystals, 4.5 oz/Bag
review_body: I bought these egg crystals for my food storage pantry.  I haven't tried them yet...but all the reviews have been good, and I watched a local news reporter make and eat them and he seemed to think they tasted just like fresh eggs.  With the horrible taste of yesterday's egg powders, that's good enough for me.  A dozen eggs for 5 bucks is a little steep...but they keep for a very long time...and could be a high quality protein, life saver in an emergency.

product_title: Grove Square Coffee, Dark Roast, Single Serve Coffee Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 18-Count (Instant Coffee) (Pack of 2)
review_body: Please do not order this product.  It is a ripoff and Amazon should not still endorse it by selling it. I ended up throwing it out.

product_title: Betty Crocker Bisquick Baking Mix, Gluten Free Pancake and Waffle Mix, 16 Oz Box
review_body:
It was wonderful. We made chicken nuggets. It was light and coated the chicken very nicely.

I highly encourage you to purchase this. Taste pretty much like regular bisquick. Has many uses flour, gravy, pancakes....excellent way to stretch your dollar.

product_title: Sunland Raw Valencia Peanuts In-Shell, 32-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I originally purchased a case of these raw valencia peanuts in the shell to feed the army of squirrels in my neighborhood. The squirrels didn't seem to like them but it didn't take long until a squadron of crows took residence in my neighbors tree. The crows swoop down in formation then line up and each crow swipes a peanut then flies back to my neighbors yard. The crows eat a 2 pound bag every day so I guess crows really love these peanuts. I hope my neighbor doesn't plan on spending to much time under his tree this summer without an umbrella ^^

product_title: Amazing Grass Green Superfood
review_body:
Energy booster
I have this ready when I feel low on energy and I forget to eat breakfast.I usually like freshly prepared food but this is good to carry with you

product_title: Gertie's Finest ® Pickled Green Asparagus 1 case contains 6-34.5 oz jars
review_body:
I've always liked asparagus, ever since my grandparents in North Dakota had a good sized asparagus patch and we'd harvest it as kids. I like it cooked, in salads or in dishes like soup. It's just an excellent vegetable. Strangely enough, my wife won't eat it. Well that's OK. Last night I went shopping on my own at the local Costco store and found, quite by accident, a display of Gerties Finest Pickled Asparagus. Mmmmm. It was a two-pack of 34.5 ounce jars. and you could see all the pickling spices on the bottom. How could I possibly resist? When I opened it the air was filled with a wonderful spicy aroma of asparagus. And believe me, it tasted even better than it smelled. The spears were crunchy and not overcooked and the mix of spices was just sensational. Well, I've now got a lot of pickled asparagus and my wife won't eat any, but these two jars aren't going to last long.

Gary Peterson

product_title: Great Northern Popcorn, Portion Packs (Pack of 24)
review_body: We use these popcorn packs for our party rental business. We can keep enough in stock. They are easy for our customers to use and taste great!

product_title: Thomas Bagel Thins Plain - 8 Thin Bagels - 13 oz (Pack of 2)
review_body: My kids are in love with BagelThins!  After seeing a commercial, my 10 year olds son begged for me to buy these.  They are the perfect size for breakfast or a snack, and they do not get stuck in the toaster like other thicker bagels.  Perfect with cream cheese!

product_title: Niveau™ Smart Energy
review_body: You will not be disappointed w/the refreshing clean taste of this drink. It's a burst of lemon flavor in your mouth that gives you energy for hours. I promise, you will love it!!! Shipping was fast. Nicely packaged..no damages. Love the sleek frosted bottle. Clever idea.

product_title: Larabar Gluten Free Bar
review_body: You better like the taste of dates as that's all you taste with these bars.  No way this should be called apple pie.

product_title: Galil Tea, Fennel, 20-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: you get what you pay for
review_body: I can not recommend this tea. We usually drink pompadour/teekanne fennel tea but that has become more difficult to find so when we found this tea at a very low price we had to try it. What a waste of money. The tea was so bad that we threw away 118 of the 120 tea bags.

product_title: Member's Mark Premium Chunk Chicken Breast 13 Oz. Can
review_body: This is the Sam's Club house brand, available from any Sam's Club for $2 a can (5 cans for about $10 really). Who on earth would buy Sam's Club housed brand canned chicken through Amazon? At $8 a can? Ouch.    Vendor is obviously a scammer taking advantage of Amazon Marketplace.

product_title: Grove Square Coffee, Dark Roast, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: this is not a k cup at all- just shake it up- it is instant coffee in a k cup package.  more than half comes out as water!!! beware- not k cups at all - theyre horrible

product_title: Organic Valley Organic Single Serve Milk, 8 Ounce Aseptic Cartons
review_body: Love this milk for my daughter's lunch. Also great to keep at my bedside while I was pregnant for a middle-of-the-night snack because no refrigeration is needed.

product_title: Tempo Meat Loaf Mix, 12-Count Box of 2.75-Ounce Packets
review_body: I love this mix! After moving south, I cannot find it locally.  It is very easy to mix in, and even a little cheaper than the soup mix.  Will definitely order again!

product_title: DisposaCups - Disposable Cups for use in Keurig® Brewers - 50 Cups, Lids, Filters - 100% Disposable
review_body: This is a great product and would highly recommend to all Keurig fans. You can make your own k cups at a fraction of the cost.

product_title: Wolfgang Puck Coffee K-Cups for Keurig Brewers
review_body:
First, let me say that I prefer extra-bold K-Cup coffees and only occasionally drink a medium blend, and never decaf. I bought three Wolfgang Puck coffees several months ago: Rodeo Drive Blend; French Roast; and Sumatra Kopi Raya. All three are quite drinkable, though they do not measure up to a few of the extra-bold blends from Coffee People: Kona Blend; Organic Blend; Jet Fuel; and Black Tiger. Even better than these, though, is my new favorite, [[ASIN:B003M7TTYG Green Mountain's Revv]]. Those who prefer a strong, dark cup of coffee (even at the larger mug setting) should try that brand.

Previously, I had found the dark-roast Green Mountain coffees rather boring, but Revv lives up to the hype, both in strength and flavor. Another great Green Mountain coffee is their Espresso Blend (though Amazon doesn't stock it, so the prices tend to be higher here than in brick-and-mortar stores such as Bed Bath and Beyond). Finally, a favorite regular over the years has been [[ASIN:B004M5W7YQ Emeril's Big Easy Bold]]. It's a very nice coffee, though don't expect the New Orleans experience of chicory flavor.

Bottom line: You won't go wrong with the Wolfgang Puck coffees, but for my taste they do not stand out among the available bold coffees.

product_title: Manischewitz Dark Chocolate Covered Matzo Mint Cracker, 6-Ounce (Pack of 3)
review_headline: food items are not returnable- be careful what you order
review_body: These matzo crackers were in poor shape when they arrived.  The dark chocolate had a white covering which generally means it got too hot or too cold.  I did try one of the crackers- stale, stale, stale.    So, now I have three boxes (minus one cracker) of inedible crackers sitting on my counter because I can't bring myself to throw away $17.77 worth of my wasted money.    They are not returnable per the website; I was going to try to return them but no luck.     As for this review, it did get one star because the system won't take the message without at least one star.

product_title: Krusteaz Multi-Grain Premium Muffin Mix, 5-Pounds
review_body: This is an 'add water' muffin mix.  It makes approximately 4 dozen standard sized muffins [not the giant type in a supermarket, not the tiny minis]    If I add something sweet to it [fruit, chips etc] my kids will accept it without a qualm.  It mixes up instantly and I will likely save it for days like today when I just didn't have time to bake anything from scratch like I normally would, but also didn't have anything to serve my non-cereal eaters for breakfast.    I would NOT buy this at the normal price however - which works out to about a quarter a muffin - I purchased it at less than half that amount

product_title: International Delight French Vanilla, 192 Count Single-Serve Coffee Creamers
review_body: Mine showed up fine with no damage. Not packed well, so I could see how these could show up squashed or leaking, but mine were fine. Saved money by using the subscription discount off of Amazon.

product_title: Nutiva Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, 15 Ounce
review_headline: tastes great and great for higher heat cooking
review_body: I love the taste of this oil. My wife hates the ways coconut smells and tastes, but when I cook with this she doesn't notice the coconut at all. It is too subtle for anything that is well seasoned. Also, this works much better with the high heat cooking I like to do when searing a meat or fish than any other oil I've used.

product_title: Envirokidz Organic Gluten-Free Crispy Rice Bars
review_body: I buy cases of these for my celiac son.  He loves them.  If you like PB and chocolate, these are for you.  They are soft and chewy, so they get smashed a bit in his backpack, but he doesn't care.

product_title: Special K Bars, Chocolatey Pretzel, 6-Count Bars Net Wt 4.6 Oz  (Pack of 6)
review_body: this was stale....must hae been in warehouse too long.  they are dry and crumble!!!!!  Amazon should make sure of freshness of product they sell.

product_title: Grove Square Coffee, Dark Roast, Single Serve Coffee Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 12-Count(Instant Coffee)
review_body: I was running low on my regular K cups and this stuff was on sale, so I decided to give it a try.  It was really terrible.  I put milk and torani's syrup in my coffee and even with all this in it, it still was hard to drink.  Will not be buying again.

product_title: Larabar Gluten Free Bar
review_body: I have really enjoyed the Cherry Bar by Larabar. There is NO added sugar at all - just dried fruit and almonds. I highly recommend it and plan on buying some more.

product_title: Barrys Gold Loose Tea 250g
review_body: As someone accustomed to Lipton and other crappy black teas, I'm giving this 5 stars. The flavor is subtle, and not at all bitter. The preparation was easier than I anticipated: I didn't need to filter out the leaves, as they managed to stay in the bottom of my cup. Anyone who thinks black tea is bitter and disgusting should try this. They'll be pleasantly surprised.

product_title: Stargazer Lily Value Bag
review_body: These were of awesome quality and great size compared to other bulbs I have purchased...already off to a good start when they arrived.  They are taking off in my garden and I can't wait to see their blooms.

product_title: Niveau™ Smart Energy
review_body: This stuff is great! So much cleaner and crisper tasting than Redbull/Monster/etc and all those other energy drinks out there. Plus it's all natural and how cool is that bottle?!

product_title: Knorr Vegetarian Vegetable Bouillon 6 Extra Large Cubes, 2.1 Oz
review_body: I prefer this veggie bouillon to any I have tried, very flavorful, but I do like my food on the salty side tho (fyi: 1/2 of a cube has 35% of your daily sodium! and does contain MSG).  It makes a very satisfactory gravy.  The price is reasonable, even when you add the shipping, for the taste value, but when I was able to find it locally it was about 2$ for a box of 6 cubes.

product_title: Lipton Tea Bags
review_body: For just a cup of good decaffinated tea, hard to beat.  Not a fancy \\"designer\\" tea, but if you drink substantial quantities, especially for its general health properties, then this is my gold standard.  Used to buy quantities at Sams and Costco, but neither has carried it for a while, and my wife and I didn't wish to buy small quantities at full retail from grocery stores, so Amazon saves the day again.

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee 10% Kona Blend (Extra Bold), K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: Great coffee!  The aroma is enticing, the flavor is bold, all in all, a great coffee experience!  Will make this a regular part of my day!

product_title: Stretch Island All Natural Fruit Strips, Cherry, 8-Count Strips (Pack of 6)
review_headline: My kids can't stop eating these!!!
review_body: My kids LOVE these!!!!  If I let them, they would eat 5 a day.  We have ordered these from Amazon probably over 20 times and have never had a bad batch.

product_title: Splenda Minis Dissolvable Tablets
review_body: THis is a great product for my husband's tea.  He loves the convenience of it.  Received it as promised.  Good service.

product_title: Sam Mills Pasta Rigatoni Gluten Free, 16 oz
review_body: This pasta is so good, you can barely notice that it's gluten free! Switching over to gluten-free is tough, especially when you learn that you cannot have your favorite pasta anymore. Yet, this pasta really takes the cake (gluten free, that is!)    Ordering from this company was a quick, easy, and pleasant experience. Product arrived quickly and very fresh!

product_title: Diet Coca Cola, 20-Ounce Containers (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Friday Coke Sale is not a Deal
review_body: I say you can never go wrong with Diet Coke.  Admittedly, I'm an addict.  But this Friday sale of 24 ea. 20 oz bottles for $24.00 is not a deal by any means.  Even at regular price, the local grocery store sells 24 oz. bottles for less than a dollar a piece.

product_title: Taylors of Harrogate Assorted Tea
review_body: I absolutely love this rose petal tea! It's delicious and I like that it comes in a pack of two !

product_title: KIND Fruit & Nut, All Natural / Non GMO, Gluten Free Bars
review_body: They are what they say they are, nutritious and tasty.  They are on the sweet side, which I like, and they you can taste the coconut, honey and almonds.  I like the crunch and again, this is cheaper for me to buy here then seperately at the three different stores I buy my gluten/dairy free foods.

product_title: Sesame Honey Crunch, 16 Oz.
review_body: I really do enjoy these Sesame Honey Crunch.  They're hard like peanut brittle, but easy to bit into.  Because they're small, and wrapped very very well, I sometimes think I'm expending all of the calories just getting the candy out of the wrap.  But they taste great and they're really good at satisfying my craving for something sweet without my going overboard ... at least not too far overboard!

product_title: Tully's Coffee, K-Cup packs
review_body: I buy this and a Kona blend for my brewer. I have tried many other brands and flavors but I always come back to this one. I \\"drown\\" my coffee with flavored coffeemates but still get a coffee taste from this one.

product_title: Fiber One, 16.2 Ounce Box
review_body: I love it.. No sugar.. That's a huge plus and also Tastes kinda like graham crackers I think.. I eat them with sugar free almond milk.. num

product_title: Tully's Coffee Decaffeinated House Blend, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: I don't like strong coffee so this wasn't my favorite.  If you like a bold coffee, you will like this one. My son likes it & recommended it to me.  I sent them to him.

product_title: SodaStream Sparkling Natural Sodamix - Cola
review_headline: Tastes like a fruitier version of Coke
review_body: I've tried all of Sodastream's regular sodamix flavors, and they're made with artificial sweeteners so I don't think they taste very good.     This flavor (natural cola) is quite good. It doesn't have any artificial sweetener taste, and it has a nice cola flavor. Now, it definitely doesn't taste like Coke or Pepsi. I'd describe it as a fruitier Coke, provided that you use slightly less than the recommended portion to make the drink. And I think that's something worth mentioning: you can vary the level of sweetness by slightly altering how much of the mix you pour in to the bottle of carbonated water.     I was pleasantly surprised by this flavor, I would definitely buy it again.

product_title: Hawaii Roasters 100% Jamaica Blue Mountain Coffee, Whole Bean, 14-Ounce Bag
review_body: My colleagues and I were anxiously awaiting the arrival of this coffee. We are \\"Coffee People\\" and all of us have wondered how good Jamaican Blue Mountain coffee would be. None of us have tried it because it is cost prohibitive.   The coffee received was stale and bitter. We were expecting to pay a premium for this coffee, however, we were not expecting the Sanka style flavor. Because we were not able to return of exchange this coffee, we were essentially ripped off. Enjoy the forty dollars Hawaii Roasters, it is the last you will receive from any of us.

product_title: Wabash Valley Farms Amish Country Gourmet Purple Popping Corn
review_body: What more can you ask for? This popcorn has great taste and nearly 100% of it pops. I use a Stir Crazy popper, plain old Crisco oil and a variety of seasonings.     We go through a LOT of popcorn and this is one that we'll be ordering again.

product_title: Frontier Chili Peppers Ground, Cayenne 90,000 Hu, 16 Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)
review_body: After reading about the benefits of chili peppers I decided to give it a try. So, I did what most people do, I did a search and I came across this company and this product. I couldn't pass up the price, It comes in 2 big bags, but even more impressive than the price was the delivery. I got home a few days after my order and to my surprise I had received my package. It was extremely fast delivery - that is always a plus.    The pepper itself, I never leave reviews, but I couldn't pass up the opportunity, this stuff is HOT, I have had other chili pepper, but this stuff packs a serious punch. If you are looking for a little zest and looking to add this to your diet, meals, or life, don't pass this up because I love hot stuff and even this is passing up my expectations.     In fact, I just had some veggies with this on it. The other night I was eating and put a good amount on my soup. I started to sweat. So, I have to say if you are going back and forth on this, you should go ahead and order, you won't be disappointed, I know I'm not.    Hope this helps.

product_title: Paula Deen 12-oz. Peanut Butter BBQ Sauce.
review_body: This is an interesting BBQ sauce, though not close to a Thai peanut sauce. It is rather thin as well but it otherwise cooks well on chicken if you layer it on as you grill. The shipping was rather high considering the size.
