review_body: There is simply nothing better than settling down with a plate of fresh whole rabbit, a glass of Tuscan whole milk, and a big bowl of uranium ore. Thank you, Le Village.

product_title: Frontier Natural Products Cayenne Ground 90000 Heat Units -- 16 oz
review_body: much better than the stuff you get from the grocery store and so much cheaper...i'll be buying more when i run out...i use it on food and i put it in gel caps to take as a supplement...

product_title: SodaStream Sodamix Syrup 16.9 Ounce
review_body: It's so much fun to make my own soda with as much fizz and syrup I prefer!  Hope it might bring others as much joy.

product_title: Chan Pui Mui Preserved Plum
review_body: These little plums are hard to find where I live! Please get more varieties...no seed  and sweet and salty.  I have had to   Order from Hawaii! Freight kills! These are pretty good!

product_title: Nabob 100% Colombian Coffee, 14-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers (Pack of 2)
review_body: I bought this coffee based on the 17 almost perfect reviews. No for me, I find starbucks blends a bit to strong but this water with some coffee flavor to it.  In essence, only for those who like watery coffee.  One more thing, have tried 5 disks so far, three were not recognized by the machine and I will be contacting amazon for a refund.

product_title: Health Valley Corn Crunch-Ems Cereal, 15.6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 14)
review_body: I used to get this cereal for my dad at our neighborhood supermarket and although it was pricey, he really loved it so it was worth it.  I never thought to look on Amazon for cereal until our supermarket no longer carried it.  Much to my delight, I found it on Amazon, ordered it and the best part is that the price was unbelievable and it qualified for free shipping.    This cereal is delicious!  It tastes great and is made with natural ingredients.  My dad loves it and since he has recently been placed on a restrictive diet, it's awesome to find a cereal that is good for him AND delicious!!  I eat it as well and sometimes find myself snacking on it even without any milk.    Corn Crunch-Ems is highly recommended.

product_title: Earth's Best Newborn Gift Pack
review_headline: Okay value but misnomer for the name - not for newborns
review_body:
I received this as a shower gift, having recently had a newborn. While he was 8.5 pounds at birth, the size 1 diapers included we weren't able to use until he was almost 6 weeks old (their diapers are pretty generously sized). The wipes we could use immediately, and I do like them, although I prefer the 7th Generation wipes. We have not used the formula, but have kept it on hand in case we needed it for emergencies (part of our emergency prep stash now). At the earliest, the cereal can't be used until 4 or 6 months (depending on your physician's recommendation) - so it just has to sit around and wait. I thought that was the most useless part of the pack, as I have not yet been able to give it to my baby.

The body wash/shampoo also comes in handy. Here are the ingredients:
Aqua (Purified Water) Aloe Barbadensis (Aloe Vera) Leaf Gel* Disodium Cocoamphodiacetate Di-Steareth-75 IPDI Coco-Betaine Vegetable Glycerin Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Oil Beta-Glucan Tocopheryl Acetate (Vit. E) Anthemus Nobilis (Chamomile) Flower Extract* Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Extract* Calendula Officinalis (Marigold) Flower Extract* Panthenol (Vit.B5) Lavandula Angustifolia (Lavender) Oil Citric Acid Benzyl Alcohol Potassium Sorbate Sodium Benzoate. *certified organic

It has a nice lavender smell and has not irritated our baby's skin. However, he doesn't seem to have sensitive skin, so keep that under consideration. I like the way the Burt's Bees baby shampoo/body wash smells better and will continue to use that once the Earth's Best is gone.

The value, as compared to what you can purchase at Target or Babies R Us is good - but if you join Club Mom at Amazon, the prices are much better for diapers and wipes. Since the only portion of the pack that I'll continue to use are the diapers, I'm giving it 3 stars.

product_title: MOCAFE Madagascar Vanilla Smoothie Mix, 3-Pound Tin
review_body:
I'm new to making smoothies with a blender at home, so I like any products that make this easier. The MOCAFE Madagascar Vanilla Smoothie Mix is a sweet powder that will give your smoothies a nice, thick, rich body. We have tried it with ice cream-based shakes and fruit and yogurt-based smoothies and it works great for all of these. The main ingredients are fructose (a type of plant sugar), nonfat powdered milk, and vanilla. There are some simple recipes on the side of the can to help you get started. This stuff is yummy! Probably because it is not low-calorie.

It comes in a generous 3-pound tin. We quit making smoothies for a while because the weather was cold. But now that the weather is warming up, we are back to making them again. When I openned the partially used tin, I was pleased to see that the powder stored well. It did not cake up, (like so many products do when weather is humid), and it still tastes just as good and freash as did when first openned a couple of months ago.

product_title: Halls Breezers Drops, 25 Count (Pack of 12)
review_body: Halls Sugar Free Cough Drops are a real hit for so many people who have coughs from bad sinuses.  Great flavor and the price is good.

product_title: Da Vinci Sugar Free Syrup with Splenda 750ml
review_body: I had high hopes for this because Dr. Bernstein of diabetes fame recommends it. I think the taste is so-so at best. I wish they'd try making it with Stevia.

product_title: Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce Huy Fong 17 Oz.
review_body: This isn't my only \\"favorite\\" hot sauce (sadly, I have about 15 I call \\"favorite\\") but it is the most versatile.  It goes well, as others have mentioned, on sushi, but it has a bit of a garlicy note, so feel free to try it on pasta (in my house we call it \\"pizza sauce\\" but we just add it to the top, not in lieu of tomato sauce), pizza, sandwiches, in soups (especially tomato!), added to salsa (or just plain on chips)...the list goes on.  I like this over the other famous US hot sauce (T*bas*o)because Sriracha isn't as vinegary so it doesn't over power flavors as easily.  Great stuff!  Give it a try.

product_title: David Jumbo Roasted Salted Sunflower Seeds, Buffalo Ranch Flavor, 5.25oz Bags (Pack of 10)
review_body: These are good sized seeds, and they taste good, not over roasted.  I know this as I rinse them before I eat them.  The flavor is a little strong for me, which if you knew me would not surprise you.  I'm not the biggest fan on spices that add heat.  If you like Buffalo Wings, I'm sure you'll love these.  It was the \\"ranch\\" part of the flavor that caught my eye.

product_title: Keurig, Celestial Seasonings, K-Cup packs
review_body: I know that taste is very subjective, but I'm a big tea drinker, and also love the lemonade/iced tea combination.  This product tastes terrible to me.   It's acidic without the tartness that I enjoy in lemonade, and the tea just tastes \\"off\\" to me.  I won't buy it again.

product_title: Ancient Harvest Organic Quinoa Pasta
review_headline: BEST GF PASTA I'VE EVER HAD
review_body: This pasta is awesome. Good quality and very close to the real thing. I've made mac & cheese, tuna pasta, and pasta salad with it and all have come out great. I've never had a problem with it cooking before. The water gets cloudy but that's about it. I find it easier to add a lot of water and a splash of oil to when boiling, just like regular pasta.     I never write reviews but I just had to on this one. Yum Yum :)

product_title: Black Russian Bread (Pumpernickel) (A Single Pack)
review_body: Bought this bread for inaugural use of our bread maker. The bread was orgasmic but it had better be for the price. I could have bought 5 loaves of bread for the cost of purchasing this.

product_title: SodaStream SodaMix
review_body: I specifically bought my Soda Stream in the hopes that I could make my own tonic water. I don't drink much soda pop, but do enjoy a gin and tonic. Tonic at the store is surprisingly expensive, and I always realize I'm out at the least convenient times (often while pouring the gin). I have long wished I could make my own tonic, but quinine isn't easy to get a hold of...    When I saw the Soda Stream product initially, I thought, \\"that would be nice for making tonic water,\\" but the thought was followed by the concern that if they had tonic, it would be inauthentic (quinine might not be tasty, but it's past of the tonic. You can't make a proper gin & tonic with sparkling water!)     So, once I was able to confirm 1) that tonic was an option from Soda Stream, and 2) it contained quinine, I was pretty excited and bought the Soda Stream at my local store. I immediately ordered the tonic mixer from Amazon (since the samples included with the machine didn't include tonic).    I admit it, I was worried about the quinine and spend any time thinking about the other ingredients.    When it arrived, I set to work drinking g&ts. ;-) Unfortunately, after making several batches of tonic, I gave up. All attempts resulted in passable tonic water, but they all had a strange, sweet tinge (which, rereading the ingredients,I assume is caused by  Splenda). I found the flavor distracting, and threw out the rest of the mix (And returned the machine.)    The Soda Stream system is easy to use, and I didn't have any trouble whipping up batches of tonic (or soda) but I just couldn't embrace the sweetness that came through, even when I decreased the amount of concentrate added to the water. If you are used to the taste of Splenda, it may not bother you but I don't like it. If they expand their selections someday, so Splenda-less versions are available, I may give them another try.

product_title: Conte's Gluten Free Potato/cheese/onion Pierogi, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)
review_body: After going gluten free, I so missed pierogi. Conte's does a great job with this GF version. Boil for a while, then switch the pierogi to a pan with onion, butter and pepper and fry it up for a while. I personally find boiling them longer to make them very soft, and them crisping them up in the frying pan. Delicious. Almost as good as the real thing!

product_title: Justin's Nut Butter Natural Chocolate Hazelnut Blend, 16 Ounce plastic jars (Pack of 3)
review_body: After browsing thru nut butters on Amazon, (and reading all the rave reviews) I decided to sign up for Justin's Chocolate Hazelnut subscribe and save.  Glad I did -- this stuff is good!  I don't like really sweet anything, tho I do use Nutella occasionally on whole wheat toast.  You can't even compare the two.  This is for grown-up taste,  great with a bananna or fresh strawberries, wonderful with pound cake, crackers, toast, the list goes on and on.    After receiving my first subscription order I found this at a local farmer's market with a price tag of $10.49 per jar!

product_title: Yogi Teas Green Tea
review_body: I first tried this as a gift from a co-worker. I like that it's all natural and that it's actually \\"leaves\\" and not the powder they sell in the supermarkets. I loved this tea. Had it without any sweetener and it's just great. It's mild flavored and you can leave the bag in the whole time for a stronger flavor.  The cost is excellent for a case of 6. I can't buy this in this grocery I usually shop at, so it is a plus to have it available at Amazon. The auto-ship is a good deal if you know how much you'll be drinking.  I \\"think\\" it gives me energy. Don't know if it's my imagination or not, but I do feel good after having a couple of cups. I will continue to drink this and probably try the other flavors they have. If you go to the Yogi site you can get more details on each kind and then get a cheaper deal at Amazon.

product_title: Nature Valley Crunchy Granola Bars, Peanut Butter, 12-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I tried these based on other reviews and am glad I did. However, I am a little disappointed in that the peanut butter flavor isn't stronger. But otherwise, they taste great and are a great alternative to snacks at work or on the road. I like these a lot but would love them if the flavor were stronger.

product_title: MIO Liquid Peach Tea, 1.62-Ounce, (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Handy and tasty way to UP your water intake.
review_body: MiO is a great little way to really up how much water I drink each day. I completely stopped sodas, because the mio, with ice cold water is far better. The peach tea for me is a 'sustainable' flavor. I drink it on a daily basis. The others are more 'in the mood' flavors for me. I really enjoy the blueberry pomegranate one as well. I went from drinking nearly no water to drinking 64+oz every day. I only add 1 squeeze to a 32oz bottle of water, as I like it mildly flavored. Lasts for a good week or more (3.99 for a weeks worth of flavored water, yay!)  The sweet ice tea flavor is one that you'll need double dosing of, as it tastes off when there's not a lot of it.    And oh yeah. Chemicals, chmemicals. If you go from drinking SODA to the mio with water, you're still doing yourself a favor.

product_title: Bakers Harvest Animal Crackers, 1-Ounce Packages (Pack of 100)
review_body: Very iffy at first ordering food online after some reviews I had read about being out of date (NOT THROUGH THIS COMPANY JUST INGENERAL), but came and very pleased about this product! I used them for my sons circus/carnival theme birthday party and were very cute and a great addition for the price (TASTE GREAT TOO)! 4 stars instead of 5 only because of the package upon arrival.[...] , and well it is food so you have to be extremely careful with that. I chose very fast shipping so it wasnt a huge issue I would be more concerned with delayed shipping. All together the product was excellent!

product_title: Ginger Chews, Original, 3 oz.
review_body: I received a package of these in my Christmas stocking. I like Ginger a lot, but had not had anything like this before. In spite of a little hotness, they are absolutely delicious. So much concentrated flavor. If you don't like strong Ginger, you might not enjoy them quite as much. They don't bite so much if you just hold them in your mouth, but I have a hard time doing that, because I want to chew down on it and get that powerful deliciousness in my mouth. I haven't seen them in the stores here yet, but hopefully soon. Another plus is they do help with mild indigestion. Also, the hard candy Gin Gins, made by the same company,  are really good and work as well as a cough drop should you need one.

product_title: Coffee Bean Direct Dark Coffee, 5 Pound
review_body: As always, fast delivery from Amazon.  This is a very good tasting decaf coffee.  Dark and rich in looks and flavor.  This bean provides a rather strong tasting cup of coffee which was just what I was looking for.  No aftertaste which is so common with many decaf coffees.

product_title: Klein's Naturals Pine Nuts, Raw Shelled, 4-Ounce Tubs (Pack of 6)
review_body:
Fabulous on salads, Fabulous on humus, Fabulous on lots of things I eat on a regular basis.
It's amazing how these plain, simple pine nuts make a bland salad turn into a standout salad.
I wouldn't consider being without this product in my kitchen.

product_title: Stash Tea Fusion Green & White Tea, 100 Count Box of Tea Bags in Foil
review_body: I LOVE Stash tea! My favorite is the fusion green and white tea though. I bought the box of tea cause it was a GREAT price for such a large quantity. I'm very happy with the purchase, and recommend trying Stash tea to anyone. I also LOVE doing business with Amazon cause they always have great low prices. I recommend Amazon.com to all as well.

product_title: Metromint Water, 16.9-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Finally!!  I'm so glad to finally see this product on Amazon!!
review_body: I'm so glad to finally see that Amazon is selling and fulfilling this product themselves.  I've been buying this at Albertsons lately and getting it 2 for $3.00 which is roughly about the same price on Amazon but of course now I won't have to pay the sales tax and I get it shipped to me via UPS 2nd Day Air for FREE since I'm an Amazon Prime member. product_title: Kellogg's Crunchy Nut Golden Honey Nut Cereal 14.1 oz
review_body:
Supposedly, Crunchy Nut has been available in England for quite some time and Kellogg's finally decided to bring it over to US shores. Kellogg's used to make \\"Nut & Honey Crunch\\", though it was discontinued a while ago. Like Crunchy Nut, they came in both flakes and \\"Os\\" versions. I have fond memories of eating Nut & Honey Crunch in the 80s, and missed it when it was discontinued. Remember the \\"Nothin' Honey\\" commercials? ;)

Well, if you want to relive those days, give Crunchy Nut a try. To the best of my taste buds' recollection, the crunch and flavor are nearly identical. There is the sweet tang of the honey coating and satisfying texture of the peanut-sprinkled corn flakes. The flavor is comparable to frosted flakes, but with honey and nut flavors. It holds up well in milk, retaining it's crunch down to the last bite. Comparing ingredients and nutritional information from their respective boxes shows that they match up pretty closely there as well, though the serving size for N&H is 2/3 cup and for CN it is 3/4 cup. If anything, ounce for ounce, Crunchy Nut Golden Honey Nut Flakes looks a little healthier for you than Nut & Honey Crunch.

That's not to say it truly healthy though. Sure, it is fortified with the usual assortment of vitamins and when eaten with milk you fill even more of your daily nutritional requirements. However, it is still laden with sugar, molasses, honey and High Fructose Corn Syrup. My taste buds must have changed a bit since the 80s because it is almost too sweet for me. Blame it on a steady diet of low sugar cereals over recent years. I would have a hard time eating this regularly first thing in the morning. Instead, I mimic a habit of my father's and eat a small bowl of it in place of dessert. You could even mix it with other cereals that contain less sugar (as my dad would do).

Don't get me wrong, Crunch Nut tastes great on it's own, and if you have a sugar/crunch craving, it hits the spot. It even makes a good breading base for fried chicken. I just no longer have quite the sweet tooth I once did. I give Crunchy Nut Golden Honey Nut Flakes fives stars for flavor, mouth-feel and craving satisfaction. One star comes off for health impact though. If you decide to give it a try, I would shop around a little. Current 3rd party vendor prices are ludicrous. A much better deal can probably be found at your local grocer.or fried chicken. I just no longer have quite the sweet tooth I once did. product_title: Sun Crystals All-Natural Sweetener, 100-Count Packets (Pack of 4)
review_body:
Sun Crystals are a combination of just two ingredients, real cane sugar (sucrose), and an artificial sweetener made from leaves of the Stevia plant. The exact ratio is apparently a trade secret. As Sun Crystals contains some real sugar, not surprisingly it has a taste very similar to sugar, but with a faintly bitter aftertaste. The product manufactured by McNeil Nutritionals, looks similar to normal granulated sugar crystals.

There are several notable statements on the packaging. These include \\"Twice as sweet so you only need half as much\\", and \\"naturally ½ the calories of sugar\\". The first statement is subjective, and perhaps not true. The second statement which should be scientifically verifiable appears not to be true, as a teaspoon of Sun Crystals has 20 calories, while regular sugar has 15 calories.

A plus is that Sun Crystals can be used as a replacement for sugar in cooking and baking. According to the manufacturer, the basic conversion formula between Sun Crystals and regular sugar is 1 to 2. This means that one cup of Sun Crystals, is approximately equivalent to two cups of sugar. Lowering sugar consumption and calorie intake is generally beneficial, particularly for diabetics, and following this ratio, both sugar consumption and calorie intake would both be reduced. This assumes that the taste is close to the same.

The bottom line is that it all comes down to taste, which is a very individual thing. When it comes to sugar substitutes, most people have tastes they prefer, whether it be saccharin (Sweet'n Low), aspartame (Equal), stevia (Sun Crystals), sucralose (Splenda), or acesulfame potassium (Sweet One). That being the case, if you have gotten used to your favorite sweetener, you may not find the taste of Sun Crystals to your liking. A solution may be palatable, is to mix Sun Crystals with your favorite sweetener, in a combination that does tastes good.

I prefer aspartame, and the taste of Sun Crystals alone, doesn't quite do it for me. Instead of using a smaller amount, I use more Sun Crystals, trying to match the sweetness that I get with aspartame. Like most people, I'm not interested in increasing my sugar intake, so I have tried mixing aspartame and Sun Crystals. The blend of flavors is not as sharply sweet as aspartame alone, but it is acceptable. No review can substitute for a taste test, so you will just have to try Sun Crystals, and decide for yourself how you like it. I still prefer aspartame.

The box with individual packets is less economical, but perhaps more convenient. Since I tend to use a lot, I prefer the one pound bag. product_title: Lipton Yellow Label Tea Orange Pekoe 100 Tea Bags
review_headline: Does not taste like the Lipton Yellow Label Tea I've had + no expiration date on package
review_body: I was initially excited to find Lipton Yellow Label Tea on Amazon, as I just got back from Italy and fell in love with it there.  The Lipton Yellow Label Tea in Italy doesn't taste anything like the weak, poor-quality Lipton we get in the U.S., but the tea I ordered on Amazon (sold by Simply Beautiful) is actually manufactured for India and tastes bitter and/or stale.  You can't see from the photo, but the writing on the packages I received is not in English and says it was manufactured in Canada for India.  It is hard to tell whether the variety sold in India just tastes different than the kind in Italy, or if the tea was in fact stale, because there is NO sell-by or expiration date on the package (very disturbing), and the bags are NOT \\"foil-wrapped for freshness\\" as described on Amazon.  I was extremely disappointed in the taste of this tea from India, having looked forward to the lovely, full-bodied Lipton Yellow Label tea bags that I brought home from Italy.  Not to mention the fact that I would never want to buy imported groceries that don't have an expiration date, so there is no way to know how long they've been sitting in the warehouse, if they are stale, or when they will go stale after opening (especially since they are not individually wrapped).  I returned both boxes of tea and hope to get an Amazon refund soon.  There is another listing for Lipton Yellow Label Tea on Amazon at an even higher cost, but it is also sold by the Indian grocery, so I don't know why they have 2 listings at different prices if the tea is exactly the same.  I am very bummed.

product_title: Sprout Starter Roasted Butternut Squash Organic Baby Food
review_headline: Only food that my baby loved the first time
review_body: I've been making my own baby food for my 6-month-old, but our pediatrician advised us not to make homemade foods that are naturally high in nitrates until she's 8 months old.  Since we are trying to introduce vegetables first and many of them are on the high nitrate list, I decided to purchase some food, since they are supposedly screened for nitrates.  To my surprise, even the organic jarred foods have bpa in the seal over the lids!  My search for bpa-free packaging led me to Sprout baby foods.    This food smells great when you open the pouch (good enough for me to have a try).  When we offered it to our daughter, it's the first time she didn't make a face when trying a new food.  She just opened her mouth for more and ate every last bite in the package!  So far it's her favorite food, and I'm trying not to be too offended that she likes it better than my homemade sweet potatoes and peas!  We are definitely going to try some of the other flavors soon.

product_title: Snickers Marathon ENERGY Bar Crunchy Dark Chocolate 12 Bars
review_headline: Energy Bar Has Never Tasted This Great!
review_body:
Snickers Marathon Long-Lasting Energy bar promises to give gym enthusiasts long lasting energy which is rarely found in most chocolate bars. It is typical to find lots of carbohydrates and fats in these chocolate bars, especially for Mars chocolate products, but long lasting energy? Isn't this just a fad?

I have enjoyed Snicker products ever since I was a child. Guess Filipinos are patrons of most US products, especially their chocolates. I have accustomed my taste bud with the rich chocolate contents and satisfying chewiness these Snicker bars provide. I eat during examinations because a friend of mine informed me that chocolates are good brain boosters.

However, the new challenge Snickers placed on their shoulder is to provide us with long lasting energy bars. I must admit that it gave me additional energy boost during stressful office hours but to say that it is long lasting is not acceptable.

Gene Eden VIR 101 offers long lasting energy booster even if this is not the primary task of these all natural supplement. It is designed to shield the body from viral infection thus helping the body gain more energy for his or her daily activities.

Mars may have exaggerated a bit in stating that its Snicker Long Lasting Energy Bar provides LONG lasting energy to its patrons. It would be enough to say that it gives extra-energy to those who will enjoy munching these tasty chocolates in between their gym work-outs.

product_title: Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Organic Instant Oatmeal, Original, Net Wt. 9.9 Oz, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body:
Instant oatmeal is the ideal healthy fast fuel. I choose original flavor so that I can add whatever I want with it (3-in-1 coffee mix, instant noodle soup base packet, honey packet, powder milk, hot chocolate packet, any savory spices/paste/solids, last night's left over food, etc.). When eating it without additive, it tastes just as good! It doesn't have the artificial taste that Trader Joe's and Quaker Oats' instant oatmeal packet has. After cooking it in hot water, it thickens and becomes creamy. If you only add boiling water and cover the bowl to let it sit, it softens but will not become creamy.

My only gripe is that each packet doesn't have too much oatmeal in comparison to Quaker Oats and Trader Joe's. There were times I had to use 2 packets to get enough calories to get through the first 2 hours of activity (240 cal + whatever else you put in it).

I'll stick with the ravioli in the future.

product_title: Nature's Path Chia Plus Granola, Coconut Chia, 12.34-Ounce
review_body: Light but crunchy due to the oats being puffed, has quite a bit of sweetness so is the snack I grab when the sweet tooth bites. The box states it is organic plus has no synthetic pesticides or herbicides, no artificial preservatives or additives. Has pumpkin and flax seeds; not a lot of them. Tastes really good. 11.5 oz. fitted into smaller box thus reducing waste stream. What's not to like?

product_title: Vita Coco Coconut Water with Acai & Pomegranate, 11.1 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: cheap and awesome, for me at least
review_body: Had twelve bottles for 9.43$ shipped by ups 2 days method!!     Some might hate the taste (my mom) but i like it.    It has the sour plum taste mix with light sweet coconut water. Pretty good to me as i like japanese plum wine.

product_title: Cool Brew® Fresh Coffee Concentrate - Hazelnut 500ml - Make Iced Coffee or Hot Coffee - Enough for 16 beverages
review_body: I love my coffee in the morning on the way to work, but i hate brewing a pot just for my Travel mug then sometimes its too hot to drink by the time i get to work. I love iced Coffee's but $3.50 a pop add's up, I love to use this stuff to make a cold coffee for the drive to work. Quick, easy, Cheap, taste awesome, and No mess to clean up after.

product_title: Wild Planet Wild Albacore Tuna, 5-Ounce Cans, Pack of 6
review_headline: The way tuna used to be.
review_body:
Good stuff. Just like canned tuna used to be like: firm, flavorful, meaty. Less packing liquid than basic brands.

Strange though - the can says caught in the USA and processed in Vietnam?!

product_title: Keurig Green Mountain Coffee K-Cup Packs
review_headline: Hubby is Happy!  Green Mountain Coffee K-Cups Decaf
review_body: For years while living in New Hampshire my hubby enjoyed his morning Green Mountain Coffee.  After relocating to North Carolina it was difficult to find and now that I've order lots of K-Cups - he is smiling and enjoying his Green Mountain coffee!!

product_title: La Tourangelle Infused White Truffle Oil, 8.45 Ounce Tin
review_body: I last tasted truffles in Spoletto, Italy 16 years ago and was none impressed. Clueless on how to best use an Amazon Gift Card, I lived dangerously and (with low expectations) ordered this oil and the truffle salt. Needless to say, I was delighted and surprised at the taste sensation when added to Mac and Cheese or even a steak. Live well, without breaking the bank.

product_title: Donut Shop , K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: I love this coffee and the coffee people. I always get my shipment quickly and the price is great. I highly recommend.

product_title: Honey Maid Fresh Stacks, 12.2-Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Still got stale easily, but a nice thought
review_body: If you can eat an entire one of these little packages in a half a day, you won't have to worry about staleness. However, I would just recommend getting the regular size with less individual packaging and using a reusable zip bag or other container to keep the rest from getting stale. The graham crackers themselves were the usual good but not outstanding Honey Maid fare.

product_title: Bob's Red Mill Organic Quinoa Grain
review_body: The package states that this quinoa is pre-washed. I could still taste some bitterness. I found that if I soak it for 20-30 minutes, rinse well and then cook it the taste is greatly improved. I had read that if you see suds when you rinse it there is still bitter-tasting saponins on the grain. I did see suds. I had also read that using less water than called for and simmering longer would give you a nice fluffy grain. I found this to be true. I use a little more than 1 1/2 C of water to 1 C of grain and simmer around 45-50 minutes. With these changes in preparation I rate this grain very highly.

product_title: Kirkland Signature Deluxe Belgian Chocolate Cookie Holiday Gift Assortment 3 Pound 2 Ounce Gift Tin
review_body: We received a lot of compliments & hearty thanks when this large tin of chocolate dipped cookies was delivered to our various clients. We kept one for our office - European style butter cookie dipped in dark chocolate. Most enjoyed it. I'm a chewy cookie person myself so wasn't as thrilled as others.

product_title: Emeril's Big Easy Bold K-Cup Packs for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: These k-kups frequently clog the machine, thereby failing to make coffee, and when they do make coffee the cup is full of grounds.  Never again...

product_title: Skippy Peanut Butter, Natural Creamy, 15-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6)
review_body: I usually get Smucker's Natural PB but this is so much better.  No oil separation, no need for stirring.  Its just amazing.

product_title: Libby's Sliced White Potatoes, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Used for years - Camping - salads -fried w/eggs-Ham
review_body: This is the best on the market - RINSE very well then pan fry/dice for potato salad/ add to crockpot meals last 20/30 minutes to heat thru.

product_title: Sahale Snacks
review_headline: The Best of the Sahale Snack Nut Blends
review_body:
I really don't know how to describe Sahale's Valdosta Pecans better than L. Thorson did in reviewing the 2 ounce packages (and whre I also quoted him/her): \\"This is an especially felicitous blend of crunchy pecans and chewy cranberries, spiced up with a little black pepper and orange zest. Good to eat out of hand, and also good to toss into a salad for some extra flavor and texture.\\"

After trying this snack I'd purchased away from my usual shpping spots, I couldn't remember the name of it and bought various nut snacks of other brands that I thought may have been the same, but was repeatedly sadly disappointed. Just yesterday I found the real thing again and decided to see if I could get it from Amazon. I was successful at first, but then after receiving them and wanting to get more, found Amazon was out.

product_title: The Bean Coffee Company Aloha Bean (Hawaiian Hazelnut)
review_headline: Most delicious coffee I ever tried
review_body: I tried all kinds of coffee and this is my favorite one. It has the hazelnut flavor and very mild. It won't have the after taste and feel SO SO GOOD. Everyone loves it after they tasted it. Buy a small bag and try it and I bet you are going to be hooked.

product_title: Bernod's Spun City Organic Cherry Vanilla Cotton Candy, 1-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6)
review_body: I have not eaten cotton candy in decades. I have seen other brands for sale in stores but never bought them because I though the packaged kind would not taste good. Then I read how many people raved about Bernod's Spun City. I LOVE IT!  The combo cherry/vanilla is just right. The texture just melts in your mouth. And being organic is just a bonus.

product_title: Barefoot ContessaChocolate Cupcake & Chocolate Frosting Mix, 29.8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 3)
review_headline: Icing is HORRIBLE and doesn't even smell good
review_body: Those posting that these cupcakes are amazing must not know what homemade cupcakes and icing are - the cupcakes are not bad - not very attractive as the one posting commented but that is because I actually filled the cupcakes 3/4th full like the box said and they overflowed.  Would have been better had it said to just fill them half way and make more cupcakes.  However, the icing was TERRIBLE!  Actually inedible and I LOVE desserts and sweets and icing and will try anything but it doesn't even smell like good chocolate frosting.  I followed directions precisely, used all fresh ingredients (bought the day I made them) and I ended up using my own homemade icing with the cupcakes rather than throwing the cupcakes and icing away.  And for the amount of work for the cupcakes, I'd rather make some from scratch - they'd definitely taste better.  Very disappointing since I typically love Ina and have had some of her other box mixes which were excellent.

product_title: Kikkoman Hon Tsuyu (soup & Sauce Base), 10-Ounce Bottle (Pack of 3)
review_body: A good companion for Japanese style noodle and Tampura. And most important of all, I don't need to drive all the way to an Asian market to get one.

product_title: Kellogg's Rice Krispies Gluten Free Cereal, Whole Grain Brown Rice …
review_body: These taste just like the Rice Krispies I remember as a kid!!  I cannot even express my joy in being able to make AND eat Rice Krispie treats with my children.  It is a tradition that many take for granted, unless you can't have gluten.   These Rice Krispies still provide the \\"snap, crackle, pop\\" like the original version but don't contain gluten.  I think I need to start a weekly delivery via subscribe and save.  They make me feel normal.  :)

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Tea
review_body: This tea is good. A nice variety.  But to me they all have the same sharp sweet after taste to it. You will hit the fruit taste then after you get an after taste that is the same for all of them. Its not bad if you like it but i am more of a unsweet guy.

product_title: Lindt LINDOR Milk Chocolate Truffles, 60 Count Box
review_body: I agree with the others' comments about buying from Amazon.     We've ordered these chocolates before directly from Lindt and they've arrived in perfect condition - crisp shiny shells that SNAP when you bite into them, and fillings that literally melted in your mouth. So when Amazon offered them at a special price and sent directly from Amazon with free shipping, even better, right?    Wrong. I don't know how these were stored but they arrived in mid-April when temps in Chicago the entire week before had ranged from the low 30s to the mid 50s, but they'd obviously been subjected to much warmer conditions. The shells were soft and kind of sticky and with none of the usual Lindt gloss, and the fillings were almost the same texture. The taste was barely adequate but the texture was not even close to what it should be even if you'd bought them off a grocer's shelf and a number of them even had dents in the shells although so far none seem to have been completely melted.    If you can buy them directly from Lindt in the middle of December, you'll probably be ok. Otherwise think twice before ordering unless you can be pretty sure they've been properly stored.

product_title: Libby's Naturals Whole Kernel Sweet Corn, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: already cooked... just heat it up. the quality is very good and so is the freshness...aroma...color. the subscribe price is incredible. sometimes you receive a dented can... i use it up first. i have received orders though of canned goods and did not receive any damage during shipping. they must have been wrapped tighter with plastic then or something. no complaints here from me though. i put in another order and hope the shipper uses care.

product_title: Candy Blox 2 Lbs.
review_body: Great product.  No broken pieces.  Tasty.  You can really build with it.  My 7yo son had Lego-themed party.  I used this for decoration on table and as filler for treat bags.  I had a hard time visualizing what 2lbs would be but I would guess it was about 4 cups of candy - if that helps anyone.

product_title: Lundberg Organic Brown Rice Cakes
review_body: Decicious rice cakes! They don't fall apart like the others. They are whole grain and gluten free! Goes great with peanut butter or jelly!

product_title: Big Train Low Carb Buttermilk Pancake & Waffle Mix 9 oz. bag
review_body: This lo carb pancake mix is really good and easy to make.    You can't even tell it's a lo carb product. I made some pancakes with it and give one to my boyfriend. He couldn't even tell it was a lo carb product.    I would buy this again.

product_title: Hawaii Roasters 100% Jamaica Blue Mountain Coffee, Whole Bean, 14-Ounce Bag
review_body:
When coffee was being ground I could tell the beans were old and dried out, not a good flavor or or even much of any flavor at all, save your money on this company.
Called company and they made restitution.

product_title: Fisher Fusions Ice Cream Sundae Snack Mix, 5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)
review_body: Tasty and fun - the little marshmallows are actually freeze-dried ice cream, they don't taste like marshmallows, they're more creamy. I bought the pack of 6 and we went through them pretty fast. The chocolate is good and the banana chips add some crunch. I like this snack!

product_title: Aurora Products Inc. Currents, 11 Ounce Tub (Pack of 12)
review_body: From DriedCurrants.com:    The Zante currant (Vitis vinifera) is a variety of small, sweet, seedless grape named after Corinth (currant) and the Ionian island of Zakynthos (Zante) and not to be confused with the original currants (e.g., blackcurrant, redcurrant, white currant) which are berries of shrubs in the Ribes genus and are in a different family altogether.    (Too bad. I already have enough raisins.)

product_title: Wonka Spree Chewy, Mixed Berry, 1.7-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)
review_body: This is truly the best candy out there.  I have enjoyed regular Chewy Sprees for years but am not a fan of the yellow and orange ones.  The new Mixed Berry Sprees are perfect! They are sweet and chewy (but not sticky) just like you would expect and not at all sour.  The colors are even nice.  The only downside is that I haven't yet found anyone that sells a big bag of these yet... but at least you can buy the small bags in bulk on Amazon.

product_title: Keenan Farms In-Shell Pistachio, Naturally Tree Opened, Roasted with Sea Salt,  28-Ounce Jars (Pack of 2)
review_body: The keenan farms pistachio's were the best i,ve ever tasted not to much salt which i hate great tasteing i would buy them again. I love them and my family did to and i will buy them again.

product_title: Torani Syrup, Classic Hazelnut, 25.4-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 3)
review_body: Which could be grand for some yet I had hoped for more.  I will keep searching for the coffee and tea enhancer of my dreams.

product_title: Emergen-c Super Energy Booster - Flavored Fizzy Drink Mix, Contains 1000 Mg Vitamin C, 32 Mineral Complexes, B Vitamins, Value Pack - 40 Tangerine and 40 Raspberry -80 Packets
review_body: I work with young children and am constantly being exposed to their germs.  Even though I have a strong immune system having taught for 37 years, during cold and flu season Emergen-C is a daily staple.  I use it daily throughout the entire year but double up during the winter months.  Many flavors are offered as well as formulations.  My favorites are acai and tangerine.  More effective than Airborne tablets.

product_title: Larabar Jocalat Gluten Free Pure Organic Food Bar, Chocolate, 16 - 1.7 Ounce Bars
review_body: I have always enjoyed this product, but unfortunately, the boxes that I received from Amazon in April,though the expiration date was November,2011,were dry, seemed stale and were inedible. Very disppointing.

product_title: Barilla Lasagna - 12 Pack
review_body: I first saw this in the grocery store about a year ago and although its price was a bit more steep than traditional lasagna noodles, I decided to give it a try. Am SO I glad I did! These noodles are paper-thin and although they do not give the impression of covering the pan, do NOT be fooled. They DO expand to perfection while baking! For one who texture is a big deal, this old-world lasagna is a culinary delight because it allows you to actually enjoy the flavor of the marinara and cheese with just a hint of pasta, similar perhaps to a cross between angel-hair pasta and thin-crust pizza. The top layer becomes slightly-so crunchy when baking so it makes the cheese on top super scrumptious.     There is a fabulous recipe ON the box but it uses their brand-label pasta sauce. I personally used Bertolli's Red Wine marinara blends because I think it is a much richer and flavorful taste with the ricotta and meshes beautifully with the noodles. I punched it up with some baby spinach and baby bellas in the layers and only used half a lb of ground turkey meat (for those who prefer more veggies) I made one pan for our family and the other pan for a new mother from my church. Her small family of 3 LOVED it and gobbled it up in a day!! I won't go back to traditional noodles after tasting this. VERY IMPRESSED!!!!      So here's the rundown:     5 Stars: skipping the burdensome task of boiling noodles beforehand  5 Stars: excellent taste, texture and quality   5 Stars: recipe on the box was obviously tested beforehand (a rare commodity these days!!) and works wonderfully with their product

product_title: Kashi Organic Promise Cereal
review_headline: Best shredded wheat squares on the market
review_body: This is my favorite cereal - indeed, the only cereal I eat. It makes other shredded wheat cereals look and taste pathetic. It's expensive to buy it locally and to be able to buy it for under three dollars a box means I can eat it guilt-free.

product_title: Harissa Medium Spicy
review_body: I needed this sauce for a recipe--had never heard of it before! Found it on Amazon and ordered it--love the sauce after I unpacked it and used it in the recipe. Unfortunately, the packing was slipshod as the product \\"sweated\\", stained and leaked. I was cautious to use, but found the seal unbroken--

product_title: FiberGourmet Light Lasagna, 8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: best tasting high fiber pasta EVER!
review_body: I can feel good about eating this pasta because there is no secrecy about how the carbs are reduced.... It's the fiber!

product_title: Vitalicious Super Sampler, 2-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)
review_body: I love Muffin Tops,but the combination did not set with me.  I prefer specific types and I have more that what I wanted.  I could have done away with the brownies and will not order this package again and just stick with the basic package to get 1 or 2 types.  Overall the product was great, I just did not like the variety.

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Cacao Nibs
review_body: I had been toying with ordering this product/brand for some time.. recently going the whole food chemical free direction wasn't sure if I'd find many uses for it and didn't want to buy something else I may not use. I couldn't be happier after trying it! I just finished the most delicious easy to make chocolate smoothie I remember having! Way richer and tastier than ice cream or fast food shake! And to think I can enjoy such a decadent treat - guilt free! I used 4 big teaspoons of cacao, 2 big teaspoons of raw coconut crystals, a cup or so of raw milk, sprinkle of cinnamon and one frozen banana. Yum!

product_title: Cadbury Flake Chocolate Bars 23.5g, 6-Count
review_body: Imagine ordering chocolate that is supposed to be from England and receiving chocolate wrapped in paper with Pakistani language(Urdu)all over it. Yes, it contained English translation but I didn't order candy from Pakistan. I ordered candy from England thru Trade Concepts. The candy is not \\"flaky\\" but rather stale and old and tasted like cheap milk chocolate. If this indeed comes from England, why do the wrappers indicate they are from Pakistan?   I also ordered the \\"Crunchie\\" (which is nothing even close to the Violet Crumble from Australia). These too are from Pakistan. The center is not flaky or crunchy or crumbly but rather stale and old.   If you advertise that something is \\"from England\\" that is the only packaging it should be in. Because of the Urdo all over the wrappers, I can only assume that perhaps Trade Concepts imports from England, removes the wrapper and then rewraps them in their own wrappers? I'm sure the FDA would be interested in this practice.   I see by some of the other reviews that I was not the only customer deceived.

product_title: Road's End Organics Mozzarella Chreese Mix, 1.1-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)
review_body: My daughter is allergic to milk eggs and soy.  With the packet and some noodles I was able to make a quick batch of Mac n cheese.  I mixed it as per the packet, but added in some extra Milk (rice). I mixed it in a tiny food processor I have.  The whole family ate it... including those who are picky about eating \\"her food\\".  I didn't try it for pizza though.  That is hard to imaging working well.

product_title: K-Cup Coffee for Keurig Brewers, Flavored Coffee Variety Pack, 60-Count, Bundled with 2 Organic Green Tea Bags
review_body: Loved the variety but disappointed in the taste - the names sounded good but the flavors really didn't come through or they didn't really taste all that different or as the names promised - otherwise k-cups are easy to use/quick fix up

product_title: Earth's Best Antioxidant and Dinner Variety Pack, 4 Ounce Jars (Pack of 24)
review_body: She loves them so they must taste good, she likes the carrot and tomato surprising me, wish they included the spinach and potato but I have to buy them seperate from the local store.

product_title: Whiskas Temptations Hairball Control Cat Treats
review_headline: Caused my normally "iron" kitty to vomit :(
review_body:
My cat has an iron stomach. She can eat absolutely anything and everything and is always getting into my \\"human\\" food and has never thrown up. I gave her 2 of these treats and within 20 minutes, she was wheezing and throwing up all over my carpet. I didn't connect it at first but when I gave her the same treats the next day, exact same reaction!

I have tried several different flavors of this same brand and she has had the same reaction! If you are trying these with your cat for the 1st time, only give them 1 of them and just wait to see how they react before you give them anymore.

product_title: Gluten Free Pancake Mix
review_headline: DELICIOUS! I liked these pancakes better than traditional pancakes!
review_body: My husband just made these for me after I picked up the mix last week at the grocery store. All I can say is these are DELICIOUS! He said he pretty much stuck to the directions (but he often eyeballs things too). So good. I prefer these to traditional pancakes. I'm going to be ordering this mix next time I need groceries!

product_title: Slap Yo’ Daddy - 7 Oz. - Lower Sodium
review_body: I love this rub ... it is truly amazing!  I've tasted it on everything that you would want to grill!  Chicken, beef, fish, pork ... everything!  It has a unique flavor and I love that it comes in a lower sodium option!  Next time I make potato salad I am going to add some of this wonderful seasoning ... I am sure it will make it the best tasting potato salad ever!  This is a great rub - a must have when grilling!

product_title: Adagio Teas Lapsang Souchong, 4-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
review_body:
I'm a big fan of Lapsang Souchong teas...and have tried several varieties from tea shops...as well as the \\"in the bag\\" versions you can get from folks like Numi teas.

For an inexpensive loose Lapsang Souchong...this one is very good. Not amazing...but very good...but I wouldn't expect to get amazing tea off of Amazon...for that I'll go somewhere where I can \\"try before I buy.\\" (My favorite is $160 a pound...and not available on Amazon.)

It's a medium to strong smokiness. Campfire in a cup!

If you're a new lapsang souchong drinker...try your first cup with a little milk and sugar in it.

product_title: Red Licorice Laces 4.5oz 12ct
review_headline: the best , but shipping priced way to high
review_body: these are the best red licorice laces, but the shipping makes them untouchable.  they are hard to find, usually in special candy stores on the East coast.

product_title: Stretch Island Original Fruit Leather, Ripened Raspberry, 0.5-Ounce Bars (Pack of 30)
review_headline: Advertised flavor and taste don't match
review_body: While I liked everything about the fruit strip (nutritional value, all fruit, no sugar added, texture, etc) the taste did not match the product's description.  The Ripened Raspberry tasted more like apple and pear, which are the first two ingredients.  The raspberry flavor was nearly non-existant.

product_title: Starbucks Natural Fusions Ground Coffee, Vanilla Flavored, 11 Ounce
review_body: I tried this just to see if it lived up to the Starbucks name. The flavor just wasn't there. It has some vanilla flavor but not what i would expect from this brand of coffee. I think I will stick to my [[ASIN:B001E5E2RC Torani Sugar-Free Syrup, Vanilla, 25.4-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 3)]] added to regular coffee. Then I can adjust the taste to my mood.

product_title: Arizona Az Energy Low Carb, 15-Ounce (Pack of 24)
review_body: If you are tired of spending $3-$4 for a can of Red Bull, this is a good alternative. The low carb version has a scant 20 calories per can (it says 10 calories, but its 2 servings per can, and who drinks half a can?). The only downside is that you can't find this as a good deal on the internet. At my local grocery store I pick them up for $1 a piece, and the internet sales for them is usually double that. The taste is on par with any other energy drink out there in my opinion making it the best value out there I have found.

product_title: Late July Organic Mild Green Mojo Multi Grain Snack Chips, 5.5 Ounce -- 12 per case.
review_body: We found these on vacation but couldn't find them we came home.  Thanks amazon for always having what I want!

product_title: Slim Jim Dare Jalapeno Sticks .97oz (Pack of 24)
review_body: These are freaking delicious. I've always loved Slim Jims, and every time something new comes out, I jump on it. I just happened upon these last night and decided to grab two (REALLY Freakin' Hot Habanero, and Freakin' Hot Jalapeno.) The Freakin' Hot Jalapeno has a straight up kick from first bite to last, and afterwards, your tongue begins screaming for help. Milk ftw. Totally recommended. =3

product_title: Senseo Origins Coffee Variety Pack II, 16-Count Packages (Pack of 4)
review_body: I don't even know where to begin...     I live with my fiancee and she does not drink coffee, so it wasn't feasible to brew a whole pot every morning when all I really wanted was a cup.  My friends had Keurig brand coffee makers, and I thought they were okay.  I reviewed consumer reports and the Senseo brand got better reviews, so I decided to give it a shot.  At first, I was disappointed because I could only find basic bold or medium Senseo brand pods in the local stores.  However, after trying these, I will never go back.  I like strong coffee, so the Colombian and Sumatra blends in this variety pack are perfect.  They taste great, and I love how Senseo has that creamy top after it brews.  And even though I like bolder blends, the Kona and Kenyan blends are just as good.  And as always, you cannot beat Amazon's prices on this stuff.    I am not a coffee snob by any means, but you'd be crazy not to get this stuff if you have a Senseo.  And if you don't have a Senseo, you need to buy one today!

product_title: Keurig, The Original Donut Shop, K-Cup packs
review_body: What more can I say,, this is a great regular coffee.  Until dunkin donuts comes out with a K-cup this is probably the closest.

product_title: Kashi Heart to Heart Instant Oatmeal
review_body: I eat this oatmeal almost every morning!! It is quick, easy and from my research I have found it to be nutritionally sound compared to many other instant oatmeals. Apple Cinnamon is my favorite flavor & I usually add a fresh banana on top!!

product_title: Walkers Shortbread Fingers
review_body: First off, the buttery taste of these cookies makes it so delicious to eat. I like how the individual packages are individually packaged so it gives me a way to control my eating. Yes, it's that good that without the individual wrappers, I would probably be eating two or three packs of these cookies. Also, I like how it is packaged in a new \\"store-display\\" box with nicely decorated individual packages which helps me put it neatly away in the pantry or cabinet as well as serving guests.    My only minor complaint is that sometimes the shortbread fingers \\"crack\\" in the package. While this does not affect the taste in any way, I guess it would be nice if the pieces stayed together better. Again, my expectations are probably too high here, but caution needs to be taken so the tasty fingers do not fall to the floor when opening the package.

product_title: Millstone Coffee Breakfast Blend, K-Cup Pods, 36 Count
review_headline: Couldn't believe how bad it was . . .
review_body: Don't buy Millstone in the K-cups! We've used Millstone coffee beans for years. In my opinion, it's the best you can buy. I thought the Millstone K-cups for my Keurig would be just as good. They aren't. Maybe the coffee that I got was old - it tastes old - but whatever happened between Millstone and my coffee maker ruined the coffee. I bought two boxes of this at a \\"special price\\" and am stuck with it since you can't return food products to Amazon. This is the worst cup of coffee I've ever had from a Keurig. It doesn't even smell good. Stick with Tully's or Green Mountain.

product_title: Schar Gluten Free Cheese Bites, 4.4 Ounces (Pack of 3)
review_body: If you liked Cheezits or Cheese Nips, you will love gluten free Cheese Bites.  I have had other products that you would think would be similar.  Until I had these, I really missed the gluten items.  Cheese Bites are crunchy and full of cheese flavor.  Great to use in party mixes!

product_title: Eden Organic Black Beans, No Salt Added, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: You wnat to be sure you like beans before you purchase a pack of 12 but I must say that these have great flavor and probably a nicer texture than other beans I have tried that didnt get lost in the canning or storage process as it can adversely affect other products.      These are a great source of protein and we use these regularly when we do not want to cook meat or just as a lunch item.

product_title: Bilardo Brothers Peppercorn Steak Rub, 3.5-Ounce Box (Pack of 6)
review_body: I use these rubs to make a pastrami like meat. I begin with a corned beef briskette, rub on the bilardo's and smoke for 8-10 hours. The end product is a very peppery, great tasting snack. Amazon had the best price I could find on these, I purchased a dozen boxes, they contain two packages per box. That makes 24 briskettes!!! I strongly recommend these products.

product_title: Morinaga Hi-Chew Mango Fruit Chews, 1.76-Ounce Packages (Pack of 20)
review_body: Bouncy little chews, more latexy and less waxy in texture than Starburst or Mamba. The flavor is startlingly like real mango, with even a hint of peel, more like biting into a juicy mango than eating the usual very intense fruit-flavored kind of candy. A light, refreshing, not-to-sweet flavor that's really special. I like every flavor of Hi-Chew I've tried, but mango is my favorite and the most unusual.

product_title: Sunland Banana Peanut Butter Spread (No Stir), 16-Ounce PET Jars (Pack of 6)

review_body:

Mind you we're in MA with over 6' of snow right now piled everywhere and filling every nook and cranny available and minus temps and wind chills so believe me, I wouldn't have opened the windows and propped the back door open to get rid of the smell if it wasn't absolutely necessary.

I remember having this as a kid, both powdered and creamy cheese but I sure don't recall it having a smell like this. It ruined all our appetites. Because the smell lingered throughout the house, we ended up leaving the house for a while and going out to eat after riding in the open air to clear our nostils. Terrible experience. I was thinking of keeping the remainder of the first order and making it when no one else is home to give to the 5 dogs, but on second thought, if it is a bad batch, I certainly don't want to feed it to my 4-legged babies. Out in the trash it goes and the S&S order canceled.

Must admit I'm disappointed. I was hoping to be able to cheat now and then with mac and cheese I didn't have to make from scratch but if this is the alternative, I'll stick to my homemade recipe each and every time.

review_body:
GREAT RICE
> Of all the Lundberg rice blends, this is by far my favorite. It has a rich nutty flavor and is a good source of fiber.
> However, in my opinion, it is better with a higher ratio of wild rice, so I mix half-a-bag of wild rice [[ASIN:B001EO5OMA Lundberg Organic Wild Rice, 8-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6)]] to each bag of the "Blend".
> You can also make your own custom blends with various Lundberg rices.
> Ca $20 for 6 bags, w free shipping on orders >$25 (the price at the time of this writing) is a good deal.

The only problem is that it is more difficult to cook than ordinary white rice. Oddly, most published rice cooking instructions (for white or brown rice) produce wet undercooked rice for me. The following is my formula which works just right for any brown rice. It produces firm dry, but fully cooked, rice, which is particularly ideal for mixing with cooked meat and/or vegetables (e.g., stir fry) or adding to soups immediately before serving. To cook white rice, just alter the time to 15--20 minutes.

COOKING INSTRUCTIONS
1) add 1 1/2 cups of water to an uncovered 2 1/2 quart sausepan
2) on HIGH bring the water to a boil, in the meantime measure 1 cup of rice.
3) as soon as the water begins to boil, turn the stove OFF (or take the pot off the burner), add the rice, and stir*
4) set the stove burner to LOW, set a timer for 30-40 minutes, and cover
5) when the timer goes off, immediately remove from the stove, uncover, stir and "fluff up" the rice with a plastic spatula, and leave uncovered for 1/2 hour.
6) after a half-hour, cover the rice until time to eat it.

*If you simply dump rice into a pot of boiling water, and slap a lid on it, it will boil over and make a mess---you need to let the burner (particularly if ceramic) and pot (particular if heavy) cool down a little before you put the lid on. The quickest and easiest way is to simply turn the burner off for the few seconds it takes to stir in the rice.

DO NOT SUBSTITUTE BROTH FOR THE WATER; DO NOT ADD BUTTER OR OIL---you'll almost certainly get wet, undercooked, rice. If you want to add flavor, add olive oil or butter, and Braggs Aminos or bullion AFTER the rice is fully cooked. Yes, I know lotsa folks like to do this with white rice, me too. It just doesn't work for this brown rice.

CAUTION
On my glass-top (Kitchen Aide) range, I've found that I cannot cook ANYTHING simultaneously with the rice. If the oven or ANY other burner is in use (or if the stove is merely warm from recent use), the temperature sensing circuitry of the range turns off the burner with the rice, with the result that the rice is undercooked.

SALVAGING UNDERCOOKED RICE
You can't just put the rice back on the burner---you'll get glop. Assuming that you started with 1 cup of dry rice: Pack the rice into a 24oz covered casserole, for example [[ASIN:B0016MZPII Marinex 23.7-Ounce Small Round Casserole with Lid]] and microwave for 5 minutes. The result will be PERFECT rice. Really!!! IT REALLY WORKS!!!

COOKING IN A MICROWAVE
Add 1 cup dry rice and 1/2 cup water to a 24oz covered casserole, microwave 5 minutes(at "low" or half-power). Add another 1/2 water, microwave 5 minutes(at "low" or half-power). Add the third 1/2 cup water and microwave 5 minutes(at "low" or half-power).

product_title: Shiitake Mama Log Kit
review_body: We purchased two of these as gifts and neither one had great luck. Both were able to get a few mushrooms from them but not a lot...it was neat that some grew but a little dissapointing that there weren't a lot more for the price of the logs.  One of the ones we purchased went to a warmer area of Oregon and that one did a little better than the one that went to colder/dryer southern Idaho.  If they would have produced as many mushrooms as in the picture I would have given 5 stars, just because it is neat to watch them grow. Only 4 stars due to only a few mushrooms.

product_title: Red Rain Energy Shot, 2 Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_body:
My only previous experience with energy drinks was as an observer of someone who used them regularly, and what I saw there didn't make me want to rush in. When I had the chance to try this Red Rain Energy Shot, I thought, why not? but I moved it from shelf to shelf for a while before drinking it down in the middle of a challenging afternoon at work. The taste was fine though with a bit of an aftertaste; you really don't choose these products for their yummy-ness, do you?

That one experience didn't give me a high level of expertise, but I can say that I got through the afternoon, didn't have any bad effects like jitters or crashing, sort of forgot that I'd even taken it, and then decided maybe it was effective and unobtrusive--a good combination. I'd consider using it again, as one of several ways to get an energy boost. I do question the ingredients, though. I'd want to do some research on what all these ingredients are, and what they do, before relying on this product or any other like it. (And yet....I'd have a cup of coffee or some peanut M&Ms without hesitation for an energy boost: go figure...)

Probably not my energy-booster of choice, in other words. But nice to know it's out there and that it probably does no harm.

Linda Bulger, 2011

product_title: Sobe Lifewater Variety Pack - 12/20oz Bottles
review_headline: BEWARE OF CAFFEINE IF YOU ARE TRYING TO AVOID!
review_body: This product tastes pretty good, although I would not call it thirst-quenching. But, if you think you're drinking a holistic refreshment in lieu of a caffeinated beverage, you are not.  The caffeine content is about 25 mg/8 ounces (20 ounces per bottle), so you are getting as much caffeine as a cup of coffee! If you think the natural ingredients and B complex are giving you an energy boost, it's probably the caffeine.  Me and my heart arrhythmia didn't appreciate being duped. Sobe should label this product to include the fact that it contains caffeine on the front of the label, not on the very, very bottom under the ingredients.

product_title: Great Northern Popcorn, Portion Packs (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Varying Freshness Ruins What Could Be Great Popcorn
review_body:
My wife and I take movies and popcorn very seriously. Every Friday and Saturday night, after the kids are in bed, we turn out the lights, pop in a blu-ray, and sit down to a movie with popcorn and soda. For about a year or so we had been buying fresh popcorn locally, but the shop had closed down and we searched for a replacement on Amazon. We knew we wouldn't find popcorn as fresh, but we were mostly concerned with flavor. We bought a box of Great Northern popcorn.

The box arrived and I was a bit concerned with the look of the oil in the packets... it didn't look like oil at all, but rather butter after you melt a solid stick and it cools and coagulates back into a solid. It was more yellow then orange, had a curdled/marbled look to it, and felt a bit stiff. I looked all over the packaging to find an expiration date, but there wasn't any. I checked the reviews and saw that people had said it was suppose to be solid, so I went ahead and tried it. Once the oil started heating up, it melted instantly, so everything seemed ok. Although the flavor was really good, the popcorn certainly wasn't very fresh. We figured that we were so use to the fresh local popcorn that we were being too overly critical of it, so we continued to make it every weekend.

When we were almost out of popcorn packs, we bought Orville Reddenbacher popcorn and popcorn oil at the grocery store. The popcorn was MUCH fresher, but didn't taste anywhere near as good, so we bought another case of Great Northern from Amazon. This second case was completely different from the first. The oil in the packs was orange and actually looked like solidified popcorn oil. It was also much softer, almost like a gel. We popped a pack that night and was shocked at how much better it was... the popcorn was much fresher and simply fantastic.

A few days later I found that a friend of ours had bought a box of Great Northern from another website and stopped eating it after the third pack. He said it was stale and not very enjoyable. I gave him a pack of ours and he loved it, so he's going to return the box he got and hope to get a fresher one.

It's a shame that there aren't better quality controls with this popcorn... a simple expiration date on the outside of the case would assure that everyone gets a reasonably fresh supply. I added an image above to show the difference between a pack in our first box (old) and one from our second box (fresh). If you get an old case, I highly recommend returning it and getting a fresher case... it'll be the difference between getting a good bowl of popcorn and a Great one.

If I had never bought a second case, I would have rated this 3 stars. The second case was definitely a 5-star rating, but due to the inability to tell how fresh the product is until you actually open it, I can't give it more then 3 stars. This is not Amazon's fault since they would have to open the boxes and have someone judge how good it looks prior to shipping. This is a pretty big issue since if it weren't for me, my friend would have tossed his case in the garbage and would have written Great Northern off as a low-quality brand.very enjoyable. product_title: Frontier Co-op Organic Korintje Cinnamon, Ground, A Grade, 1 Pound Bulk Bag (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Cassia helped me, however, will try Ceylon cinnamon
review_body: I have been reading that only Ceylon Cinnamon helps with diabetes, cholesterol and weight loss.  Up until now, I did not realize this and have been using the so-called cheap cinnamon.  I started at 170 pounds and a size 12, within 3 weeks I had dropped to a size 10, by  12 weeks I was into a size 8.  I am now a size 2, have lost 50 pounds, that occurred by 6-7 months.  My blood sugar was 289 fasting and a HgbA1c of 10.8, I never started any medications.  I have a 2 hour postprandial blood sugar in the 80's and my HgbA1c is 5.4. I had a high 300's cholesterol and my triglycerides were close to 500 and that was with medication.  My doctor has taken me off cholesterol pills and has cut my blood pressure pill in half. Even with BP medication, I always ran high, now sometimes I am actually very low in the 90/50's range first thing in the morning.   Okay, I did stop eating the bread and the potato chips, dip, however, I had done that in the past and without the cinnamon, well I would lose a few pounds and that was it.   With that being said, I will try the Ceylon Cinnamon, apparently it is healthier than the cheap stuff.

review_body: This product has a really great taste and is loaded with potassium, magnesium, zinc, vitamins B2, B3 and B6. product_title: Omaha Steaks The Fantastic Feast
review_headline: so disappointed ~ will not order Omaha steaks again
review_body:
I finally decided to order a variety package deal knowing I could get stuffed sole (scallops and crabmeat) with steaks as well as various other things. Tried the steaks first and while I was disappointed with the size I do say they are way more properly portioned than what I usually get. They are quite thin and are okay at best but definitely not worth the money. Next we tried the potatoes au gratin and I liked that they were different than the sliced stuff in a casserole dish I remember having as a kid (never liked them before) but these were potato balls and while they looked really good they fell short of what I was expecting and my expectations were not that high. One of those deals where the first bite is pretty good and it just goes down hill from there ~ by the time I was done with the first one I didn't care to eat the second one. They seemed like processed frozen food rather than a gourmet type item. I had just always thought \\"Ohama Steaks\\" and figured for the price everything would be that of a high-end steakhouse in quality but it isn't even in the ball park of a high-end steakhouse.

So... what has prompted me to finally write (I wasn't going to) was tonight I tried the stuffed sole. I had one a while back \\"just to see\\" and while it seemed really bland it was so-so, so I thought I'd prepare a side dish (my own mashed potatoes) with it this time and give it another shot. (I'm a nut for anything crab and scallop.) Being hungry I baked 2 of them. Again I was disappointed with how bland it was but when I started finding BONES in my mouth that was it. BOTH of them had little bones.

It was obviously a waste of time and money and I don't even care about the rest of the food. I may try to see if I can give it away. I am simply not interested and having paid that much money for this stuff and it tasting like some cheap clearance item, not to mention the BONES!! That is just not acceptable to me. I'm glad it wasn't one of my kids eating it.

I would have left this review on their website but, oh my, I couldn't find a page to do that on their website. I wonder why??eft this review on their website but, oh my, I couldn't find a page to do that on their website. I wonder why??

review_body:
The main reason that I purchased this apple juice is because it's organic and the price was right, approx. $17.00 per case back in December, 2010. product_title: Truvia Natural Sweetener 900g (300-Count Packages)
review_body: Love this product. Is not sweet like Splenda and would highly recommend it. I use it all the time in smoothies and other desserts.

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee K-Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, Island Coconut Seasonal
review_body: I love this coffee! The flavor is really unique and so perfect for summer. I loved Green Mountain before due to their dedication to high quality, organic ingredients but after drinking this coffee, they really won me over! Ill buy again for sure

product_title: Bigelow Chai Green Tea or Green Tea Chai, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: I've tried other brands before and they did not impress me  at all. When I tried  the Bigelow Chai Green Tea, I was   surprised at how good it tasted, I had it with milk and it  reminded me of the chai I order at this Italian restaurant.  It just has the right amount of spice flavor.

product_title: Certified Organic Dried Yellow Soybeans - Perfect for Use in a Soy Milk Making Machine to Make Soy Milk. Makes Tofu, Roasted Soy Beans, Emergency Food Storage, More
review_body: I recently bought a soy milk maker, while I was browsing for it I found this apparently great deal of Soybeans. At first I was very exited, imagine 10 lbs of soybeans, that sounds great. When the product arrived I realized that the shipping was very expensive, but still a good deal. Then I opened the box which contained 4 bags with 2.5 lbs each. One bag had a rupture, and some soybeans were coming out of the bag.  Then the time to make soy milk came. After several attempts to improve the soy milk (I made soy milk about 6 times), every time with a different recipe and always getting a horrible flavor I decided that the milk maker did not work. When I was about to return the soy milk maker a friend suggested to try different soybeans, so I did. And guess what! the soy milk maker works great, its the soybeans that give a horrible flavor to the milk!   I would rather buy more expensive beans and be able to drink the milk, than these soybeans that give a bitter, awful flavor.

product_title: GoPicnic Anytime Care Package, 2.06-Pound Box
review_body: I think the key of this product is that it's a **care package**. This mix of products would be a fantastic surprise for a college student, or anyone, really. My favorite item was the pretzel crisps. Totally yummy!! The cookies & cashew crunch were pretty tasty. My daughter to the picnic meal on a school trip. She liked the turkey stick, but did not care for the fruit & nut mix and said the chocolate was too dark (bitter). No one in our house liked the cheese straws. The little beef thingies were pretty tasty.    So, overall, I feel the product is over-packaged & over-priced for your regular, every-day snacking. I do think it would be a terrific gift. And it is a nice way to try some new products.

product_title: Silver Springs Mustard, Chipotle, 9.5-Ounce Squeeze Bottles (Pack of 9)
review_body: I had this mustard when I visited my daughter in Florida. It was soooo delish! When I came back home, I could not find it in any NY stores nearby...so I purchased the case of 9 from Amazon. I will continue to buy it as long as they have it for sale...you'll LOVE IT!

product_title: Yogi Tea, Refreshing Mint Vital Energy, 16 Count (Pack of 6), Packaging May Vary
review_body:
I received this from Vine then put it away in my cupboards, forgetting about it until I got sick this week with a cold. There is nothing more soothing to me than some mint tea with honey when I'm not feeling well.

The aroma is wonderful. My husband, who pretty much only drinks green and jasmine tea, commented on how good it smelled. And while I don't know if it actually \\"revitalized\\" me, since I wasn't feeling well, I like the idea that it might. I also like that it has a black tea base, most mint teas are caffeine free and I do like a jolt of caffeine with my tea.

It's a good tea with a great taste and aroma and something I will buy once this runs out.

product_title: Baronet Coffee Fair Trade Organic French Roast Dark Roast (140 g), 18-Count Coffee Pods (Pack of 3)
review_headline: Great coffee, but bag that rips off consumers
review_body: This is a totally enjoyable dark roast coffee, but Baronet has chosen to sell it in a \\"fair trade\\" bag that contains 8 unprotected pods and drastically shortens the shelf life of the coffee once you open the bag.  If you drink 3+ cups of coffee a day and only drink this variety, this is fine because you'll use up all the coffee pods in less than 3 days.  But if you like to choose from several varieties of coffee pods, and drink only 1-2 cups a day,it's a definate minus and totally anti-consumer.  One of the most important advantages of single-pod packed coffee is the freshness and aroma that's assured when you tear open the bag.  This form of packaging is the equivilent of using your mother's Maxwell House coffee in a 1-pound can that often stayed around the house for months.    At least give the customer a choice of packagings!    SUGGESTION FOR CONSUMERS:  DON'T BUY ANY COFFEE SOLD IN THESE BAGS!!!  SUGGESTION FOR AMAZON:  DON'T SELL ANY POD COFFEE THAT'S NOT PACKAGED IN SEAL INDIVIDUAL SERVINGS!!!

review_body: I have switched the family over to these chips as a healthier alternative to the deep-fried corn chips.  They have great flavor and offer some significant nutritional advantages over the standard corn tortilla chip.  The Thai flavor is very good, my wife and kids all love the chips.

I compared it to pretzel salt I purchased from another site and to Kosher salt, and I have to say it appears to be Kosher salt. review_body: I ordered my regular chai and decided to try this.. glad I did.. it is so luscious!     Give it a try... especially if you like chocolate flavor without it being overpowering.

product_title: Powdered Peanut Butter - 85% Less Fat and Calories
review_headline: The diet answers you're looking for!
review_body: I really never thought I could find a PB substitute this amazing.  I have heard about this one for some time and found out that it was sold locally so I picked some up today.  I chose to try it first as the package suggests, 2 tbs of PB2 (45 cal) with 1 tbs of water.  I found it to be thick, creamy, and very good.  It has everything I enjoy about peanut butter except for the oil.  I just love it.  The possibilities for this stuff are endless.  You can put it in shakes, yogurt, mix it with jelly or honey, anything you like.  I have tried the Walden Farms Zero Calorie version and Better N' Butter in the past, but this really makes the cut.  It's great stuff.

product_title: Eddie's Corkscrews Vegetable Pasta Organic, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I eat this all the time to fill out Indian food. It is what we call in our house. . . . excellent lunch.

review_body: It can be hard to find Perciatelli or Bucatini in any brand, let alone a good brand like DeCecco.  This DeCecco far exceeds most of what you will find on the shelf at the supermarket and is even better than many more expensive brands.  A must for an Amatriciana sauce.  The box says to cook it 12 minutes, but if you like it al dente, and especially if you are going to finish it in a pan with the sauce, start checking it at about 9 minutes to make sure you don't overcook it.
