I hate the texture, it feels 100001% FAKE, It feels like melted gooey plastic in your mouth, and it tastes like a blob of yuck.

product_title: Charleston Seafood Oysters,  50 count box
review_body: I was recently in Charleston and loved the oysters so decided to order via Amazon. These are not the same type that I had so didn't know what to expect especially with the little info you get via the product description but am very happy!  Got order in less than 2 days very well packed with tons of ice packs. Took me longer to open the carton than it did to shuck an oyster and enjoy it. I rec'd 75 huge osters! 1 doa. Some were as big as my hand! You do need to do alot of cleaning. These are fresh out of the ocean as is. Do what I did and buy a good scrubber and a shucking kit. I ate the 1st 2 raw as I had never eaten they raw before and they were very good. I then steamed some and overall very good though of course not as good as going to Charleston and eating them just harvested.  You just can't beat the free shipping and when I went to the same seafood website they wanted $125 just for the shipping.   So expect a foam cooler filled with yummy oysters and enjoy! I wish the seller would provide more pics, a much better description and some instructions. I would if I were the seller. These are not shucked as stated in the description. They are live intact and well worth it. TY

review_body: I don't know how it happened but I have a son who isn't crazy about candy at all.  That is until he ran across the Charleston Chew Bars.  He loves the strawberry flavored ones. product_title: Sweetleaf Stevia Extract Clear Liquid 120ml (1x4 OZ)
review_headline: First time stevia user very pleased!
review_body: This was my first time buying a stevia product and I'm very pleased. I've been using it for over a month for our lunch time beverage like lemonade, jamaica tea, cucumber lemonade and ice tea. Nor my husband or my children have noticed the change from splenda to stevia. I have also used it in my morning oatmeal, coffee, and just today I baked some cornmeal blueberry muffins using stevia instead of sugar asked in the recipe and they came out great! product_title: Starbucks VIA Ready Brew Coffee
review_headline: I wasn't a big coffee drinker until I tried this. Now I'm hooked
review_body: I wasn't much of a coffee drinker before. Once in awhile I'd go to Starbucks to get an iced coffee but that was probably once a month and for awhile not having any coffee at all for a year. So it's not something I drank much.     I have tried some other instant coffees from my girlfriend but didn't like them so much.     Then we tried the Starbucks VIA. The flavor of it is perfect for what I like! It's so easy to make. The instant coffee tastes better than anything I can buy at Starbucks so I never go and buy a coffee. This saves me a lot of money.     Since I don't drink much coffee, one cup of this has enough \\"kick\\" to keep me up all day long.     Now I drink a cup of coffee but I go running and it makes me feel like I can run much longer.     So I would highly recommend this. Again I wasn't a two cup of coffee per day person but now 2-3 times a week, I enjoy a cup of Starbucks VIA.

review_body: My husband and I bought this tea, from Nob Hill, with the purpose of gaining a health benefit. We thought that this would be a great product but for us, it was the opposite.  Both my husband and I got sick after trying this product for a few days. We had to see the doctor whom told us to stop using this immediately. We seem to be allergic or  have an adverse reaction. My husband described his symptoms as feeling as if he had strep throat and I would describe my symptoms as burning throat and muscle spasms in my throat. I have discarded this product and will never use again. I wish that the outcome would have been different but for us, this was not our  \\"cup of tea\\".

product_title: Hot-Kid Baby Mum-Mum Original Flavor Rice Biscuit
review_body:
My 6 month old daughter LOVES these. I was, at first a little apprehensive to give them to her, as she gums them so hard she often breaks pieces off of them. I used to sit right next to her as she gnawed on them but as she is getting older she is chewing them more and can navigate them quite easily. They arent very messy, in my opinion, and are much easier to clean then the biter biscuits or arrowroot cookies.

She likes all of the flavors, especially the veggie. She actually kicks her legs excitedly when I get them out of the package for her.

I find they are cheaper to buy in bulk on Amazon than at Target, etc.

OVerall a great product for eating at home.

product_title: Plum Organics Baby Food, Sweet Potato, Corn & Apple, 4.22 Ounce Pouches (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Our Son Loves Them, Very Convenient
review_body: We love these baby food things in a little pouch. Sooooo much easier to feed to a baby or toddler on the go. Our son loves sucking the mish mash out and we are pleased that it is both organic and healthy with nothing added. He'll eat the sweet potato and other veggie pouches when he is more hungry, but probably because of the sweetness of fruit, he far prefers the fruit mish mashes to the veggie ones. For smaller children, not good to let them handle it themselves, because they love to squeeze it, which gets things everywhere. But older ones can feed to themselves. I like the 3 oz size rather than the bigger one like this (4 oz) because it assures that he will eat all or most of it in one sitting rather than having to save some for later. They only keep for 24 hours after opening and need to be refrigerated if not eaten, but then he doesn't like them cold, so they have to be warmed up a bit in warm water to reuse, so a bit of a hassle. You can also take the 3 oz size on airplanes without having to have it tested for explosives - not the case with the bigger 4 oz pouches. I also like that it is BPA free. If your little one likes them, ordering in bulk and with subscribe and save makes them much cheaper than at the store.

product_title: Colavita Extra Virgin Olive Oil Special, 17 Ounce (Pack of 2)
review_body: I have not purchased this oil in this container format, but have purchased in a smaller format in the past.  It's a very good buy for the money, but let's be clear that it is not a \\"Good\\" olive oil.  True, it is extra virgin and cold pressed, but remember that any oil from large brands like Colavita, Bertolli, etc.. is filtered and mixed which means that it is not the way nature intended it.  My recommendation is that this is a great oil for cooking, and frying;fry an egg in Olive oil and you will never eat eggs another way again.  But if you want to make a simple greek salad for example, where olive and salt is the only dressing, you should go for the premium stuff that you'll find at your local gourmet food shop or in a meditteranean market.  My personal favorite (and yes I am biased because of my background) is Greek Olive oil from Messinia (southern peloponesus), but there are some varieties from Crete that are excellent as well.  Try to find one that is from a single source (meaning that it is not mixed with different varieties of olive oils to make a consistent taste), it's okay if your olive oil is different from one batch to the other, because that is natural.

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Tea
review_headline: A Visit to the Peppermint Room
review_body:
Several years ago, I went on a tour of the Celestial Seasonings tea factory in Boulder, Colorado. The guide showed us the bales of tea as they arrived, machines that ground and mixed the tea, and a machine that put the tea in tea bags. The tour included a visit to the room where the peppermint tea was stored. Our guide told us that peppermint was stored separately so that it would not contaminate the other teas. He did not tell us what was to come.

The doorway into the peppermint room was surrounded by bright red stripes. This should have served as a warning to us. We all innocently strolled into the peppermint room. The smell of peppermint was overpowering. It entered my nose, my head, my lungs, and then my whole being was infused with peppermint. What a rush! The crowd stampeded out of the room in a hurry. For the rest of the day and into the next, all I could smell and taste was the mint.

I am now addicted to [[ASIN:B000E63L8S Celestial Seasonings Peppermint Tea]]. Every time I have some, I am reminded of that fateful day in Boulder. The events of that day have changed my life forever. Amazingly, the tea is still legal, openly sold in stores and on the Internet. I think that the tea is great, but then again I am not an unbiased observer. On your next visit to Boulder, take the tour. Or go a safer route; buy the tea from Amazon.

Also, for how it's marketed (look at that box)... I'd like it to produce a healthier meal. Your healthy future does not involve fried food. I ate half the batch. product_title: Blue Sky Cafe Energy, 15 Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I like the flavor, I like the fact that a whole can only has 200 calories, is enriched with vitamins, taurine, and potassium, calcium, and ginseng.
It is low in fat and sodium.
It is fairly low in sugar, but does contain glucose.
Note: 1 can is two servings, each serving contains 100 calories

This review is my test-drive of the product.
I had a long weekend with alot of exercise, and not enough sleep. On the first day I drank a can after lunch, when I normally start to get sleepy. I felt energized and wanted to be productive. I did not feel jittery, but I am used to drinking coffee.

The second day was the real test of the product, I had less than 4 hours of sleep, I ate a light breakfast, went on a quick 2 1/2 mile walk (under 38 minutes, and I am 52 years old in fair shape, but not very athletic)

I drank a can of this about an hour after exercising, in a short while, I felt less depleted from the exercise, alert, and mentally focused.

Just a quick highlight on some of the ingredients
Glucose is one of the quickest sugars that our bodies process, it is vital to normal brain function and is the fuel our minds run on.
Potassium, calcium, and sodium are vital to balancing our electrolytes.
This product actually has a better ratio of sugar to potassium than many sports drinks.

I drank my can of the Caf'e Energy at approx 10 am on the second day, at 3 pm that afternoon, I still had energy and my mind was still focused.

Overall I highly recommend this product and I will be using it to refresh my mind and body after exercise in the future.

product_title: Huy Fong, Sriracha Hot Chili Sauce, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Great stuff for that authentic Thai and Vietnamese heat
review_body:
This Huy Fong rooster brand sriracha sauce is very popular in Asian communities. Its distinctive shape and green top is the kind you see in Vietnamese, Thai, and Chinese restaurants all over. Named after the Thai city of Sri Racha, this bottle is on almost every table of every Southeast Asian restaurant I've ever eaten at, next to the soy sauce and napkins. The squeeze bottle and pointed nozzle makes dispensing very easy. The sauce is smooth, so a gentle squeeze will give you control and precision. It looks like ketchup coming out, but is a bit more viscous.

It's great on chicken or beef satay skewers and just about any food. It made with chili peppers and garlic and has a wonderful flavor on its own, not just heat. I enjoy it regularly with Vietnamese beef pho. It dissolves easily into the soup and adds a wallop. It's hot, but not insanely so, and the heat doesn't stay on your tongue and keep burning you like habeneros. American-styled hot sauces like [[ASIN:B001SB34JE Trappeys]] and [[ASIN:B0004LZSYS TABASCO brand Pepper Sauce]] are typically very drippy with a dominant vinegar taste and smell. Sriracha is not.

The product contains preservatives, so it needs no refrigeration. Refrigerating can cause the ink on the label to come off over time.

product_title: Sushi Sonic Pickled Ginger (No Added Sugar), 35-Ounce Bag
review_headline: Different! And not in a good way!
review_body:
If you are used to eating the pink colored (artificial) ginger sushi slices, you will be disappointed with this product, just like I was. The reason I tried it was the fact that they do not add artificial colorants to it. Nor do they add any sugar. But!!! They add tons of salt! It is so salty, I can't eat it at all. I put it into a big bucket of water, to let the salt leak out. So far, after 5 rinses, it is getting milder. But, the salt takes away from the natural gingery taste. Why oh why did they have to do that? If I have to choose between a vinegar-sugar mix or a vinegar-salt mix, I will pick the sugar anytime, when it comes to pickled ginger. By the way, the saltwater-vinegar blend makes up 10 % of the product weight indicated (I drained and measured it). I now replaced it with a sherry vinegar plus some sugar. I'll let it sit for some days in the fridge and see if it becomes edible. In conclusion, this was not a great buy, especially when adding the cost of the bottle of vinegar (5.90) and the sugar, and the time to work it up.
Unless you like it extremely salty, in which case, you'll be really happy!
One more thing: what do you do with all that ginger in a plastic pouch, once you open it? This is terrible packaging! How about a jar with a screwcap? That would definitely help with storage! (I had to find myself a glass jar to put it into.)

review_body: My wife and I love this tea.  She is a tea drinker, keeping all kinds of different teas in the house so she has what she wants when the mood strikes her.  I love this tea in particular because of the warm wonderful feeling I get as it goes down. Mmmmmmmm. Our local store stopped carrying it so here I am on my old stand-by.  Maybe I should just stay home and buy everything through Amazon. Try it with a bit of stevia powder.

product_title: Honeyland Manuka Comb Honey, 7-Ounce Tub (Pack of 2)
review_body: I have recently been introduced to manuka honey and I have tried 5 kinds to check the results. as I have chronuic fatigue and a severe neuritis.  This has helped immediately.  I take only 1/2 teaspoon 2 times a day.  I am stronger, my memory is better and chronic inflammation is healing.  I am SO PLEASED!!! The item was shipped quickly and the price was the best I could find after checking other sites. Absolutely fantastic product.

product_title: Legacy Valley Certified Gluten-Free Whole Grain Rolled Oats, 48-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 2)
review_headline: great gluten free oats at a great price!
review_body: I finally found gluten free oats that have just the right consistency and flavor, along with a price that is not outrageous as many brands on the market. These oats have been great for cooking breakfast oatmeal and oatmeal cookies. They do not have a smoky flavor that many other brands possess. At $17 for two large bags it is definitely worth the price.

product_title: Annie's Homegrown Organic Bunny Classic Crackers
review_body: I MAILED THESE TO MY DAUGHTER AS PART OF A CARE PACKAGE, AND ANNIE'S CHEDDAR BUNNIES WERE HER FAVORITE THING.  SHE CALLED TO SAY THANK YOU FOR THE BUNNIES, DELICIOUS AND SOMEHOW COMFORTING. THEY MADE HER DAY.

product_title: Wolfgang Puck Coffee K-Cups for Keurig Brewers
review_body:
I tried this coffee on a half dozen quests this weekend and they all loved it. For those that like their coffee mild, I brewed 7 oz cups. For those of us that like it bold, I brewed 5 oz cups.

As an earlier posted noted, it does have a slightly flavored quality to the taste that makes it stand out from other coffees. The taste isn't obvious enough to turn off drinkers who want their coffee \\"regular and black\\" but strong enough to note for those of us that pay attention.

I plan on trying all of Wolfgang's line. Wish he'd offer a variety pack.

product_title: White Shirataki Noodles 7.0 Oz Made in Japan
review_headline: Excellent, but you have to know what you are buying
review_body: I read with amusement those who gave it one star complaining of the odor and flavor.  Obviously they did not know what they are buying.  Shiritaki noodles MUST BE RINSED thoroughly before use unless you really like the smell and taste of old fish.  They don't contain any fish, but they do smell like it. I can't imagine trying to eat them without rinsing, but there again, as you are supposed to rinse them.. no problem.  I found them to be really high quality noodles, that taste literally like nothing at all except the sauce you put them in.  Boil them for about 5 minutes in any sauce at all and they are not slimy at all and quite good.  I have used them to help me lose quite a lot of weight and they are very satisfying and set well on my stomach.  I highly suggest these to anybody who would like to have pasta now and then but are trying to lose weight or have blood sugar problems.  I have made these for my mother who is a fragile diabetic (meaning just about anything puts her sugar way up) and they did not have an impact on her blood sugar at all.

product_title: Glutino Gluten Free Crackers, 4.4 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is the closest thing I have found to a \\"water cracker\\" that's gluten free. There isn't any seasoning that would detract from or clash with whatever you put on this cracker, but for that same reason it doesn't really work well as a stand-alone, unless you just prefer a bland cracker. It's not at all salty. Texture...well, it breaks a little too easily, and when you chew it, it feels more powdery in your mouth than what you'd probably think of for a cracker, but it's not bad.  Of the Glutino crackers, we like [[ASIN:B001CWSK98 Glutino Gluten Free Multigrain Crackers, 4.4 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)]] best, because the fennel in the multigrain gives it a little more texture and taste.    This is the only brand of GF cracker that my gluten-eating family will eat, other than [[ASIN:B00250HYA2 Sesmark Ancient Grains Chips With Parmesan Herb, 3.5 Ounce Bags (pack of 12)[Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging]]] and [[ASIN:B000ET93N2 Sesmark Savory Thins, Original, 3.2-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)[Amazon Frustration-Free Packaging]]] -- but Sesmark isn't marketed as GF, just as \\"no gluten ingredients.\\" (I'm Celiac and never have reacted to Sesmark, but YMMV.)

product_title: Colavita Extra Virgin Olive Oil Special, 17 Ounce (Pack of 2)
review_body: Always love this olive oil!  A staple at our house.

product_title: Bergin Nut Company Oat Bran Packages, 32-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: It was exactly as described, and arrived quickly, and in perfect condition. I am very pleased!

product_title: Come With Me Kitty Harness and Bungee Leash
review_body: My cat was spooked while sitting next to me in our back yard, wearing this thing. He escaped in 2 seconds flat and is still missing six hours later. Useless. As effective as tying him with dental floss.

product_title: Country Time Lemonade
review_body: Great taste, but it's bright yellow!  Artificial colors have been banned in Britain and now require a warning label in Europe.  Couldn't they make Country Time Lemonade with natural coloring so that it isn't potentially harmful to our children?  It would also look more like the \\"real thing\\".

product_title: South Beach Living Snack Pack Delights Dark Chocolate Covered Soynuts, 7-Count Boxes (Pack of 5)
review_body: These are the BEST! Great taste, low carb, healthy snack! It's real chocolate, too.People may hesitate to buy because they think 'diet food'. Not so! It's the real thing and delicious.

product_title: Keurig, The Original Donut Shop, K-Cup packs
review_body: I love Donut Shop coffee and Amazon has the best price for auto-delivery!  and so convenient!

product_title: FiberPlus Antioxidant Bars, Dark Chocolate Almond, 5 - 1.2 oz  Bars per Box, (Pack of 12) (Package may vary)
review_body: Great taste,easy small enough to put in lunch for an energy snack, has dark chocolate (supposed to be better for you than milk chocolate), and as a senior heaven knows I need plenty of fiber!!!

product_title: Roland Eggplant Pulp, 6lbs. 4.5oz Cans(Pack of 2)
review_body: Good product, excellent for baba ghanoush.  As previous reviewer states, these are a couple of very large cans, but freezes very well in ziplock bags for portioning.  Get some tahini, parsley, roasted (or not) garlic and lemon juice, and you've got a killer dip before you know it.  Maybe not quite as good as charring your own over a charcoal fire, but this is close, especially considering the time saved.  I hit my baba with a couple of drops of liquid smoke to compensate.

product_title: Cherry Queen Cherry Liquor Pralines Gift Box Net Wt 150 g (5.25 OZ)
review_body: This product was delivered in a box without gel packs in the middle of August. The chocolates are in a matal tin which helped to create an oven for chocolates. The resulting mixture was interesting and expensive. My wife however didn't understand it.  Their add should tell which month to ship to which state or advertise them as roasted chocolates.

product_title: Kopiko Coffee Candy 25 Pcs
review_body:
This candy comes very close in taste to a real cup of double latte, though a tad sweeter. This does contain caffeine, so its not a decaf alternative to coffee, and its definitely not recommended for kids.

Pros:
1. Great tasting coffee candy; a good caffeine fix
2. Hard toffee, so it lasts a long time
3. 20 calories per toffee, which is not too bad
4. Individually wrapped pieces

Cons:
1. All the cons of regular coffee; overuse can cause headaches, dehydration, digestive dependence, restlessness, sleep disruption, stained teeth, bad breath and caffeine crashes
2. Very hard, brittle candy that is sometimes broken with sharp edges; I've hurt my tongue on occasion
3. A little sweeter than I'd like

I ordered a 20-pack from Asian's Best through Amazon. Great value at roughly 2 bucks a bag including shipping.

product_title: Donut House Collection Coffee, Keurig K-Cups, 72 Count
review_body: BUYERS BEWARE - I guess it's my fault I really thought when I ordered this coffee I was gettinng TWO BOXES of coffee for 22.50 like almost every other coffee dealer on Amazon sells this stuff for. But this guy sells this coffee for 22.50 for ONE!!!!! box of coffee.When it arrived at my house I asked my wife where the other box was and she said: \\"Thats It just one box arrived!\\" I looked my order over and sure enough he does sell it for 1 box of coffee for 22.50 making this probably the MOST expensive k-cup coffee on Amazon. So shame on me for not looking the order over before I purchased it. If you look at all the other sellers, their coffee is 23.00 for TWO BOXES OF 25 count k-cups. Thats 50 k-cups. This guy only gives you 25 k-cups for 22.50 which is EXTREMELY EXPENSIVE!!!!! congratulations you fooled me, but I hope this review warns others off.

product_title: Vruit Vegetable and Fruit Juice, 8 Ounce Cartons (Pack of 27)
review_body: This juice is amazing, has a serving of fruit and vegetables in every serving.  It tastes amazing, and no added sugar makes me feel great when I am drinking it.  I feel healthy when I drink this yummy juice.  I find it hard some days to get a serving of fruit and vegetables in my diet, so this juice really helps out.  I use to get V8 splash but it is way way too sweet, so this is my drink of choice.  If you have kids, I dont, but if you do they will love this and it will be a way to sneak those pesky fruits and veggies into their diet and they wont even know.     The only problem that I find with this juice is it is not organic which makes me sad, but it is all natural and there is no added sugar so that helps that fact that it is not organic.

product_title: Jelly Belly White Chocolate Dutch Mints,  10-Pound Bag
review_body: We used the mints for a candy bar at my daughter's wedding.  They were wonderful!  They tasted good and everyone loved them.  I wish I could have purchased a second box but they were gone.  I'd definitely do that again.  They were perfect for the wedding!

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Cacao Nibs
review_body: This is the best raw cocoa out there. I recently transitioned to eating raw and use this for everything. My favorite is simply fresh strawberries topped with some cocoa powder and stevia! I use it to make chocolate milk for my kids and MANY other fabulous recipes raw and unraw.

product_title: Pocky Chocolate Almond Crush
review_body: While the price is high, my daughters love this, so I am buying it as a stocking stuffer.  If you can find it in a local store, you'd be better off buying it there.  Kids do love these and it's worth seeing their faces light up for Pocky, but shop around for a better price.

product_title: I.M. Healthy Soy Nut Butter, Unsweetened Chunky, 15-Ounce Plastic Jars (Pack of 6)
review_body: Soynut butter does not taste like peanut butter but is pretty good in its own right. We are a peanut free home due to allergies,and soy nut butter is a good alternative. This brand is high quality. No added sugars and great crunch. Tastes great on apples. Also one gets the great properties that soy contains.

product_title: Scott's Cakes Chocolate Fudge Lovers Delight Cake
review_body: I had originally given this 1 star, since my cake wasn't in the best shape when I got it.  But, Scott contacted me and made it up by sending me the dollar amount in cookies to replace my cakes.  The cookies arrived very quickly and were quite tasty and moist.  I will definitely purchase from this company again.

product_title: Altoids Mints PACK_12
review_body: We feed these to our horses so I needed to get them in bulk. Shipping and cost perfect.

product_title: Libbys 100% Pure Pumpkin, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: My mother has used this for over 50 years. It is by far the best.

product_title: Imagine Organic Lentil Apple Soup, 14.5-Ounce Can (Pack of 12)
review_body:
I did like the soup, but it is mushy. No chunks of apple, carrots, celery etc can be seen as in the picture on the can.
So if I buy it again, it will be more to use as a base, as I will add my own non-mushy fruits and vegees.
I paid $1.00 a can at \\"Grocery Outlet\\" in Bremerton, WA.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_headline: Taste Great and is good for you!
review_body: You keep hearing about how good white tea is for you and I've been looking for a nice tasting white tea for awhile.  I have had no success, until now.  My first k cup was over ice for iced tea.  It was surprising!  I'm from the south where iced tea is a way of life and it's drank very sweet. Did I say I pretty much have a glass of iced tea nearby all the time.  So, when I say my first white tea k cup made iced tea, this is \\"the\\" big test.  Oh, yea we're talking straight, no sugar, sweetener of any kind.  K cup medium strength on the rocks.  It was excellent!!! Refreshing, lightly sweet, smooth and refreshing almost a \\"clean\\" taste with the gentle definite taste of white tea.  I shared some of the K cups with my Dad, he had been looking for a good white tea also.  He made his hot at the medium strength setting, nothing added just tea, and he enjoy it very much.  (My dad isn't going to say he loves anything, especially if someone else found it!) I know he really liked it, he was drinking a cup it his quite morning while watching recorded West Wing.  That's as good as any Good Housekeeping seal of approval.  I and my dad highly recommend this tea.  It is a definite must try.  This is my very first online review on anything!!  That's how good it is.  Try it!

product_title: White Tangerine Tea, 30 individually packaged nylon Infuser Bags
review_body: This is good, refreshing, and tasty tea.  It has good flavor, hot or iced.  It is one of the best teas I've tasted.

product_title: Happy Baby Organic Baby Food 3 Hearty Meals
review_body: My daughter loves this food. This is her favorite of all the HappyBaby Organic Baby Food. I make all of her fruits and vegetables but decided not to continue this with the meats. She did great transitioning from the food I make at home to this packaged product so it must taste pretty fresh.

product_title: Donut Shop , K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_headline: Not much taste to this one! Xbold Coffee People Donut Shop Coffee
review_body: Not much taste to this one. the donut shop medium roast extra bold was not that good to me as i am a coffee lover. i will not be ordering it again.

product_title: Vita Coco Coconut Water
review_headline: tastes almost like fresh out of a coconut
review_body: I bought these coconut water two times and both the times its taste was very close to the fresh coconut water. Only negative thing is one of the container has rotten water which could be prevented during packaging.

product_title: Good Sense Black Currants,  4 Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: These are a good snack food in convenient 4 ounce resealable packagess.  They can be eaten plain, or can be added to trail mix, cereal, mixed fruit, etc.  Black currants are generally considered a heart healthy product, and they contain significant amounts of fiber and vitamin C.  The main complaint that I have is that they are not 100 percent natural as inferred on the label.  The listed ingredients are black currants, glucose/fructose syrup, lemon juice concentrate, and palm kernel oil.  They are a soft dried fruit with the present ingredients and packaging.  They have an expiration date on the label which in my case is about 6 months in the future.

product_title: Dentyne Fire Spicy Cinnamon Sugarless Chewing Gum, 12-Piece, 3-Count Multi-Packs (Pack of 20)
review_body: I first purchased a multi-pack of Dentyne Fire Spicy gum over a year ago.  When I was nearing the end, I immediately returned to Amazon to purchase another multi-pack.  It is the only gum I chew, and the Amazon.com price is much less than in my local store, plus I am not always running out and having to remember to buy more.  Highly recommended if you like \\"hot\\" gum!

product_title: Kettle Potato Chips, 8 Count
review_body: These are the best unsalted chips around and we have tried many.  They have the best potato flavor.  They came when you said they would.

product_title: Magnum Exotics Kona Blend Coffee, Whole Bean, 16 Ounce
review_body: This is a very good KONA blend coffee and compares to others that cost twice as much or more!  I was using Kona blend from a small company - Thanksgiving coffee Co, Fort Bragg, CA., but their price (about $18/lb. + shipping)is quite  a bit more, and its sold in 12 ounce bags. This coffee is just as good. Plus as a Prime member the shipping is free............

product_title: Maxwell House Cafe Collection House Blend Decffeinated Coffee (Medium), 16-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers (Pack of 2)
review_body: I recently gave up caffeine, but not coffee.  I wanted a great tasting decaf for my Tassimo brewer.  Unfortunately the only two options are the swill they package as Maxwell House and Gevalia - though I suspect they're the same coffee with different labels - they both taste exactly the same and that's NOT a good thing!    This decaf is so bad, it has forced me to do the unthinkable ... give up on my beloved Tassimo machine and switch to a Keurig brewer instead.  My Tassimo and all of the caffeinated discs are packaged up in the Keurig box and sitting in the basement now.    Tassimo you have lost a fan and loyal user of your product because you failed me in a major area - providing a great tasting decaffeinated coffee option.

product_title: Fortuin Wilhelmina Peppermints, 7-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: I don't care for peppermints, but my Dutch girlfriend grew up eating Wilhelmina peppermints and had been talking a lot about how she missed them, so I decided to find her some online! Since Amazon offers free shipping on this item (it was around $30 when I bought it) and any other website I found had such expensive shipping, it cost around $10 anywhere else to get 3.5 ounces of these things! Amazon offered 24x the amount of mints for only 3x the price so I decided to just go for it and buy the whole 12 pack. I didn't realize until it arrived its more than 5 pounds of mints! I am very pleased with the amount for the cost on Amazon.    About the actual mints- The size surprised me- they were around the size of a quarter and fairly thick. For the taste- I don't like mints, so I'll give my girlfriend's opinion here. She says they are the best mints she's ever tried! I read the ingredients and the flavoring comes from pure peppermint oil- no artificial flavors, and the list of ingredients is short (generally the shorter the list the healthier and less processed stuff goes in it), so if you like mints these would be great to try. From my online research I have to say the smaller containers of mints generally have much cuter packaging(some are in a nice roll that looks sort of like a pack of rollos, and some are in tins with blue and white pictures of stereotypical dutch things like windmills-- these mints are just loose in bags). My girlfriend said the mints she's had in the past had the design imprinted in the center of the circle like a coin, but these were just plain round circles with the queen's head on it. These may not have the best packaging or the coolest design, but if you primarily care about the taste of the mints, these are by far the greatest deal!

product_title: JOLT Hyper-Caffeinated Gum, Spearmint ,12 Packs
review_body: I wish they would go back to selling this at your local Super America stores and Walgreens but they dont. Sad because it works wonders, unfortunately, my kids say i'm addicted. So needless to say, i hope amazon never runs out. i chewed it years ago and then found it at a little rinky dink store by my new home, bought it all, they ordered it just for me and sold it at 1.79 a pack, well needless to say once again they couldnt get it so i found it on amazon, so all you people out there that love it save some for me, i know get it shipped monthly!!!! Yippie for jolt gum!!!

product_title: Pacari Manabi Chocolate Bar
review_body: The times when the only way to get incredible chocolate was to buy european confections are gone.  Now you can enjoy this delicious chocolate bar made right there where the cacao beans were ALWAYS being grown and be totally satisfied, and if flavor is not enough for you, your soul can be happy to knowing that Pacari cares for the environment and is socially responsible as well. I love this chocolate bar!

product_title: Lindt Petite Dessert Truffle Cake, 5.3-Ounce Bars (Pack of 5)
review_body: Most of their chocolate is fantastic but this is off the hook. You'll have to decide for your self if you love it as much as I do.

product_title: Good Earth Green Tea, Jasmine, 20-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is good tea. I like the individual tea bag wraps because it keeps it very fresh. I love the taste of the green tea in this product but the Jasmine is lacking. There's a slight Jasmine presence but not that lush, full bodied Jasmine taste and smell. I once had the best Jasmine tea at a local downtown Los Angeles dim sum restaurant and have been searching for that taste ever since. If anyone has a Jasmine tea recommendation I'd sure like to know about it.

product_title: Hot Lix Cinnamon Flavored Toothpicks 20ct
review_headline: My Favorite Toothpick of ALL TIME
review_body: These are by far my favorite toothpicks of all time.  They are solid and full of (spicy) cinnamon flavor.  The flavor reminds me of the old-time red-hots.  If I have any complaint, it might be that they are a tad too thick...sometimes difficult to wedge between your teeth.  Otherwise, though, I highly recommend them.

product_title: Gevalia Caramel Latte Macchiato (8 Servings), 16-Count T-Discs for Tassimo Coffeemakers (Pack of 2)
review_body:
This is a great find! Can hardly say the word Macchiato but the flavor is easy on the taste buds. This is my newest favorite. If, you have read any of my grocery reviews you already know I am the biggest fan of Tassimo and all of their products.
If, you love caramel, then this is for you! Be sure an order 2 packs if you can...you will not be sorry.

A gal on the Internet told everyone about this find and she was so right!

product_title: Sanissimo Oven Baked Corn Tostadas (20 Count)
review_body: I recently took a trip to Mexico, and discovered these. They are wonderful,I searched for them in the states, and havent found them anywhere. They have chips called salmas, that are individually packaged, with sea salt. completely healthy. I reccomend this product to everyone, i cant wait for them to make it to the states!! :)

product_title: Elyon Marshmallows, Fat Free and Gluten Free, 7-Ounce Packages (Pack of 4)
review_body: I searched for VEGAN MARSHMALLOWS and these came up but they contain gelatin- clearly it states it in the decription but if you one-click quickly you might not notice.    Marshmalows were fused together and it was messy and annoying to pull apart.    Not as tasty as normal marshmallows but thats just an opinion.

product_title: Stonewall Kitchen Key Lime Cheese Ball Mix, 2.1 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I got this , 6 Boxes total. Easy to make.  All You need is 1 box of this, & 8 Ounce room temp cream cheese.  You mix up the herbs and cream cheese, place in saran wrap, and form it into a ball.  Let it sit overnight, to let herbs set in, then right before serving, roll the ball in the crust.  Serve it with grahams, crackers, and it taste like Key Lime cheesecake.  Great Party food, Or snack to watch a Movie.  Would serve probably 6 people.  It's Very Good, and easy to make.  Good deal for 6 Appetizers or snacks. If you Like Key Lime cheesecake, you'll love this!

product_title: igourmet Dorothea (Goat Gouda with Basil Oil and Potato Skins) (7.5 ounce)
review_body: This is my new favorite cheese!  It's deliciously smooth, mild, and creamy with a wonderful flavor that to me tastes of basil even though there is no basil in this cheese.  I've mostly eaten this with crackers or on it's own.  I keep meaning to see if it melts well but I end up eating it all before I get the chance.  I've also served this cheese to many friends and it's always a big hit.

product_title: Nutiva Hi Fiber Hemp Protein Powder - 16 OZ
review_body:
I play a lot of tennis in summer and do good amount of lifting when the weather gets colder. Turning 40 I started to notice that my recovery time gets longer, and I often still feel it the next day. After doing some research on the Internet I decided to try protein + glutamine/creatine powder. ([[ASIN:B001FA0XDI Optimum Nutrition Creatine Glutamine Taurine, Wild Berry, 1.32 Pound (Pack of 2)]]) It really works. I drink 2 tea spoonful of each mixed with orange or mango (my favorite) juice after workout and always ready for more the next day.
It also ensures that I always have enough fiber in my diet.
I guess people complaining about taste of hemp protein tried mixing it with water - really bad idea. It's too grainy to stay suspended in water. Use thicker juice or milk.

product_title: Extra Dessert Delights Sugarfree Gum Key Lime Pie Flavored Gum 15 Stick per Pack, 10 Pack
review_body: Like other reviewers, I had low expectations for this gum, but was happily wrong.  I love key lime pie, and lime flavor in general.  When first chewed, this gum has the tangy-bite of key lime, with a creamy sweetness, and a hint of graham cracker crust flavor.  After the initial flavor burst fades, there is that surge of artificial sugary-sweetness that occurs with some brands/flavors of sugarfree chewing gum, but the surge isn't as overwhelming or long lasting as it is with some sugarfree gums.  Once that fades, the gum has a mellow, subtle, lime zest flavor.  I really like this gum.

product_title: Walden Farms Caesar Dressing Calorie Free, Carb Free, Fat Free, Sugar Free
review_body: This is surprisingly good! I would never guess it was zero calorie(or even light/lo-cal) if someone had given it to me without telling me. It is creamy and flavorful.  I would eat this even if I wasn't on a diet.  I like this flavor much better than their ranch, although the ranch is not bad either.  I am looking forward to trying walden farms other products.

product_title: Haribo Gummi Candy
review_body: These Haribo candies are so good. If you like sweet and sour these are the ones. Great prices at Amazon.com. Thank you for carrying this product.

product_title: Glass The Original Dirty Sue Premium Olive Juice, 12.69-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4)
review_body: Like others have mentioned, I frequently ran out of olive juice before running out of olives and was so grateful to find Dirty Sue. I have tried other brands of olive juice and many have had a fake, metallic taste to them. Dirty Sue tastes fabulous and makes a great dirty martini. We no longer worry about running out of the juice in the olive jar. I will be ordering more of this!!

product_title: Mariani California Apricots, 6-Ounce Units (Pack of 12)
review_body: I am very pleased with the quality of these dried California apricots.  Dried California apricots are difficult to locate in the stores anymore.  You can find \\"dried apricots\\" or \\"dried Turkish apricots\\" which are often good but are a sweeter variety without the tang I enjoy. These add a nice counterpoint in a sweet baked item and are delicious cut up in hot cereal/oatmeal.    I am very pleased to be able to purchase these through Amazon.  Previously, Amazon sold another brand on the subscribe and save program but they were discontinued.  Mariani brand is even better!

product_title: Albanese Assorted Swedish Fish, Sugar Free, 1-Pound Bags (Pack of 10)
review_body: Tastes more like gummy bears than Swedish fish. Extremely gassy if you have more than 3!

product_title: Legacy Valley Gluten-Free Granola, Cutbank Cranberry, 10-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
review_body: I used to live in Bozeman, MT where these are made. Legacy Valley's products are good, but not well preserved. I bought some of this granola from the local food co-op, and it was rancid. (Obviously bad smelling and tasting). However, this doesn't happen with all packages. Just a warning-I would refrigerate it as it seems prone to spoiling. Their cookies are like that too-- delicious, but often already spoiled when I buy them in the town they're made in.

product_title: Erin Baker's Breakfast Cookies, 3 Ounce
review_body: I have never been more pleased with a purchase. It was my lucky day when I found these little beauties.

product_title: Two 12-oz Canisters of White Chocolate Amaretto Cookies
review_body: I got one of these in a gift basket with a bunch of other junk.  I thought I'd give it a try with my black morning coffee.  Holy #$% this is a good cookie!  Right now I'm scouring the internet trying to find them.  It appears they sell out quickly before Christmas and don't ship between May and October due to heat.    Dunk for 4 seconds in your black coffee and munch, fuhgetaboutit!  I've got to start stocking up!

product_title: Zevia All Natural Soda, Dr. Zevia, 12 Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_body: Dr. Zevia has to be may favorite of all of the Zevia flavors (and I really do like them all).  I think it tastes just like Diet Dr. Pepper.  And the stevia aftertaste is very minimal... more so than the other Zevia flavors.  I would highly recommend Dr. Zevia (plus, the name is so cute!).

product_title: Aromat Seasoning for Meat (Knorr) 3 oz (85g)
review_body: I have written cookbooks and used this product in most of my recipes for years.  I believe this is the best all purpose seasoning on the market. Lulu Grace

product_title: Little i City Girl Sugar Free Chocolate Mint, 0.28-Ounce Flip Top Mirrored Tins (Pack of 12)
review_body: I was a little disappointed in them!  They are so tiny, they don't give much of  a taste of chocolate!  The case with the mirror inside is adorable, but, I   would have much preferred more of a chocolate taste.  I give it 2 stars!   Ginny Meyer

product_title: Mementa White Tea, 100 Count (Pack of 8)
review_body: I've been ordering this item for about 3 years. It has always been a consistent quality individually packaged white tea. I love all teas but this is my main-staple-every-day-tea. I was a little disappointed the organic version was not available. This particular order came in a timely manner and in good condition. However, the way the individual packets are sealed, have caught the corners and the strings of some of the tea bags causing them to tear. I hope this packaging problem is fixed by the next time I have to order. Maybe it is just this one box?

product_title: Todd's Incorporated Cholesterol Free Pretzels
review_body: All 36 bags had an expiration date of 1/31/2010. I received them on 9/9/2010!! I simply will not eat anything that far past the due date.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee, Kona Blend Medium K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50)
review_body: Wonderful coffee for our Keurig coffeemaker. We look forward to the shipment every two months. Great product and excellent shipping time. Thanks!

product_title: Wild Ride Beef Jerky Cowboy Strips
review_body: These are excellent cuts of meat, soft and chewy.  Bold pepper taste but not overpowering.  I get a bag once a month on the subscribe and save offer.

product_title: Newman's Own Organic Special Blend Decaf K-cup for Keurig Brewers, 12-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is a medium roast coffee.  I think it has a rich and smooth taste.  I would recommend.

product_title: General Mills Honey Nut Chex, 40 Ounce
review_headline: The cereal itself is great, great deal < $8
review_body:
I love the taste of Chex, but keep in mind that 40 ounces is less than 3 normal (14 oz) boxes. Check the price... this value pack is no value.

edit: when i purchased 11/4/2010, the price was 19.75. Now that is $7.18, it is a excellent buy now

product_title: Natural Brew Outrageous Ginger Ale, 12-Ounce (Pack of 24)
review_body: I actually love the bite this ginger ale has.  Especially since it's a natural product, which is another bonus.  However, I do find it too sweet.  Has good fizz & love the bottled format.  (I prefer to avoid aluminum.)

product_title: Dilmah Premium 100% Pure Ceylon Tea, 50-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: My husband and I returned from Africa where we were introduced to Dilmah Premiun Ceylon.  We have been tea drinkers for many years, but had never enjoyed our morning cup of tea like we did there.  On our third day in Cape Town the hotel resteraunt ran out of their supply and we were given another brand of tea...which we didn't even finish.  Instead we went to a local grocery store and purchased these tea bags for our use.  We will not drink other kind of tea ever again. I am so relieved to find in available through Amazon.  Please do consider bringing us the 100 count tea bag packages that we found in Africa.

product_title: O Organics Oats And Honey Granola Cereal, 17 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: This is the house brand at Genuardi's (Safeway).  I mix this with plain yogurt for breakfast several times a week.  The main ingredients are almost the same as the Heartland granola, but it seems lacking for some reason.  Maybe it's the sunflower vs. canola oil?

product_title: Oregon Fruit in Heavy Syrup
review_body: fast delivery excellent product...I cant get this in my area stores any longer so grateful to find I can order on line

product_title: 4-bags of Cheezie Cheezies Cheese Are Like Cheetos, Cheese Puffs, Cheese Twists but Better From Canada One Snack Bag of 285 Grams Each -Almost a Half Pound of Real Cheese Cheezies Each Bag. Made in Canada
review_body: These things are great, I love them. I have not found a cheese snack in the US that compares.

product_title: Flavor Wheel - Wisconsin Cheeseman
review_body: I thought I was purchasing a cheese wheel sample for my husband, and it turns out all we got was processed fake \\"cheese\\". We tried one and it was disgusting. All I can think of doing now is giving this as a gag-gift. I regret my purchase.

product_title: Somersaults Pacific Sea Salt Crunchy Nuggets, 6-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6)
review_body: I took a chance ordering multiple bags of a snack I never tried but I was very pleased.  The nutrition & protein is what I was looking for and this healthy snack filled the bill nicely. I will definitely order again!

product_title: Gerber Good Start Protect PLUS, Powder, Case Pack 24-Ounce Can (Pack of 6)
review_body: My Son was put on this by a Pediatric GI Doctor because the other formulas were making him constipated and his poop very acidic. She just said that the water should only be luke-warm otherwise the probiotics are killed and never put a mixed bottle in the microwave--this also will kill the good bacteria. I nuke the water for about 20 seconds, mix well, stick my clean finger into the water--if it is the same temperature as my hand--I mix in the formula, mix well and feed my son. His GI issues are getting better and we're very happy. I just recommend talking to a Specialist before playing with a bunch of different formulas. My son was in pain off and on for 8+ weeks due to our Pediatrician just guessing.

product_title: Nature's Path Organic Cereal, Smart Bran with Psyllium & Oatbran, 10.6 Ounce Box (Pack of 6)
review_body: Was intoduced to this cereal while participating in a diet program.  I have reached my goal weight, but have continued to use this as a mainstay in my daily diet.  Have also recommended it to a couple of friends who are also using it.  Great tasting, low in calories, high in fiber; what else could I ask for?

product_title: Bionaturae - Organic Fruit Spread Apricot
review_body: I read about this jam on the internet that RAF pilots would consume some Bilberry jam and somehow this would increase their night vision. I don't know if any of that is true, but what I can say is that it is very delicious and I will purchase more Bilberry jam. The problem is the shipping cost for a jar of the stuff. Come on, twice the price of the product? Even without the consumption of Bilberry jam it's easy to see that this is not a good value, and this somehow leaves a bad taste in my mouth.

product_title: Canada Mints - Pink * Wintergreen 2 Lbs
review_body: I love these pink mints, but they are so hard to find in regular stores, especially with so many of those stores going under. To find these mints online and in bulk was more than I could ever ask for! They arrived quickly and for a reasonable price.

product_title: Peanut Butter & Co. Peanut Butter
review_body: I liked it with oatmeal, in a sandwich, etc. However, by itself, it is too sweet in my opinion. I wish there was a little more peanutty flavor coming out. There was a bit too much sugar, cinnamon, and raisons.

product_title: SweetLeaf Sweet Drops Liquid Stevia Sweetener, Lemon Drop, 2 Ounce (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Great for sweetening, not for lemon flavor
review_body: I bought these after I bought [[ASIN:B001J5FN48 Mr. Coffee TM70 3-Quart Iced-Tea Maker]] . I tried using Stevia packets but noticed the Stevia would clump up at the bottom and would not separate even when stirred. Loving the taste of lemon with my tea I opted for this flavor. However, it does not taste like lemon. It sweetens really well, better than expected. However, you cannot taste the lemon in it at all. I will still buy liquid Stevia in the future since it works but will be leery about trying any `flavored' ones.

product_title: riceworks Sweet Chili, 5.5-Ounce Bag (Pack of 12)
review_body: Every single bag we recieved was bad.  Tasted like they were well past the expiration date.  Complained, but seller was very difficult..and would not refund or return.  We now get these at costco when they have them..and they are always great at a much better price! Don't buy from this seller!

product_title: Wheatena Toasted Wheat Cereal, 20-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: Wheatena is a comfort food for me.  My father used to make it for us kids when I was little on cold wintry mornings before school.  He did the same for my children when he became a granddad.  Now that he is deceased, a warm bowl of Wheatena takes us all back to those happy mornings.  My local store carried it for a long time.  But suddenly it was discontinued.  Life was a little sadder.  Thank goodness for Amazon!  I went online, ordered a four pack and we went through two boxes almost immediately eating a warm filling bowl every morning.  Now that we are satiated, we will do through the last two boxes at a more reasonable pace.  Thank you Amazon and the makers of Wheatena for being around for me and my family for over 50 years.

product_title: Lawry's, Louisiana Red Pepper Marinade,12-Ounces (Pack of 6)
review_body: I found this in the close out section of the supermarket and they no longer carry it.  I used it to marinate some steaks which we grilled over a fire and it was the best steak any of us had ever eaten.  I have not been able to find it since so I looked on line.  I am ordering some and plan to give it for Christmas gifts.  It's that good.

product_title: Fireworks Popcorn Orchard Blossom Popcorn, 15-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)
review_body: I do love my popcorn, and I have it as a healthy snack most afternoons.  I use the \\"popcorn bowl in the microwave\\" method to prepare the popcorn...that way I control the fat and salt, other additives, in my food.    This has been a very nice popcorn.  We have consumed most of our first order at this point in time.  A medium weight type of corn, I would say.  There is some hull left after popping, which I like.  The popped kernel is white and fluffy.  Not small, but not the biggest I have seen, either.    A good choice, you will not be disappointed.  I gave it 4 stars...pretty much a top-shelf product.

product_title: Glico Pocky Chocolate Dessert - Chocolate Fromage
review_body: I bought a box of these at a convention. They were very good. Though the stick count is low, they are well worth it.

product_title: The Gracious Gourmet Savory Pairings, 12-Ounce Boxes
review_headline: Why fuss when The Gracious Gourmet has done all the work?
review_body: These products are simply SENSATIONAL -- best products on the market in years! I mix the chili red pepper tapenade with mayonnaise and voila, there's your dip or sauce on the side for crab cakes. And NO ONE will know or be wiser. One product is better than the next! And they make my life so easy! Great gift to bring to friends -- particularly for the holidays.    And the sweet ones can be mixed with vanilla ice cream that will WOW your guests -- mine, one evening and ALL serious foodies, were awed! Of course, I didn't tell them the ice cream for the dessert took 5 minutes to make! It's my secret and now it is yours! Have fun!

product_title: Farmer's Market Foods Organic Canned Pumpkin, 15-Ounce Cans
review_body: I ordered a few days ago and some of my cans arrived dented. Multiple cans were on the outside edge of the box, but only one row (3 cans total with 2 severely dented) was dented. So, I guess packaging could have been a small factor. BUT these cans are amazingly malleable. Simply squeezing the can in my hand caused it to yield. The small area containing air space is very weak. Libby's canned pumpkin, the brand I've used my entire life, does not have this issue.      I already cooked with one of the non-dented cans. The color is different than what I'm used to, it's more of a dirty orange-sepia color, and the texture seems a bit thicker, but it tastes fine.     My order also had a long expiration date, 2013.     (FYI The packaging consisted of a large box containing a smaller box of cans with bags of air to keep it from rattling. There was no damage or excessive wear on the box. )

product_title: Chocolate Cherry Cookie Biscuit 4 Ounces (Case of 12)
review_body: Everything about these chocolate cherry almondina \\"biscuits\\" (think super-thin biscotti) is perfect--the crunch, the lightly sweet chocolate and chewy dried cherries.  And they're studded with tons of almond slices! No added fat and they are absolutely perfect with a cup of coffee or tea.  My biggest problem is knowing when to stop eating them!   I'd give them fifty stars if I could.

product_title: Frank's RedHot Xtra Hot Sauce: 5 OZ
review_body: I've been a straight Louisiana brand hot sauce fan my whole life. I like the vinegar flavor for killing a lot of other flavors I don't like. Recently I tried Frank's RedHot Xtra Hot. The flavor is very nice with a fairly mild tingle of heat. To be fair, I eat stuff in the 500,000 Scoville range regularly so don't take my word on heat if you are uninitiated. I came to this sauce for flavor, price, max heat of the product line and to try out the competition. I love the flavor of cayenne peppers and this has an abundance of it. I wish they came in at over 200,000 heat level because that would make the perfect sauce and flavor. Habaneros really overpower anything at high concentrations.    This sauce is great, heat is decent for a mass market product, and the Louisiana flavor is perfect. Not entirely too vinegary when eaten on food and milder in that aspect than its competition in my opinion. I do like the flavor of vinegar, however, so be forewarned to that facet which is inherent to this type of sauce. The heat is on par with Tabasco but the flavor is less sharp by a small margin. It tastes better to me with most foods also, but eggs is always going to be Tabasco's domain (or Tapatio, which can make a mean ranchero style sauce).    I can easily recommend this sauce. I've been tasting it off my finger throughout this review to make sure I provided my actual impressions in real time. I also ate Tabasco just to be sure.    Chileheads: If you are like me, then you like a good sauce that has a tingle to it for when you get tired of just torturing yourself. This has a decent flavor, heat like Tabasco, vinegar is milder, pepper flavor is stronger and would make a nice mixer to wash out the habanero flavor if you want to mix your stronger sauces in and make a southern style super powered sauce. I tried Blair's Ultra Death with Louisiana habanero style sauce and that was a bit vinegary and didn't mix well which is the entire reason I'm trying this. I don't like habaneros all that much for flavor and the vinegar can really tone down and kill that \\"smoky\\" flavor they have without completely washing out the sauce.

product_title: Crystal Light Skin Essentials, White Peach Tea, 10-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: Never knew that white tea existed --- but this, with a subtle peach flavor is excellent.  white tea is known for its restorative qualities throughout the body and drinking it flavored with the peach is excellent --- I wish they would make other flavors.

product_title: Davidson's Tea Bulk
review_headline: The grade tea is good for the price
review_body: I found that the grade of tea is good for the price. I has a nice flavor and also blends with other green tea as I like a little stronger flavor on the loose leaf tea.

product_title: Vita Coco Coconut Water
review_body: Coconut water is soooo delicious and refreshing.  This is my favorite brand.  It's great to drink after a workout instead of sports drinks.

product_title: Van Houtte Spicy Mayan Chocolate K-Cups for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)
review_body: I ordered this product because it was a great deal.  I was not disappointed. I like K-cups a lot, but they can be so expensive.  Ordering them in bulk was a great idea!

product_title: Nong Shim, Shin Ramyun Noodle Soup Gourmet Spicy (Pack of 20)
review_body: Shin ramen is delicious, but this is sooo expensive for a 20 pack.  Guys there are much cheaper sellers right here on amazon (<1.00 ea).  Look around!

product_title: FiberGourmet Lite Frosted Brownies, 1.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: These are so good! If you are following WW you will really love them because they have 12g of fiber per serving and are only 1 pt!

product_title: DiabeticFriendly Sugar Free Assorted Fruit Gummy Bears (1lb/bulk)
review_body: I have tried jelly-beans, chocolate, cookies, etc. that were all sugar-free, but these gummy bears were the best of the bunch. I am not a fan of gummy candies, but these had excellent flavor and the texture and freshness were great. It satisfied my candy craving and did not cause any teeth problems. Keep up the good work with this product.

product_title: Bare Fruit 100% Organic Bake-Dried Mangos, 1 Pound Bag
review_body: very good and fairly priced --- like trader joes better but there isn't a trader joes where i live so will buy these again :-)

product_title: St. Dalfour Gourmet On The Go, Ready to Eat Couscous, 6.2-Ounce Tins (Pack of 6)
review_body: Surprisingly tasty and filling. Low calorie, healthy, quality ingredients, good price and convenient package with a fork included. What else do you need?

product_title: Stash Tea Holiday Chai Black Tea
review_body: I love Stash Chai tea, so when I saw this one I was excited by the description but the reality was a disappointment.  I also bought the Chocolate Hazelnut tea which was also a disappointment, and it also contains peanuts, so persons with peanut allergies have to be careful.  The Chai, and Double spice Chai are really the best.

product_title: Go Raw Freeland Super Chips, Spirulina, 3-Ounce Bags
review_body: Can be very time consuming. We aren't 100 percent raw but I try. We are fortunate to have a restaurant about 20 miles from us but I still prepare the bulk of our meals. Salads and fruit get tiring as snacks and these offer a wonderful alternative to a veggie tray for guests or a bag of carrots in my hubby's work bag.   They are health filled and all flavors are wonderful. My husband prefers chocolate. I have found the ginger flavor to be too strong for some children.   I was delighted to find them on Amazon so I can always keep some on hand. The \\"cookies\\" have a slight crunch and don't get stale if the package has been left open for a day or two.  I recommend them to anyone who is looking for a healthy snack. You don't have to eat raw to appreciate their flavor and nutrients. And, I am confortable sharing them with my dogs, unlike some of the garbage that is sold as pet snacks.

product_title: DeLallo Hot Cauliflower, 25.5-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6)
review_body: We have always loved Vlasic Hot Cauliflower and it is no longer available. This Delallo Hot Cauliflower is every bit as good and is always a big hit at picnics and family dinners. It's unique and delicious. We absolutely LOVE it.

product_title: Mars Chocolate Bars, 6-Count (33.8g bars)
review_body: I love Mars bars, and these taste just like the ones I would buy in the UK.  Great product and they were nice and fast.

product_title: Gevalia Latte T-Discs for Tassimo Hot Beverage System, 8 Espresso and 8 Creamers (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Not happy with the Latte change
review_body: We have been drinking the Tassimo Latte for years and are very unhappy about the recent recipe change. It is now bland and watery. There is now no difference between the Latte and the Cappacino, I am not sure why they are still making both. We have emailed Tassimo multiple times and they claim that only the bar code has been changed, so that the machine makes a Latte with more foam. This is not true and when we suggested this we were passed along to their \\"escalation\\" department. We have not heard from them since. I should add that the Tassimo customer service leaves a bit to be desired.

product_title: Double Bergamot Earl Grey Black Tea
review_body: Sometimes more is NOT better.  In this instance, however, double the bergamot IS FAR superior to regular Earl Grey tea.  Stash found a good balance and actually improved on what a basically good thing (Earl Grey tea).  If you have not tried this I highly recommend it.  You will never look at tea the same again.

product_title: Green Mountain Coffee Decaf Dark Magic, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body: I managed to taste this before purchasing and I have to say, in taste and character, it is easily equal to its non-decaffeinated counterparts. It makes a hearty cup with no bitter aftertaste. My sister in law likes to mix it with flavored coffee for strength (as the Green Mountain flavors tend to be on the light side), I like it on its own. An impressive decaf.

product_title: Post Shredded Wheat Honey Nut Cereal, Spoon Size, 20-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: This is the best tasting cereal there is. And best of all is healthy. To bad more stores don't carry it, but you can buy on line.

product_title: Caribou Coffee Caribou Blend K-Cup (24 count)
review_headline: Didn't appeal to me at all
review_body: This K-Cup was one of the samples that came with my [[ASIN:B003XPHG06 Mr. Coffee BVMC-KG1 Single Serve Brewing System, Silver]].  I hate to be the lone dissenter, but I didn't like this coffee at all; in fact, it was the first of the four samples I've tried so far that I did not like.  To me, it tasted like over-brewed coffee--i.e., like coffee that has been sitting in the pot for several hours.  It wasn't bitter, exactly, but it just did not have a particularly appealing flavor.  I definitely would not buy this coffee again, and I would not recommend it.

product_title: Nongshim Shin Noodle Ramyun, Gourmet Spicy Picante, 4.2-Ounce Packages (Pack of 20)
review_body: I stated on the batch this week and it goes well with everything I have tried to put in it.  It taste great with hot dogs, Vienna sausages, eggs, spam, various veggies, and slices of old pizza.  I thought I would only eat half of it, but it tasted so good, I just gulped it all down.  The spice is really intense, I might just save a few packages and put it in my other bland foods.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee, Kona Blend Medium K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 50)
review_body: I love a good cup of coffee. I have recently bought a Kuerig brewer and wanted to try different types of coffee. Timothy's Kona Blend is a bold but smooth cup of great tasting coffee. I highly recommend this coffee to all that enjoy a good cup of coffee to get the day going.

product_title: Carte Noire Instant Coffee 3.5oz/100g
review_body: Just came back from my vacation in Poland (what a great country; our hotels & shopping places cannot come close to their new ones!)  Because their economy is truly fantastic - I paid for exactly the same coffee (even better) Carte Noire Expresso Gold Instant something about 20~22 zloty's.  After transferring to US dollar - about $6.00. Voila!  Is this price on this page for real? Wouldn't be cheaper to buy a whole box in Poland and mail to my address in Wisconsin?  By the way, this coffee is absolutely marvelous!!! For the taste 5 stars.

product_title: Sahale Snacks Variety Pack, 4 Flavors, 2-Ounce Pouch (Pack of 12)
review_body: These are the perfect size!  The bigger bags you can buy in the grocery stores lead to the temptation of eating the entire bag!  But with these portions, you could eat half the bag for a snack or the entire bag for a meal replacement and not feel bad.  They are actually 2 servings per bag.  They were fresh and delicious when they arrived.

product_title: Barista Prima Coffeehouse Italian Roast 4 Pack of 24 K-Cups
review_headline: Strong but good.  VG for iced coffee.
review_body:
One of each variety of Barista came in a free sample pack, with my shipment from Keurig Direct.

I don't like very strong coffee. This is very strong. I usually drink coffee black, no sugar, but couldn't handle this.

But-the VG flavor came through. Not bitter, not burnt. Very smooth. Far superior to Emril.

Not wanting to waste it, I added some rice milk (I'm lactose intolerant) and filled a glass with ice cubes.

Made an excellent iced coffee. Tasted like a coffee bar iced coffee.

I will order this for use as iced coffee.

product_title: Jungle Grub Snack Bars Variety Pack, Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough, Peanut Butter Groove, Berry Bamboozle, 5-Count, 4.4 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Not quite what I was hoping for
review_body: I was expecting a lot more from these bars!  They are very small - about the size of a fig newton - so they aren't a very cost-effective snack!  That said, the taste is acceptable.  I didn't mind them, but my kids didn't really go crazy for them.  The texture is a little off too.  I would not choose to buy them again unless being a frugal mom suddenly was no longer a requirement for me!

product_title: Haldeman Mills Shortcake & Cobbler Mix, 2 lbs
review_body: THIS IS THEE BEST MIX I'VE COME ACROSS FOR COBBLERS, SHORTCAKES & KRUMBLES!  THE MIX IS EASY AND BUTTERY TASTING.  IF YOU CAN FIND IT -- BUY IT!!

product_title: Peet's Coffee & Tea Major Dickason's Blend Grind Coffee, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)
review_body: I've never been a huge fan of the overpriced coffee at Starbucks, even if I am in the minority...to me, it's just too bitter, and way overpriced for what it really is. It's just coffee, folks, no matter how you dress it up (and I prefer just cream and sugar).     Being from Canada and loving the smoothness of Tim Horton's coffee (indeed, I bring back as much as I can when I'm home visiting), I have always tried other coffees in neighborhoods I've lived in around the US, hoping to find something local that I like just as much.    When I arrived in the San Francisco area a few years ago, I tried Peet's, and enjoyed it enough that when the coffee became available in local grocery stores, I tried the different types.    Major Dickenson's has a robust flavor, and no bitter aftertaste, as mentioned by another reviewer...and I was so missing it after leaving San Francisco, I was overjoyed to discover that it is now available in a local grocery store here in Tennessee...It's not too strong, nor too weak, when brewed to your taste...I use a heaping tablespoon per 2 cups of water, and it comes out just right in my 4-cup coffee maker.    Peet's is my favorite US brand, replacing Dunkin' Donuts, which I enjoyed when I lived in the Boston area, but when that became available in grocery stores, I bought a bag to compare to Peet's. I was surprised to taste how much weaker it tasted, and that it took more coffee to brew it to the strength I liked.     Since I currently have a can of Tim's at home, I'm taking Major Dickason's blend to work with me to share....

product_title: Celsius Calorie Reducing Drink, 12 Ounce Cans
review_body: Expect to get jittery, feel warm, break a sweat. A few hours later expect a crash and feeling sleepy.  It tastes ok as you are drinking it, but the an immediate chemical aftertaste follows.

product_title: Chocolove 55% Dark Chocolate with Almonds & Sea Salt Bar 3.2oz: 12 Count
review_body: This chocolate bar is so freaking good, it is RIDICULOUS. I have never reviewed anything on Amazon before, but this Chocolove bar is so yummy it makes my eyes roll back in my head, and in my opinion that is worth a good review.

product_title: Almond Breeze Almondmilk
review_body: This almond milk is actually my favorite. However, the price on Amazon is outrageous. I thought it might be cheaper on Amazon, but it is almost double the price of Walmart or Costco. It pays to shop around, don't pay more than necessary.

product_title: Ella's Kitchen Organic Baby, 3.5 Ounce Pouches (Pack of 7)
review_body: I have been buying these for about a year now for my 2 boys now 2 and 4yo.  These are a great on the go snack that a mom can feel good about serving up.  It is neat and resealable.  My younger son started on these earlier and will eat any version of the pouches.  The older son is a little more picky and wants only the fruity version.  I just wish my local grocery store would carry but I can usual find a great selection at babys/toys-r-us, [...] and amazon. This site is great and I am a happy consumer but....amazons price is higher than most on this product.

product_title: La Tourangelle Infused White Truffle Oil, 8.45 Ounce Tin
review_body: I saw a recipe that everyone was raving about and one of the steps was to use this oil. I had never Truffle oil before and was curious. I purchased this one since it seemed to be a decent seller with ok reviews.      As soon as I open the container I thought phoowa.. that is different and not in a nice way.  I went ahead anyway and used the oil hoping that once cooked it might infused some wonderful favour into the dish. It didn't.  The taste was exactly how it smelled and it practically turned my stomach. I have an iron clad stomach and rarely does something make me feel ill.     I have given it 4 stars because I am sure the product itself is exactly what is being presented. I am just letting people know that if you have never tried Truffle oil before, it might not be to your liking.  I can't imagine using the oil again, it really did not settle well for me.

product_title: Cookie Combos - Brownie Chunk and Chocolate White Chocolate Chip in a Decorative Large Tin
review_body: Absolutely some of the worse cookies I've ever had, and I'm sort of a cookie monster.    The texture was dry and brittle, crumbling into pieces.  Sealed in a tin with wax paper, they should have been soft and moist.  This indicates one of a poor recipe, poor ingredients, or left out far too long before packaging.    Even with a poor texture, one could tolerate it with good flavor.  Unfortunately, the flavor was abysmal.    With poor texture and poor flavor, these cookies are inedible.  I threw the entire tin in the garbage, and I almost never throw food away.    Coupled with the high price and very high shipping charge, I just had to write a review, and this is my first one.  Best to skip this item and save your money and your stomach.

product_title: Glutino Gluten Free Pantry Pizza Crust Mix
review_body: I wanted to make a french bread apple bake. I made it in my pre-gf days and have missed it terribly. Not anymore! This mix was easy to follow with few ingredients to add to the mix. I made mine in a regular bread pan and baked it in the oven. Made 2 loaves because I thought I would need that much for the Apple Bake. Did not need both so froze the other. This bread was golden and crisp on the outside and soft and chewy inside! It is the best gf bread I have found in the past 20 yrs! review_headline: Definately a step in the right direction
review_body: Best mainstream Stevia product around. Nothing beats 100% pure organic, wholesome Stevia powder from Trader Joe's, but this is a great product...all things considered.  For one, there is no dextrose. People are unaware that a lot of the mainstream Stevia brands like Truvia, and even Stevia in the Raw are nothing more then equal/sweetnlow/aspartame - mixed with Stevia. Also these products contain more artificial stuff then actual Stevia. It totally defeats the whole purpose of an all natural alternative. Through sneaky marketing, these companies have probably managed to make millions of dollars. Avoid all of those brands. If you're in pathmark, acme, or any other mainstream supermarket....try to find a 100% pure Stevia powder where the ingredients list has NOTHING but Stevia. If you can't find it - the 2nd best choice IMO is this Sun Crystals product.  Sun crystals is nothing but pure cane sugar, and Stevia. In other words, this is actually 100% legit..NATURAL. It's also very low calorie and low carb.  My only complaint about this product is there's more pure cane sugar then there is stevia, seeing as the ingredients list reads: Pure cane sugar, Stevia. It should be Stevia, pure cane sugar. No biggie though, really.  The taste isn't for everyone and takes getting used to. If you go from using sweetnlow/equal/sugar/splenda/etc., to Stevia and expect the same sweetness...it's not going to happen. Sweetnlow/equal = addicting chemicals. Stevia is a plant. Personally the taste doesn't bother me but to me health is most important, and living in this world, to maintain good health requires sacrifice. So if you're tea isn't as sweet with stevia as it was with sweetnlow....DEAL WITH IT. Or just use honey. Artificial sweetners lead to all sorts of problems...including HAIR THINING AND BALDNESS. Research it. Stevia is the future. Train yourself to like it, period.    I also can't wait for soda companies to start making Diet sodas with Stevia instead of aspartame.

review_body: I'm not sure if it's because of the terrible packaging (see many of the other 1-star reviews) or what, but there is something wrong with these K-cups. They seem to be full of air - maybe the effect of cabin/air pressure on those \\"frustration-free\\" boxes? - such they they practically burst when the needle in the Keurig pierces them. A few drops of water trickle through, then the machine stops. And, yes, my Keurig has recently been properly cleaned, complete with vinegar, and other brands of the K-cups do work.     Aside from this hassle, once I do manage to get a full cup of coffee out of one of these things, it just doesn't taste good. I was hoping for a bold roast (I like my coffee very strong and black), but these K-cups produce only a bitter, watery sludge masquerading as a bold blend. Granted, the off flavor could be due to the faulty cups, but either way, the product is no good.     After 5 failed attempts at producing a decent cup of coffee, I gave up and shipped these back to Amazon. I'm going to stick with Timothy's dark roasts from now on, and will leave the frustration-free packaging for non-edible orders.

review_body:

It has a real fine, rich licorice taste plus it's quite salty. It's tough and chewy, perhaps somewhat like a fairly hard gummy bear in the shape of a fish. Nice mix. My wife (Russian) says it's more characteristic of northern European candies which tend to be less sweet. This licorice is imported from Sweden.

You may find this a delicious candy and have trouble putting it down. That's my problem. On the other hand, you may not like it at all. Licorice sold in the U.S. tends to be much sweeter and less flavorful. If you're used to this type and then try these salty licorice fish, you may find it quite startling. My take is that it's startlingly good.

Gary Peterson

product_title: Himalayan Blue Poppy 20 Seeds - Meconopsis
review_headline: Growing Meconopsis from seed is difficult
review_body: Meconopsis betonicifolia (Himalayan blue poppy) is a plant that grows in fairly limited geographical areas and USDA growing zones. The plant thrives in Anchorage, Alaska (cold winters/cool summers mostly 60-70 degrees F) but will likely not survive in most areas in the continental U.S. because of the summer heat. Growing Meconopsis from seed is fairly challenging, particularly without good instructions. Seeds will frequently germinate, but the seedlings will damp off and die. If the summer temperature where you live exceeds 80 degrees F on a daily basis, the likelihood of Meconopsis surviving is fairly limited, at best.     This is, of course just my opinion, based on my experience with Meconopsis and the literature that I've read. I live in Anchorage and have grown Meconopsis commercially for more than 10 years.

Here in Japan, coffee is very expensive and Starbucks is the favorite place to drink coffee, but not for me.     Now I have my Dunkin' Donuts coffee, thanks Amazon for thinking of us, the military civilian coffee drinkers overseas.

review_body: I tried this because I had a coupon and I think the flavor lasts a long time...although I would not want to get paid in gum!
