review_body: Try adding some GF smooth peanut butter and about 2 T of heavy cream....let the dough sit in the fridge for 30 minutes, then bake as directed.  The wait time lets the dry rice flour absorb moisture and the cookies won't be as grainy.  You can also bake in a brownie pan for GF \\"Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip\\" brownies - very tasty.

product_title: Concord Foods Fresh Cranberry Bread Mix (Value Pack of 6 Boxes)14.1 oz. Boxes
review_headline: Quick and easy recipe - low in sodium and fat!
review_body: I had been searching for recipes for my mother-in-law who is on a sodium and fat restricted diet for congestive heart failure. I spent hours on the internet and was successful at a few recipes but really needed something quick. I found the Concord Foods Cranberry Bread mix in my grocers produce department and was thrilled to see the sodium and fat amounts fell within my mother-in-laws diet restrictions. I had to subsitute dried dates for the cranberries because they are not allowed on her diet and was pleasantly surprised at the results. The bread was light and moist and full of flavor with only 125mg of sodium and 1.5g of fat.     My mother-in-law loves the bread. I've made it as muffins so she can freeze them and take them out as needed. Our only disappointment is that this is a seasonal item. I stocked up with a few boxes of the mix and I will look for it again next spring.

product_title: Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Vegan Spring Onion Noodle Soup, 1.9-Ounce Cups (Pack of 6)
review_headline: A very nice, low-cal, instant noodle soup without the junk additives, thanks Dr. McD
review_body:
I've tried various Dr. McDougall's products (as I'm lazy in the kitchen and anything quick to fix, but healthful, is a boon). This is one of the nicer soups. I didn't give it 5 stars, which I'll explain below, but I still recommend this to folks who like instant noodle soups, but want something vegan, vegetarian, non-gluten, or without a lot of added junk.

For a mere 180 calories, this is a very generous serving of soup with pleasantly-textured rice noodles. The flavor packet (with dried veggie mix including shallots, garlic, green onions, white onions) mixes in without lumps. It is microwaveable, but I like adding boiling water and letting it sit a few minutes. The broth is very \\"oniony\\", and if you don't like a strong onion/garlic flavor, this is not for you.

The one star removed is for me finding it too salty. This almost has 700 mg per cup, which may not sound like too much for convenience soup, but I found it was very salty to my taste--and I love salt. I also found that there is a very faint, slightly unappealing undertaste (again, YMMW, it might just be my taste buds), that kept it from being a five-star soup for me. That said, I enjoy this soup, and I would order it again, simply because it's hard for me to find a noodle instant soup that satisfies me in the taste and texture dept. This one has lovely texture and a pretty decent flavor, and it doesn't have the artificial colors and flavors or trans fats that I don't want or need.

Another good Dr. MCD product! And with the subscription option, comes out to a tad over a buck fifty for soup for lunch. I like that, too.

product_title: Ambrosia Pure Honey From Colorado's Western Slope, 16-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 4)
review_body: I ordered two 3-gallon jugs of honey to cook with for the Specific Carbohydrate Diet.  I received four 16oz. bottles of raw Ambrosia Colorado honey.  It's great.  I haven't tasted good, natural honey like this in years.  I'll reorder, it's going fast.

product_title: OliveNation Chanterelle Mushrooms 4 oz.

product_title: Freedent Gum, 15-Stick Plen-T-Paks (Pack of 24)

review_body: I've purchased this item in a smaller quantity for an outrageous amount of money.  This is an extraordinary value!

product_title: Arrowhead Mills Organic Chocolate Cake Mix, 18.6 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: Being a big fan of chocolate and cake and organic products, I thought that this product would just fit the bill. However, I was disappointed that this tasted more like German chocolate than the luscious rich chocolate depicted in the pictures. This was the opinion of my family and friends that we had visiting also (does that count for 6 reviews?). The cake was moist, but otherwise, lacking in real chocolate flavor. product_title: Sant'Eustachio Il Caffè Whole Bean Coffee - Rome
review_headline: Deserves its place in the pantheon
review_body: Low acidity and medium-level roasting... therefore it's a good one to drink as an espresso shot without milk. But it's also tempting to try and make as good coffee (with milk-foam and sugar) as they make at San't Eustachio in Rome. product_title: Glutenfreeda Gluten Free Instant Oatmeal, Variety Pack, 6-packet Box, 6 Pack
review_body:
I have been gluten-free for over 5 years and dairy and soy-free for 9 months. My daughter has been corn-free for quite some time and gluten and dairy-free for the past 10 months. We were ecstatic when we learned about Glutenfreeda's Oatmeal being safe for both of us. It had been soooo long since I could make a packet of flavored oatmeal in a jiffy. And with my daughter's corn-allergy, it has been even longer for her. We are now in heaven and love all three flavors, but my favorite is the Banana Maple and my daughter's fav is the Maple Raisin. We eat it for breakfast, snacks, whatever. It isn't as sweet as we both like it, but a spoon of demerara organic sugar and we're both ready to enjoy.

Anyone who can buy any brand or kind of instant oatmeal off the shelf just can not fathom our excitement, but it is truly a wonderful thing to be able to enjoy instant oatmeal again!!

product_title: Zoe Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 25.5-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
review_body: Zoe is made from big fat olives that are meaty and buttery tasting. When my husband and I went to the Pennsylvania Macaroni Company in Pittsburgh, PA, the olive oil buyer guided us through our first olive oil purchase. She had us eat the olives that went into different kinds of olive oil and then pick the olives we liked best. Our first purchase of Zoe was the result. It is an olive oil with a distinctly buttery taste. I use it in baking cakes whenever oil or melted butter is called for. It tastes great! Absolutely great! Plus, it's heart healthy, which butter is not. Sigh. Other olives, particularly Italian olives that are made into olive oil are very peppery. Hence, their oil is peppery. This might be what other people are talking about when they say they don't like Zoe. Zoe is not a bit peppery. So please, you must try for yourself in this case. It is not a good idea to take anyone else's product review for olive oil to heart. (a pun!) You must decide what you like in an olive oil and buy according. Also, I want to mention that the buttery taste stays there even through a saute. We bought different types of Italian olive oil in smaller bottles that same first time at the Pennsylvania Macaroni Company, and then we came home and made fried eggs with all of them. In that venue the taste of the olive oils really came through and Zoe kept that buttery taste. Good eating!

product_title: Muir Glen Diced Tomatoes
review_body:

My initial conversations with them they contradicted this fact, which to me was misleading. General Mills owns Cascadian Farms as well and now I don't buy there either.

Now I also just make from scratch which is made simple by chef Andrew Carmellini in Everyday Italian. Lydia Bastianich is another favorite chef that deserves mention for simple yet big flavors.

product_title: Fantastic World Foods Instant Refried Beans Bulk Mix, 3.33-Pound Bags (pack of 3)
review_headline: WAY better than canned (prep instructions included)
review_body:
I used to buy this product in bulk from Wild Oats, but haven't been able to find it in several years (Wild Oats was bought out by Whole Foods and the one near me doesn't carry this in bulk). I was so happy to find this product in bulk on Amazon (whether buying 12 7oz. boxes or buying the 3 3.3lb bags which is what I bought). Yes, it's a ton of mix, but I make this so often and it lasts practically forever provided it's kept sealed.

The flavor is so far superior to anything canned and, dare I say, even better than refried beans made at home. This is mainly due to the extra flavorings added to the mix whereas home recipes usually only add salt and/or garlic. This product is perfect for anyone who loves refried beans and wants a convenient way to prepare them. I think it's incredible that something this easy and fast to prepare actually tastes better than something you can make at home (that also takes much longer). It's great for quick bean and cheese burritos or breakfast burritos (bean, cheese, and egg with some red sauce) and also great for campers. Plus, if you buy the 3 3.3lb bags, you can divide this product up and make as much or as little as you need.

Preparation information: Many sites I researched for this product said to mix 1.75C boiling water with 1C of mix in a bowl, cover, and let sit for 5 mins. However, THIS IS INCORRECT and results in runny beans. I contacted the good folks at Fantastic Foods and was forwarded preparation instructions which are as follows.

Pour 1.75C boiling water of 1 1/3C of mix in a bowl. Stir well, cover and let sit for 5 mins.

I haven't tried this ratio yet as I just received the email and wanted to post a review including the instructions since they all seem to be incorrect everywhere I look. If the beans are still too runny for you, increase to 1.5C of mix and try that. I personally like my beans very thick for both eating plain and in burritos.

product_title: Vino Italiano 4 Week Wine Kit, Pinot Chardonnay, 15.5 Pound Box
review_headline: Easy to make, can't wait to see how it will taste
review_body: Ordered the kit from Amazon, and had no issues with delivery.     Making the wine was easy enough, follow the directions, and in about 4 weeks you've got yourself a batch of wine. I'll be the first to admit that I am a novice when it comes to wine making. (This is the first batch of white that I have made.) I waited a couple of days after bottling to try it out, and found this new batch to taste.. well... new. I will hold off for a couple of months before I try it again, to see how some time in the basement affects the taste.    I liked the fact that the kit contained all the necessary corks, labels and caps. The instructions were easy to follow, and I didn't run into any snags during the process.    5 stars for Amazon's delivery. 5 stars for the price. 5 stars for the kit including corks, etc.   I marked the product 4 stars, simply because I will wait to see how the finished product turns out. product_title: Velveeta Loaf
review_headline: over priced! this should be a two pound brick not a one
review_body: I like to make cheese dip with chili or salsa and eat with chips topped with smoked brisket with jalapenos. I do this when I have day off from work and drinking with friends. It's cheap and satisfying and something that I can get online that doesn't hurt my pocket. However, my local wall mart puts wolf chili no beans on sale ($1 to $1.30) every time it is cold. Velveeta two pound block is like 4 or 5 dollars and marked down at Super Bowl and holidays weekends. I would really give this a one star rating because I was expecting twice as much faux cheese. At this price I could get a decent cheddar and definitely a good Longhorn colby jack. Maybe since I am from Texas, which I would think would be a target market for Velveeta, it is cheaper here. I order online so on my day off I can cut down on chores and do important things like getting inebriated. So far i have been doing well ordering online but I do think that this price is doubling what I would pay at a store down the street. I don't really know why any one would order this unless they are like me. Maybe it is not available in your area or you are far from wall mart. I will stop rambling this is overpriced even with free shipping which is a shame since chips, salsa and jalapenos are all on this wonderful Amazon for good prices and free shipping. product_title: Sunny Sea Mackerel Fillet In Oil, 4.25-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Cheap & edible, but sunflower oil and mackarel don't go well together
review_body: All boneless mackerel fillets contain small sections of radial bone. The radial bones in these fillets are unusually thick, and while they are easily chewed, they will occasionally crunch noisily between the teeth. I found the 'crunchies' to be unpleasant.    The sunflower oil imparts a strong flavor that is very different from olive, soy, or canola. It almost completely removes the mackerel's slight 'fishy' taste, but also makes it very bitter. The taste isn't bad when used as a substitute for tuna in a recipe, but eating directly from the can, I found the flavor of sunflower oil to be overpowering.    At less than $1/can, they are cheap. I will eat all 24 of them, but I won't buy them again.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: A cup of coffee after a meal is lovely.  And when it is delicately flavored with chocolate, it's like having a calorie-free dessert.  This brand delivers just a hint of chocolate. I used to swear that Lindor made the best white chocolate (don't get me wrong, all of their chocolate is absolutely divine) but when it comes to white, this is the creamiest, most delightfuly sweet vanilla white chocolate ever.  I wouldn't say the same about the rest of the Green & Black's chocolates however, they are good, but they are a little too bitter for my tastes.

product_title: Maté Roasted
review_headline: It is More Than Just Energy
review_body: When people bring up yerba mate tea, the word \\"energy\\" is generally found in that sentence. And it is true: mate tea has just about as much caffeine as coffee, without the jitteriness. Yes, the caffeine in mate tea absorbs more slowly than that in coffee, leaving a steadier and more pleasant energy boost without the sudden crash.     But that is not why I love my roasted mate tea. Unroasted, mate has a grassy, herbal flavor that is between pleasant and unpleasant. But when it is roasted, it takes on a darker, richer, nutty character. The color is a medium brown (rather than the unroasted green), and the flavor becomes a bit weightier. It is not as flavorfully strong as coffee, but it is probably the closest to a coffee-ish flavor of any tea.     One small complaint: with all the complex flavors of the tea world, roasted mate (like its unroasted sister) comes off a little bit unidimensional in flavor. One can taste the nutty richness, but not much else behind it. So, this is a good everyday tea (I drink a few cups in the morning) but not a tea that will satisfy the connoisseur's palate. I wouldn't call the flavor thin, but wouldn't accuse it of being thick, either.     As always, specialteas' packaging ensures freshness, packing the poundsworth of tea in four separately sealed 4 oz. bags. In my order, they even threw in a sample size of a flavored mate tea, but I can't attest to whether this is standard practice. (Of course, they don't know me, I'm a first-time customer, and I didn't buy but [...] worth, so I am guessing it is standard practice.)     Good tea. Good company.

review_headline: THE popcorn for movie theater popcorn lovers
review_body:
I am one of those people who MUST have popcorn when I go to a movie. Many times, its my favorite part of the movie.

So, I finally bought a movie style popcorn popper because I didnt like the taste of microwave popcorn.

When I first got my popcorn popper, I just went to the grocery store, picked up a bag of popcorn, some of that powered popcorn butter flavoring and some vegetable oil. It did the job but, like microwave popcorn, just didnt replicate the taste of movie theater popcorn.

I searched and read tons of reviews on Amazon and finally decided to order this brand.

MY GOD! This IS it! With my first batch, I was blown away by the taste. This tastes exactly like the movie theater popcorn. If not better because you KNOW its fresh.

First: The 2.5 ounce packet is enough of a serving for a person. I popped 2 of packets the first time and it was the equivalent of one of those huge buckets you'd get at the theater. I had to share. haha.

Second: When I received the box of packets, I thought the oil was going to be a liquid. Its actually a solid. I had first thought I received a old batch but no, thats how its supposed to be.

Third: Like the packets tell you... let your popper heat for about 5 minutes, then slide the \\"solid\\" oil contents into the popper as well as the corn/salt mix. All at the same time.

It takes about 2-3 minutes before the popping starts but it'll pop up a TON of popcorn. And again, the taste. WOW! This is the popcorn I've been looking for.

product_title: Patak's Sweet Mango Chutney, Mild, 12-Ounce Glass Jars (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Perfect addition to any Indian meal and a versatile condiment that works as a dip or spread
review_body:
I like to tinker in the kitchen and make my own chutney but when winter comes I fill my pantry with Patak's. Compared with other chutney brands, I find Patak's offers a bolder taste that is both spicy and salty.

We buy Sweet Mango Chutney for the entire family because Patak's rates this blend at two chilies on a five-chili scale. Our sons, ages 7 and 5, have no trouble enjoying the chutney. I like hotter chutney as well but don't want to use up the refrigerator space by storing multiple jars.

Chutneys - derived from the Hindu word chatni - have many variations and can range from sweet, sour, hot or mild. Chutney consists of fruits, vegetables or a combination of both that is reduced to a pulp that is roasted or simmered and flavored with spices, sugar and vinegar.

Patak's Sweet Mango Chutney blends juicy mangoes with authentic spices and is served as a condiment to a curry but is also delicious on sandwiches (especially turkey, so keep it handy after Thanksgiving!) and hot salads.

Aida Mollenkamp at Chow offers this recipe for Cheddar and Chutney Tea Sandwiches.

TIME/SERVINGS
Total: 35 mins
Active: 5 mins
Makes: 8 tea sandwiches

The question is not whether cheese and chutney go well together, but rather which cheese to choose. As a nod to the British, we've opted for an aged sharp cheddar to star in this sandwich, but snacking in the test kitchen revealed that fresh goat cheese is a close runner-up.

Game plan: Let the sandwiches rest at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving, so the chutney has time to soak into the bread.

INGREDIENTS
8 tablespoons mango chutney
16 slices (2-1/2-by-2-1/2-inch) dark pumpernickel cocktail bread
4 ounces aged sharp cheddar, thinly sliced

INSTRUCTIONS
Spread a thin layer of chutney on one side of each bread slice. (You will use 1 tablespoon per sandwich or 1 1/2 teaspoons [1/2 tablespoon] per slice of bread.)

Top 8 slices with a layer of cheese (about 1/2 ounce per slice) and close sandwiches with remaining 8 slices of bread. Let sit about 30 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld. Serve sandwiches whole, or if you like, slice each sandwich in half on the diagonal.

This about ruins this dish for me, and I'm afraid of the other products that are still in the mail  -Tastes far too salty (you will notice the 2 grams of salt in there!)Do not add salt to your rice when cooking, when this dish is diluted by the rice it is consumable. product_title: Coffee People Dark Roast, Jet Fuel, K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_headline: BEST FOR THE KEURIG BUT KEURIG NOT THE BEST FOR COFFEE TASTE
review_body:
I tried many, many coffee beans for my new Keurig and settled for Jet Fuel as \\"best\\" tasting using the Keurig. However, I still have my cheaper Cuisinart burr grinder coffee maker. My wife and I decided to do a side by side taste test. We used the Keurig with Jet Fuel and the Cuisinart with Starbucks French Roast. The results? I say the Cuisinart slightly beat out the Keurig, it just tasted better. My wife says the Cuisinart is definitely better. Not a strict test since we didn't use the same coffee bean. But it's interesting to note that the initial Consumer Reports ratings for the Keurig are not favorable. Looks like our household agrees with the folks at CR.

The Keurig is less messy but it generates all those plastic cups as waste. The Cuisinart just leaves behind a non bleached paper filter. And the $99 Costco version comes with a gold filter.

One other thing about the Keurig. Google Keurig to find other owners who have complained about it failing after a few months or year and the poor customer support from Keurig. Mine has not failed so I can't attest to those other owners but they are out there with an opinion.

review_body: I ate beef jerky every single day at my school cafeteria when I was growing up. I loved the stuff. And then I became a vegetarian and, alas, I thought my beef jerky days were done for. Until I discovered this. It is very convincing - the texture isn't gross or suspect like many fake meat products. It isn't too tough, is a bit moist, and has a nice flavor. It is much softer than Tofuky Jerky beef jerky replacement, so the texture is easier to deal with, but this flavor is more sweet than the spicy Tofuky Jerky version. I'm excited to taste other flavors to see if there is something a bit on the spicy barbecue side rather than sweet barbecue side, but in general, I really like this and it might convince even the most skeptical meat eater. My dad even liked it, which is saying a lot - he is an old school eater who was very skeptical of anything vegetarian.

review_body: I have been eating this Nile Spice soup and the Red Beans and Rice for lunch for a few years.  What I like about this is it is fast, easy, filling, tons of fiber and although not organic it doesn't have a lot of crap in it.    My only complaint is the texture. product_title: Santa Fe Bean Co., Instant Fat Free Vegetarian Refried Beans, 7.25-Ounce Pack (Pack of 8)
review_body: I tried the regular variety [[ASIN:B000FI701Y Santa Fe Bean Co., Instant Southwestern Style Refried Beans, 7.25-Ounce Pack (Pack of 8)]] first. Although I liked it, I was disappointed at how much salt had been added. Usually with fat-free varieties, there is more sodium than the regular equivalent, but in this case, the fat-free is lower in sodium. This turned out to be perfect for my tastes and nutrional needs. I use equal parts of this dried bean mix and water, then I add a little bit of Clint's Salsa (which is relatively low in sodium) and a little bit of shredded cheese. The result is both flavorful and still reasonably healthful.

product_title: Whole Wheat Israeli Couscous (21.16oz)
review_body: Israeli couscous is impossible to find here in our \\"urbanized rural\\" area.  It's a product I have to look for when traveling out of the area.  I had not heard of the whole wheat version until I decided to look for Israeli couscous on Amazon.  This is terrific, tastes a little nutty rather than grainy, and cooks nicely in about 10 minutes (1 cup dry couscous to 2 cups water or broth).  It's terrific for risotto-like dishes. The problem for me is the price, especially when you add shipping.  You essentially get 3 scant cups.  That said, I like it enough to pay it again if I can't find it elsewhere.

product_title: Bigelow Flavored Tea
review_headline: Constantly good, mid-range price, Earl Grey
review_body: OK, for those of you having kittens about the four bags per foil packet, let me clear this up for you.  This is packaged for making *POTS* of tea.  I know my Mother-in-Law would find it excessive, but four teabags for a pot of tea is what it is expected to take for 4-6 cups of tea.  I, personally, like it for individual cups too because there is less waste, and bending over the top of the foil packet is very easy and keeps my tea perfectly fresh for three more days as I use up all the bags.  Now, for the actual review:  This had been my Morning Tea, every morning, for over a decade.  High-quality, expensive, tea companies (who really do know good tea) tend to not want to hide the wonderful flavor and aroma of their tea leaves with the bergamot flavoring Earl Grey is loved for.  They hardly add any bergamot, and while the tea is delicious, it is not really Earl Grey.  Cheap tea companies tend to overload their tea with flavorings to hide the fact that it is very poor quality tea.  Their Earl Grey is aromatic, but all you taste is bergamot (if you're lucky).  Bigelow has found a wonderful middle ground.  The bergamot is fragrant and flavorful but you still get to taste the tea, which is great for the grocery-store-friendly price.  If you want to sit by the fire and sip Earl Grey enjoying every bit of the moment, and you're willing to pay for that moment, then treat yourself to Rishi Tea Earl Grey Supreme (it's even organic).  If you want to guzzle it down for the caffeine fix then keep your budget happy and go for Stash.

product_title: Nando's Hot Peri-Peri Sauce (125ml) - Pack of 2
review_headline: THIS IS TRULY A GOURMET HOT SAUCE!
review_body:
Peri-Peri means \\"pepper pepper\\" in Swahili, and the pepper referred to is the African Bird's Eye Pepper which was carried back by Portuguese traders in the 14th century to Angola and Mozambique, and has finally ended up on worldwide tables, lucky for us!

The hot sauce is indeed hot. In that aspect I would compare it to our own Tobasco Sauce. It is not intolerably hot. I find it to my taste. It is particularly a delicious additive to shrimp and chicken.

Alas to say, I do not have the courage to sample \\"Hot Hot Peri-Peri Sauce.\\"

It is sun-ripend, and the exotic mix of herbs and spices is what makes it pass with flying colors. Really a treat.

Be sure to keep it refrigerated after opening. One warning: check the shipping fees. They are steep. But since the seller's website has a $20.00 minimum on orders, unless you want to buy more than one item, Amazon seems the best way.

product_title: Smithers Chicken Broth Concentrate, 200-Count 0.33-Ounce Packet (Pack of 200)
review_body: I first discoverd the Smithers Chicken Broth concentrate around 10 years ago during a month plus long hospital stay and was on a liquid diet for most of the time. I didn't care that I couldn't have solid food as this stuff is soooo tasty! Over the years I have been hosptialized on numerous occasions and I actually look forward to this stuff. I like it so much I buy it for my home! A word of advice though, it takes two packets to get a large styrofoam cup of hot water the right strenghth. Also you will have to get past the fact that you squeeze the thick jelly-like concentrate out of the packet like fast food jelly. Get over it and stir it up and enjoy. Makes a great late night snack or early morning pick me up.

product_title: Eden Organic Kamut Vegetable Spirals, 12-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)
review_body: Kamut pasta is my favorite and I love the plain ones. These vegetable spirals just don't taste right though. They have a very odd flavor. The texture is good and I will use them in soups and with strong flavored sauces and hope no one notices.     I was disappointed when I tried these and no one in my kamut loving family ate more than a bite.

product_title: Hawaii Roasters Organic 100% Kona Coffee, Whole Bean, Medium Roast, 5 Lb
review_body: Excellent. Better than most I have seen. Still I can not justify paying the price to drink it every day. Starbucks Organic Serena is almost as good for less than half the price.

product_title: China Mist Leaves Pure Tea Organic Hoji-Cha Roasted Green Loose Tea
review_body: This is a tea for folks who love coffee.  The roasting of the leaves  brings out a chicory/coffee flavor without the acid or buzz of java.  I enjoy this tea well-chilled without a bit of sugar or sweetener added.  Leaves Pure Teas always provides a high quality product and this particular tea is one of their best.  It has layers of flavors that come to surface gradually.  I usually prefer Chinese teas, but Hoji-Cha is a very satisfying drink.

product_title: GURU Natural Energy Drink
review_body: I've never been a big fan of energy drinks because of the taste, but Guru tastes great! It's a great drink for an energy boost. I find that I get less jittery than if I were to drink coffee or some other energy drink. I believe this is due to the fact that there isnt TONS of sugar (only 22g per bottle) and that the caffeine comes from guarana. Each can contains 125mg of caffeine (about the same from a medium coffee).    Stay away from the lite/diet version of this drink: it isn't artificially sweetened (it doesn't have any sweetener at all) and tastes awful.

product_title: Taylors of Harrogate Assorted Tea
review_headline: If you like a smokey tea, you'll love this Lapsang Souchong
review_body:
In the world of tea, there are a few varieties that stand out like a sore thumb. They have a very peculiar taste and probably a small subset of tea lovers partake of them. Lapsang Souchong might very well be at the top of the list.

Prior to this tea, I had sampled a few other brands and never really liked Lapsang Souchong. For those who don't like it, you'd probably be inclined to describe it as a brew of burnt rubber or factory soot, with just a hint of campfire. Not something you'd be craving to try again.

Well, on a lark I decided to try Taylors of Harrogate Lapsang Souchong, and I'm very glad I did. Taylors got it RIGHT. This tea is very smooth and has a pleasant smokey aroma and taste. You really have to stretch your imagination to conjure up thoughts of burnt rubber when sipping ANY Lapsang Souchong tea, and why would you want to when you can really enjoy it? Comparatively, this tea is better than Twinings. I have both and tried them side by side. There was no contest--Taylors won.

So, if you have already tried Lapsang Souchong and haven't quite found a version that suits you, look no further. You've found it with Taylors. :-)

product_title: Yogi Tea Organic Redbush Chai, Tea Bags, 16-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: Great tea!  Quickly became our favorite, along with \\"Fasting\\" and \\"Cold Season\\" Yogi teas. Good for drinking any time of day.

review_body: I was shocked by the value and flavor of this tea! It has stunning nuances of apricot and peach that evolve dependent on the sweetening added.

review_body: This is a fantastic tea! My mom and I drink it all the time together. We like it best with a bit of milk and a teaspoon of honey. Yummmm...

product_title: MarketSpice Cinnamon Orange Tea 16 oz(454 g)
review_body: Market Spice Tea is blended in the Market Spice shop at the Pike Place Market in Seattle.  Back behind the famous fish-throwing guys is the small shop that not only will sell you almost every herb or spice you can imagine, but blends the tastiest tea I've ever had.      Market Spice tea is made with black tea, and contains essential oils of cinnamon and orange.  The result is a delightful tea that is naturally sweet without the use of sugar or artificial sweeteners.      In Seattle, the tea is widely available, sold in many of the grocery stores.  Not so available to me since I moved across the country.  I'm happy to be able to order it online here at Amazon.com.

review_body: This has a very nice flavor.  It's not overwhelming with garlic taste -- it's more of a mild, elegant taste.  The tuna itself is also great (yellowfin) and much higher quality than the typical canned tuna.  I eat the Roasted Garlic and Lemon Dill flavors for lunch; they're really handy and they have the added benefit of being nutritious and filling. review_body: These cookies are our favorite summer treat - we keep them in the freezer so they get a cool soft crunch. They are sweet in that european way, so your teeth don't hurt when you eat them! I am a health conscious sugar addict (a tough combo!) and these fit the bill just right when I cannot bake my own desserts. We love the fresh lemony flavor after a meal, or as a mid-afternoon snack.    If you like very sugary sweets, you probably won't like these. However,  if you want to wean yourself (or your kids!) off of a lot of white sugar intake, you might want to give these a try! A pack of 12 goes faster than you think...

review_body: My family loves these bars.  We all have our own favorite.  Three out of five of us prefer the chocolate, one prefers the berry, and I love the peanut butter, but chocolate is a close second.  These are great to take along on outings.  They aren't crumbly, keep well, and are delicious.  Good, portable gluten free snack food is hard to come by, these are just the thing!

review_body: The Veggie flavor is GREAT!  I like having an non sweet alternative for snacking.  I loved the Original Mum-Mums and now I love the Veggie too!

review_body: I first had Tajin when a co-worker from Mexico visited, and brought me some as a gift.  He said to try it on fruit, but my favorite has been to put it on pizza -- addicting!  Soups, egg dishes, etc. benefit from it, too, and I'm sure it would be good on fish.  He said it was sort of like \\"dried salsa\\", and to some degree it is.  It is somewhat lemony as well.  I recommend it!  I still have yet to try it on fruit... :-)

product_title: Nescafe Tasters Choice, Vanilla, 6.1-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 3)
review_body: A client served me this instant coffee, and I went in search of it on local grocery shelves.  It was in stock for several months over the Christmas holidays, then disappeared. The unflavored Nescafe is generally in stock, though I've not tried that.  I don't drink the amounts of coffee many do.  One 12 oz.  cup a day will suffice, but that one cup has to be good.  This is amazingly good, particularly for an instant.  It's smooth and has a sweet taste, when served black.  I thought that odd, and searched all over the canister's information to find what that taste is.  Finally I asked a coffee afficionado, who said that coffee is naturally sweet to the taste, unless it is processed incorrectly or was processed from stale beans.  I'm of an age now where I favor cream in my coffee, for my stomach's sake, but this coffee is good any way you want to take it.

product_title: South Beach Living Snack Pack Delights Dark Chocolate Covered Soynuts, 7-Pack Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Tasty snack but not really a good weight loss choice
review_body: These chocolate covered roasted soy nuts are tasty, but they're sweetened with sugar and corn syrup, so the fat and sugar content of these is pretty high, which is why the serving size is just one little packet.  Connecting this with the South Beach diet is a Kraft-y marketing tool, but if you are on a diet plan to improve your health and lose weight then this item would be something to use sparingly.  You can probably find healthier soy nut snacks in a health food shop and look for organic, Non-GMO soy content as well.

review_body: It has a weird after taste that I think is the tea part.  The berry and citrus flavors are way better.

review_body: Without a doubt, this is hands down the best coconut water product I've tried.  The others I've experienced have a flat or slightly bitter taste but this one has that subtle essence and sweetness of coconut water drank directly from a freshly opened raw coconut.  Let me tell you, this is the most refreshing, hydrating, and re-energizing elixir you can partake of.  I'll take this over Gatorade any day of the week.  Great way to start off any day.

review_body: Sent my son in college some of these and he says they're delicious, will put on Subscribe N Save.

product_title: Baby Tears Plant - 4" Pot - Helxine - Terrarium/Fairy Garden/House Plant
review_body: I have wanted a Baby's Tears plant for at least 30 years.  Before my parents divorced, my mom used to have a huge table of houseplants and her Baby's Tears plant and every other one was discarded when we had to move.  My grandmother had a Baby's Tears plant but after she died, all of her plants were discarded, too and I have forever been chagrined to have such a dysfunctional upbringing that even simple houseplants could not survive such abusive turmoil.  FINALLY, I discovered that Hirt's Plants sells their own Baby's Years plants and I literally frantically ordered one.  It arrived practically immediately (1 or 2 days at best) and it was packaged perfectly and was in perfect shape when I took it out of its carton.  I have since transplanted it into a ceramic planter and I am very, very happy with this plant and with Hirt's Plants for helping me finally have my own Baby's Tears plant after more than 30 years.  I simply have never seen one in person to buy one myself!  I am very happy.

review_body: This is not an overly strong coffee.  It has a nice flavor and pleasant aftertaste. The price for the combo and scheduled delivery is remarkable.

review_body: We love making special coffees and this just added a great touch to them.  Also we have put it on top of our soy ice cream and found it to have a nice taste on that as well;)OH we have also added it to our soda, making vanilla coke, vanilla dr. pepper and vanilla orange soda.. Very Very NICE:)

product_title: Coca Tea NovoAndina Yungas Gold 100ct
review_body: i, probably like most people reading this page about this product, thought there was no way it would provide the benefits the package says. relief from headaches, appetite suppressant, wakefulness, feeling of wellbeing are all said to come about by drinking the tea.  i brewed up tea in near boiling water with 2 teabags, and let it steep for over and hour to cool down. i then poured the tea in a glass with ice, so in effect it was ice tea.  a pleasant taste not unlike green tea, and i'll be darned if my mouth felt numb! i was thirsty so i drank it rather quick, and pretty soon, my daily afternoon caffeine crash was lifted with my headache and just felt like it was a very nice day. went to my cubicle and got to work and time seemed to fly. it was like a very strong espresso but without the jittery effects of the caffiene.  my friend made some with 4 teabags, with a larger amount of water so he could make 2 cups. he wound up drining it himself over the course of the afternoon and he was, in his words 'feeling great, able to concentrate, focus, and it made normally bad parts of work just fly by'...    i hear you can chew the leaves too for a stronger effect but you have to use baking soda to release the alkaloids. however, there is very little, to such a small amount of cocaine (less than .08%). not sure were the energy seems to come from.  but i would take this over a 64oz MT.dew, or a double/triple espresso anyday. no sugar crash, no headaches, and it doesn't make you stay up all nite, or kill your apatite.     this is a great tasting tea that is definitely something people should try if they are allergic or otherwise avoid caffeine.

review_body: First the order process and delivery was very good.  Spectrum Naturals - Coconut Oil Organic, 14 oz Works very well. I bought it for cooking and am very pleased at how well it works. review_body: I would say that the Timothy's Hazelnut coffee has a rather nice flavor.  The coffee is medium mild in strength, probably a 5 on a 1-10 scale for strong coffee taste.    I find the hazelnut flavor to be nicely done.  I like Duncan Donuts hazelnut coffee and I find the Timothy's to be a decent replacement to this.  I favor the Timothy's over Gloria Jeans Hazelnut but I am looking forward to trying the Timothy's dark roast hazelnut as I would prefer a slightly stronger brew.    Enjoy!

product_title: EnviroKidz Organic, Amazon Frosted Flakes Cereal, 1.93-Ounce Cup (Pack of 30)
review_headline: Frosted flakes that are organic and gluten free
review_body: One bite of this cereal and you are back to being a kid.  Oh yes, my kids love it too.  Parents with children with celiac disease, autism, or on a low gluten diet will find little arguments from your child since their sweet tooth will be satisfied with much less sugar than regular cereals.  No GMO ingredients.  A chance to teach about endangered species such as this Honey Bear.

product_title: Hot Buttered Rum Batter Mix

review_headline: Great for getting your fiber up...not for the weak stomach peeps
review_body: I have been eating Fiber One bars for 2 years now, and I've lost 50lbs. I am a runner and I'm always thinking of ways to increase my fiber intake. Luckily Fiber One products have me covered. These bars are so easy to take with you; to the gym, work, lunch, as a snack! I buy them in bulk now and enjoy them in my lunches. The recommended amount of fiber a person should have a day is about 18-25 grams...and this one little bar can take care of 9 of those grams! How awesome is that?!  I love the chocolate ones the best, but they now have a new one call chocolate mocha! And the gas that people have talked about on these reviews goes away once your body is able to handle more fiber. I have none of those side effects now.  Enjoy!

product_title: Tabasco Pepper Sauce, Original Flavor, 2-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Essential for Us Louisiana and Texas Foodies
review_body:
Tabasco is an important staple in Louisiana and Texas pantries. We like it on scrambled eggs for breakfast. When we have barbecued pork sandwiches for lunch, we like them extra hot; so we sprinkle on some Tabasco. Many of our restaurants have bottles of it on the table with the salt and pepper.

Tabasco is a natural with collard greens. In [[ASIN:097419123X The Collard Patch]] we use it on all kinds of dishes with collards. Several of the recipes in [[ASIN:0974191221 Flavored with Love: Mary Lou's Family and Friends Can Cook]] contain Tabasco. Here's one we like:

Crawfish and Shrimp Bread
1 loaf French bread, split lengthwise
1 stick butter (¼ pound)
6 ounces Philadelphia® Cream Cheese
1 pound crawfish tails, cooked
1 pound shrimp, cooked and peeled
1 pound Colby cheese, shredded
Dash of Tabasco®
2 splashes Pick a Peppa® sauce
Dash of crushed red pepper

Melt the butter and add the cream cheese, heating and blending until smooth. Add the Tabasco® and Pick a Peppa®. Add the crawfish tails and shrimp. Heat approximately 5 minutes: do not let boil. Spread the mixture over the bread.

Heap mounds of shredded cheese over the crawfish. Lightly sprinkle a dash of crushed red pepper over the mixture.
Bake at 375° for about 5 minutes. Cut into 1-inch wedges.
----
When we say a dash of Tabasco, we mean as much as we want. For us Spice Mouths, it is a big old shake of it.

I must confess that we enjoy all the flavors of Tabasco, and we grab whichever bottle is handy.
----
Our idea of entertainment is to go to the Avery Island Tabasco plant south of Lafayette, Louisiana. We highly recommend this powerful and pure seasoning.

review_body: I really enjoy this tea and love that it is caffeine free too!  There isn't any other Jasmine Tea that I've found that is also caffeine free.  I can share this with my mother who normally does not like tea, but she enjoys this.  Because of her heart condition she has to stay away from the caffeine so this works out great.

product_title: Fiber One Chewy Bars
review_body: It's a sweet healthy high fiber snack bar that makes you feel like you are eating a bowl of oatmeal cookie dough with out feeling guilty!

product_title: Cultivated Wild Rice - Oregon
review_body: Cultivated wild rice is hard to find in my area, so I was glad when I found it offered by Oregon thru ChefShop.com and it was reasonably priced too. I just used it to make wild rice pilaf and it was very good. It comes in an attractive clear standup package. Some people don't know there is a difference between wild rice and cultivated wild rice but, there is a big difference. This pack should last me awhile but now I know where to get more when I need it. Thanks Oregon and ChefShop.com for making this hard to fnd product available.

product_title: Byzantine Fresh Olive Antipasto, 5-Pound Bag
review_body: This assortment of olives in light oil with rosemary, red peppers, and light spices is delicious and long-lasting.  Great for doing a large buffet, appetizer plate, holiday meal, or to keep in the fridge during times when company may stop in. Just pour into a bowl and serve - festive and great for snacking.  Very yummy!

product_title: Lizzie's Kitchen Garlic Dipping Oil, 12-Ounce P.E.T. Bottle (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Should be "Lizzies Dipping Vinegar" instead of Oil
review_body: I did not like this product at all....in fact, I tossed the other bottle in the trash. I was expecting a garlic-flavored dipping oil, but got more of a balsamic-vinegar salad dressing. WHERE'S THE GARLIC??  It was brown in color, with big black chunks of....something in it, maybe the vinegar? I am a very good cook, and sometimes make my own garlic dipping oil. This product was more vinegar than oil. I could barely taste garlic and saw NO slices of garlic in the product. I would not buy any of \\"Lizzie's Kitchen\\" products again, due to the fact that this one was so bad-tasting. I do not recommend this product to potential buyers.

product_title: 40 count 100% Butter Syrupwafers (Stroopwafels 100% Butter)
review_body: We received them fairly quickly and they were super duper yummy! We usually get them (though it's a different brand) from relatives in germany but the urge was too strong and we decided to try these. We were not disappointed! they go great with a cup of tea or just as a snack!

product_title: Larabar Fruit and Nut Food Bar
review_body: No added anything.    I eat one of these every morning on my way out the door.  Great complement to some granola and yogurt when fresh fruit is out of the question.  Keeps you satisfied.    I love em.  Simple raw ingredients produce a fantastic diversity of nutrition.    You won't find natural nutritional balance like this in anything else.    To the negative reviewers here: these are not candy bars.  There is no added sugar so they are somewhat tart.  They provide nearly a full meal's worth of balanced nutrition.  Yes, that means fruit/vegetable proteins, fats, and sugars.

product_title: Lavazza Crema e Aroma - Coffee Beans, 2.2-Pound Bag
review_body: Read other reviews that were very positive and decided to try it.  Not my favorite.

product_title: Arrow Spacemaker Deck Box Basket Weave
review_body: My husband is diabetic and has been using this product for some time now.  It really has made a change in keeping his blood sugar from spiking since this sweetener is low glycemic.  We use it to sweeten drinks, on pancakes, on oatmeal, etc.[[ASIN:B000FL521G Wholesome Sweeteners Organic Blue Agave, light,  23.5-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 6)]]

product_title: Honibe Honey Drop with Lemon 12 Count Box
review_body: I purchased this product upon the recommendation of a friend.  Not as a sweetener for tea, but as a throat lozenge.  The natural honey and lemon are perfect for a sore or scratchy throat.  I keep a box in my desk at work to stave off the ill effects of cold-like symptoms.  Living in a sub-tropical climate (Houston, Tx) lends itself to the affects of rampant allergy symptoms and the like.  These little drops are the perfect antidote against feeling awful and boosting ones defense against \\"The Houston Crud.\\"  Highly recommended as such.

product_title: Earth & Vine Provisions Red Bell Pepper and Ancho Chili Jam, 10 Ounce
review_headline: THE VERY BEST PEPPER JAM AROUND!
review_body: I was so happy to find this jam available on Amazon at a lower price than what I normally pay! I used to drive hours to visit my daughter in the Sierra Mts. and purchase from a winery where she works. It is best poured over cream cheese with bread, crackers, bagels or warm muffins. Any way you eat it this jam is a special treat. I've served to guests and everyone goes wild over it. Order in quantity --you won't want to run out!

product_title: One Quart Glass Sprouter Jar w/ Sprouting Strainer Lid: Grow Sprouts: Includes 2 Oz. Organic Sprout Seeds & Sprouting Instructions
review_body: I bought the sprouting jar with lid and the seeds.  Both the jar and the seeds came with instructions on how to grow sprouts.  One set of the instructions was vague, but the other set work well.  The seeds sprout well and require little attention other than rinsing and draining a couple times a day.  The instructions say that when the sprouts are ready you can fill the jar with water and the seed hulls will float out the lid - the openings in the lid are too small for this but I just put them in a bowl of water and they float to the top.  Otherwise great product and it works well.

product_title: True Lime Crystallized Lime Mix, 32 Packets, .91 Ounce Box (Pack of 12)
review_body: If you like lime\lime flavor, you will love this product.  Our local stores quit selling this product so I was very relieved that I could find it on Amazon and ordered a case as we use it so much.  It is very versitile.  We use it just in water, in our smoothies, and in cooking.  It's a wonderful portable product that you don't have to worry about spoiling anytime soon like you do with fresh fruit.

product_title: San-J Black Sesame Rice Crackers, 3.7-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Too good to be called crackers.
review_body: These are so unbelievably good.  Addictive, even.  The tamari is perfect - not too salty, a little acidity and a lot of umami - and the nuttiness of the sesame is a nice foil.  Great by themselves, but I love them topped with goat cheese and dusted with chives.  They're also much more visually appealing than your average saltine - they're a very dark brown, liberally speckled with black sesame seeds.

product_title: Wasa Crispbread
review_body: My grandpa used to tell stories about eating this stuff in his Army days.  They called it \\"hardtack\\" or just simply \\"tack\\".  It also seems to be a Swedish staple food.  I grew up in Texas so it is kind of hard to find around here, especially the hearty rye kind.  One time I went to purchase a few packages of it at the local \\"gourmet food and liquor\\" store and the cashier warned me someone had returned it because it was \\"stale\\".  I told her that they must have been clueless, cause that's how its SUPPOSED to taste.  The stopped carrying it soon after.  I'll just have to start special-ordering it.  It's cheaper here, anyway..    I've tried many other Wasa crispbreads and I always come back to this one.  Nothing compares to the hearty rye.  It has a very thick, satisfying crunch and a nice, bland rye flavor.  I eat it with anything and everything, or even by itself.  It's great if you spread butter on it and eat it with soup.  Other examples: tuna fish, cheese, lunchmeat, peanut butter, ice cream, salsa verde, chocolate pudding, Wolf chili, banana slices, SPAM, etc.  Be creative.    It NEVER GOES STALE, so don't worry too much about sealing up the package.  I believe that's a design principle in all hardtacks (see wikipedia).  In my opinion, it only gets better with age.  In reality, there is negligible difference between the freshly opened package and the months-old package.  Same crunch, same flavor.  It's like bread, but without the possibility of mold.  Oh, it's also healthy and stuff.  Lots of fiber.    I highly recommend the hearty rye.  Buy a few cases now to prepare for Y2012 :)

product_title: Hot Sauce Gift Set, Baboon Ass Brand Triple Threat Gift Set. The Greatest Hot Sauce Set Ever Assembled Includes Habanero, Jalapeno, and Ultra Hot Chile Extract with Habanero. Flavor and Heat For Every Hot Sauce Lover. Fun to Give, More Fun to Eat
review_body:
The Jalapeno Sauce in this set is fairly mild, similar in spice to tobasco, but has a nice jalapeno taste to it. Not for everyone, it is sort of a pungent taste. Eating this sauce actually cools my mouth off from hotter sauces.

The 'Original' sauce in this set is hot for most people, warm if comparing to, say, Dave's insanity and thinking of that as, \\"Hot!\\" It has a nice enough taste to enahance the flavor of certain things. Maybe it is in the range of 15000 SU? That is my best guess, relative to Tobasco and Dave's insanity sauce (~100.000 +- a lot).

The \\"Gone Rabid\\" sauce is way hot for your average consumer, or decently hot for your hot sauce lover. I'd guess it is about half as strong as Dave's Insanity sauce (So... 30,000 - 50,000 SU? Just a guess, it's not published.), and tastes about the same - that is to say, not that good.

I like this set. I won't order it again because it is not very interesting in terms of flavor, but it is an excellent set to get an experimenter off of hot sauces like Cholula and Tobasco and into some more advanced heat!

Have fun, and like with any new hot sauce, try it ONE DROP AT A TIME!

product_title: igourmet Kerrygold Dubliner - Pound Cut (15.5 ounce)
review_body: I just love this cheese.  An interesting (but not TOO interesting) flavor, a nice texture with little bits of hardness to chew on..My old favorite used to be a soft cheese-Pierre Robert-melted on some crusty bread, but Dubliner is great without all the melting...just slice some off and eat with a pint or a glass of wine.  So good!

product_title: Wild Ride Beef Stick, Variety Pack of Four Flavors, 15 Count 1-Ounce Packs
review_body:
I bought some of these at Gander Mountain today and it taste great.
Did not know Amazon sold Wide Ride. Should of checked before paying more at Gander. Will buy from Amazon next time.

product_title: Chincoteague Seafood She Crab Soup, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Where's the Crab - A Real Disappointment
review_body: Friends of ours recommended this soup.  What a disappointment.  It is a an unmemorable  cream soup.  The picture on the can is misleading.  If you look at the picture you would expect it to be full of chunky goodness.  Instead you find a cream soup which is condensed and when reconstituted is a notch below the famous brand name Cream of Mushroom.   There is no chunky goodness. Certainly expected more at over $3 a can.

product_title: Linde Lane Etiquette Memory Cards (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Great way for kids to learn rules of etiquette and have fun
review_body: I have played this game with my kids, nieces and nephews several times. It's fun, quick, and a great learning tool. It reminds kids of basic rules like saying please and putting your napkin in your lap. I highly recommend it because the kids are having fun and don't realize it is helping their etiquette and memory skills.

product_title: Gloria Jean's Coffees, K-Cup, Pecan Pie, 25-Count Box (Pack of 2)
review_body: I love this coffee, I usually get Green Mountain Southern Pecan this tastes just like it only a tad bid less expensive.

product_title: Starbucks Caffe Verona Coffee; T-Discs f
review_headline: A little bit of stale bitterness detected
review_body: Starbucks Caffe Verona $10.99 for 12 (91 cents per drink)     Individual tastes vary of course, but for me, these T-discs, higher in price than others, leave a bitter acidic aftertaste that I do not get from the Gavalia T-discs. Not bad when the drink is very hot, but halfway through, it's not so delicious. Having said that, the brewed coffee sold inside an actual Starbucks is often about the same as these, so if you can enjoy that, you may like these, and enjoy the convenience and savings.    As with all the T-discs, you can improve your experience by starting with a warm cup/mug/glass and by never using the add more-water-to-overextract-the-grounds feature. If you feel you must add extra water to your cleverly designed coffee drink, do it with plain water through the yellow cleaner disc, not through the spent coffee disc.

product_title: Good Earth Organic Tea
review_body: An outstanding chai tea. Make an easy chai latte, take one tea bag, fill your cup about 1/4 full of water and microwave for a couple of minutes and let sit for a few.  Then add a teaspoon (or two) of sugar and top off with milk and heat up.

product_title: Kongo Mamefubuki Mix Cracker
review_body: These things are awesome.  I first bought them as a gag because there is a dried anchovy on the front cover, and it took me off guard.  Had to try it.  Now, I'm addicted to them.  You only get one or two anchovies in each pack, but, truly, that should be enough for you.  It's like a super-salty prize in the Cracker Jack pack.    Enjoy!

product_title: Pasta Roni Shells & White Cheddar Mix (Pack of 12 Boxes)
review_headline: Use this as a Base to Get Creative!
review_body: I used this mix as a base to make Tuscan Chicken Alfredo like they serve at that wonderful Italian Restaurant that we all know and love (but can't mention here). I used 2 boxes (preparing according to package directions) and added about 1/4 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, 1/4 cup chopped roasted garlic cloves (from the deli - already roasted), 1/4 cup chopped canned roasted red pepper (or pimento) and a 12 oz. can of white meat chicken chunks plus the broth. When it was done, I stirred in about 1 cup baby spinach leaves. This was delicious and made 4 very large servings for a great main dish.

product_title: Aux Anysetiers du Roy - "Gourmet" Milk Chocolate Fondue in Pottery Crock - 7oz
review_body: Great desert for a dinner if you don't know how to create a desert, does not want to spend too much money buying a prepared one, and wants to impress your guest. It is delicious. I used blueberries and the combination was sensational. Just be careful not to heat it too much. Follow the instructions!

product_title: Calbee Toasted Shrimp Chips, 4-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_body: baked, tastes like shrimp, and so much better then a regular potatoe chip, they're extremely addicting so be warned. But they taste amazing and go really well as a side with some ramen.

product_title: IZZE Fortified Sparkling Juice, 8.4-Ounce Cans
review_body: This is a rather refreshing take on apple juice.  It has enough tart taste without being bitter or acidic.  I especially like the size.  Perfect size to throw in a lunch box, purse, brief case, tote.  The serving size is just enough as well.  I like the narrow design of the can.  I don't think the \\"health\\" aspect is plausible however.

product_title: Stash Tea Licorice Spice Herbal Tea, 20 Count Tea Bags in Foil (Pack of 6)
review_body:
I've been \\"addicted\\" to this tea for years and glad that it has become more widely available.

A few weeks ago my cousin and I were discussing our love of tea. I put forth Licorice Spice as my favorite and she said her all time favorite was, surprisingly enough, a tea made by Aveda - the haircare company - called Comforting Tea. She lamented that she found it hard to find and described the taste to me. I immediately told her that she had to try Licorice Spice then. A few days after my recommendation she emailed me that she had tried the Stash tea and it was EVEN BETTER than the Aveda one! I so do love making converts!

As an added bonus, I've discovered after many nights of letting the tea steep, forgetting about the cup I've made, but not wanting to waste the tea bag - it tastes really good cold too!

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Herbal Tea, Sleepytime, 20 Count (Pack of 6)
review_body:
Welcome to heaven, Judy.
What?
Yes, you have arrived.
What?
You are asleep now, thanks to Celestial Seasonings Sleepytime tea.
But I don't remember going to sleep.
My point exactly. That's why I call it heaven.
But who are you?
I am Sleepytime Judy and I am asleep.

What welcome relief, knowing there is a pleasant, calming antidote to the stresses of a relentlessly busy mind that sometimes refuses to shut down. Just walk to the kitchen, put the kettle on, pull out a Celestial Seasonings Sleepytime teabag, place in a favorite cup--mine is a slender version of a Blue Willow cup, pour on water at just the boiling point, and wait for the tea to steep.

Meanwhile, pick up the box--how many times now--and read the the words.
\\"100% Natural Herb Tea, Caffeine Free.\\"
\\"a comforting blend of chamomile and spearmint creates a lullaby of tender flavor to soothe your senses...\\"
\\"...it lets you curl up under a quilt of flavor and quiet the tensions of your world...\\"
'The sweetest way I think of you is when the day is done.' Emily Dickinson
Ingredients: Chamomile, spearmint, lemon grass, tilia flowers, blackberry leaves, orange blossoms, hawthorn berries, and rosebuds.

But before I take my cup back to bed, I look at the last panel of the box. There's papa bear asleep in his cozy chair in front of the fire, Mama is carrying the baby and holding the hand of another, taking them to bed. Through an open door one can see two little bears already asleep in their bed. All in all, a cozy room of happiness and warmth and the promise of sleep.

I sip my cup of Sleepytime tea quickly, almost gulping. I have learned that if I sip my usual slow sipping, I will fall asleep only halfway finished. That is how efficacious the tea... really... is.....

product_title: Silver Springs Mustard, Chipotle, 9.5-Ounce Squeeze Bottles (Pack of 9)
review_headline: Used neat or as a base note in a recipe, this is a great mustard!
review_body: The chipolte kick in this mustard is assertive but won't send the fire department to your table.   Silver Springs managed to get the balance just right.  Use this neat on burgers or hot dogs or breathe new life into some of your favorite recipes.  Sometimes, if a new recipe seems a bit flat, this chipolte mustard can \\"save dinner\\" with a wonderful base to mid note.      Very highly recommended !!!!!!!!!!!!  : )

review_body: This mix cost 7.99 on amazon and one still requires the (2) 8oz packages of cream cheese and 3 large eggs. The topping and cake were not good. Eli's cheesecake factory (Chicago) sells a low carb (edible) cheesecake in their store that is cheaper and taste much better. product_title: ATOMIC FIREBALLS 12 ct
review_body: I love the fireballs. Can't get enough. The only negative is they can be purchased cheaper at our local Dollar Store when they are available.

product_title: Fiber One Cereals - Caramel Delight, 15.6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: This cereal is so tasty - it seems like you are eating one of those not-good-for-you sugary cereals that kids love. They are very similar to Cinnamon Toast Crunch. They do have a slight \\"healthy\\" taste, but it's hardly noticable. Even the kid's will enjoy this cereal which has an amazing amount of fiber in it - especially to taste so good (not like sticks)! I used to eat raisin bran b/c it had 7g of fiber and still tasted okay. Now I eat this, which has 9g of fiber and tastes awesome!  I highly recommend it. Oh, and the squares are small, about 1/2 the size of CTCrunch, so it's the perfect size for toddlers to pick up and eat. They'll think they are eating candy, but you'll know it's good for them ;)

product_title: Keebler Animal Cracker (packaging may vary), 2-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 24)
review_body: Crackers were not as fresh as the ones in big bags served at my daughter's school. She didn't like it even though she loves the same crackers served at school.

product_title: PTs Coffee Co. Bourbon Pecan
review_headline: Pt's coffee is an absolute luxury.
review_body: About 7 years ago, I was fortunate enough to try PT's Coffee...and I have been a loyal customer ever since.  Though I am not a major coffee connoisseur, I knew that this was top-notch quality and it immediately became our daily luxury.  The coffee is fresh, the beans are whole (I never tire of the smell of grinding my own beans), and the taste is smooth and full, like a hug for your tongue.  :)  I love to brew it for company too, as the reaction to quality is always fun to see.  PT's is both my daily coffee, and my special-occasion brand--and highly recommended.

product_title: Westbrae Natural  Mustard
review_body: This is a delicious salt-free mustard for those of us watching our sodium intake. You could probably serve this to anyone and they wouldn't even realize it's salt free. I have been having some trouble finding low sodium/low cholesterol snack options (suggestions welcome and appreciated!), but this with some salt free pretzels makes a great snack that doesn't make me feel like I'm depriving myself. I'd still like to find something with a spicier mustard flavor, but this is a good basic mustard with a lot of flavor.

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Tea
review_body: I used to make my own chai tea from a recipe I got off the internet, then I discovered I could get a good chai from Celestial Seasonings, and started doing that instead. I ordered this item because my favorite Celestial Seasonings chai had been discontinued. I am very pleased with this tea as a replacement flavor. It's so rich in spices like cinnamon, cardamom, ginger, nutmeg that it almost feels like my tongue is tingling when I drink it! It also has a touch of vanilla, which I love. I happily look forward to my two cups, morning and afternoon, each day. I ordered a 6-box case at a much better price than I can get at a local supermarket. Thank you, Amazon!

product_title: Nutiva Shelled Hempseed, 8-Ounce Bag (Pack of 3)
review_headline: tasty, but it gave me gas
review_body: I liked the taste okay, but when I cooked with it (in a vegetable stew) it contributed to a lot of post meal gas, if you get my drift.

product_title: HEART 2-TONE LOLLIPOPS
review_body: The lollipops arrived in perfect condition and were individually wrapped immaculately.  The only thing I wish I could have seen online is that the colors are not as vivid as they appear to be on the computer monitor.  Other than that, they were a success.  Thank you!

product_title: Sociables Baked Crackers, 8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: These are very good, they were a great price and fast-free shipping when you purchase enough food.  The only thing is that the box was smaller than I guessed it would be.

product_title: El Sabroso Blazin' Hot Nacho Tortilla Chips, 4.75-Ounce Units (Pack of 24)
review_body: Very authentic tasting nacho tortilla chips...don't even hesitate to buy these...they put all others to shame! A scrumptious creation: light and crunchy texture, sufficiently cheesy, pleasantly hot, and set off with just a whisper of lime. If you're into health, they're weighing in at only 1.5 grams of saturated fat, zero trans fat, and two grams of fiber. So order up, crack a cold-one, and prepare for some nearly guilt-free, munching pleasure!

product_title: Hershey's Milk Chocolate Bars with Almonds
review_body: Don't give me that gourmet-foodie chocolate crap. (Well, you could.) Hershey remains the best balance of sweet and salty and I return to it again and again. Get over it.    (Subracted a star for those stale almonds.)

product_title: Barbara's Bakery Crunchy Organic Granola Bars Peanut Butter, 7.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Great snack or pick me up
review_body: Love these, especially when fresh and crunchy.  Sad you only get 5 to a box but thats why you buy them in bulk.  Not too sweet and not too salty, perfect.

product_title: Honey Stinger Energy Gel, Gold, 1.2 Ounce (Pack of 24)
review_body: I have used this during trail runs and cycling with no stomach upset and no crash afterwards. Just keep moving to avoid attracting bees...or bears with the honey :)

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: Great taste! Great price! Wake up to a fresh cup of silky chocolate/coffee every morning!

product_title: Lowrey's Bacon Curls, microwave Pork Rinds  (chicharrones)
review_body: After buying these for quite sometime, I was quite disappointed when Walmart didn't carry them any more. They are not the same brand, but still pretty good. I wish there was more in the bag. You don't get a whole lot in each bag. I am glad to have them though. I bought 2 cases, and when I run out will probably get more.

product_title: Sylvia's Country-Style Gravy Mix, 1.6-Ounce Packets (Pack of 20)
review_body: Sylvia's Country Gravy Mix arrived quickly, was well in date for use, and tasted as good, if not better, than any cream gravy I have ever eaten. From start to finished product takes only a matter of minutes and it is so good on biscuits, bread, potatoes, country fried steak, or just anything you put it on. I do not know if you can tell, but I highly recommend it. A country boy away from home.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee Canarino, Italian Hot Lemon Beverage, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers, 25-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)
review_body:
This is one of my favorite drinks. Canarino tea is made from the peel of lemons (no pulp or juice) so it has a mild lemon flavor, one that is never sour, bitter or tart. Great for upset tummy's, I also enjoy this tea any time during the day for it's soothing qualities. Someone wrote that this tea reminded them of Theraflu and I had to laugh because it absolutely does smell like it but it does not taste like it. There have been studies done to show that the use of lemon peel in the diet may also be beneficial to reducing your risk of squamous cell carcinoma - so in addition to tasting great, this tea just might be good for you too!

You can sweeten this tea with sugar or honey if you prefer, though I find this tea to be sweet enough on it's own (as a frame of reference, I do find other teas such as Chamomile, Orange Spice and Peppermint 'sweet' as well). Definitely one worth trying. Enjoy :)

product_title: Arbuckle's Pastry Shoppe flavor sampler 10 count single pot coffee packets
review_body: I am by no means a 'morning person' but the smell and flavors of these coffees makes mornings a bliss.  The smell, as soon as you open the package you want to just dive your nose into it.  The flavor is just superb, no bitterness and before I know it my cup is empty and I need more!  Even the look of those dark ground makes my heart twitter.  I have tried many coffees over the years and this is my FAVORITE brand by far.  It's hard to want to drink any other brand.

product_title: Kids Organic Macaroni & Cheese, 8-Ounce Microwavable Containers (Pack of 6)
review_headline: $10 for one meal? ARE THEY CRAZY?????
review_body:
Only mac & cheese are mentioned. The picture gives the impression of the carrots and fruit as suggested side-dishes. I wrongly got the impression that there would be more than six.(a six-pack of six) After all,who charges $10 for 8oz. of mac & cheese. The fruit dessert was sour.

product_title: Jolly Rancher Sugar Free Hard Candy, Assorted Flavors

Highly recommended! I also recommend [[ASIN:B000HTYIES GOLIGHTLY Sugar-Free Candy, Just Chocolates Hard Candy, 4-Ounces (Pack of 12)]]

product_title: Panda All Natural Licorice Bar, 1 1/8 Oz/ 32g (Pack of 36)
review_body: A few weeks ago I found myself with a hankering for licorice.  Unfortunately I live in a small town in South Carolina, not exactly the kind of place where you'd expect to find a Trader Joe's or any other specialty foods store.  Once again, Amazon came through where brick & mortar options failed me.  I had tried Panda licorice before, in the form of little bite-size pieces.  But this 36-pack of man-size licorice sticks clearly had more to offer.  The moment I placed my order, I sensed that something had changed within me.  I felt bigger, stronger, perhaps even more virile than before.  The air smelled of new life, and every breath thereafter imbued me with a growing sense of adventure and vitality.  A few days later the licorice arrived at my house.  And then, the taste...  oh, the taste!  Like thousands of years of Eastern confectionery tradition condensed into a chewy brown stick, it was.  My eyes wide open in delighted surprise, I quickly turned the wrapper over to read the ingredient list.  Only four ingredients, each indispensable, each equal in importance, as the four ancient elements of creation itself.    Also worth mentioning: The day after I ate that first licorice stick, I noticed that my chest hair was thicker, darker, more voluminous.  I'm no scientist or doctor, but I'm pretty sure this was a direct result of consuming that most manly of all confections, Panda licorice.  I highly recommend that you order a pack...  if you're man enough to handle it.

review_body:

product_title: Old Wisconsin Snack Bites

product_title: NongShim Shin Big Bowl Noodle Soup, Gourmet Spicy, 4 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: I used to buy these years ago in packet form from an Asian grocery store near Cincinnati and couldn't find them when I moved away.  They are a proper-sized meal, very tasty (and spicy) and just need hot water.  They are quite hot (spicy) and a bit salty:  you can tone it all down by just using less of the included flavor packet.  I like to add some pouch-salmon, tuna, or some sliced hard-boiled egg to make a very nice lunch or dinner.  These are great for traveling or a quick and easy meal with no cleanup.  Cheap too!  These are in no way like the grocery store Top Ramen or Ichiban, these are the real deal.

product_title: Dr. McDougall's Right Foods Apple Flax Oatmeal Made With Organic Gluten Free Oats, 2.3-Ounce Cups (Pack of 6)
review_body: This product was ok, but due to it's size (each feeds two) it does not really work for me. It tastes fine and I will use up what I have for on the go times.

product_title: Powdered Coca Tea Novoandina Yungas Gold Premium Organic 6.5 Oz Sealed Tin Can
review_body: Coca tea needs to be kept away from heat, light, air and moisture, it is not coffee, so please don't put it in the freezer or it will turn Grey!  The tin can keeps your tea fresh for long, it is convenient, solid and you can refill them over time from the air tight bags.  You only need a bit to prepare a good cup of strong tea.  McMate Gold is very crisp, I like McMate Caranavi better but it's no longer in stock and only Gold comes in tin cans.  I learned that only small, new shade-grown coca tea leaves give a bright green powder otherwise the color is grayish or yellowish. Brighter the green color means that the leaves dried outside in the shade and were not exposed to direct sunlight what makes a high grade coca flour.  McMate is clearly bright Green!

product_title: Organic Sprouting Seeds Red Cabbage 16 Ounces
review_body:
Very easy process: Use a mason jar. You don't need the lid, just the
seal. You'll also need a nylon (cheesecloth, etc) and
a rubberband.
Put a couple tablespoonfuls of seeds in the jar and fill it
with water. Then Cover the end of the jar with nylon, put seal
on and put a rubberband around it. Now swish the water around
to get all the seeds wet and dump the water out through the nylon.
Kind of shake the jar to spread out the seeds on the bottom (actually,
the side) of the mason jar. So the mason jar will be laying lengthwise
on your coutertop. Twice a day fill the jar with water , swish, and
dump out the water; then redistribute the seeds again so they're spread
out along the mason jar. Put in front of a sunny window a few hrs each
day. Ready to eat in about 5 days. So much nicer than buying them at the store and wondering how long they've been sitting on a shelf.

product_title: Tasty Bite Tom Yum Soup, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: It's something, but it's not Tom Yum
review_body:
I eat Thai food a few times a month, and always get Tom Yum Soup - and not just from one place. I've lived in Seattle, Boston, San Francisco, and New York, and order from many places, so I don't have just one notion of what Tom Yum should taste like.

I am a BIG fan of Tasty Bite - I love the Madras Lentils especially. So I gladly bought a case of the Tom Yum soup.

All I can say is that whatever was in this package, it's not Tom Yum, or anything resembling it. It's a soup, and it's not terrible, but I did wonder why I was finishing the bowl I heated up considering that I didn't like it. I am certain I will not be consuming the other 11 boxes in the case.

If you look at my profile you'll see I really write almost universally good reviews - I generally feel compelled to endorse products, not bash them. What made me compelled to review this is that I really am such a fan of Tasty Bite, and this was a disappointment. Still love the company, but not this product.

I would urge you, before buying a case, to go try to find a box at your local store and try it. Amazon's pricing is so economical, and I knew I loved Tasty Bite, so I didn't feel like \\"wasting\\" the money the sample this product at the retail price in my local store - I just assumed I would like it, so bought the case from Amazon. It's just so far off from what it's supposed to be though, so now I'm stuck with a case. It's too bad .... Tom Yum soup is really a favorite of mine.

Perhaps you disagree with me and think that this soup is tasty - and that's fine, but it's really not at all like Tom Yum, so all I recommend is that someone try it first before committing to a case. If you like it, then ... no disputing taste!

I remain a loyal fan of Tasty Bite, and personally consume 2-3 packages a week (of different varieties) for lunch at work. I'm so torn about posting a negative review ...!

review_headline: Just what I was looking for.

product_title: Campbell's Pepper Pot Soup

review_body: I have long been an avid fan of Glenny's products.  Unfortunately, the two stores in my hometown that carried Clenny's Soy Crisps stopped carrying them. review_headline: Great for skincare, not for smelling

It smells like coconut, yes...but not sweet, perfumey coconut. Makes a great additive to hair conditioner for dry hair. It is not a heavy oil, turns white and very fluid when used in the shower, which makes it perfect as an after shower body oil. When mixed with the wrong essential oil it smells like vomit to me(tried a bit with tea tree, I don't reccomend this). Mixed with Lime essential oil, it smells like coconut cream pie.
