product_title: Hershey's Cinnamon Chips
review_headline: No real cinnamon in these chips
review_body:
Ingredient list for Hershey's Cinnamon Chips:
Sugar; nonfat milk; partially hydrogenated vegetable oil (palm kernel and soybean oil); palm kernel oil; contains 2% or less of: cornstarch; artificial colors (Yellow 6 Lake; Yellow 5 Lake; Blue 2 Lake); natural and artificial flavor; salt; palm oil; soy lecithin.

I wish I'd known the ingredient list for Hershey's Cinnamon Chips when I bought these (the ingredient list was not part of the product description as the time of this review). There's no real cinnamon in them. I had been using King Arthur's mini cinnamon chips previously (ingredients: sugar, palm oil, cinnamon, nonfat dry milk, soy lecithin) and was happy with them, but I was curious about Hershey's chips. They were cheaper than King Arthur's, and I'd heard people rave about the Hershey's cinnamon chips.

Well, curiosity killed the cat. Now I have a lot of bags of Hershey's cinnamon chips that I don't want to use in my baked goods..... I might end up using them if I'm baking something to give away where the person eating it won't know I made it. I used my King Arthur chips in Cinnamon Chip Bread, great results, but when I switched to Hershey's, the chips kinda melt and get mixed a little with the bread dough, and that turned my bread YELLOW. Artificial colors are on the ingredient list before the natural & artificial flavor.... that's a lot of artificial color! I usually don't care about artificial ingredients, I'm a junk food addict who drools at the sight of bright orange Doritos, but the yellow bread the Hershey's cinnamon chips made was displeasing. Not to mention the flavor of the bread, which was negatively affected by the Hershey's chips. Didn't have that same sweet cinnamon flavor that the King Arthur chips give.

Why'd I give this product 3 stars instead of 1 star? My husband didn't care about the changes in the bread, he'll eat anything I turn my nose up at, so he'll probably end up eating stuff I make for him with the Hershey's cinnamon chips. Also, his coworkers still gobble up the Hershey's cinnamon chip bread, so I'll use the Hershey's chips there too. Hopefully my bags of chips won't go to waste, but I won't buy Hershey's cinnamon chips again.ips. Also, his coworkers still gobble up the Hershey's cinnamon chip bread, so I'll use the Hershey's chips there too. Hopefully my bags of chips won't go to waste, but I won't buy Hershey's cinnamon chips again.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee Peppermint Tea, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Great Tea, but boy is it strong!
review_body: They call it Peppermint Tea and that's exactly what it is!  Boy, do you get Peppermint!   In fact, even at the 11.5 oz setting of my B70 it's over-powering! product_title: Bentley's Royal Classic Open Top Wooden Tea Chest, Item #10952 12 Flavor, 120 Tea Bag Set

review_body: couldn't find this rice at stores and found this on line and it is what we were looking for

review_body: We had to throw it out.  The corn pops up soggy and a bit stale.  Something was \\"off\\" about our bag of it.  Hopefully it was just a fluke.  Also, we thought from the description that the actual popcorn would be colored, but it's not, just the kernels.  That was our mistake.

product_title: Colman's Wet Mustard 4oz
review_body: This is the perfect mustard to eat with ham sandwiches (or any sandwich that needs a kick of flavor), bangers, or even Chinese food. product_title: Hemp Hearts Raw Shelled Hemp Seeds - 8 oz Pkg
review_body: I am a regular Splenda user and this is the first time I tried Stevia and I don't like the taste. I am a tea drinker in the British style with milk and when I tried putting this in my tea, I just have to throw it out. There is a bitter after taste. product_title: Ragu Fresh & Simple Smooth Pasta Sauce, Traditional Tomato Basil, 13.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6)
review_body: If you like Ragu sauce, you'll probably like this. It's nothing special. The sauce is sweet, and it has a slight basil taste. I wouldn't eat it plain over pasta. I can't say I understand the pouch it comes in. It only holds 3 servings, so this won't work for a family of four. It's fine for a couple or a single person.    If I bought Ragu, I'd stick with the jars. Those can be re-used or recycled, while this pouch is apparently intended to be thrown in the garbage.

product_title: Chestnuts, Fresh, approx. 1lb
review_body: They were just like I remembered.  It took me back to the first time I had roasted chesnuts, about 35 years ago.  Thanks for the wonderful memories and taste.

product_title: De Cecco 100% Italian Olive Oil
review_body: I just received my De Cecco Extra Virgin Olive Oil, and I must say it was a plesant surprise, as this is the best tasting olive oil I've tried. Very economical for the quality(outstanding!). I will purchase this again!

product_title: 123 Gluten Free Allie's Awesome Buckwheat Pancake Mix, 24-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 3)
review_body: These were great--light and fluffy. We bought them for a visiting relative and served to the family. Made them a couple of different ways--added blueberries one day and bananas another.  My picky 2 year old (not on a gluten free diet) loved them!

product_title: PowerBar Harvest Whole Grain Energy Bar, 2.29-Ounce Bars (Pack of 15)
review_headline: Tasty meal on the go - just beware of sugar content
review_body: While hunting for something that would be satisfying, tasty, and not completely full of fat/calories - I found the PowerBar Harvest Energy Bars...    As a college student, who commutes 40 miles, it is hard to pack a lunch or dinner and have it be appealing when it comes time to eat.  The PowerBars are an easy way to bring something along to eat, so that I do not threaten to gnaw off my arm during class.  I really enjoy their taste - they are more like a granola bar than a traditional power/protein bar.  They remind me of a mix between a Luna Nuts Over Chocolate bar and a Quaker chocolate chip bar.  Only - the PowerBar, being larger and having more calories, stays with you longer than either of those alone.    If you are trying to avoid excessive sugar - you may want to stick to fresh chopped veggies, because while the PowerBars are tasty - they do have 18 grams of sugar each

product_title: Kernel Season's Popcorn Seasoning, White Cheddar, 2.85-Ounce Jars (Pack of 12)
review_body: Many popcorn seasonings are little more than salt. But I've been very happy with Kernal Season's products, including White Cheddar. You really can taste the cheese.

product_title: Baklawa (Baklava) w/Walnuts, 28-30 Pieces
review_body: I sent the Baklava to my mother who is 90.  She and all of her friends just couldn't believe how good it was.  I will order it again.

product_title: Marmite Yeast Extract 250g - Pack of 2 Jars! (2x250g)
review_headline: Best thing since slic . . .uh, ON sliced bread!
review_body: I was actually trying to find Vegemite, just out of curiosity. Apparently it's not available in the US, and during my searches I found that Marmite, the British equivalent of the Aussie Vegemite, was available. By equivalent, I mean they are both made from yeast extract. I don't know if they taste the same. Now I ordered and received two 125 gram jars. I'm nearly finished the 2nd jar. The simplest way to eat it is to spread a THIN layer on buttered toast. If you like salty snacks, you might like it. If you don't like salt, run, don't walk from this product. I happen to love salt. Pretzels, potato chips, crackers, etc. without salt have no flavor to me. Personally, I think 2 slices of buttered toast with Marmite is a great way to start the day! I WILL be ordering more soon.

product_title: Pamela's Products Raisin Walnut Cookies, 6.52-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: My new favorite cookie from Pamela's
review_body: I've been eating gluten free for about seven years, and a couple of Pamela's cookies with a cup of decaf have gotten me through my 4 p.m. \\"low\\" many times in those years. When I first discovered them, I loved all the shortbread styles. Then I moved into the chocolate chip versions. Most recently it was the peanut butter, with and without chips.    I love them all, but this raisin and walnut cookie may be my all-time favorite. It's tender, chewy and generously studded with nuts and raisins. Unlike some of the others, which can be a little sweet for my taste, this one seems to rely on the raisins more than sugar for sweetness. After eating one or two, I feel like I've eaten something that might be good for me (and not just totally self-indulgent).     Like all the Pamela's cookies, they're a little pricey, but the prices here on Amazon are definitely the best I've found. (Likewise for the Bob's Red Mill GF bread mixes, which are also wonderful.) Thanks, Amazon, for your great selection of GF foods.

product_title: Pamela's Dark Chocolate-Chocolate Chunk Cookies
review_body: These cookies are really good, you wouldn't even know they are gluten free if you didn't read the package. My only complaint is the size is a little small for the money althogh the individual packages are really nice to help with portion control.

product_title: Dreamfields Pasta Healthy Carb Living, Penne Rigate, 13.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: This pasta product will help to keep your sugar down if you mare a diabetic.  The product does not have a off taste and for those pasta lovers it fits the bill.  Due to the way it is made, cooking time will be greater than with regular pasta.

product_title: Hershey's Cocoa, Special Dark, 8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_body: I make some pretty killer brownies, that always draw requests for the recipe whenever I make them.  A little while back I tried making them with Hershey's Special Dark cocoa and it really pushed my brownies to a decadent level.  Ever since I finished my last container, I've been scouring the local groceries in search of some more, and had just about giving up on ever finding it again. What a surprise to find it on Amazon--I'm thrilled!

product_title: Garlic Mayonnaise - Aioli - pack of 4
review_body: This is a very nice Aioli.  Make sure if you purchase it, you will use it quickly, once opened the shelf life is not that long.  It is of a more liquid consistency, not thick like mayonaisse, but excellent tasting.  Makes for a good soft spread, sauce or dressing.

product_title: Good Earth Tea Red Tea Sweet & Spicy, 25-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I order this stuff by the case. Besides being no calories and cafeine free, it's great for when you're sick with a cold. Wonderful aroma and flavor. Good hot or cold but I usually have it hot. Great late night drink when you want a treat w/o the fat!

product_title: Udi's Granola, 13 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: I LOVE the cereal, however, when I've purchased it at a store it was fantastic and what I bought through Amazon was a bit stale.  The cranberries were so hard I couldn't bite into them.

product_title: Nestle Hot Cocoa Mix, Fat Free, 7.33-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 4)
review_body: I buy Nestle's Fat Free Hot Cocoa mix and add some Fat Free Hazelnut Dairy Creamer, and I have a drink that's low in calories and high in taste.  I got tired of having to go to several different stores to find this size and particular brand.  Those little one serving packets are not for me.  So I was very excited to realize this particular size and brand is carried by Amazon.

product_title: Carefree Koolerz Mint Splash
review_body: its the best gum in the world.l have looked every where for it. I just bought the last of it. It should last me a year but its so worth it!

product_title: Popchips Potato Chips, Snack Size
review_body: These chips are so good!  Feel like I'm eating real potato chips ... what flavor ... I love all of them!

product_title: Avruga Caviar - 55 Gram (1.9 ounce) by igourmet.com
review_body: Basically, this is a dull caviar.  There is little flavor and a very mushy consistency.  Might be alright for cooking; but definitely not for serving with a traditional caviar service.  I am throwing away what remains.

product_title: Earth's Best Organic Whole Grain Multi-Grain Cereal, 8 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: I chose this as my son's first food.  He loves it.  It was a great transition from being nursed, to mixing expelled milk with this cearal.

product_title: Teas' Tea
review_headline: Actually does have some caffeine... but delicious just the same
review_body: Just wanted to correct the earlier comment, as Green Jasmine Teas' Tea actually does have caffeine - 45 mg per 16.9-oz bottle.     I love this product - fresh tasting with a delicious aroma.  We need more unsweetened, tasty teas out there, but despite what innovation is to come, I expect this one will remain the pinnacle of its category.  Yum.

product_title: T1L-58637-V0Parent
review_headline: Nairn's are superb, and they're wheat free
review_body: The Nairn's fruit cookies are crunchy, not too sweet and delicious. We are a gluten free family, and we love these. They are worth the price!

product_title: 100% Natural Organic Flax Pre-ground Cold Milled Golden Flax Seed - 40 Oz
review_body: All American vendor, with a conscience.  Flax is flax, so service is   paramount.  This one delivers

product_title: Certified Organic, Raw, Jungle Peanuts
review_body: The display for this item doesn't show the number of ounces.  How can I know the true cost?  Otherwise, I might buy it because I want organic, raw nuts.[[ASIN:B0015LWUJC Certified Organic, Raw, Jungle Peanuts]]

product_title: Ring Pop, Jewel Shaped Hard Candy Variety Pack
review_body: This candy isn't about taste, instead the experience young children can have with it. What young girl wouldn't be into this gem? It's one sweet ring, from someone quite special, sure to get at least one \\"I Do.\\"

product_title: Tim Hortons 15 Oz. Stainless Steel Travel Mug From Thermos
review_body: This so-called \\"thermos\\" brand mug is a cheap, cheesy, Chinese made imitation of a real \\"Thermos\\" brand mug.  The real ones hold ice for hours, these only for minutes.

product_title: 100 Calorie Packs Oreo Thin Crisps, 6-Count Packs, net weight 4.86 oz (Pack of 2)
review_body: These things are low cal oreo's: minus the creme, minus the cookie! The title \\"oreo\\" is basically a total misnomer. These are nothing but black crackers with some sugar. If that is what you want, then click purchase.

product_title: Pamela's Ultimate Baking and Pancake Mix
review_body: Pamela's is one of the best GF products available.  The pancake mix can be used for many things.  Good recipes can be found on the back of the packages.  Waffles are excellent.  Banana bread is delicious.

product_title: Fiber One Chewy Bars, Oats and Chocolate, 5-Count Box
review_body:
I've been looking for ways to get more Fiber in my diet. I've tried the cereals. Cereal has always been kind of a pain for me because I usually like to sleep in and it's not something I can take to work with me. These have been great. I can grab one on the way to work or throw one in my lunchbox. They are a super convenient way to get my fiber.

The added bonus is that they taste pretty good and satisfy my sweet tooth while being pretty low and fat and decent in calories.

I'd recommend them to anyone that wants a better way to get more fiber.

product_title: Udi's Granola, 13 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is my third time purchasing Udi's Original.  It remains my favorite, with a wonderful balance of healthy ingredients.  I mix it in Stoneyfield no-fat unsweetened yogurt, and have it for breakfast.  It is sweet enough that it compensates for the blank yogurt, and makes a great meal.  I especially like th banana chips, and nuts.  Nothing in it is too hard for my sensitive teeth.  I've tried Udi's other flavors, which are good, but this is by far the best.  A great value too, when you purchase 6 bags.

product_title: Earth's Best Organic Tots Cereal Bars, 5.3 Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Great taste and price but early expiration date
review_body: My daughter loves this product and it becomes a little treat.   The only reason I give only three stars here is because of the expiration date. When I ordered (April 09), the expiration date was about the end of July 09 (About 3 months away). I called the customer service but they said it is \\"the freshest\\" one. I don't know whether it is because they don't use preservetives or that is the freshest one in the Amazon warehouse.  My husband helps eating them out now.

product_title: Sprecher PUMA KOLA -  caffeine-free "The Grandest Of 'em All!", 16-Ounce Glass Bottle (Pack of 12)
review_body: Wean yourself onto this stuff and you'll never miss Pepsi - I haven't had caffeine in two years and it's thanks to Puma Kola .

product_title: Tazo Wild Sweet Orange Tea 20ct Box
review_body: It's wintertime and there's nothing better than a hot cup of tea on a cold winter's day.  Tazo's \\"Wild Sweet Orange\\" has been a favorite tea of mine for almost 10 years now. I first got a sip of Tazo when we lived in Portland, OR and I learned from the natives that a hot cup of tea from a local vendor was better than a pair of gloves to keep you warm. I still love \\"Wild Sweet Orange\\" especially with just a hint of cinnamon to pick up the flavor.

product_title: The Sprout House Organic Sprouting Seeds Baby Black Sunflower 1 Lb
review_body:
We have bought five types of sprouts from this seller and have tried four of them. Those four have sprouted well, but the sunflower seeds still have their hulls.

Therefore, when sprouting these sunflower seeds, each sprout has to be removed from its hull to be eaten. It would be better to buy hulled sunflower seeds for sprouting and not to use these.

product_title: Sea's Gift Korean Seaweed Snack (Kim Nori), Roasted & Sea Salted, 0.17-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Good Stuff and good for you.
review_body:
Personally, I hate seaweed. But my wife loves the stuff. We used to buy it locally at Whole Foods, but they are often sold out even though they charge a lot more than the online price.
So it's a great deal if you eat enough to justify buying 24 packs at a time. My 20 month-old daughter also likes it. I guess she takes after her mom.

product_title: Glutino Gluten Free Crackers, 4.4 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: These are the best gluten free crackers I have had so far.  I saved $5.00 by buying them through amazon than buying them at the grocery stores.

product_title: Pataks Tandoori Paste 11ounces
review_body:
I used this product to create Tandoori chiken - which I marinated in yoghurt and this paste, and then cooked it on the barbeque for maximum flavour. I have always used Sharwoods Medium Tandoori Paste, however I could not find this product in the USA. I tried Pataks Tandoori paste, and it was nice, but definitely not as good as the Sharwoods Paste or the Sharwoods Tandoori Curry Powder.

Use Pataks if you cant find the Sharwoods equivalent.
Craig from Melbourne, Australia.

product_title: Haribo Gummi Candy
review_body: These are wonderful candies and I just love them.  They can be hard to find and therefore I often find I have to order them from the internet.  They are so good, though, that is why I do go to great lenghts to find.

product_title: Tiger Indian Spices, Curry Powder, 4.4-Ounce Tins (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Certainly could use a little more spice!
review_body: I enjoyed using this product in both salads as well as other cooked vegetarian dishes.  I can't put my finger on why - I quickly grew tired of the taste of this curry!  Regardless of personal preference over unique curry mixes, I'd have to say this product would benefit from a bit more spice, perhaps by adding in more dried pepper.  I'd purchase it again once I've experienced some other products beforehand.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body: This coffee has a really bitter taste and leaves a really bad after taste.  I would not recommend this coffee at all.  The only good kcups are Green Mountain the Columbian is superb.

product_title: Aunt Gussie's Wheat Cracker Flats, Cinnamon Raisin, 5-Ounce Stand-Up Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: These crackers are almost a cross between a cracker and a cookie.  They're sweet but not too sweet.  I love having them for a snack when I want something just a little sweet.  One of the best parts is you can recognize and feel good about all the ingredients in these tasty cracker flats :)

product_title: Twinings
review_body:
Trust me- that's a high compliment.

I like hot beverages all day long- but not caffeinated ones too close to bedtime. So you'll always find some of this stuff in my pantry.

Is the taste wonderful? No. Does it taste exactly liek Rooibos? You bet. Don't look for any fancy mango or vanilla here- this is pure, un-fooled around with rooibos. If you like rooibos, take advantage of this price and stock up. If you dont, you'll never finish the six-pack.

And remember- this is naturally caffeine free! If you think decaf teas taste like sludge, taste this for something uncaffeinated that's totally different.

product_title: Pamela's Products Chocolate Cake Mix
review_body: I love this mix. Can make it into other recipes as well. Great job, Pamela!

product_title: Ragu Fresh & Simple Smooth Pasta Sauce, Traditional Tomato Basil, 13.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is good sauce. The packaging is great, a pouch that stores easily upright and takes up little space in your cupboard. No bulky jars to take up space. The heating is also very convenient, just clip a corner and pop in microwave... couldn't be easier. Flavor is good, it's mild and easily doctored with a few spices.  What I didn't like about this is there isn't quite enough for one pound of cooked pasta. And that's how most pasta comes packaged, is in one pound packages. Two of these would be way too much. So, I found I needed to add a little bit more to the mix. Otherwise, really good stuff.

product_title: Vital & Delicious Deep Chocolate VitaTops , 2-Ounce Units (Pack of 24)
review_body: I've really enjoyed all the VitaMuffin products that I have tried so far and the Deep Chocolate Vita Tops are no exception.  They are the perfect compromise between nutrition and great taste.  Even though the nutritional profile is impressive all you taste is great chocolately flavor and satisfaction.  Most \\"diet\\" foods don't do it for me when it comes to zapping chocolate cravings, but these muffin tops are the exception to the rule.   When warmed the gooey chocolate chips taste delicious and enhance the chocolate flavor.  I find them to be much more enjoyable to eat than an energy or meal replacement bar and often much lower in calories too.    Those on a diet (especially weight watchers) will appreciate that these do not pack a caloric punch making them perfect for those days when you want a sweet treat or a filling snack but do not have a lot of calories or points to spare.  I also appreciate that they are fortified with so many vitamins and minerals since I am terrible at remembering to take my vitamins.  I typically eat them as a snack, but they would also be great for breakfast with a side of fresh fruit or scrambled egg whites.    As delicious as these muffin tops are there are a couple of downsides.  First is the size.  Weighing in at 2 oz they are actually pretty small so I have to consciously slow my eating down to avoid chomping them down in two seconds (and I am usually a slow eater).  Additionally, you pay for the great taste, convenience and nutritional profile of these muffins.  They are definitely much pricier than making your own.  However, after making healthy muffins for myself for years I have still been hard pressed to make one with the nutritionals of these.    As long as you don't mind the cost and the size I highly recommend these delicious muffins.

product_title: Chalet Suzanne Newburg Sauce Ready To Serve, 13-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)

product_title: Grandma's Fruit and Nut Cake Ring 2 lb Holiday Tin
review_body: This is the best fruit cake I have ever tasted. If you don't try this you are passing up a the BEST!

product_title: Weinbrand Bohnen Brandy Chocolates
review_body: These are the only brand of brandy chocolates to buy...one bite and your are hooked!

review_body: I love English Teatime, but lately I've been unable to find the decaf in any of my local stores.  Leave it to Amazon to save the day!

review_body: this is yummy cereal.  it has good flavor and doesn't get mushy real fast like some other natural brands of fruity cereal.

product_title: Now and Later Cherry, 9-Piece Packages (Pack of 144)
review_body: usually if you buy candy online you dont have very very high expectations for the product. Amazon totally suprised me. Not only did they ship my item same day, I had the item in less than half the time estimated by USPS. I also recieved my candy fresher than I ever had before.

product_title: Cirio Sugo Al Basilico Sauce
review_headline: OOOOops - it's gone! Better buy two, or three, four and more
review_body: I love this. When I'm cooking and I forgot about the tomatoes, or I don't have enough, I add this.  The problem is, I love trying things... before I'm done the pot is empty.  So I always try to have at least three to four pots in the cupboard.  The taste - delicious! Good tasty tomatoes, a little salt, onions, sugar and basil.  Personally I only use it as a base, but if you want you add a little cream and sherry and you have a nice soup. Don't forget a few fresh basil leaves when you serve it.

product_title: Spicy World Cardamom Seeds, 3.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: I grind this in the coffee grinder when I need it.  It smells and tastes so fresh.  Also, there's no chance that the husk is ground with it like most store bought cardamom spice; here you are just grinding the most important part - the seed.  I highly recommend this product.  In fact I gave away one of the packages as a gift to someone who really appreciated it.

product_title: Udi's Granola, 13 Ounce (Pack of 6)
review_body: Udi's should almost call these \\"toasted oats\\" instead of granola, because they are so devoid of the usual clumpy, slathered in sugar trait of regular granola.  Simply toasted oats, crunchy, with just enough sweetness to make it work.  I add them to yogurt and other cereals or sometimes even casseroles.

product_title: Murray Sugar Free Cookies
review_body:
When I was diagnosed with type-II diabetes about two years ago, it felt like a death blow. I mean, I love sweets. And my favorite were peanut butter cookies (my wife also made a mean peanut butter cheesecake that I still crave to this day but am able to hold off thanks to these Murray Sugar Free Cookies). I'd tried other sugar free items but they all had a seriously bad after-taste to them. The artificial sweetners were pretty bad.

But the Murray brand are pretty darned good. And I can eat about 6 of them that equal 32 carbs (I'm a tall guy --- 6 feet, three inches --- with a big frame). There's no horrible after-taste and the peanut butter flavor is just enough to satisfy my slavering pallete.

If you're looking for a quality cookie that won't shoot your blood sugar up into the statosphere, these are a great option.

product_title: Campfire Mini Marshmallows - 12 Unit Pack
review_headline: Perfect Marshmallows for Gluten, Lactose, Soy restricted diets!
review_body:
I have used Doumak products for years, and these most wonderful and allergen free marshmallows are an integral part of my notorious homemade Sinful Chocolate sauce. review_body: Hires root Beer sustained me through many months as a newspaper delivery boy. It is just as I remember it. Great taste, not too sweet and nicely carbonated.

review_headline: McCann's Oatmeal is perfect for my rice cooker
review_body: After reading reviews online, I bought this product. On my Zojirushi rice cooker, I set a morning timer for cooking Oatmeal porridge. It's just what I wanted for my breakfast. The only imperfection is there is a slight stale smell when opening each can. but wiil be gone few days later.

review_body: The Twinings loose Earl Grey tea is fine for a morning cuppa (certainly better than most bagged teas).  It's not *great* loose tea (you have to pay about 2x as much for *great*, in my experience), but it's certainly satisfactory.

review_body: Dear Tuscan Whole Milk, 1 Gallon, 128 fl oz,    I find your ideas intriguing and would like to subscribe to your newsletter.    Best regards,

product_title: NOH Korean Kim Chee Seasoning Mix
review_body:
I like kimchee and I enjoy cooking, so this looked like an interesting experiment. Well, now I know.

My first suspicion came when I saw that this slim package, just a few tablespoons, alleged to season five pounds (over 2 kg) of cabbage. I like big flavors, so I figured I'd just use more. Then, the first step in preparation wilts the cabbage by soaking it for a few hours in salt water - a process that left a strong salty flavor that won't rinse off. It took some effort to get the lumps out of the mix, when I added the water it calls for, and finally figured the small ones remaining would dissolve on their own. The final product is what counts, though - I just didn't like it. It doesn't have the tang I want, it does have a sweetness I don't look for in kimchee, the spicy flavor doesn't come across as fresh, and I just don't care for the taste.

So, I'll try another kimchee mix if I find one. I won't try this again. I hate wasting food, but I'm not sure I'll be able to finish this batch. I'm very disappointed.

-- wiredweird

product_title: Jack Link's Beef Steak, Hickory Smoked, 1-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)
review_body: I love Jack Links Beef Steaks. These have a wonderful flavor with just the right blend of spices and hickory flavoring. I have trouble eating just one. It makes a great snack anytime. Before letting my grandkids know I have some, I make sure I hide a few first. Kids love them too.

product_title: Boston's Tea Ginseng Tea, 16-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: If steeped for a short amount of time this tea isn't too bad. I used to LOVE the old brew (that came in the tins). I think Boston Tea cheapened the mixture on the boxed bags and now they ad more black (read Lipton-like) leaves.

product_title: Sumatra "Mandheling" Coffee
review_body: I was hesitant to order coffee online, but this Joe's Coffee is very fresh. You can see the bean oils in the bag. Very impressed. You get a whole pound, when was the last time you saw an actual pound of coffee? Sumatran Mandheling is a very thick cup of coffee. My favorite.

product_title: Gatorade Performance Series Nutrition Shake, Chocolate, 11-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_body: I have tasted a few nutrition/weight loss shakes in my time, and this was pretty much like the others.  I liked the chocolate taste.  To me, it actually tasted a lot like Slimfast or some generic grocery store versions I've tasted.  After only one serving, I can't really rate the product on the nutrition aspect.  I may buy more cans and drink them for breakfast.  It's low fat and lo cal, so it's something I can drink quickly and better than skipping breakfast altogether.  Also, I highly recommend that you drink this very cold.  The taste is definitely better cold.

product_title: Knorr Aromat Seasoning, 3 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body: This is one of my favorite spices.  Glad to see Amazon carry it, discontinued everywhere and not sure why as it is a great item.  Everyone should try it on eggs, fish and chicken, on any food really.

product_title: Baronet Coffee Organic Espresso Dark, Fair Trade, 18-Count Pods (Pack of 4)
review_body: I've tried a number of pods for my semi-commercial espresso machine (Illy, Lavazza, and Starbucks; of these, my preference by taste was the first of these, and by taste and price, the last).     I have found these pods to be tightly packed, have a very good pour, with a good crema, and very good taste (better pour than Lavazza,  and less bitter than Starbucks), and a good value for the money. Organic and fair is a wonderful bonus.    All in all, high marks and strongly recommended.

product_title: Eight O'Clock Coffee, Original Whole Bean, 12-Ounce Bag (Pack of 4)
review_body: We heard about a taste test for the coffee and wanted to try it. We wre not disappointed.  The coffee is very good and we will buy it again.

product_title: Seapoint Farms Dry Roasted Edamame, Lightly Salted, 4-Ounce Pouches
review_body: I got these in hopes that I could replace some of my snacking habits with something a little healthier.  First of all, I love edamame in its normal form, cooking them like lima beans.  Unfortunately, either I got a bad batch, or my taste has changed.  I can only eat one or two beans before they get a funky aftertaste.  They are nice and crunchy, and just salty enough, but for some reason, the taste is off-putting.  Don't think I will buy these again.

product_title: Chicken Broth Powder, 8 oz.
review_body: I won't get into the back and forth between those who are upset about this not being vegan despite it's being listed as such, and those who think they have no right to complain.  I'm neither vegan nor anti-msg, and was actually looking for a real chicken broth powder.    At [...] , their own website, the picture of the product shows a different ingredient list than the description. Chicken fat, MSG are shown while they explicitly advertise vegan and NO MSG.  I was hoping that they did not intend to mislead, with either the photo or description was for an older version. I emailed them multiple times over the last few weeks (literally resending my questions over and over), without a single reply.  All I wanted was a final answer as to the ingredients! Not much to ask before I consume a food product of theirs.      As I have not received any reply, I can assume they do not care, are intentionally misleading, or do not ever read customer emails. None of these is acceptable. It's a shame because I had planned on buying alot of dried vegetable products, but cannot support such shoddy company behavior.

product_title: Murray Sugar Free Cookies
review_body: theses cookies are good , oatmeal seems to be my favorite and best of all you would never know they were sugar free if the label didnt say it. i will purchase this product again ,they're that good!

product_title: Stonewall Kitchens, Maine Teaberry Tea, Loose, 2.8-Ounce Cans (Pack of 3)
review_body:
If you like flavored tree bark, then this tea is for you. I now have 3 cans of MAINE TEABERRY TEA (1 open; the other 2 sealed). I know I should make myself brew it because (A) it tastes bad enough to be good for me and (B) frugality and self-flagellation demand that I consume what I purchased. I dread drinking it, though.

review_body: This is a great tasting and handy product for those who must follow a gluten free diet. Requires no refrigeration so easy to pack, etc.

product_title: Earth's Best Organic 1st Peas, 2.5 Ounce Jars (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Almost as Good as Mom Makes
review_body: I make 99% of all my son's food- this is the only food item I DO buy.  (peas require a little more work to make)  Great product!  Their prunes are good, too.

product_title: Annie's Bunny Grahams, Chocolate, Graham Snacks, 7.5 oz Box (Pack of 12
review_body: My whole family loves these bunnies. They are so good and better for you than most of the junk on the market. I love Annie's products!

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Green Tea
review_headline: All green teas are not created equal
review_body: Big green tea fan and love Celestial Seasonings.  The decaf mint is very tasty but I get tired of it before the gallon is gone  (I know, just make less...).  Not so with the regular decaf green tea or the decaf china white teas.

product_title: U.S. Mills Uncle Sam Cereal, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I am so happy to find Uncle Sam on Amazon. We have purchased this product for years and now I can't find it in the grocery store.  Thank you for carrying it.

product_title: Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Flour, Original, 16-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_body: I first had this waffle mix at a Best Western in Corning Ca., it was part of their free breakfast.  It was so yummy that I asked the manager what brand it was.  When I got back from my trip I Googled it and was surprised when an Amazon.com URL appeared.  Great price - great waffles!

product_title: Donut Shop , K-Cup for Keurig Brewers
review_body:
I worked for three years in various barista (coffee slinger :) ) positions, grinding beans in the morning and brewing a billion different types of coffee. The funny thing was, I love the smell of coffee but hated the taste of most blends, but if the beans were fresh ground and brewed, it was something I could enjoy.

I read up on the best k-cups to get for our new machine, and every site I looked at had lots of rave reviews for the Coffee People Donut Shop blend, so we gave it a try - WOW! Delicious, thick, and absolutely perfect with a little milk and sugar, I was astounded at how good this \\"pod\\" coffee was. We promptly bought two boxes to keep on hand for company. Just the smell alone perks me up if I'm tired.

Highly, highly, highly recommended, especially for those that primarily drink tea (as me and my guy do) and are dipping a proverbial toe into the whole \\"coffee thing\\" at home. No guest would turn down a cup of this fine joe!

product_title: Bartolini Truffle Oils - White Truffle Oil
review_body: The nose evokes the earthiness of white truffles, just barely. review_body: Think of each tin as one chocolate bar.  I got these for my husband, since I'm not usually fond of fruit chocolate, however, I really like this kind. The tin has a pizza-ish disk of 8 cut wedges to make it easy to eat one bite after a meal even if you're at work or traveling.  I look forward to trying the other flavors.

product_title: Tully's Coffee, French Roast, K-Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers
review_body:
I have a Keurig B60 and have used it with a variety of coffee 'k cups' for several months now. I was a little disappointed in the Tully French Roast.

Now let me quantify that I I tend to like my coffee "light and sweet". I also find French Roasts to typically be among my least favorite types of coffee.

I do sometimes opt for a bold cup of java. However, I find the Tully French Roast to be more bitter than bold. I've tired different cup size setting on the Keurig, but the Tully French Roast keeps resulting in a bitter cup of coffee. It really had a burnt taste to it.

I went so far as to run the same k cup through the Keurig twice to see if the Tully coffee was simply too bold for my taste. I realize k cups are not intended for re-use but I was trying to figure out if the coffee was just too bold for my taste or really just bitter.

SEE TIP AT BOTTOM OF REVIEW.

While the second cup of coffee was on the weak side, it was still drinkable....however, just like the first, it was bitter.

Where the Keurig is concerned I have found the best bold cups to be the Newman's Own Organic "Extra Bold" and the Emeril's "Big Easy Bold".

Again, while not a huge fan of French Roast, I liked the Timothy's World "French Roast"; that brand is what you would expect, a nice cup of bold coffee. The Tully's - just bitter.

TIP: While you probably don't want to reuse k cups as a regular practice, it does not hurt the machine, so if you like your coffee mild or want to cut down on costs, here is what you do. Brew a cup of coffee using the k cup of your choice. Then, go through the brewing process again: simply leave the used k cup in and lift and reclose the handle when the unit displayed 'Ready To Brew'. This is best done with the small cup setting, otherwise your coffee will not be mild, but just plain weak.

product_title: Espresso Americano Espresso Roast, Whole Bean, 80-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_headline: A Hedge Against Rising Coffee Prices
review_body: This coffee is flavorful and a good value, but I only gave it 3 stars because I would not classify it as an \\"Espresso Roast\\".  It is more on the medium side to my palate. With the very real probability that coffee prices will rise in the near term, this is a good purchase.

review_body: I have tried them all just about literally! from nature food stores, the major brand that begins with Q (you know it) and just about every store brand. The Amazon price for this places it just a tiny bit more than buying store brand and below just about EVERY name Brand I have seen. The taste, texture and quality over the years has not changed at all! It is EXACTLY what I want in an Oatmeal and I can pretty much assure anyone that tries it would agree! review_body: Count Chocula is hard to find and has been a favorite of mine since I was a kid.  It was so cool to find them here on Amazon.  I highly recommend them.

product_title: Nature Valley Chewy Trail Mix Bars
review_body:
The Nature Valley Chewy Trail Mix Bar (Fruit and Nut variety) is a typical, but decent entry in the world of snack bars. There a a few traces of raisins and cranberries in the bar, but it is dominated by oats (as expected) and rice, with a few bits of almonds and peanuts thrown in. At least in my samples, I was surprised to see more sunflower seeds in the mix than nuts, but it not enough to detract from the product. And as advertised, the bar is chewy, but luckily not sticky or overly sweet.

I'm having a hard time coming up with a word that describes the taste of the bar other than \\"typical.\\" There is not enough of any one product, either fruit or nut or sunflower seed, to change the taste from that of the oats, rice, and honey that make up a majority of the product. And as noted above, the honey used to hold the bar does not make the product overly sweet. In this case \\"typical\\" isn't a bad thing, it just keeps me from giving the highest rating to the product.

Overall, an acceptable product with a pleasant but not-quite-memorable taste.

product_title: Dr. Andrew Weil For Tea, Darjeeling, 8.2-Ounce Can (Pack of 30)
review_body:
I guess I purchased Dr. WEIL's DARJEELING brewed tea because I thought that an 8.2-ounce tea-in-a-can must have something WONDERFUL going for it. Not true!

Learn from my experience: opt for the tea bag and hot water (heck! use tap water if necessary).

It's just a narrow can featuring a picture of Andrew Weil, M.D. and a name-dropping reference to the Himalayas. It tastes like unsweetened tea. Period. And it comes with a price.

I can think of one reason to pay for these little-but-expensive cans: lure of elite status. You might think you look cool drinking the tea. I doubt it, though, because I just felt foolish (and ecologically irresponsible ... a STEEL can of flavored water, for goodness' sake!).

Save your money.

Berry Blast is definitely not my favorite- but with a little half & half or creamer and sweetner to taste, you can \\"fine-tune\\" the outcome. Interestingly a few friends just can't get enough of it! So it's never wasted.    Lastly, the Chai version- I just shake up (makes it foamy) and add Soy Creamer (plain for Vanilla) and tiny bit of sweetner to jazz it up- and it's a great \\"curl-up-on-the-sofa-with-a-blanket on a rainy day\\" flavor.    I just don't think you can go very wrong having this on hand for yourself or guests. For most these wouldn't be everyday flavors- and frankly I'd get tired of any of them if it was. product_title: Campbell's Select Gold Creamy Portobello Mushroom, 18.3-Ounce  Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: I fell in love with this soup over a year ago and it's been a tuff row to hoe. I went through a serious depression when I could no longer find my obsession on the grocers shelf. I suffered needlessly for weeks until I had the idea to look for it online. Amazon was my saviour, and it brought my creamy, porto-baby back into my life. This would be the end to my story if only I hadn't recently had an even worse scare. I had used the last of my golden goodness in a box, so naturally I needed to order more. My mouse hand started to quiver like a junkie needing a fix, when I saw that it was no longer available from Amazon. Could my worse fears finally be realized? Had Campbell's really killed my love? I knew they were revamping the select lines so in a fit of rage and desperation I went to the Campbell's website and logged a complaint, but not before signing up to be notified if/when Amazon would again deliver my life's blood to me.     Well this story does have a happy ending. I was resigning myself to the fact that I would never get to taste the soup of the Gods again, when today I got the email that brought me out of the slump I was in, IT'S BACK!!! Do I want to place this in my cart, the link asked me as if there was any other option. So I wanted to write this and let more people know that they too can enjoy the creamy, mushroomy goodness of this soup, and they should tell their friends about it too. I never want to be without this soup again and if more people demand it, then they have to make it, right?     OK this was whimsical, or just goofy but in all seriousness, I use this soup at least once a week to make my favorite dish of Portobello Mushroom Chicken over rice. It's also very good as a soup and it's so delicate and rich at the same time, it makes you feel like serving it in the good soup bowls. Nothing else I have found can compare to the taste and I really am addicted to it. I am so grateful to Amazon and I am considering signing up for the very first time for a delivery subscription so I won't be without it again.

product_title: Kikkoman Instant AKA Miso (Red) Soup
review_body: Kikkoman Instant Aka Miso Soup is fantastic. It's quick, convenient, and pretty good considering it comes out of a small pack. You add the powdered mix to a cup of hot water and voila... instant miso! What you see on the product bag is what you get... there's pieces of konbu (seaweed) and other goodies you'd expect in miso soup (but not tofu, that's not in this particular \\"flavor.\\") It's a great desk-drawer-at-work snack. Although it may not taste as \\"authentic\\" as the way a mama-san would make it in Japan, it definitely satiates the miso-soup-hungry palate in a pinch, you know, when taking a quick flight to Japan just won't fit into your schedule. It's comparable to the bowl of miso soup you'd get at a Japanese restaurant in the states. Not bad, if you ask me!    The only thing you should know is that it contains a LOT of sodium. We're talking about a third of % daily value (RDA, based on the nutrition facts on the back of the package). If you have high blood pressure or are trying to maintain a low-sodium diet, this may not be the soup for you, or something you'd have often.     Otherwise, get a few and take 'em to work or keep 'em in your pantry. It's too quick, easy and delicious not to!

product_title: PG Tips Premium Black Tea bags
review_body:
This is a very drinkable blend of Assam, Ceylon, and Kenyan black teas from PG Tips, one of the UK's most popular brands. Although some California grocery stores (and Cost Plus World Market) stock this tea, I had not tried it until reading helpful reviews on Amazon.

Each PG Tips bag weighs 38 percent more than the Lipton bag (that is available in the USA). As expected, PG Tips makes a stronger brew. Each PG Tips bag has so much tea that I can easily make a 12 ounce mug with a single bag. I drink my tea black, but PG Tips is clearly robust enough to maintain character with milk or sweetener.

PG Tips is a sturdy, straight-ahead blend with more strength than Lipton's. It is a caffeine-rich tea - in part because each bag has more tea than other brands.

PG Tips uses a pyramid shaped bag that allows more room for tea leaves to expand while steeping. Does it make better tea? I don't know, but it is a point of differentiation.

PG Tips also sells loose tea. Many tea enthusiasts prefer loose tea. Tea bags contain the less expensive \\"fannings\\" or \\"dust,\\" remains from processing loose leaf tea. And with some others brands of tea (not PG Tips), many people can taste the paper used in the bag. However, if you (like I) sometimes appreciate the convenience of bags, I recommend trying PG Tips as a sturdy everyday tea

product_title: Splenda No Calorie Sweetener Packets
review_body:
Splenda is a very good sweetener for beverages like coffee or iced tea. It has no calories and no carbohydrates either. It uses sucralose as a sugar substitute.

I usually prefer Sweet And Low for my sweetener; but when I can't get my hands on that Splenda is a fairly good substitute. Splenda is my second choice (along with Equal) because it's not quite as sweet as Sweet And Low. On the other hand, if you prefer a non-sugar sweetener that's not too sweet or potent, then Splenda would be a good choice for you.

Splenda is a powdery white substance. Just open the individual packet or packets and pour it in to your beverage. It is probably quite good for certain recipes as well. They say you may prefer to use the granular form of Splenda for recipes but if you don't have that handy these packets will do. Keep the individual packets in the box they come in or you can put them into any container you wish.

Overall, Splenda is a good choice for a sweetener substitute for sugar. It isn't quite as potent as Sweet And Low; that can be a good or bad thing depending on how sweet you like your beverages or recipes. I myself prefer the taste of Sweet And Low. Of course, you can always add a little more Splenda to make the drink or recipe a bit sweeter.

Four stars.

product_title: Xanthan Gum, 4 oz.

review_body: Arrived promptly, extra care taken to ensure arrival in excellent condition; would order again!

product_title: airforce Nutrisoda Energize, Mandarin and Mint, 8.4-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: If you are like me (and few people are so keep *that* in mind), you do not care for the taste of many energy drinks. For me, I suspect it is the taurine. It's a bitter taste that most drink makers try to hide with intense citrus. It never works. Mandarin Mint is no exception... however... once refrigerated, the taste was fairly decent. The \\"mint\\" flavor is drowned out by the taurine, but on the other hand they almost cancel each other out - which is pretty much a *good* thing. And the \\"mandarin\\" flavor is supposed to be a little more bitter than typical \\"orange\\" flavoring, so it does a good job of masking the remaining taste. As for the \\"energizing\\" effect, I give this drink a jittery thumbs up.    My short answer: Don't drink them when warm, but otherwise chug-a-lug!

review_headline: What the heck is in this coffee?
review_body: For starters, there is no indication anywhere, here or on Timothy's web site, that indicates that this is actually a flavored coffee. Well, it is. My first taste was so shocking that I almost spit the coffee across the room.  To say that this coffee has a \\"lively full-bodied flavor\\" is one of the biggest understatements I have ever heard. The flavor is SO complex that I cannot even begin to identify the indivdual components.  It is more like a train wreck of tastes in my mouth.  There is one stand-out flavor that I have as yet to identify.  It might be cardamom.  Not really nutmeg.  Definitely not cinnamon.  Whatever it is, it is strong and lasting.  Well after finishing the cup the taste still lingers.  I'm not completely turned off on this coffee, but I cannot drink more than once cup of this stuff in any given day and will not be buying any more of it.  To be fair, it is a decent cup of coffee.  But be warned that there is definitely a shock factor if you were expecting a regular cup of (unflavored) coffee and received this instead...I sure wish I had the opportunity to sample this coffee before going ahead and buying a 2-box pack...

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Maca Powder, 1 Pound Pouches
review_body:
The reviews as of today are correct.

Navitas Naturals is a great brand. I prefer the cacao powder to the nibs but then freshness isn't a factor. I use a pound in no time. Be aware however, this is not a processed food. I've bought three pounds of cacao powder and all are slightly different in taste. I assume the Maca would be the same.

Now..as to the taste. Well...it is different. Nothing something I would buy for the taste. It is smokey, deep, complex and if you take a lot, somewhat gagging. But I added 2 tbls to a 32 oz smoothie and couldn't really tell it was there (but then I loaded it down with cacao powder). It is also hydroscopic. More than instant potatos. Not as much as psyllium. Takes a few minutes to hydrate. Don't underestimate how much water it will absorb. It takes a lot.

Medicinal benefits? I can't even sort out the anecdotal evidence I and those in my family I've given it to have experienced. Lots of clinical studies on the net. My concern, because liver failure was an issue, was it did no harm. And I don't see it did. Nor do I read of any in the literature.

The five stars is twofold:

I trust the brand (the packaging is great..it stands up in the cupboard and has a plastic liner. Light is kept out by the brown wrapper, water and air by the liner).

Why not? The price is OK. Foodies (of which I am one) should know about Maca and this amount gives you more than enough to fool around with using it. Might be a recipe out there which needs a tsp or so of Maca in it to give it depth.

Pills are usually overpriced and I want to see and taste the raw product (well not with some pills but with supplements which are also foods).

product_title: Economist
review_headline: Simply Refreshing! As close as balanced reporting as you're gonna get.
review_body: Those on the far-left cry of its \\"callous conservatism\\" and those of the far-right call it a \\"bastion of ivy tower liberalism\\", but for your average American, this is what commonsense journalistic reporting should be: well-written, researched, for a somewhat educated but not strictly academic audience, and simply about the facts. You'll find articles written from nearly every political perspective here, but the most common take on the issues is a moderate one, usually just slightly left-of-center or right-of-center.    The Economist keeps up with the world current trends and puts them into the context of a economic and political landscape. Despite the magazine's title, you don't really have to be an economist to understand or enjoy reading it. Give it to your teenagers and watch how smart and aware they become come time for them to take their SATs.

product_title: Taaza Ghee, 8-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6)
review_headline: A healthy alternative to cooking oil and butter
review_body: Ghee (clarified butter) has been used in India for ages, it can be used as a substitue for oil or butter, in most applications. It's a healthier option to butter and the other questionable frying mediums in use today.     A more detailed description from [...] :  \\"ghee is unsalted butter that has been baked to remove not only its butter fat solids, as in drawn butter, but also all water -- so as to produce a food that contains no molecular oxygen, and is thus extremely storable and not subject to rancidity as in normal cooking oils. The health advantages accrue from the fact that ghee contains no oxidized cholesterol, the kind which leads to free radical damage in the cells of the body. Ghee is pretty well known among nurtrition nuts, plus it's a staple within Asian Indian communities and can be purchased in specialty food stores. It looks just like butter in a jar\\"    For those new to Ghee, do bear in mind it has a unique odor and flavor that may take some getting used to. The odor is not really strong and is somewhat buttery.    If this is your first time trying it and you don't like it, you can always use it instead of butter for baking, provided the dish you are baking has a reasonably pleasant odor of it's own. Overall, the quality of the product itself is really good and it tastes great.    I like the small 8oz jars instead of one large one, it's easier to handle them and you don't need to scoop some out into a smaller container for daily use. Once a can is over, just pop open a new one. Also, ghee has a long shelf life and you don't need to refrigerate the unopened jars. However, if you don't plan on using up an open bottle in about a month, it helps to store the container in the refrigerator, especially in summer!

product_title: Pacific Foods Ready-to-Serve Rice, Roasted Chicken, 8.8-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Husband described the first forkful as "an abomination".
review_body:
Great idea poorly executed with an extremely unappetizing presentation. This is from someone who makes flavored rice a few times a week. That being said, this is the worst review I have ever given anywhere, so bear with me.

You know how sometimes the rice sticks to the bottom of the pan if you overcook and you have to boil it out and it turns oddly clear but covered in carbon water? Yeah. Like that. The rice came out sticky (not it the palatable uniform Japanese steamed rice way) and was an almost alien kind of translucent brown that was nothing like the picture. Nothing. If you look closely, you might be able to tell it had once been rice.

Yes, I followed the instructions.

My husband, who wanted to try having fresh rice at work, described it as an abomination, which was a relief to me because when it was cooking it stenched up the house with a horrifying yet familiar odor that when I put my finger on it smelled exactly, EXACTLY, like Onondaga Lake in Syracuse NY is the summer back when it was the most polluted lake in the world and people were warned never to eat the fish they caught (assuming there were any alive in there) and kids weren't allowed to wade in it. It smells like raw sewage, dead fish, rotting feathers and chicken soup.

It was 45F out and I opened the window.

Sometimes you buy a case of something and it turns out to be something you don't care for, maybe it has too much onion or whatever, but you know someone else will like it. Normally I donate these things to a needy family. I think in this case it would be cruel. I can't imagine anyone who has made rice on their own mistaking this for rice. Do yourself a favor and just drop a boullion cube in a pot with your stovetop rice. That's what they're trying to do here and failing at miserably.

I can't sell the rest on an auction site because I'm afraid that even if I am completely honest about the smell I will get a bad rating.The only thing I can think of to use them for is to smoke out people in the breakroom with the odor next April Fool's Day.

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body: At the recent Consumer Dairy Show in Las Vegas, I found myself wandering aimlessly wondering about the social and economic forces that have driven this form of product shopping and selection.  Where, in the barnyard that is today's diary market, is the innovation, the excitement?  After passing dozens of displays hawking the same old stuff, I decided to head for (potentially) greener pastures.  And it was in the back corner of the vast slop and straw covered convention floor that I made the discovery of the year.      In a small, dimly-lit display barn, I was introduced to Tom Uscan, a recently retired investment banker who had dropped it all to pursue his passion - dairy.  The hay-bale strewn stall featured a pair of the Gallons from Tuscan's Whole Milk line.  One try and I was hooked!  This was easily the best presentation at the whole show.  In a moment of weakness, I actually toyed with the idea of sabotaging Tuscan's sign so that other reviewers would pass them by.  Fortunately my conscience got the better of me, and I prostrated myself, literally begging to test a sample in my own drinking room at home.    Tom was more than happy to oblige and less than a week later, the FedEx truck pulled up out front and disgorged two boxes from Amazon containing fresh examples of the Gallons that I had tried at CDS.  After lugging the heavy boxes up to my fifth-floor drinking room, I immediately unpacked them and set them on the table, ready to experience what I recalled from the stall in Vegas.    My initial experience was disappointing, however, as the smoothness and lack of grain that had characterized the Gallons were missing.  In a panic, I immediately tried a number of tweaks - changing glasses, pouring technique, even removing the labels to try and restore the balance I knew was in there.  After some hours of frustration, I called Tom Uscan for some advice.  Tom suggested that the problem was one of break-in and recommended allowing the Gallons to settle in my cryogenic storage unit.  Hoping for a cure I left them in there overnight and, after a short and fitful sleep, woke and even before brushing my teeth pulled the Gallons out for a test.    What a difference a night makes!  Suddenly order was restored and the creaminess and texture that I expected from the Tuscans was back in force.  I immediately began trying new combinations - the Apple Jack Cheerios were an instant success, better even than the Honey Nut which slightly over-emphasized the liquidity of the Tuscans.  Oreos, foie gras, and plums all paired well with the Gallons bringing out the terroir that I had first experienced in Vegas.    It was only after considerable testing - short sessions interspersed with cryogenic treatment - that I began to notice certain issues, nothing mind you that rises to the level of flaw, but issues nevertheless.  First, Gallons are very sensitive to cryogenic treatment - too long between sessions and things can go south fast.  Second is the size.  I am a big fan of big milk, but frankly these things did not do all that well in the Wife Acceptance Factor test.  The color combination - white with a red cap - was also the subject of a number of snide comments.    Notwithstanding these issues, the Tuscan Whole Milk Gallon is a screaming bargain, delivering all of the performance of milk costing far more with only minor compromises.  Showing sensitivity to the expected tweaks (try the Golden Cow Intelligent Udder for a real treat!) without being overly fussy as to imbibing vessel or food pairing, the Gallons will likely fit in well in your home - even considering the WAF.  For their performance alone, these are easily worthy of a Dairyophile B rating.  Well done!

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Marrakesh Express Vanilla Spice
review_body:
\\"Ideals are like stars: you will not succeed in touching them with your hands. But like the seafaring man on the desert of waters, you choose them as your guides, and following them you will reach your destiny.\\" ~Carl Schurz

Black teas from Assam, Indonesia and Africa, vanilla, cinnamon, licorice, cardamom, anise, American Panax ginseng, guarana and cola nut are the main ingredients in this energy enhancing drink. This has more caffeine than cola, less than coffee and much less than a double espresso. Well, that is if you only use 1 teabag. Two teabags will give you 120 milligrams of caffeine. While this might not be the tea you want to reach for right before bed, it does wake you up in the morning.

Celestial Seasonings also makes a Teahouse Chai mix (decaf) in Vanilla Ginger Spice and a few teaspoons (or up to 1-2 tablespoons) can be added to the tea to make this a creamy dreamy drink to sip while you eat some banana muffins. By adding the spice mix, you also add honey, cinnamon, clove, cardamom, clove, anise, ginger and Tahitian vanilla. These two teas go very well together and warm you nicely in winter. The brew actually looks a little like hot chocolate when you mix them together, so whipped cream and nutmeg might be an option.

So, if the Vanilla Spice seems a bit mild, try mixing in the Teahouse Chai mix and I think you will be very satisfied with the combination of spices. Not creamy enough? Add in some powdered milk or a dash of cream.

~The Rebecca Review

However, after getting most of the way through the 5th one, I poured some seeds into my hand, along with a weevil. I was disgusted by the possiblity that I might've eaten one or some already without even knowing. I then looked in the bottom of the sixth container and saw a weevil in it as well. product_title: Organic Dark Chocolate - Regular, 59% cocoa, 12 Units / 2 oz
review_headline: Possibly the best dark chocolate there is
review_body:
The Dagoba 59% Dark Organic Chocolate is the best dark chocolate I've ever had. A recent dark chocolate tasting contest conducted with a group of San Francisco food critics concurred.

I find the 59% to be much better tasting than the 73% version, and light years ahead of the bitter, sour 87% bar (which finished next to last out of about 17 bars in another recent taste test where the bars were unmarked so the testers didn't know which was which). At 59% the dark, bittersweet taste is still strong, but not overwhelming, allowing the other subtle flavors to come out. And with enough sugar to have a pleasant sweetness.

I recommend eating it in small pieces, allowing it to melt in your mouth. Eating it too quickly will deprive you of much of the enjoyment. I eat only 1/3rd of a 2 oz bar a day.

Dagoba is very serious about the organic aspect of their products, going to great lengths to insure that all of the ingredients are true organics.

My only cautionary note is that if you buy twelve bars of it and slowly consume it, savoring the taste. Then after a month or so, you pick up a common chocolate bar, that bar is going to taste like a piece of chocolate flavored wax. This Dagoba stuff will spoil you.

product_title: Green Giant Asparagus Spears - 15 oz. can
review_headline: So good right out  of the can...
review_body:
Here is my recipe using these delicious asparagus spears.I normally eat some right out of the can, they are so delicious.

ASPARAGUS CHEESE BITES

These tasty miniature quiches will put you in everyone's good

graces-especially if you surprise someone with breakfast in bed. Quiches retain heat, so cool five minutes before serving.

12 slices old-fashioned white bread

1/4 cup butter, softened

1 (15-ounce) can asparagus spears, drained and cut up

1 cup shredded medium cheddar cheese

2 cups fat-free milk (try 1 1/2 if the bread is very fresh)

4 large eggs

1/2 teaspoon salt

1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg

1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper

1. Preheat the oven to 350*.

2. Stack the 4 slices of bread, use a sharp knife to trim the

crusts. Butter one side of each slice.

3. Set out a 12-cup muffin tin. Gently press the bread,

slices, buttered side down, into the muffin cups.

4. Top each slice with an equal amount of asparagus and

then sprinkle with cheese.

5. In a medium bowl, beat the milk, eggs, salt, nutmeg and

pepper until smooth; ladle into the filled bread cups. Bake

25-35 minutes or until egg is completely set.

Makes 12 little quiches

~The Rebecca Review

product_title: Tahitian Treat Soda, 12 oz (24 Cans)
review_headline: Retro Soft Drink Is Worth a Few Measured Sips But Oh That Calorie Count!
review_body:
A soft drink does seem like a trivial item to review especially since the general category of food and beverages depends more on one's own palate. A friend of mine introduced me to this drink based on his own childhood remembrance in the Midwest. I don't recall it from mine, but once I tasted it, it did take me back to the days when miniature plastic bottles of Hawaiian Fruit Punch stood next to my mother's jell-o mold in the refrigerator.

With the appropriate color-clashing, tropical décor on the can, Tahitian Treat is tasty in that fizzy, retro sort of way and is definitely not for the macrobiotic among us, as there are standard, life-shortening ingredients like sodium benzoate and Red #40 pervading the carbonation. And you certainly can't drink it like Diet Coke since it is an astonishing 200 calories a can. But baby boomers should have a stash when they feel like a walk down a sugar-infested memory lane. Be forewarned that Amazon may be the only option to get this soft drink since it is not easily found at stores as specialized as Beverages and More, at least here in Northern California.

review_body: I love these, found them in health food store in Kailua-Kona, they are made in Australia (NSW) where macadamia nuts are native to.  If you have to eat something like this, might as well eat something that really tastes good--what's not to like about macadamia nuts, apricots and coconut--well, if those are the things you like, which I do?  And, it's a bit different than the usual combinations that you can find in these types of energy bars, in case you get tired of peanuts and yogurt and granola and chocolate.  Note that--in case you have allergies--according to the label, these bars are *NOT* reliably 100% free of peanuts, wheat, or tree nuts other than macadamias even though those items do not appear in the ingredient list, alas.  Makes good food to take on the plane, when you know you won't have time to get breakfast and they are not going to feed you.  Didn't know where I could get them on the mainland, so glad to see I can order them on-line.

product_title: Zola Acai Power Juice Beverage, 11-Ounce Units (Pack of 12)
review_body: I first had Acai at Robeks in a smoothie and it tasted awesome. The Zola Acai is my favorite juice. If its to strong at first, start drinking the smoothie one until you get used to it. Acai is supposed to be one of the most healthy fruits. It has more antioxidants than any other fruit.

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Sleepytime Tea Variety Pack
review_headline: It's nice to have that something EXTRA.
review_body:
I use to take valarian root pill before I went to bed, but always felt it was a little too sedating. With this tea, it's a lot milder (the differance is like a Lullaby vs. a sledge hammer). It also has a nice aroma, bouquet, and flavor. I like to mix this with blueberry, or (when I'm under the weather) Echenacia tea (Celestials wellness tea).

One word of warning. If you're on any medications for anxiety, depression, etc., you may want to stick with regular Sleepytime.

product_title: India Tree Boughs of Holly Party Decoratifs, 3 lb
review_headline: I Felt Like A Thief When I Bought These!
review_body: What a steal!  I make a lot of Gingerbread Cookies during the holidays - large ones - over 6\\" long - and I bag them in florist corsage bags.  They look like you bought them at a fancy store.  These decorations are the best and they are so cheap.

product_title: Teeccino All-Purpose Grind Caffeine-Free Herbal Coffee, Almond Amaretto, 8.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_body: I am not a coffee drinker.  This product has a pleasant and full-bodied flavor.  I truly enjoy it.

product_title: Twinings
review_body: Love the smoky flavor. It has a slight whisky smell. This works for me as I enjoy single malts. My wife hates both, though, so beware.

product_title: World Confections Cigarettes
review_body: I love these! they are my favorite childhood candy and are so hard to find . Finally!

product_title: KONRIKO® Jalapeno All Purpose Seasoning
review_body: This stuff is great for almost everything....  We're going to get a case and give them away at Christmas.

product_title: Nature's Path Oaty Bites Cereal, 12.5 Ounce Box (Pack of 6)
review_body: Oaty Bites are very tasty, sweet cereal.  We use them for munching while watching movies, etc.  If you like sweet cereals, you'll enjoy them for breakfast as well.

product_title: General Foods International Coffee, French Vanilla Cafe Coffee Drink Mix, 9-Ounce Tins (Pack of 6)
review_body: Simply put, I've always loved this flavor and the price for a 6-pack was great. I love my Amazon deals. This is my first \\"grocery\\" purchase so it's nice to come out satisfied. I would have never thought to get food items from Amazon, but now I will!

product_title: SPANISH SAFFRON
review_headline: Dimwits - do you know what you are buying?
review_body: 1.  I highly doubt you were able to buy 1oz for $14.00.  Perhaps that was from your regular \\"dealer\\" for something else.    2.  And sure you can buy Indian or Chinese saffron but it is entirely different than Spanish saffron.    Amateurs.

product_title: Nature's Path Optimum Power Hot Oatmeal, Pack of Six 11.2-Ounce Boxes
review_headline: Tastes good and it's healthy, too!
review_body:
I bought a box of this oatmeal at our local grocery store, thinking it would make a nutritious easy to make breakfast for me. I was surprised it tasted so good. It's slightly sweet, just the way I like it.

The real test was when my 16 year old asked me if she could try it. She loved it! Now the only problem is keeping enough of it on hand for the both of us.

I heat the water in the microwave, and add it to the oatmeal in a bowl. It is nice to have a healthy choice for breakfast that is so easy to prepare.

product_title: Sea's Gift Korean Seaweed Snack (Kim Nori), Roasted & Sea Salted, 0.17-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24)
review_headline: Perfect little snack for seaweed lovers
review_body: I stumbled upon Sea's Gift (roasted/salted) seaweed at a Whole Foods and tried it.  It was cheap and delicious.  They're by no means filling but a great little treat for the price.  I didn't find any of the cloying fishy taste that I'd expect from a seaborn snack.  They are a lot like paper thin chips.  Directions encourage using them as a topping.  Have not tried that yet and probably won't.  The flavor, I think, would get lost on other food.  I eat them straight from the container.

product_title: Nature's Path Organic Frosted Toaster Pastries, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: These are delicious! They are much better and much better for you and the planet than more processed alternatives.

product_title: Womens Bean Project Mix Gldn Cornbread
review_body: You are supporting a very good cause, and this cornbread is rocking-good!  It turns out nice, moist and sweet.  You will enjoy it with any of the Women's Bean Project soups or chili mixes!

product_title: Amora Dijon Mustard
review_body: A friend of mine gave me a jar as a gift when she returned from Paris. It was amazing! So naturally I raved about it to her. She gave me another jar. I'm afraid to open it till I have to. I have looked all over the internet and there is none to be found. I thought my savior was here when I ran across it on Amazon.com, but alas no. Now I'm frustrated and having cravings.

product_title: Kellogg's Special K Bars, Honey Nut, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Healthier and tastier than Rice-Krispie treats
review_body: Now that I have a sit-down job after bartending for 12 years, I need to watch what I eat BIG TIME.  As I get older, though, I really crave a bite of something sweet after my meals.  I bought a case of these after I tasted how delicious they are.  While the red berry bars are a tad too sweet for me (but still good), I am tickled by how subtle the flavor is in the Honey Nut variety.  I don't normally care for nuts, but I think they really make the texture substantial in this context.  And there are a LOT of nuts (as you can see by looking at the area directly surrounding my desk chair).     At 90 calories, I have one in the morning with my coffee, and another at lunch after my noodle bowl.  Just right.  Don't expect a hefty, filling snack from these.  They're just enough to satisfy my sweet tooth, though.

product_title: Three 15-oz Bottles of Tangy Apricot Chipotle Sauce
review_body: Great sauce!  We found this at a store in the Sacramento,CA. area and have enjoyed it since.  It has a sweet taste followed by a mild spicy taste.  The only other thing I can liken this to is a mild chutney sauce but with a great spicy kick to it.  It is a bit pricey but worth it as a dipping sauce for ribs or chicken.  I have used it on ribbs and on grilled chicken with excellent results and rave reviews from friends and family.

product_title: Necta Sweet Sugar Substitute 1/2 Grain 1000 Tablets (Pack of 3)
review_body: No Problem.  This item had not been available in the local stores.  I now have a 3 year supply.

product_title: Santa Fe Bean Co., Instant Fat Free Vegetarian Refried Beans, 7.25-Ounce Pack (Pack of 8)
review_headline: Good refried beans, but too salty...
review_body: I agree with the other reviewers that these refried beans taste good, but I consider the salt content too high - both in terms of taste and health. Whenever I prepare these beans, I add salt-free corn to reduce the sodium content per serving, which helps. If the Santa Fe Bean Company would reduce the sodium content of this product by one-third, I would enthusiastically buy again. As it is, I probably won't, as I am watching my sodium intake.

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body:
Don't make the mistake of using standard ground shipping. I thought that this milk was a little too expensive because it is 'gourmet,' so i opted out of the overnight shipping to reduce shipping fees.

BIG MISTAKE! By the time the milk arrived on that hot summer day, it had been TWO WEEKS after it shipped out. The jug had burst and saturated the whole box. To make matters worse, the box had turned into cheese. Now I have a big, brown, rancid cheese block...a cheddardboard-box if you will.

product_title: Pamela's Ultimate Baking and Pancake Mix
review_body: This is the best pancake mix I have ever tried. Whether you NEED gluten-free mix or not, it make excellent pancakes! I have tried several other brands, and Pamelas stand above all others, IMHO.

product_title: Empacadora San Marcos Whole Jalapeno Peppers, Mild, 11-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: My family loves these peppers!  They were so mild, but still had enough flavor to taste like a jalapeno pepper.  I wish I could find them more often.  They are very hard to come by.  If you like mild peppers, these are excellent.

product_title: Ambrosoli Honees Filled Drops, 24 Pack
review_body: I couldn't believe it when I saw these on Amazon. I hadn't seen them in 25 years, since my teens. They've got a great, creamy-honey filling and are still as good as I remembered them.

product_title: Tazo® Zen Tea
review_headline: I feel at peace with the world when I drink this Zen Tea......
review_body: Tazo has done it again, folks.  When they concocted Zen, they definitely knew what they were doing.  For starters, this isn't your abuela's green tea.  Zen has notes of ingredients that include exotic green teas, lemon verbena, spearmint and natural flavor.  I especially took note of the spearmint, upon sipping it for the first time.  It's invigorating and dances on your tongue.  You can drink Zen with (or without) honey.  It's really your preference.  The tea tastes great on its own, but honey adds a great note of sweetness to this wonderful blend of herbal and green tea.  This is one habit you don't need to worry about breaking.  If you are ever feeling stressed out, make a date with yourself and set five minutes aside to sip this lovely beverage.  You won't be sorry.

product_title: Navitas Naturals Organic Raw Chocolate Powder Cacao Power King of Cacao, 16 oz (Pack of 2)
review_body: This stuff is delicious and you can create oh, so many recipes, but beware of the buzz about it being a SuperFood.  It's a DRUG, replete with caffeine, chocolate, all the things that give you a high and then drop you down low.
