In fact, it has more stimulants by weight than coffee or a chocolate bar, however natural it may be.  Just a word of warning...

product_title: A1 Steak Sauce - Original, 15 fl oz
review_body:
I can't believe I'm reviewing steak sauce here. But here goes. The best steaks don't need any sauce. But when you are dining on something below the sirloin cut, A1 is a mealsaver. Nothing beats it. It's also good on tenderloin, ribeye, or filet mignon, but if the meat is top quality, you want to taste the meat, not the sauce.

A1 is very good on hamburgers when you want a little zip. I especially like it on 95% lean ground sirloin burgers. The leaner the meat, the more you need a little something else to give it some zip. Ketchup gets the job done, but A1 is a nice detour from the ordinary.

product_title: Kraft Deluxe Rotini & White Cheddar Cheese Sauce with Broccoli, 9.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Hope you don't like broccoli much
review_body:
I knew that only a small amount of broccoli would be included and obviously in dried form. Even so, I was disappointed with the tiny particles of broccoli debris. They come wrapped in a dark green plastic pouch to help prevent you from noticing until the moment you dump them into the boiling water.

The next disappointment came when it was time to drain the boiled pasta and broccoli. Unless you've got a colander made from fine mesh like a tea strainer, you're going to lose a lot of the broccoli specks while draining. The alternative is to try skimming the water out instead of draining it completely, but you will end up with soupy, diluted cheese. This probably isn't too bad an idea if you prefer milder cheese flavor like me because the white cheddar cheese sauce was stronger than I expected.

Other than the draining challenge, the product was quick and easy to prepare, and a reasonable value.

product_title: Kellogg's All-Bran Cereal, Extra Fiber, 11.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: This cereal provides, in one-half cup, about half the recommended daily amount of dietary fiber.  Fiber is important for resisting weight gain, and it provides many nutritional benefits.  Since All Bran's taste is not that great by itself, I have always combined it with other cereals, making a moderate-sized bowl of cereal that provides both fiber and good taste.  It's a great way to start the day.  (No, Kellogg's didn't pay me to say that!)

product_title: Pamela's Products Chunky Chocolate Chip Cookies
review_body: These cookies are very rich, and at something like 120 calories for one cookie, that is probably a good thing - you won't overeat.  I like them, though, and they are the closest glutenfree chocolate chip cookie I have been able to find.  They make a very good treat for when I'm craving something really sweet!

product_title: Pirate's Booty Veggie, 1-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24)
review_headline: yummy and makes a great first finger food too!
review_body: we got these are having some of a friend's. our 10 month old actually liked them, and since they are much better for her than gerber puffs we bought a case.  she has since decided to be picky and not eat them anymore, but the rest of us love them, including my 2 year old. they make a healthy and surprisingly tasty snack!

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee, Mocha Java, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)
review_body: not a bad cup of coffee.. would have liked it to have more of a Mocha taste though.

product_title: U.S. Mills Skinner's Raisin Bran, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I buy this cereal by the case because my local store does not carry it. It is the best Raisin Bran, in my raisin eating opinion.  Not too sweet... is what I like about it.  Just great flavor and consistency.

product_title: Rye Berries, 1 lb.
review_body:
I ordered 4 pounds of rye berries and they were very satisfactory.Shipment arrived promptly and with no comlications.

Great product!

product_title: Vermont Morning Original Blend Oatmeal Plus, 100% ORGANIC, 8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: I have never been an oatmeal eater..just didn't enjoy it.  I knew it was good for me, but left me feeling sick to my stomach..and a bad way to begin my day.    Then...enter Vt. Morning!  This stuff is fabulous!  I eat it every morning, and am not hungry for 4 hours.  It is warm, comforting with a bit of crunchy chewy-ness and delicious without the slippery feeling you would expect from regular oatmeal.      The 8 grams of fiber with 3g of soluble fiber are good for my heart..and very satisfying.  For people who are allergic to wheat they also have a wheat free blend, which I plan to enjoy next order!    I highly reccomend this product and will definitely order it again!

product_title: Double Devon cream in 6oz jar-pack 2 jars
review_body: Enjoyed this product while in London so I was familar with it. Only place I could find it in my area.

product_title: Native Forest Artichoke Hearts, Quartered, 14-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_body: I won't order these again.  I was pleased to be ordering something that said \\"sustainable agriculture\\", but these are not good.  Half the cans are dented.  I'm afraid to eat these unless they are cooked, so cannot use them in salads.  They are not quartered, as near as I can tell, but are in tiny bits, lots of tough outer leaves and all the cans I've used so far are full of extremely mushy, teeny artichoke pieces.  I wish I had even one good thing to say, but I don't.  I've throw out over half of every can I've tried to use so far.

product_title: Pamela's Espresso Chocolate Chunk Cookies
review_body: I love these!  The only thing good about being on a gluten free diet is discovering these cookies!  I'm hooked.  I love the coffee flavor mixed with chocolate.  And for a dessert all the ingredients are pretty good!

product_title: Millstone Breakfast Blend Coffee, Whole Bean, 12 Ounce Package (Pack of 2)
review_headline: Smooth & Robust with Very Low Acidity
review_body: This is a great product at a good price. I am disappointed that it is currently unavailable. Hopefully this is just a temporary glitch as other Millstone products are still available.

product_title: Morinaga - Japanese Hi-Chew Strawberry Candy - 2.0 Oz
review_body: Extremely tasty candy with a texture unlike anything on the candy shelves in America. Imagine, if you will, popping a piece of soft strawberry gum into your mouth and beginning to chew--the first few seconds are always the best, when you get a blast of intense strawberry flavor along with a firm, enjoyable chew, right? Then imagine that gum melting away gradually on your tongue, without losing any of its flavor, rather than enduring and just becoming stringy and bland. Very nice indeed.

product_title: Candy Tree Organic Strawberry Laces, 2.6-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_body: My 5-year-old daughter is allergic to every artificial food color so it is difficult to find treats that are tasty and dye-free. This licorice has an excellent natural strawberry flavor. The pieces are a smaller size, which is nice for a child's portion. My only negative is that the texture is a little harder than what you've come to expect with your non-organic full-of-dye licorice, but I found myself gladly chewing a little longer for the wonderful flavor. Besides, it's not a bad thing to have to take a little longer to eat a piece of candy! I'm back to try the raspberry next.

product_title: Novello Di Macina Extra Virgin Olive Oil
review_headline: I am addicted to this novello olive oil
review_body: This harvest is only offered once a year, and my local cheese gourmet shop runs out of it quickly during the holidays when it comes out, so I was thrilled to find it on Amazon.  I bought 3 bottles, I use olive oil daily.  It has a wonderful nutty smell and taste, not a mild flavor at all.  Very special, pricey, but worth every penny.  I love it drizzled on bread or in dressings.  NOT a cooking oil.  I could drink it from the bottle.  Each year it tastes a little differently.  I also love Frantoia for everyday extra virgin olive oil.  It tastes like Italy!

product_title: Nutiva Organic Virgin Coconut Oil, 15 Ounce
review_body:
I have been studying the benefits of coconut oil for some time. I tried several different brands but when I opened a jar of the Nutiva I knew that I had found what I was looking for. Absolutely the freshest most wonderful organic virgin coconut oil on the planet.

I substituted the butter and/or vegetable oil in several recipes with the Nutiva coconut oil and achieved incredible results. I even fried eggs in it last night and they were GREAT! I will never fry with any other oil again. I also use it as a spread on toast, bagels, and muffins.

AAAAA+++++ Try it, you'll love it!

product_title: Big Train Blended Ice Coffee, Mocha, 2.8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 25)
review_body: My buddy got hooked on the \\"Coffee House\\" iced coffees, but was getting in too deep trying to fund his habit.  Ice, milk, and a packet of this makes a much cheaper but still yummy alternative. We liked it so much we ended up buying a case of the big bags - 17.5 lbs of iced coffee heaven.

product_title: Maxwell House Vanilla Ground Coffee, 11-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_headline: It's a coffee, it's a great smelling kitchen!
review_body: As a coffee drinker raised on Louisiana drip pot cafe au lait and coffee and chicory, I never thought I'd be hooked on a Maxwell House product, but here I am, unable to do without my Maxwell House Vanilla. Rich coffee flavor chased with the subtlety of soft brown-sugary  vanilla makes an unbeatable combination, plus when I brew a pot, my house smells as delicious as the coffee. I recommend Maxwell House Vanilla very highly;  it is not the cloying overpowering \\"flavored coffee\\" sledge hammer that so many of the blends can be, rather the natural pairing of complementary flavors.

product_title: Bare Fruit Organic Dried Mangos, 2.6-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 24)
review_body: I have tried many unsweetened, unsulphured mangoes, along with sweetened. The \\"mangoes\\" in these packages are just terrible. They are these little tiny pieces about the size of a scrabble piece, and are very thin - there is not a hint of moisture in them, and they have some type of scoring pattern on one side. I felt like I was eating a paper product. I do not recommend these to anyone! There are many many better options than this type - if you've ever tried the ones from Trader Joe's or Whole Foods Market....go back there! These are not even from the same family. If I can say one good thing, it is that they are organic. I thought the price was good, but the quality tells me why!

product_title: A Taste of Thai Peanut Noodles Quick Meal, 5.25-Ounce Containers (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love this stuff. My two complaints are: You can't see the fill water line well and the fact that it's 330 calories...but has two servings in one container. Like many \\"quick meals\\" I just thought it was one serving. Whoops. You do get a lot of noodles in here, and adding chicken, pork or shrimp will make it enough for 2 for dinner. Great value for the price. Yummy.

product_title: 3 Ballerina Tea Extra Strength Dieters Drink Value Pack - 54 Tea Bags (In 3 Boxes)
review_headline: couldnt use it but family loved it
review_body: I ordered this product because my sister said it worked great for her, I later found out I couldnt use it because I was breastfeeding. My family used it instead and it worked great for them, I will look into using it ince Im done nursing as my son is 6 mos old

product_title: Nirmala's Kitchen Spice Blend, Peruvian Inca Aji Blend, 1.6-Ounce Units (Pack of 4)
review_headline: Best Aji On The Market In This Country
review_body: I cooked a Bolivian Dish called Aji De Pollo and it tasted just like the Bolivian Aji.  I really enjoyed cooking and eating it and look forward in trying out some new Peruvian Recipes.

product_title: Lawry's Burrito Spices and Seasonings Mix
review_body: We made this seasoning purchase based upon the item as-pictured. Unfortunately, the received seasoning is quite different from what was pictured. To explain further, Lawry's made a significant change in their taco seasoning, not for the better, a number of months ago. When they did so, they also changed the packaging of the product. We based our purchase upon the pictured seasoning, the \\"old\\" and tasty seasoning, yet what we received was the \\"new\\" and not-so-tasty seasoning, which can be purchased at any grocery store. Not worth sending back, but if what you're looking for is the good stuff, avoid this one. I finally think I'm going to try my hand at making my own taco seasoning.

product_title: Teeccino All-Purpose Grind Caffeine-Free Herbal Coffee, Maya Caff?, 8.5-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)
review_body: So good that I don't think I could go back to regular coffee  [[ASIN:B000GRGW8Q Teeccino Maya Caffe All-Purpose Grind Naturally Caffeine-Free. 8.5 Ounce cans (Pack of 6)]]

product_title: Sorbee Sugar-Free Cookies
review_body: This flavor is just okay. They are crunchy, which is good, although MANY arrived broken to pieces. The peanut flavor lacks richness.  For those of us who love cookies but have to avoid sugar and white flour, the pickings are very slim.

product_title: Ker Cadelac Butter Biscuits from Brittany, Galettes de Bretagne, 11.5-Ounce Tin  (Pack of 2)
review_body: Great Cookies! However, amazon plans to send these cookies at the end of July... isnt that a long time for shipping?

product_title: Caffe Appassionato Organic Shade Grown Arietta Blend, Ground, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 3)
review_body: I highly recommend this coffee; it has great taste and aroma and is one of the best organically grown coffees that I have ever purchased.

product_title: Madhava Organic Agave Nectar - Raw, 17-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 12)
review_body: The taste is delicious and the product exceeded our expectations.  The price was very reasonable.

product_title: Diedrich K-Cups, Paradiso Dark, 25-Count Box (Pack of 2)
review_body: I just received this order yesterday and had some this morning.  So far, this is my favorite K-Cup coffee.  It is dark and rich with no bitter after taste.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars it that Amazon doesn't have it all the time, so when you see it, I'd suggest you order it right then.  I ordered this on Tuesday of this week and when I checked on Thursday, it is showing as unavailable.

product_title: Gator Hammock, 10 fl oz
review_body: This is an amazing hot sauce for those who really like to kick it up a notch without inducing extreme pain. It has the perfect blend of heat and flavor and it goes with everything. I have a collection of hot sauces, but this is the only one I almost need by the case. For a real delight, mix it with sour cream for a fast dip that is bound to get you big points. I can't say enough positive things about this product. In a world full of sauces that exist only to be hot, this is truly a condiment designed to be savored.

product_title: Panda Licorice, All-Natural, 1.125-Ounce Bars (Pack of 72)
review_body: This is a fantastic product.  All natural and for a licorice (un)liker like myself, this is a great way to enjoy licorice.  You will not be dissapointed with this product.

product_title: Nature's Path Organic Flax Plus Multibran Cereal, 13.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: Imagine a healthy low calorie cereal that tastes as good as the more main stream cereals!  Ever since I switched to a low fat, high nutrient diet, Flax Plus has been the standard choice with which to start the day.  It's definitely great that Amazon stocks it in multipacks since quantities are usually difficult to find locally and usually at a significant markup.  I strongly recommend it for those that are trying to ease into a diet regimen.

product_title: Annie Chun's Noodle Soup Bowls
review_headline: Considering it sits on the shelf...
review_body: ... it's not too bad.  They keep a long time so when I forget my lunch or simply have to work much later than I expected, I have something to eat at work without resorting to a vending machine.  More filling than popcorn and one of the better shelf-sitting noodle bowls available.  Adds variety to my workplace pantry.

product_title: Leonidas Belgian Chocolates: General Assortment
review_headline: I'd like to give it 5 stars, but...
review_body: It's just got that great.  Of course it's very good, it's Belgian chocolates, but I've had better.

product_title: Jelly Belly, Belly Flops
review_body: I ordered 5 bags and had two of them that were similar, but they still have a lot of variety.  It's amazing how close the shape was to the regular ones.... very particular quality assurance people!  Loved them

product_title: Fantastic World Foods Instant Black Beans, 6.1 -Ounces (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Don't Recommend it for Gluten Free Diets
review_body: I was glutened by this product.  It claims to be gluten free, yet at the same time it clearly states on this website, though not on the box, that this product shares production lines used by gluten foods.  Didn't care for the heavy handed spices anyway.  If your goal is gluten free, stay away.

product_title: Nature's Path Organic Frosted Toaster Pastries, 6-Count Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: I have a big family and appreciate a tasty snack that is wholesome and organic.This item fits the bill!! My sons really liked this treat. When toasted they are very fragrant and crisp, almost a cinnamon graham cracker like pastry with a rich fruit center, BUT lower in sugar than most snacks!! You will be suprised at how good they are!

product_title: Senseo Coffee Pods
review_headline: Do not buy this coffee flavor, get something else!!
review_body: Maybe it is just my personal taste, but I have tried close to all of the Senseo pod flavors and this is the only one I regret buying.  I generally like dark coffee, such as Yuban.  However, I will never purchase this flavor for my Senseo again.

product_title: Euro Patisserie Twiggles, Assorted, 4.3-Ounce (Pack of 8)
review_body: These sounded so good, but they're just not very exciting. Bland and kind of doughy in a shortening sort of way, not crispy or flaky like one might expect from the description of \\"butter\\" and \\"puff pastry\\". Perhaps refreshed in the oven, as the package suggests, would improve things.

product_title: ZICO Natural Coconut Water,11.2 fl. oz. (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Not even a little bit good
review_body: I would have to absolutely agree with the reviewer that said to try this before you buy a case of it. It really is an awful taste, it tastes like something that has sat in the sun for way too long. Perhaps, I was under the misguided impression that coconut water would taste remotely similar to coconuts, but this is sadly not the case.

product_title: Wabash Valley Farms Popcorn All-Inclusive Popping Kits - Real Theater Popcorn - 5 Pack - 27.5oz
review_body: We have really enjoyed the old time taste of this popcorn. I made a mistake and ordered two boxes but now am glad I did. Will probably have to order more sooner than expected. Thanks for the quality product--

product_title: Big Train Spiced Chai, 1.2-Ounce Bags (Pack of 25)
review_body: Big Train Spiced Chai is the best thing to happen to our kitchen since I learned the joys of oven-roasting.  This chai is SO unbelievably delicious, it is every bit as good as the chai lattes you pay a fortune for at your local coffeehouse.  In fact, we actually discovered this product because my husband became addicted to the chai lattes he was getting near his office.  It turns out that the place uses Big Train to make the chai lattes they charge 2 or 3 dollars for.  It's true! They apparently buy this in a large coffee can-sized container (which I think is also available here on Amazon, by the way).  Trust me on this.  You will not be sorry to have this in your pantry.  You won't get milk froth from these handy little packets, but you will get every bit of the flavor of the expensive coffehouse chai lattes.

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body: This stuff is amazing!  I ordered some the other day and selected express shipping so the total was like $35.00 for a gallon of milk, but it has changed my life.  My once bald head is now covered in thick, Fabio-like hair, my impotence is cured, I no longer have vertigo, dementia, incontinence, ringing ears, depression, psychosis, post-nasal drip, explosive diarrhea, herpes, or the plague.  Thank you Tuscan Milk!!  I am totally getting this for my wife for Christmas.

product_title: La Choy Chow Mein Noodles, 3-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 24)
review_body:
These crispy noodles have a lot of great uses. We use them to top all our stir frys and all our chinese/japanese dishes.

A super use of these is to add a whole can to a standard green salad. They add a super nice crunch to the salad and taste far better than croutons.

product_title: Reindeer Pooper Candy Dispenser
review_body: This little gem became a big hit with kids and adults a like.  I bought it as a stocking stuffer.  Easy to re-laod and fill with Sugar babies candy.

product_title: Bare Fruit Organic Dried Fuji Apple Chips, 2.6-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 24)
review_body: I was very disappointed in the taste of these. I found them very unpleasant as I usually like dried apples as a snack on WW but these aren't sweet or crunchy at all. Dosen't even taste like apples .It is more like a chore to eat these. I liked the Sensible Foods brand much better. I would not recommend this brand at all.

product_title: Fleur de Sel Caramels (5.3 ounce)
review_body: These caramels are simply splendid.  The touch of salt adds a nice richness and the texture is simply divine.  They're firm enough to be worth chewing, but not so dense that you need to worry about your fillings.

product_title: Healthy Choice Hearty Chicken Soup, 15-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: I had a good time with this soup, I mixed it with a pasta mix and added some extra chicken, this made it a larger meal and it was very good. The soup by its self makes a good quick bowl of soup with great flavor.

product_title: Anna's Thins
review_body: I love these cookies and intended to give them as gifts in gift baskets.  Each box had more than 50% broken cookies so I did not use them for gifts.  The case packaging is obviously not adequate for shipping.

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body:
This guide provides system requirements, installation instructions, and other, step-by-step instructions that you can use to deploy milk clusters if you are using Tuscan® Milk Server(tm) 2003 1 Gallon, Enterprise Edition, or Tuscan Server 2003, Datacenter Edition, operating systems.

The milk cluster technology in Tuscan Server 2003, Enterprise Edition, and Tuscan Server 2003, Datacenter Edition, helps ensure that you have access to important dairy-based resources. You can use milk cluster technology to create several cluster nodes that appear to users as one gallon milk. If one of the nodes in the cluster fails, another node begins to provide service. This is a process known as \\"dairy-failover.\\" In this way, milk clusters can increase the availability of critical applications and resources in the dairy farm.

product_title: Doctor Kracker Snackers, Seeded Spelt, 8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 5)
review_body: Previously, I ordered these crackers from the original Dr. Kracker company. I was completely satisfied until Amazon took over. After that, Amazon changed the bundle so that one must buy 6 boxes at a time, which is way too much. Also, the last shipment of crackers I received were expired. I only noticed that after I had gone through half of them wondering why they were stale. Make sure yours are not expired before you eat them. The crackers are tasty. I prefer the pumpkin cheese, but the overall experience has been meteocre.

product_title: Twinings Prince of Wales Tea
review_headline: My favorite tea - for a reason!
review_body: I can't say enough good things about this variety and brand of tea.  The bergamot and other citrus elements in the tea and the delicacy of the tannins make milk, sweetener or lemon completely unnecessary.  The color and aroma are just lovely, making this a fantastic treat for the novice or experienced tea drinker, and it has just enough caffeine to get me through tedious afternoons without making me jittery.  I carry the bagged variety everywhere I go.

product_title: Sinfully Delicious Mocha Butterscotch Sundae, 6-Count, .9-Ounce Box (Pack of 2)
review_body: *****  I love the Sinfully Delicious products.      The taste doesn't exactly match the flavor, but all of them are still good.    You just have to get over the taste of the outer coating of fake sugar.    It's worth waiting for the flavor inside.    I'm so glad that Amazon carries them now so that I can buy them in bulk (CHEAP)   and I don't have to pay shipping.      I ordered almost every flavor beccause I can't find them in the grocery stores here.      I thought that I would have a lot of help from my co-workers in eating them, but   at least half of them hated these things -- too much like Rolaids -- they said.  I think they're nuts.    You don't chew them -- you let them dissolve.      So great for only a few calories!!!!   ( I AM on a diet so my taste-buds are \\"trained\\" for fake sugar.)      I have to restrain myself from eating too many (or they will make me sick...like any fake sugar products.)

product_title: Wild Oats Natural Roasted & Salted Virginia Peanuts, 9-Ounce Bags (Pack of 9)
review_headline: Good Virginia Peanuts, but could use more salt
review_body: Don't get me wrong - I'm not addicted to salt and I actually never add salt to anything that I eat, but I expected these nuts to taste like Whitley's famous Virginia Peanuts and they just don't.  They could use a little more salt.  They also taste a little over blanched -- it's hard to describe.  For virginia peanuts, however, these are a good value.  I'm afraid, however, that I'm headed back to Stew Leonards for their version of these Virginia Peanuts -- they taste more like Whitleys.

product_title: Sun Maid Tropical Trio, 7-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: This product is simply awesome...specially the mango and pineapple cubes...you gotta try it to understand what I mean...moreover the price at Amazon is cheaper than retail price at local stores in Orange County area...so I always order it off Amazon...truly speaking I am addicted to it!!! :-)

product_title: PG Tips Pyramid Black Tea 160 Bags, 17.6 Ounce Unit (Pack of 4)
review_body: very good quality tea, absorbed into water very fast, only pain is to pick up the dowsed bag

product_title: Numi Tea Puerh Mini Tuocha, Flowering Black Tea, Loose Leaf, 8-Ounce Bags (Pack of 2)
review_body: This is a good tea.  The tea is very fine & actually gets through my fine mesh tea strainer.  Rishi makes their bowl tea with big fat leaves, not tea dust compacted together, similar to partical board.  That's why I gave it 4 stars.  I'd give it 3.5 if I could.  Rishi tea is far better.  Right now Amazon isn't offering it.  If you find you are able to try it, please do!  This is a VERY dark tea.  As black if not blacker than coffee!  The flavor is bold and intense.  You will either love it or hate it.  I don't think there is an in-between.  This tea is fermented/composted first giving it it's bold flavor.  Sounds nasty, but it works!  I've also read that this tea is used to support weight loss if your looking for a tea for that purpose.  Not for the faint of heart! By the way, I wouldn't call it a \\"flowering\\" tea.  It isn't shaped to open up like a flower.  If you leave it loose in your mug you will have to strain it.  It's in a bowl shape that isn't tied, but individually wrapped in paper.  You must remove the paper to brew it.  A tea brewer or bag is recommended.

product_title: Swee-Touch-Nee Tea, Orange Pekoe (97.5% Caffeine Free), 24-Count Tea Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: Swee-Touch-Nee was my mother's favorite tea, so drinking it brings back fond memories. I was delighted to find this nearly-decaf version at the local supermarket last year, but they stopped carrying it. The decaf tea tastes just as good as the original. Admittedly, it will take a long time to use up 12 boxes....I debated for a while whether or not to buy it, but I'm glad I did.

product_title: Kashi GOLEAN Bar Roll! Caramel Peanut, 12 - 1.94 oz Bars
review_body: I love eating these for breakfast, since they have a good amount of protein and fiber.  They taste like a peanut roll, are very chewy (so eating them takes a bit) and go great with coffee!

product_title: LightFull Smoothie, Chocolate Fudge, 11-Ounce Units (Pack of 12)
review_body: The flavor, consistency and content is GREAT!  I just love it.

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body:
I've been hearing a lot about \\"milk\\" lately. Its supposed to \\"do a body good\\" and improve your quality of life. My friends have been telling me for years that its essential to a balanced meal. I was just told last week that \\"everyone was doing it\\" and if I wanted to be cool I should too.

Well, after 30 years I've just had my first glass of milk and I've got to say that I'm not impressed. Sure, it goes great with cereal, but I still couldn't run all that fast. I can't lift up cars or move giant pieces of concrete to save small animals. I still can't fly, turn invisible, or change into spandex in a phone booth. The only thing I was really impressed with was the way milk bubbles out my nose when I laugh. Still, thats not enough to get me to drink 3 glasses of the stuff a day! All in all I'm more than a little disappointed. I'd suggest shopping around a bit before spending that $3.99.

product_title: Savory Choice Beef Broth Concentrate, 5.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
review_body: This broth tastes just like roast beef; rich, delicious and full of flavor. Some may think it's a little salty so taste your food before seasoning with extra salt. I'm definitely going to buy more because it is so easy to turn into broth and takes up much less cupboard space than the boxes of stocks. Excellent product.

product_title: Mahatma Rice Spanish
review_body: This is a must for accompanying tacos or fajitas in our house.  I have tried all the others and not only is this easy and pretty healthy (minus the MSG - Mahatma, please remove it!) it is definitely the best tasting - clearly, why else would I order it online?!  It's a must have.

product_title: Nana's Single Serve Cookies, 3.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12)
review_body: These are the only cookies I have found that I can safely eat without feeling poorly afterwards and which taste similar to a \\"real\\" chocolate chip cookie. I try to limit refined sugars, wheat flour, and dairy products in my diet for health reasons, but oh, how I miss cookies. The ones I bake myself just don't taste that great, but these chocolate chip cookies from Nana's help me keep to my prescribed way of eating. I don't know what I'd do without them! I like to freeze them, and sometimes I top one with a bit of Rice Dream \\"ice cream\\" on top. Yummy!

product_title: Planters Macadamia Lovers Mix, 5.5-Ounce Canisters (Pack of 6)
review_body: I was a little disapointed that the product was so small, I didn't bother to read how big the cans were. Also the serving size is tiny, I sat down and ate an entire can then looked at the label to see that I just ate 6 servings!!

product_title: Emerald Nuts Glazed Walnuts, Chocolate Brownie, 6-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 12)
review_body: Overall good but the chocolate glaze tastes like dried cocoa. Not exactly the chocolate you may be expecting??

product_title: Slim Jim Snack Sticks
review_body: If you like regular Slim Jim's, then you should like the Nacho flavor.  Similar to most of my food reviews, these are great for a low-carb diet.  For low-carbers the only problem is the HEFTY dose of sodium, so drink lotsa water with these.

product_title: Gumbo File, 1 oz.
review_body: Have purchased green fava beans  from this seller and they were/are great. Fast shipping, great quality fair price considering I couldn't find 'em any where around here :) Just ordered, File Powder for Cajun cooking. Can't find THAT around here either. I expect it to be of the same high quality as the Fava beans.

product_title: Fresh Whole Rabbit
review_headline: Delicious if you baste it poperly
review_body: Rabbit is delicous if you baste it properly.  Any chef will tell you that the ONLY way to baste a rabbit is from the inside.  Also you cannot let it sit in the bottom of the roasting pan.  The BEST tools for this are a bit unconventional.    I like to use some kind of kinky anal lube device to squirt the juices all over the rabbit.    Also, we use banana hammock underwear to support the rabbit during the long juicy cooking process.

product_title: Newman's Own Organics Newman O's Cookies
review_body:
These high-sodium ginger cookies are too tasty to have around - you'll easily surpass your RDA of sodium in one sitting.

The nutrition facts that Amazon neglected to post are: Serving size is 2 cookies (28 g). Each serving has 160 mg of sodium, 4.5 mg of fat (2 g saturated, 0 g transfat), 19 g of total carbs (10 g sugars), and 0 g of cholesterol.

The ingredients in these \\"Made in U.S.A.\\" cookies are organic unbleached wheat flour, powdered sugar, organic palm fruit oil, organic molasses, organic sugar, sodium bicarbonate (leavening), ground ginger, soy lecithin (an emulsifier), salt, monocalcium phosphate (leavening), and nutmeg. There are no hydrogentated oils or trans fats.

On the back of the package is an Ode to Ginger-O's, which reads: \\"You might, m'lady tweak my nose. You could, m'lord step on my toes. But Heaven help those poor bozos, who try to filch my Ginger-O's \\".

Again, these high-sodium cookies taste too good in order to effectively exercise self-discipline to limit the quantity eaten.

product_title: Just the Cheese Popped Cheese, 1.7-Ounce Bags (Pack of 6)
review_body: I found these okay at best.  On the salty side.  Not very enjoyable.  Okay snack.

product_title: Coombs Family Farms Maple Syrup, Premium Grade B, 32-Ounce Jugs (Pack of 2)
review_body: The syrup tastes good.  However, it is very difficult to pour without spilling over onto the side and being wasted.

product_title: Mementa White Tea, 100 Count (Pack of 8)
review_headline: i know nothing of white tea
review_body: this is my first straight up white tea purchase, i bought this on a clearance sale at Marshall's. It's very light and aromatic. I use it a lot in my \\"healthy\\" iced tea. Here's the recipe for a gallon. 4 bags of black tea, 4 bags of white tea, 4 bags of oolong, 4 bags of Lipton citrus or Berry flavored green tea. Goal is to get the health benefits of all the teas without making pots and pots of each. I brew it in a big teapot for about 10 minutes or so and pour it into the gallon pitcher and then add filtered water to make one gallon. I personally add ONE little packet of sweet and low,but it really doesn't need any sweetening. It's delicious and healthy. I'm about to order more of this white tea.

product_title: Amedei Limited Edition Chuao Napolitains
review_body: Having always a refined palate and sense of smell, good food has long been a joy in my life.  Not to say it is purely a blessing: as a child I hated zoos because the smell would penetrate my core and incapacitate me to some degree.  But on to the chocolate.  I would by no means call myself a choco-holic, at least I wouldn't have before I tried these amazing creations from Amedei.  Chocolate usually leaves an unpleasant aftertaste in my mouth that lingers long beyond the joy I receive from its initial flavor.  However, the Amedei I have tried thusfar provides no unpleasant aftertast whatsoever.  On the contrary, the incredibly potent, delicious aromas and contrasts lingers on the tongue and in the nose for fifteen, sometimes thirty minutes after enjoying the chocolate.  As for the initial flavor, imagine the purest cocoa aroma.  However, like I have hinted already, Amedei chocolates are unlike any other I have tried.  Like a fine glass of red wine, the chocolate possesses layers of flavors that change as it melts on your tongue.  As the chocolate begins to melt, notes of raspberry and currant light up, still accompanied by this delectably smooth, rich chocolatiness that can only be described as bliss.  A friend who was luckiest enough for me to share with described the sensation as if she were on some sort of drug: a chocolate drug.  I agree, and recommend buying several napolitains, and savoring one each morning.  Amedei might have found a substitute for morning coffee, one that far surpasses in both flavor and effect.  Trust me, your days will be much happier with a start like this.  But this chocolate is so special no description can truly do it justice.  You much try it yourself, and remember not to chew.

product_title: Triple Leaf Tea Blood Pressure Tea Bags, 20 Count
review_body:
I bought this online for my husband. I was going to order a more

expensive brand from another online store, but this was fabulous.

Not only did it lower his blood pressure, he felt lighter and energetic

(the tea has detox properties) and he was \\"friskier\\".

My husband takes the worst care of himself and if this can help him it will help anyone.

product_title: Nature's Path Organic Granola Bars, Lotta Apricot, 5-Count Bars (Pack of 6)
review_body: I am deployed to Iraq, so I needed some healthy snacks I could take with me, that were semi-perishable.  I ordered these bars and couldn't be happier!  They are soft, chewy and taste great!  The fact that they are organic and made from whole grains and other wholesome ingredients is a big plus.  These are a good substitute for a dessert, especially when you are craving something sweet and chewy.  The only negitive for me was that Amazon will not ship to APO addresses, so I had to ship these to my parents first, for them to ship them to me.

product_title: Timothy's World Coffee, Midnight Magic, Bold, K-Cups for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count Boxes (Pack of 2)
review_body: I have tried quite a few of the different brands of coffee put out by Timothy's, Green Mountain and also Dietrich's and I do have to say that this is my favorite so far.  If you like a full bodied, flavorful cup of coffee...look no further this is it!  Not that any of the others aren't good, they are, but this one really hits the mark!  Enjoy!

product_title: General Foods International, Chai Latte Drink Mix, 9.7-Ounce Tin (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Nice Surprise from General Foods International
review_body:
I still remember the 1970's commercials for General Foods International with Broadway star Carol Lawrence in some faux-garden waxing fondly of the joys of orange cappuccino. I thought the product line had long since been eliminated, but to my surprise, I received a tin of the Chai Latte as part of a free promotional package Amazon sent a couple of months ago. I finally got around trying it, and it's pretty tasty. Instead of coffee, the makers intriguingly decided to use a base flavor of black tea infused with cinnamon, cardamom, nutmeg and ginger.

Naturally the tea is all combined with sugar and non-dairy creamer, and the resulting powder provides a lighter taste than other instant chai latte mixes I have tried. You do need to use copious amounts to get the rich flavor, about four teaspoons as prescribed. It also helps to use milk instead of water and then nuke it for two minutes. According to the nutrition facts, each serving without the milk has seventy calories, twenty of which comes from fat, and there are 18 servings per tin. If you are looking for lighter alternatives to your hot chocolate, definitely give it a try.

product_title: Original LantChips, Mesquite BBQ, 1.5-Ounce Bag, (Pack of 28)
review_body: These potato chips are very tasty -- they have a very pleasant crunch and the BBQ seasoning is just right. They say 150 calories per serving, but watch out, because they also indicate that each bag is 1.5 servings. There are enough chips to be satisfying -- a great portion controlled snack!

product_title: Haribo Gummi Candy Gold-Bears,
review_body: Received 5 lb poly bag of gummie bears....very disappointing... they are somewhat hard and difficult to chew. Not like the Haribo Gummi bought at Walgreens in a small package, which were soft and easy to chew. Are these dried out? Old stock?

product_title: Health Valley Mini Cookie, Chocolate Chocolate Chip, 8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)
review_body: Six pretty little bags in a box. No packing, no padding. Six pretty little bags of cookie crumbs. If you manufacture ice cream you should contact this vendor. This cookie crumbs would be very nice if mixed in with vanilla or even chocolate ice cream. A creative person might even salvage their purchase by sprinkling the crumbs over a desert. Whoever it is selling this stuff should be ashamed.

product_title: Violet Crumble 50gm (Pack of 3 Bars) Australian
review_body: This is my absolute favorite candy bar.  It is similar to sponge candy (seafoam to Michiganders), with a honeycomb like center that just melts in your mouth.  The outside is covered in chocolate.  It's somewhat hard to find and a bit expensive, though Amazon's price is a little better than the last time I purchased it in a store.

product_title: Cereal, Puffed Millet, No Salt, 6 oz.
review_body: I was a little afraid that this cereal would be plain and have no taste, but it has a mild nutty flavor and a pleasant texture.  Definitely recommend.

product_title: Post Waffle Crisp Cereal, 13.75-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 5)
review_body: This cereal is great.  I am not a big cereal eater but I cannot resist Waffle Crisp.  I wish it was in more stores because it is so hard to find.  You will not be disappointed with this cereal.

product_title: Yogi Tea
review_body:
I've tried every green chai available and this is hands down my favorite. The dominant spice is ginger and the aromas during steeping are incredible.

Unlike many green teas, you can brew this for an extended time (i.e. when you forget about it) and it still doesn't get bitter. I take mine with a little sweetener and some cream.

Excellent tea and it can't hurt that it is organic. Enjoy!

product_title: Mariani California Apricots, 6-Ounce Units (Pack of 12)
review_body: This item is difficult to find in my area of western North Carolina.  I was pleased to see it available here.  The product is a great snack loaded with fiber and nutrition.

product_title: Altoids Curiously Strong Mint, 1.76-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Altoid smalls: the iPod Nano of Altoids
review_body:
These are the best Altoids ever. Each mint piece has the same great strength and now without all the Sugar!! Eating 2 of them can really make some people cry, they are that strong. 1 mint is just the perfect dose.

The box is a delight to open each time, with a perfect disappear anywhere size. The design is just awesum.. as my review title say, its just like an ipod nano compared to the larger box. If you are an altoids fan you jut have to try these. Buy them NOW.

The only problem:
Since these are so portable you would feel like carrying them on you everywhere and then the mints would jingle like bells with each step you take. Very distracting.

UPDATE:
My original review was written for Altoids smalls peppermints but somehow got mapped to the normal original altoids. If you like the original altoids you GOTTA try altoids smalls. They are the functionally exquisite.

product_title: Immaculate Baking Company Cookies, Pumpkin Gingerlies, 1.25-Ounce Snack Bags (Pack of 32)
review_body:
I love anything and everything pumpkin, whether sweet or savory it brings a smile to my fave and makes me feel warm, cozy and happy. Maybe that's why Halloween is my favorite holiday and I start celebrating it in September! Since pumpkin pie is my favorite dessert I ordered these Pumpkin Gingerlies simply because I have never had a pumpkin flavored cookie before. The beauty of the Immaculate Baking Co. is the deep flavor each tiny cookie has. Each little treat is about two bites and is satisfying and flavorful, I don't feel the need to eat a huge cookie when I can have one or two of these guys and feel my sugar cravings bite the dust!

What hit me first was the spicy, tropical ginger, then the mellow buttery pumpkin, it really tastes like a mini pumpkin pie, crust and all. The flavor combination was superb, from peppery and zingy it melted into luscious, creamy milky pumpkin. These cookies are packaged in 2oz. bags that are easy to throw in my purse and take with me wherever the road leads that day. Each baggie is only 130 calories and these are so rich and delicious I feel like I am eating a whole pie and at times can't even finish the little bag. I love knowing they are all natural with no trans fats and the brand is not only eye catching but worth the consumer's time.

For those who like their life a little sweet, a little spicy and definitely tasty this is the cookie for them! These were a lovely surprise but since trying few other flavors from Immaculate Baking Co I do not get surprised anymore, I know their cookies will taste great and I am never disappointed.

- Kasia S.

product_title: Pear Champagne Vinegar 8.45 oz
review_body: This stuff is yummy! I have a lot of food sensitivities, including berries, so the raspberry vinegrettes used in many salads are out. I think this one is even better anyway since the pears add a consistent sweet sweet note to the vinegar tang. I blend it with my favorite olive oil (Spectrum Organic Spanish Extra Virgin)to make delicious (and healthy, lower calorie) dressing for green salads, coleslaw, potato salad, brown rice with salmon and capers, etc. In many cases I don't add anything else besides salt and pepper. I've gotten rave reviews from guests of all ages. The only thing I could wish for is that it would be organic as well.

product_title: Kudos with Snickers Milk Chocolate 10 ct Granola Bars 8.3 oz
review_body: At only 100 calories each & tasting just like snickers bars, these are always in my pantry for a quick chocolate fix!!!

product_title: Arrowhead Mills Apple Cinnamon Buttermilk Pancake/Waffle mix, 28-Ounce Unit (Pack of 6)
review_headline: Wonderful Pancakes for Apple Cinnamon Lovers
review_body: When my local Whole Foods in Chicago stopped carrying this (supposedly due to shelf space), I went online to find it.  The downside is that you have to order 6 of them (case) but I was amazed to find how quickly this inventory starts to dwindle down.    The mix itself is classic Arrowhead Mills:  Whole grain goodness, high quality ingredients and a light, fluffy pancake.  The mix has bits of dried apple so when you mix it things appear lumpy but it's not a batter issue.  I've turned on a few friends to this subtle yet flavorful batter mix.

product_title: Sugar Free Cherry Licorice Bites
review_body: This is the most disgusting, dry, tastless licorice I have ever tasted in my 47 years of life on this planet (44 years of eating licorice). I ended up throwing most of it away!

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body: I have been a brewer of milk for sixteen generations and I am yet to have stumbled across such a magical taste. Some would say that expired rice and twelve types of clover do not a milk drink make, but those folk are liars. Buy this milk.

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body: I remember Tuscan Milk from our days back in the Marine Corps.     We served 16 tours of duty in 'Nam and Tuscan always had my back. Our working relationship was a beautiful thing to behold. I remember one month when it rained the whole time... it was that month where Tuscan took 6 commie RPGs that were meant for me! Talk about milk doing your body good! With all the nurtients and minerals he was packing, he shrugged each one off with a maniacal grin and then let Charlie have it with the .50 cal. Tuscan was also 1 hell of a chopper pilot, always buzzing Charlie's hair and gettin' in and out with a minimum of flak.    So I hardily recommend Tuscan Milk for your everyday battles: at work, at school, on the freeway, or on the bus. You will always be glad that you had Tuscan Milk!

product_title: Bob's Red Mill Diced Dried Apples, 8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 8)
review_headline: Bob's Red Mill Diced Dried Apples
review_body: Bob's Red Mill Diced Dried Apples, 8-Ounce   Red Mill products are always excellent quality. The apples are no exception. they, being dried, are quite sweet so maybe figure that into any recipe you are preparing.

product_title: Stash Tea Premium Green Tea, 10 Count Tea Bags in Foil (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Very good for what it is
review_body:
We've been \\"product testing\\" a variety of green teas in our office. So far the Stash green has been the most favorably received, just ahead of the Yamamoto-yama \\"Sushi Bar\\" tea. Stash won out due to the fact that it's got a distinctive green tea \\"taste\\" and seems resistant to bitterness from oversteeping. \\"Sushi Bar\\"-like some others-tended to be a little weak. Other rejected greens veered to the other end of the spectrum were overly bitter if you so much as looked at them wrong.

As described, it is slightly sweet and nutty. The description also states that this green tea is imported from Brazil. That might be a bit off-putting at first. However, it's idiot-proof and, like the title alludes to, this is teabag tea and for that, the Stash is very good stuff.

product_title: Norfolk Manor Jelly Babies, 8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: A good imitation of the original
review_body: Let's face it.  Bassett's Jelly Babies are the original and the best.  But this Jelly Babies copy, from Norfolk Manor, is enough to tide me over for a while.  I recently visited the UK and became pretty well addicted to Bassett's Jelly Babies.  But they aren't sold in the US because of some ingredient not approved by the US Food and Drug Administration. The Norfolk Manor version is also from the UK and importable.  I was eating my last remaining Bassett's Jelly Baby and decided that I must have more, so these from Norfolk Manor showed up and I had all 12 8-ounce packs sent to me. They are not the same quality, a bit too sugary like the standard candies I am used to in the US. But they are still better than most other \\"sweets\\" I have tried, and I don't want to be too harsh on them because they are a decent imitation.  I recommend them, but you candy enthusiasts and Doctor Who fans should get your hands on some Bassett's originals in your life at some point.

product_title: Individually Wrapped Pickled Crunchy Green Plum (Karikari Ume) - 8 Oz
review_body: This isn't really a candy, it's actually a whole plum in each wrapper with a crunchy skin and sweet \\"pickled\\" taste. It's somewhat addictive, and goes fast. Surprising how loaded with carbs it is. Very tasty and unique.

product_title: Freeze Dried Strawberries CAN, 6 oz.
review_headline: My picky toddler can't stop eating them!
review_body: My two year old is extremely picky, but he always loved to pick out the strawberries from my special K cereal. After accumulating three boxes of berry-less cereal, I decided to give these a try. The first canister was gone in a week! They are yummy right out of the can, or in cereal, smoothies, desserts, you name it. Ive also tried their banana chips, very tasty!

product_title: Kalahari Camps Bay Chamomile Red Tea
review_body: This is one of my favorite Kalahari teas.  It is perfect when you're looking to sit back, relax and do some reading.  With a bit of honey, it is just that much better.

product_title: Saffron Stigma, Fine Quality, Gold of Spices
review_body: Very good quality saffron, I would recommend not only the product but the seller too. I have used it and I very much like the quality and I will happily by this brand of saffron again.

product_title: Calbee Harvest Snaps Snapea Crisps
review_body: First things first. Snapea Crisps do have 8 grams of fat (and 150 calories) per serving, with a serving size being one oz., which is approx. 22 of the cute little life-sized pea pod thingies. The good news is that they also have 5 grams of protein per serving, so you can hold you chin up while scarfing down the bag, which has been the compulsion of everyone I've known who's tried them. Kids love the taste, too! These also make great finger food snacks for toddlers, as the little pod thingies are finely textured. My only complaint is that I have to share them with every one else in the house. At this price, tho, you can afford to buy a case and hoard a few bags for yourself.

product_title: Illy Cafe Medium Roast ESE Serving Espresso Pods, Medium Roast, 18-Count 4.4-Ounce Cans (Pack of 2)
review_body: The coffee makes a pretty good shot of espresso, and although I once got a tin full of loose grounds, Amazon was quick to ship me a replacement set.  However, the current price (over thirty dollars for two tins), IMO, is much higher than what you can find at other online coffee retailers, where the newer tins with individually wrapped pods sell for twenty-five per 2 tins.

product_title: Gib's Bottled Hell Hot Pepper Sauce
review_body: This is absolutely the best relish-style hot sauce available.  I first tasted it at the restaurant, which closed several years ago.  It's great in cajun dishes, as well as in chili and on sandwiches.

product_title: Japanese Style Mochi Cookie Sampler Pack (Matcha, Purple Yam, Peanut, Red Bean, Seasame) - 30 Pieces - 32 Oz with 2 Free Brown Rice Tea Bags
review_body: I was expecting it to be literal rice cakes but what I found them to be were sort of a clear gelatinouse wrapping filled with a cream mixture of the different flavors described on the box though the box didn't contain much english (much of it was in taiwanese)on it or a picture guide for me to tell which fillings were which.

product_title: Heat Up Your Valentine! Award Winning Chipotle Double Fudge Chunk Cookies: Four 4-Packs (16 Cookies Total, 1.33 lb)
review_body: These are the best cookies!!!  I picked some up at Central Market in Austin and was happily surprised by the unique flavor.  The Chipotle makes it a great chocolate surprise.

product_title: Medaglia D'Oro Instant Espresso Coffee, 2 oz
review_body: I of course prefer freshly made espresso but sometimes instant is good in a pinch.  I travel around Europe extensively and there are several brands available there which aren't at all bad.  This brand is OK for using it as a coffee flavoring in custards, etc., but as a beverage, it rates rock bottom in my book.

product_title: Back to Nature All-Natural Cereal, Flax & Fiber Crunch, 14-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: This is the best tasting cereal I have ever had.  It has just the right amount of textures (flakes, crispy rice and crunchy oats).  It stays crunchy in milk.  Plus it's good for your heart & colon!  I'd pick this cereal over any other cereal on the market, even the sweet, sugary kinds!

product_title: Red Vines European-Style Black Licorice Bites, 7-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_body: Liked this real licorice taste. But should not eat too much at one time.Will buy again

product_title: Taylors of Harrogate Imperial Gunpowder Leaf Tea, Loose Leaf, 4.41-Ounce Tins (Pack of 2)
review_body: I make no claim to being a tea expert. I simply like to drink tea. This one makes a nice change. The flavor is gently smokey and smooth; one could call it lapsang for beginners :-). If you find you enjoy its gentle smoke then be daring and try lapsang souchong which is _very_ smokey indeed. Go easy on the amount, a little goes a long way, and give it a few minutes to fully unroll its leaves. Then enjoy!

product_title: Genisoy Soy Crisps, Rich Cheddar Cheese, 1-Ounce Bags (Pack of 18)
review_body: Genisoy's soy crisps are a great alternative to potato chips or rice cakes.  They have just enough cheesiness to satisfy cravings and have lots of soy protein to keep you feeling full. I think the larger bags might be a better deal, but the individual serving bags are handy- I keep a few in my desk at work and also in my car. I have also tried the apple cinnamon, sea salt, and salt & vinegar, and this one is by far my favorite.

product_title: Pirate's Booty Veggie, 4 Ounce (Pack of 12)
review_body:
They're good! My mom who is in a nursing home loves 'em too. I take her a few bags each time I go to see her. I bought 3 cases just for that reason.
And they have Kale!!!...tasty, and with Kale???....amazing feat! (not feet)

product_title: Raw Revolution Organic Live Food Bar
review_body: I don't know what the GI is for these bars, but they really manage to keep me full for hours.  I split one for breakfast and a snack a few hours later, and it does the trick.  When I start my day off with a Luna bar, i am hungry just an hour later. They are sweetenned with Agave nectar which does not affect your blood sugar as much as sugar, nothing artificial and everything organic and raw makes these actually good for you!  They do taste a lot like figs and cashew butter, which might turn some people off but I think its delicious!  Raspberry Chocolate flavor is amazing too.  Calorie count is 276, which is fine for breakfast and lunch combined.

product_title: Butlers Chocolate Caramel Crunch Bar, 2.6475-Ounce Bars (Pack of 20)
review_body: These Butler bars are the best ever that we've had.  We live in the US and chocolate here is completely different.  European chocolate tends to taste richer and less waxy as is certainly the case with this Irish chocolate.  It is well worth the money to import these premium chocolate bars.  In bulk it's cheaper than your standard supermarket bar and tons tastier.

product_title: Sour Punch Bites Strawberry, 5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24)
review_body: great source to order virtually any kind of candy your sweet tooth desires, and speedy shipping too. !!!

product_title: Niederegger Marzipanerie
review_headline: It's expensive but definitely worth it!
review_body: I really love these marzipan candies. They are great all year, but especially during the holiday season. This product has a fine almond taste  and it is NOT SO SWEET like the usual stuff which only tastes of sugar! Yes, they are expensive and the shipping is even more expensive, but for me they are worth it.

product_title: Bawls Buzz,  0.68-Ounce Tins (Pack of 12)
review_headline: It's Bawls, except, you know... solid.
review_body: The mints are just as the title says, solid bawls. They really don't taste like mints at all, more like sweet tarts. The Fizzy carbonation effect is sweet as hell though, they're worth it just for that.

product_title: OrgraN Fruit Filled Bars, Blueberry, 20-Count Box
review_body: Good fruity taste and good tasting all around.  I just wish the bars were a little bigger so I wouldn't have to eat two of them to curb my appetite.

product_title: Sweet Memories of Cebu Philippine Brand Dried Mangoes Naturally Delicious (1 lb 4 oz)
review_body: That's the best way to describe it.  You pop it in your mouth, and the sensation is similar to chewing on beef jerky, only much better.  The flavor starts to come through very quickly - creamy and aromatic.      It's certainly the easiest way to get the full mango flavor experience without the mess.  The quality is consistent - you don't get the odd funny-tasting piece like you do with other dried fruits.        This is a terrific snack.  The chewiness makes each bite last, and the flavor just keeps coming.  You can easily make a single serving size last 5 minutes, and there aren't many snack foods that can match that!

product_title: Lundberg Organic Sushi Rice
review_body: This rice blend is wonderful.  It is very hearty, but the taste is fairly delicate and complex.  My husband who does not like brown rice, was really taken with this rice.  I have served it plain as a side dish to meat or fish, and also it makes a really lovely foundation for stir fried vegetables.  We're looking forward to trying Lundberg's other brown rice blends.

product_title: Vifon Pork Rib, Instant Noodle, 2.9-Ounce Bowls (Pack of 24)
review_body: Vifon is definitely my new brand of instant lunch.     The noodles in this one are the same kind as what you'd find in a Nong Shim cup or something like that. The missing star in this case is for that reason, I'm not a big fan of the typical instant noodle. If you are, though, I'd pounce on these.     What sets the vifon product apart is the broth. It's rich and sweet (my coworker smelled ginger, but I'm not so sure), and the included packets of veggies and flavorful oil really improve the taste. These really do taste like pork.     I'd recommend you have some Sriracha Chili sauce on hand if you're used to Nong Shim (nuclear spicy), because these aren't hot by defualt.

product_title: Peeled Snacks Fruit & Nuts, FigSated, 2.6-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Health, well being and finally... TASTE!
review_body:
Here's the deal with Peeled Snacks, which are simply the best, tastiest portable snack food one could hope to find. Along about 3 o'clock when your hunger starts \\"pokin at you, pokin at you...\\" you have a billion choices... and if you want to eat something that's not junk, you have merely a million choices... the problem with the healthy snacks is that they, more often than not, taste like cardboard (every health bar out there - i dare you to find me a good tasting one) or something that you could eat 15 tons of and still feel hungry (every rice/soy crisp out there)...

And FURTHERMORE.. all the other fruit/nut things out there are sugary sweet. This has unique fruit that tastes great (Pears, big cherries, figs, dates)... It's not just raisins and cashews...

Anyway, buy some. Try all three - my favorite is the red one - the bing bing cherry.

product_title: Blue Crab Bay Co. Sea Salt Nuts, 12-Ounces (Pack of 4)
review_body: I bought some of this company's Sea Salt Nuts and they are absolutely to die for.  I nearly ate the whole can myself.  I buy them all the time now for parties, they are fantastic, very large peanuts.  Good product.

product_title: Ener-G Foods Yeast-Free Pizza Shell, 6 inches, 12.7-Ounce Packages (Pack of 5)
review_body: Extremely hard-not our favorite.  We have always been pleased with Ener-G foods, but this was a bitter disappointment.

product_title: Peppermint Liquid Soad - Gallon
review_body:
I agree, lose the label....but, aside from that...5 stars, hands down!

We have been using Dr. Bonner soap for years....not only the liquid, but also the Dr. Bonner Castile soap that I recently found!! I love all of Dr. Bonner's soaps. The peppermint is our personal favorite because of the \\"tic tac in your mouth and get a bang out of life\\" feeling it gives your entire body. I have no problem using it from head to toe - it feels good all over - tingly, invigorating, and very refreshing. It lathers nicely and smells heavenly.

I have never seen the gallon bottles - so I will definitely start purchasing from amazon! I keep soap dispensers at all the sinks and in the showers/tubs - and I keep them filled with Dr. B.

I sometimes like to use bar soap - and that was why I was so excited to find Dr. Bonner's Castile soap! The packaging is just as it was over 50 years ago, when my grandparents used it!

I have Multiple Chemical Sensitivities and cannot use anything fragranced - this is the perfect solution for me, my family, our home and the planet.

I think you will be very pleased with this product.

product_title: Crown Prince Kipper Snacks, 3.25-Ounce Packages (Pack of 24)
review_body: Enjoy these tasty, lightly smoked fish fillets on a Salad Nicoises, in a sandwich, or straight out of the easy-open tin with a little red wine vinegar, Worcestershire  sauce, Herb de Provence, and extra virgin olive oil.  Their mild flavor and boneless succulence make them a welcome source of Omega 3.

product_title: Celestial Seasonings Tea
review_body: I can drink this tea all day, every day. Doesn't need sweetening. Best herb tea I've found!

product_title: Stretch Island Fruit Leather, 0.5 Ounce (30 Pack)
review_body: We've been buying all flavors of Stretch Island's fruit leathers for years - strawberry is one of our favorites. These are delicious. The kids love them. And no added sugars or other ingredients. Just pure fruit in a convenient way to take it along. My diaper bag and purse always have a few in them for the kids - and me - to snack on. But I do prefer their organic ones.

product_title: Honeyville Farms Blanched Almond Meal Flour, 5 lb
review_body:
Our son is on a gluten free diet and Almond Flour is a daily staple.
Pancakes,muffins,\\"breading\\" for chicken & shrimp. Well worth every penny.
I like how finely ground this one is.

product_title: Mini Marshmallows
review_body: I have a custom designed chocolate greeting business and I use the mini marshmallows for a few of my custom chocolate covered pretzel rods and they are an excellent addition to my product line.

product_title: India Tree Dark Muscovado Sugar, 2.8-Pound Jars (Pack of 2)
review_body: I discovered this India Tree dark Muscovado sugar on a trip to D.C. a couple of years ago and became hooked.  Unfortunately, the few pounds that I bought soon disappeared and I searched everywhere for more Muscovado.  Nothing I tried compared to the India Tree sugar.  We live in rural Wyoming, where gourmet food stores are fairly non-existant.  Finally, I did a Google search, found India Tree Dark on Amazon and now I get my fix 5.5 lbs. at a time.  This is the best sugar you will ever taste - hints of caramel and spices, slightly salty undertones, uneven and lumpy texture with delicious dark chunks heavy with molasses.  Excellent with gourmet coffee, over fruit, etc.  I brew beer as well, and this sugar is my \\"secret ingredient\\".

product_title: Wonka Heartbreakers (4 lbs.)
review_body: In the tradition of their famous Gobstoppers - layered flavor jaw breakers, are these small, heart-shaped \\"heartbreakers\\" that you can bite in half without breaking your jaw - although you should have healthy teeth before attempting to do so. I usually pick out the purple and pink ones for myself (I'm so selfish) and distribute the rest during Valentine's Day.  They can be \\"disposed of\\" quickly, unlike a Gobstopper that must be sucked on for about 10 minutes before it's safe to gobble up.

product_title: Lipton Iced Tea Mix
review_body: My family & I have tried all the various flavors out there and this one is by far the best! We all love it!!! Additionally, you can rarely find this particular flavor at your local grocery so buy it here.

product_title: The Gluten-Free Pantry Quick Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I found this mix in the usual places - Wild Oats, Whole Foods, etc - and really liked it and then suddenly my semi-local WO stopped carrying the company's products.  Luckily I found it on Amazon.  The biscuits that this mix makes are really good - all that required butter doesn't hurt, you know - even my husband and daughter (the gluten eaters in the family) seem to enjoy them, too.

product_title: My Family Farm Arctic Bear Cookies, Iced Lemon, 6-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_body: I love these cookies too!  They're crunchy animal cookies with a lemony coating that doesn't feel waxy in your mouth.  The lemon taste is great and they're not too sweet.  They're a perfect afternoon snack when you want a sweet treat but don't want to overdo it with calories or sugar.  The box is a little skimpy on the number of cookies you get, but the taste is worth it.

product_title: Doctor Kracker Snackers, Klassic 3 Seed, 8-Ounce Packages (Pack of 5)
review_headline: Healthy but a little too dry
review_body: I like the crunchiness but found these to be too dry or lacking in some other flavor

product_title: Horizon Organic Low Fat Organic Milk Box Plus DHA Omega-3
review_body: put them in your kids lunch boxes - a great alternative to juice boxes.  they have a long shelf live too!

product_title: Nutrition Bar, Chocolate Brownie, 2.4 oz., package of 12
review_body: We received the products well packaged and quickly. However I ordered Mint-chocolate and received chocolate brownie. Also one box had an expiration lasting several months and another box had an expiration of only 3 weeks.

product_title: Nestle's Quality Street 17oz Assortment
review_body: These are great chocolates and a fun assortment. There is something for everyone in the box. Quality at  a reasonable price.

product_title: Traverse Bay Fruit Co. Dried Cranberries, 4-Pound Box
review_body: Very happy with these; keep them in the fridge to add to granola and yogurt.  Helps to get enough fruit in diet without having to worry about rotting and throwing away fruit, or being forced to eat it because it will waste.  Good practical diet option, and I like having more options.

product_title: Manischewitz Mandlen for Soup, 1 Ounce Canister (Pack of 12)
review_body: All I can say is that Manischewitz should sell this product all year round.. I would buy a dozen boxes each time I go food shopping.. we just love them even as a snack .. especially my grandchildren!!! please can someone tell me where I can get some of these now.. I am also a Diabetic and these are great snacks for me too... thanks so much . Linda S.

product_title: Christmas Blend - Starbucks Christmas Blend Half Pound Whole Bean Coffee
review_body:
This coffee is by far superior to every other single coffee in the entire universe--provided that you have good taste, of course.

2006's Christmas Blend is the best of their run for many years.

The characteristically bold coffee draws you in with its earty tones, strong, yet refined character, mild acidity and aroma that nearly makes you burn your nose...

Starbucks Christmas Blend is a sophisticated coffee. It is not for the faint of heart. The Foldger converts shouldn't come running. It is very bold and has a forceful presence on the palate. Yet the woody, spicy earthy tones of the coffee are not overpowering. To the experienced coffee drinker, they're actually mellow. Much more mellow, in fact, than any African or Arabian coffee.

If you're a coffee connoisseur, who enjoys a bold brew, full of flavour, sans the acidity and bite, you can't go wrong with Starbucks Christmas Blend.

product_title: TWIZZLER RAINBOW TWIST 18/PKS
review_headline: like chewing on colored rubber bands
review_body:
I've been a Twizzler fan for ages. I love the fake licorice Strawberry whips that are dietary garbage but happiness for the mouth.

This was one of those impulse buys when I had a magazine and some other items and saw these new Rainbow Twists at the checkout. I knew from experience that 'fake' Twizzlers are horrible - but these were actually Twizzler brand and I trusted that they would be good.

When you open the bag, you're overwhelmed by the smell of fresh fruit. You'd think the taste would match the smell. There, you'd be wrong.

These have close to no flavor whatsoever. It's like chewing on old rubberbands. Yuck. If you like Twizzlers, stick with the original. These are an utter failure.

product_title: OrgraN Spaghetti in Tomato Sauce, 7.7-Ounce Cans (Pack of 12)
review_body: I was very excited about this spagetti, but unfortunately, it was awful! The consistancy was mush, and my daughter wouldn't even eat it. It is a bummer, when you have a case of it!

product_title: Stash Premium Christmas Eve Herbal Tea, Tea Bags, 18-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: Christmas Eve tea (which does not actually contain tea) is not just for Christmas Eve. (Although if you are frazzled, it does releave the stress.) Christmas Eve is good any time. I do not know anyone who doesn't like it, and have often given it as gifts. It is especially nice in the winter when mint teas are a little too brisk and do not produce the same level of cozy comfort as Christmas Eve which is a soothing combination of spices and mint. It is almost as comforting as a cup of warm milk, but without the calories.

product_title: Post Grape-Nuts O's Cereal, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)
review_body: I agree!!!  They don't sell them in Mobile, AL either.  Whats up with that???  I can't be the only person that knows this is the greatest all-time cereal.  Crunchy and good for you too!  Please tell the people at Post to not stop making this cereal.  Is it popular anywhere???  Is it in stores anywhere anymore?

product_title: Molasses, Blackstrap, Unsulfured, 31 oz.
review_body: this is the best molasses i have ever tried. it is flavorful without being biting or bitter. Smooth on the tongue. Wonderful in BBQ sauces, and on biscuits!

product_title: Tuscan Dairy Whole Vitamin D Milk, Gallon, 128 oz
review_body:
Frank was a quiet man, a strange man. His neighbours would give him a polite wave as they passed when caught peering in through his window across the overgrown lawn and the local children would dare one another to go and ring his doorbell. No one would ever answer as Frank spent his time in the garage, slaving over his one passion- a revolutionary new fuel.

It was the passion of his father, and his father before him, and each in the line had spent their lives dedicated to the cause. Frank has not fallen far from the tree, cursed to live the same lonely existence.

Or so all would believe.

It was a balmy summers evening, when, after not sleeping for 4 days, Frank stumbled down to his local convenience store, and while in a tired stupor flung his arm to the spot where his normal brand of whisky was and purchased what he believed to be another bottle of his old pal jack to keep him company through the long nights and unforgiving mornings.

Upon returning to garage, he sat down on his small, rotting, 3 legged stool in front of his prototype engine, reached behind him fumbling across the many oil stained tools on work bench, to find his filthy glass. He poured a drink, and to his shock he saw not the usual brown nectar he was expecting but rich creamy white Tuscan milk. He stared at the glass, his eyes filling with tears and his face with rage. He hurled the glass at the monstrous creation which lay in front of him and hung his face in his hands while sobbing. The milk had hit the engine, and trickled down in to the opening for the fuel tank. The engine juddered. A single chug. Frank looked up as it chugged once more and then sank back in to silence. He wiped his eyes and surveyed the sight before him, when he noticed the milk. He picked up the bottle from the floor, and added a little more. The engine chugged a little more, starting to build to a rhythm, as he added more and more the engine shook and burstin to life. It was the missing ingredient, and made the fuel so potent, he didn't even have to start the engine.

Frank added the remainder of the milk and threw open the garage door, and sat upon the makeshift tractor like vehicle he had built around the engine and rode it out in to the street, screaming with glee and shouting at his neighbours.

No one ever saw frank again.

product_title: Golden Temple Sweet Home Farm Low Fat Granola with Raisins, 20.5 Ounce Box (Pack of 4)
review_body: Just tried this granola today---it's really good! The packaging is also great; just like a milk carton. No broken bags or messes to deal with and really easy to pour. This granola has the perfect blend of grains and just the right amount of raisins.

product_title: Nature's Path Organic Cookies, Lemon Poppy, 9-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)
review_headline: Best pick of the Nature's Path brand; a perfect dollop of lemon flavoring
review_body: We encountered Nature's Path Lemon Poppy cookies at Whole Foods.  We enjoyed them so much, we ordered a box of 12 here through Amazon.  We've tried the brand's other flavor offerings, but the Lemon Poppy cookies are the standouts.  Don't be the dissuaded by the 'organic' tag (which often seems to be a code word for 'bland').  Nature's Path has done a great job here infusing its product with a perfect dollop of lemon flavoring.

product_title: Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal, 4.3-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 24)
review_body: I am a guy on the go. I need to be able to grab something with me to work to eat. This little box is exactly one meal, no more detail is required. In addition it tastes great and is good for you. Does not get any better than this.

product_title: Nestle Cerelac Mixed Vegetables 400g (Europe)
review_body: This stuff is not only healthy,but taste yummy too. my son loved it. It also arrived quickly and well packaged.

product_title: Pirate's Booty Chaos, 2-Ounce Bags (Pack of 24)
review_headline: It's like punk, except it's snack mix!
review_body:
One of those things I've never seen in a supermarket (okay, I wasn't exactly looking), but since I like gorging on junk food while watching Kiefer Sutherland torture people on \\"24,\\" I just had to have some. I got a large box filled with 2-serving bags of Robert's Ameerican Gourmet's latest creation, which is their take on snack mix. It's about fifty percent pretzels and fifty percent whatever they had lying around--i.e. random bits 'n' pieces of their other products. Hence, \\"Chaos.\\" Don't be fooled by the sandal-clad hippie cartoon on the bag, 'cause this is totally punk! Why? It's called \\"Chaos\\"! Hey, if any fresh scrubbed caffeine-addled mama's boys hopping around on \\"TRL\\" can be punk, why not snacks?

In case you were just dying to know, each 2-serving bag has 140 calories and 6 grams of fat (1 gram saturated) per serving. Now start munching!

(Review update for 5/2/06: I bought another shipment of Chaos and discovered the pretzels were almost gone. The mix is now made up of tortilla chips--both yellow and blue corn as well as nacho cheese--potato puffs, fried cheese curls, just a few pretzels and other random things I'm probably forgetting about. Chaos is still totally punk, however, and Kiefer Sutherland is still torturing terrorists and saving the world. Tasty!)

product_title: Terra Chips
review_body: I love these chips..They are really different from the regular chips, only better..the only drawback is ...the quantity per bag is a little small...they should sell a lot more of these in bigger bags!!! I absolutely love them!!!!!

product_title: Tazo Sweet Cinnamon Spice - 2-Pack
review_body: This tastes so good that even I, who grew up in the South, can drink it unsweetened.  It's a staple in our home.

product_title: Old Fashioned Hot Cinnamon Hard Candy Drops, Bulk, 16 oz
review_body: They were just hot, no cinnamon flavor at all. Very disappointed, I threw them away.

product_title: Nature's Path Gluten Free, Organic Corn Flakes
review_headline: Excellent dry cereal and organic as well.
review_body:
I enjoy Nature's Path brand products and used to eat the Heritage grains, which I enjoyed, until they ran out at my local store and I bought a bag of these Millet Rice Oatbran flakes which I like better.

Local cost is $8.50 a bag so the Amazon deal is much cheaper even if it is not on sale. On Sale it is 1/2 the price of the local stores.

Thank you.

product_title: Sun Crystals Natural Sweetener, 250-Count Box
